colloquial.mt: Lina: Għandi bżonn inġib il-passaport? Pawlu: Iva, huwa importanti ħafna. Mingħajru ma tistax tivvjaġġa magħna.
colloquial.en: Lina: Do I need to bring my passport? Pawlu: Yes, it's very important. Without it, you can't travel with us.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我需要带护照吗？保罗：需要，这很重要。没有护照，你就不能和我们一起旅行。

messages.speaker: Lina (旅客)
messages.zh: 我需要带护照吗？
messages.en: Do I need to bring my passport?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa importanti ħafna. Mingħajru ma tistax tivvjaġġa magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa importanti ħafna. Mingħajru ma tistax tivvjaġġa magħna.
messages.zh: 需要，这很重要。没有护照，你就不能和我们一起旅行。
messages.en: Yes, it's very important. Without it, you can't travel with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在旅行清单的护照旁画一颗星，再写 importanti：凡是影响结果、必须重视的事情，都能这样标记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not possible to do, happen, or achieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法做到、发生或实现的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax isir, iseħħ jew jintlaħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不可能的；无法做到或实现的。

formal.mt: Mingħajr aktar riżorsi, huwa impossibbli li l-proġett jitlesta sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: Without additional resources, it is impossible to complete the project by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 如果没有更多资源，这个项目就不可能在月底前完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu naslu hemm f'ħames minuti? Mark: Le, impossibbli! Il-post jinsab wisq 'il bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we get there in five minutes? Mark: No, impossible! The place is much too far away.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们能在五分钟内到那里吗？Mark：不可能！那个地方太远了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们能在五分钟内到那里吗？
messages.en: Can we get there in five minutes?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, impossibbli! Il-post jinsab wisq 'il bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Le, impossibbli! Il-post jinsab wisq 'il bogħod.
messages.zh: 不可能！那个地方太远了。
messages.en: No, impossible! The place is much too far away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 impossibbli 和“五分钟赶到很远的地方”这个画面绑定，记住它表示客观上不可能做到。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Required or enforced by an authority or another person rather than freely chosen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由当局或他人强制施加，而非自主选择的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie stabbilit jew infurzat minn awtorità jew minn persuna oħra, mingħajr għażla ħielsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被强加的；由他人或权力机构强制施加的。

formal.mt: Il-limitu impost mill-awtorità japplika għall-vetturi kollha li jidħlu fiż-żona.
formal.en: The limit imposed by the authority applies to all vehicles entering the zone.
formal.zh: 当局施加的限制适用于所有进入该区域的车辆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma nistgħux nibqgħu aktar? Pawlu: Hemm limitu ta' ħin impost mis-sid.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't we stay longer? Pawlu: There is a time limit imposed by the owner.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们为什么不能再待久一点？Pawlu：店主规定了时间限制。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能再待久一点？
messages.en: Why can't we stay longer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm limitu ta' ħin impost mis-sid.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm limitu ta' ħin impost mis-sid.
messages.zh: 店主规定了时间限制。
messages.en: There is a time limit imposed by the owner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门口贴着必须遵守的限时规定：impost 强调限制是别人施加的，不是自己选择的。

gloss_zh: 给……留下深刻印象；使赞叹

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone admire or remember a person or thing because of its qualities or achievements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人或事物的品质、能力或成就而使人赞赏，留下深刻印象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jammira jew jiftakar persuna jew ħaġa minħabba l-kwalitajiet jew il-kisbiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给人留下深刻印象；使人赞赏或赞叹。

collocations.zh: 给观众留下了深刻印象
给老师们留下了深刻印象

formal.mt: Il-kandidat impressjona lill-kumitat bi tweġibiet ċari u eżempji prattiċi.
formal.en: The candidate impressed the committee with clear answers and practical examples.
formal.zh: 这位候选人以清晰的回答和实际例子给委员会留下了深刻印象。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok il-kunċert? David: Iva, il-kantant impressjona lil kulħadd bil-vuċi tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you like the concert? David: Yes, the singer impressed everyone with his voice.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢这场音乐会吗？David：喜欢，那位歌手的嗓音让大家都很赞叹。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这场音乐会吗？
messages.en: Did you like the concert?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kantant impressjona lil kulħadd bil-vuċi tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kantant impressjona lil kulħadd bil-vuċi tiegħu.
messages.zh: 喜欢，那位歌手的嗓音让大家都很赞叹。
messages.en: Yes, the singer impressed everyone with his voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“歌手一开口，全场记住他”来记 impressjona：重点是某人或某物给别人留下深刻印象。

gloss_zh: 令人赞叹的；给人深刻印象的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing admiration or a strong impression because of quality, size, skill, or achievement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因品质、规模、技巧或成就而令人赞叹或留下深刻印象的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqanqal ammirazzjoni jew iħalli impressjoni qawwija minħabba l-kwalità, id-daqs, il-ħila jew il-kisbiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人赞叹的；给人留下深刻印象的。
令人赞叹的；因出色的表现或显著的特点而让人印象深刻的。

formal.mt: It-tim kiseb riżultat impressjonanti minkejja ż-żmien limitat għat-tħejjija.
formal.en: The team achieved an impressive result despite the limited preparation time.
formal.zh: 尽管准备时间有限，团队仍取得了令人赞叹的成果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt it-tpinġija ta' Marija? Luqa: Iva, tassew impressjonanti! Id-dettalji huma sbieħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you seen Marija's drawing? Luqa: Yes, really impressive! The details are beautiful.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看过 Marija 的画吗？Luqa：看过，真让人赞叹！细节画得特别美。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你看过 Marija 的画吗？
messages.en: Have you seen Marija's drawing?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tassew impressjonanti! Id-dettalji huma sbieħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tassew impressjonanti! Id-dettalji huma sbieħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 看过，真让人赞叹！细节画得特别美。
messages.en: Yes, really impressive! The details are beautiful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到出色作品时说“真令人赞叹”：用 impressjonanti 描述作品本身给人的强烈感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An idea, feeling, or opinion formed about someone or something after an experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接触某人或经历某事后形成的看法、感觉或印象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idea, sensazzjoni jew opinjoni li tifforma dwar persuna jew ħaġa wara esperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印象；对某人或某事形成的感觉或看法。

formal.mt: L-ewwel laqgħa ħalliet impressjoni tajba fuq il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The first meeting left a good impression on the participants.
formal.zh: 第一次会议给参与者留下了好印象。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'kienet l-ewwel impressjoni tiegħek tal-post? Ben: Tajba ħafna; il-post kien nadif u n-nies kienu dħulin.
colloquial.en: Anna: What was your first impression of the place? Ben: Very good; the place was clean and the people were welcoming.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你对那个地方的第一印象怎么样？Ben：很好，地方干净，人们也很热情。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你对那个地方的第一印象怎么样？
messages.en: What was your first impression of the place?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajba ħafna; il-post kien nadif u n-nies kienu dħulin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajba ħafna; il-post kien nadif u n-nies kienu dħulin.
messages.zh: 很好，地方干净，人们也很热情。
messages.en: Very good; the place was clean and the people were welcoming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 impressjoni 想成见面后脑海里留下的画面；搭配 l-ewwel 就是最先形成的第一印象。

gloss_zh: 要紧；有关系；具有重要性

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be important or relevant to someone or to a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某种情况具有重要性或关联；要紧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun importanti jew rilevanti għal xi ħadd jew għal sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 要紧；具有重要性或意义。
有关系；对当前的人或情况具有重要性或关联。

formal.mt: F'din l-evalwazzjoni, jimpurta kemm hi ċara l-ispjegazzjoni.
formal.en: In this assessment, how clear the explanation is matters.
formal.zh: 在这项评估中，解释是否清晰很重要。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Skużani, wasalt ftit tard. Ġanni: Ma jimpurtax, għadna ma bdejniex.
colloquial.en: Marta: Sorry, I'm a little late. Ġanni: It doesn't matter; we haven't started yet.
colloquial.zh: Marta：抱歉，我来晚了一点。Ġanni：没关系，我们还没开始。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 抱歉，我来晚了一点。
messages.en: Sorry, I'm a little late.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 没关系，我们还没开始。
messages.en: It doesn't matter; we haven't started yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先整句记住 ma jimpurtax“没关系”，再把肯定用法和“这件事要紧、值得在乎”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaving badly or playfully disobeying rules, especially when describing a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为不乖或爱调皮、不守规矩的，尤其用来描述孩子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu ħażin jew ma jobdix ir-regoli, speċjalment meta jingħad għal tifel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淘气的；顽皮不听话的。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of mqareb
sense_translations.zh_definition: mqareb 在辅音后使用的形式，也可作为其另一基本形式；意为“淘气的、顽皮的”。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, tifel imqareb jaħbi l-ġugarelli ta' ħuh u mbagħad jitgħallem jitlob skuża.
formal.en: In the story, a naughty boy hides his brother's toys and then learns to apologize.
formal.zh: 故事中，一个淘气的男孩藏起了兄弟的玩具，随后学会了道歉。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn mar iż-żarbun tiegħi? Toni: Il-kelb ħadu taħt il-mejda. Kemm hu imqareb!
colloquial.en: Rita: Where has my shoe gone? Toni: The dog took it under the table. He's so naughty!
colloquial.zh: Rita：我的鞋跑哪儿去了？Toni：狗把它叼到桌子底下了。它真调皮！

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.zh: 我的鞋跑哪儿去了？
messages.en: Where has my shoe gone?

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb ħadu taħt il-mejda. Kemm hu imqareb!
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb ħadu taħt il-mejda. Kemm hu imqareb!
messages.zh: 狗把它叼到桌子底下了。它真调皮！
messages.en: The dog took it under the table. He's so naughty!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小狗把鞋叼走”的画面记 imqareb；同时把它与 mqareb 配对记忆，识别同义的形式变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lamp that produces light by burning oil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以燃烧油料产生光亮的灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lampa li tagħti d-dawl billi taħraq iż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油灯；以油作为燃料的照明器具。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of msiebaħ
sense_translations.zh_definition: msiebaħ 在辅音后使用的形式，也可作为其另一基本形式；此处表示“油灯”。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi imsiebaħ taż-żejt biex juri kif kienu jiddawlu d-djar.
formal.en: The museum displays oil lamps to show how homes used to be lit.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出油灯，展示过去家庭照明的方式。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'hemm f'dik il-kaxxa? Pietru: Hemm imsiebaħ taż-żejt li kienu tan-nannu.
colloquial.en: Marija: What's in that box? Pietru: There are oil lamps that belonged to Grandpa.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那个箱子里有什么？Pietru：里面有爷爷以前用过的油灯。

messages.speaker: Marija (姐姐)
messages.zh: 那个箱子里有什么？
messages.en: What's in that box?

messages.speaker: Pietru (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm imsiebaħ taż-żejt li kienu tan-nannu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm imsiebaħ taż-żejt li kienu tan-nannu.
messages.zh: 里面有爷爷以前用过的油灯。
messages.en: There are oil lamps that belonged to Grandpa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 imsiebaħ 和“油燃烧后照亮房间”的画面联系起来，再与 msiebaħ 配对记忆，熟悉两种形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grapes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用葡萄发酵酿成的酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika magħmula mill-għeneb iffermentat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄酒。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of nbid
sense_translations.zh_definition: nbid 在辅音之后使用的形式，也是其另一种基本形式。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi għażla ta' inbid aħmar u abjad.
formal.en: The menu includes a selection of red and white wine.
formal.zh: 菜单提供多种红葡萄酒和白葡萄酒。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tixtieq tazza inbid mal-ikel? Lara: Iva, ftit inbid abjad, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like a glass of wine with your meal? Lara: Yes, a little white wine, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：吃饭时想喝一杯葡萄酒吗？Lara：好，请给我一点白葡萄酒。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃饭时想喝一杯葡萄酒吗？
messages.en: Would you like a glass of wine with your meal?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit inbid abjad, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit inbid abjad, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好，请给我一点白葡萄酒。
messages.en: Yes, a little white wine, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把餐桌上的两杯酒作为记忆画面：红的是 inbid aħmar，白的是 inbid abjad；共同的 inbid 就是葡萄酒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to act or exist without depending on or being controlled by others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够自主行动或存在，不依赖他人或不受他人控制的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jaġixxi jew jeżisti mingħajr ma jiddependi fuq ħaddieħor jew ikun taħt il-kontroll tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独立的；自主的；不依赖他人或不受他人控制的。
独立的；自主的；能够自行行动或作出决定的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab lil espert indipendenti biex jevalwa l-proposta.
formal.en: The committee asked an independent expert to evaluate the proposal.
formal.zh: 委员会请一位独立专家评估该提案。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Irrid inkun aktar indipendenti u nsajjar għalija nnifsi. Sara: Mela llum tista' tipprepara l-ikla int.
colloquial.en: Marta: I want to be more independent and cook for myself. Sara: Then you can prepare the meal today.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我想更独立一些，自己做饭。Sara：那今天这顿饭就由你来准备吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid inkun aktar indipendenti u nsajjar għalija nnifsi.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid inkun aktar indipendenti u nsajjar għalija nnifsi.
messages.zh: 我想更独立一些，自己做饭。
messages.en: I want to be more independent and cook for myself.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela llum tista' tipprepara l-ikla int.
messages.mt_standard: Mela llum tista' tipprepara l-ikla int.
messages.zh: 那今天这顿饭就由你来准备吧。
messages.en: Then you can prepare the meal today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人自己做饭、自己决定生活安排，用整句 Irrid inkun indipendenti 记住“我想独立”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show or make something known, or to point out a place, person, or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过信息或动作表明某事，或指出某个地点、人物或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri jew jagħmel xi ħaġa magħrufa, jew juri fejn jinsab post, persuna jew oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表明；显示；通过信息、迹象或动作使某事明确。
指；指向；用手指或其他方式示意方向或对象。
指出；指示；表明。

formal.mt: Il-mappa tindika l-post eżatt tad-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The map indicates the exact location of the main entrance.
formal.zh: 地图标明了主入口的确切位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tindikali fejn hi l-waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja? Toni: Iva, ara hemm; dak is-sinjal jindika l-waqfa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you point out where the bus stop is? Toni: Yes, look over there; that sign indicates the stop.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你能指给我看公交车站在哪里吗？Toni：可以，看那边；那个标志标示的就是车站。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tindikali fejn hi l-waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tindikali fejn hi l-waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja?
messages.zh: 你能指给我看公交车站在哪里吗？
messages.en: Can you point out where the bus stop is?

messages.speaker: Toni (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara hemm; dak is-sinjal jindika l-waqfa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara hemm; dak is-sinjal jindika l-waqfa.
messages.zh: 可以，看那边；那个标志标示的就是车站。
messages.en: Yes, look over there; that sign indicates the stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指、地图和路牌都在把信息指给你看；用这个共同动作记住 indika 的“指出、指示、表明”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sign or piece of information that shows or suggests something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够显示或提示某种情况的迹象、信号或信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sinjal jew biċċa informazzjoni li turi jew tissuġġerixxi xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迹象；指示；显示或提示某种情况的信息或信号。

formal.mt: Iż-żieda fin-numru ta' applikazzjonijiet hija indikazzjoni ta' interess akbar fil-kors.
formal.en: The increase in the number of applications is an indication of greater interest in the course.
formal.zh: 申请人数的增加表明，人们对这门课程的兴趣有所提高。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm xi indikazzjoni li l-ħanut se jiftaħ illum? Mark: Iva, hemm nota fuq il-bieb li tgħid li jiftaħ fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there any indication that the shop will open today? Mark: Yes, there is a note on the door saying it opens at nine.
colloquial.zh: Lara：有什么信息表明这家店今天会开门吗？Mark：有，门上有张便条，写着九点开门。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi indikazzjoni li l-ħanut se jiftaħ illum?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi indikazzjoni li l-ħanut se jiftaħ illum?
messages.zh: 有什么信息表明这家店今天会开门吗？
messages.en: Is there any indication that the shop will open today?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm nota fuq il-bieb li tgħid li jiftaħ fid-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm nota fuq il-bieb li tgħid li jiftaħ fid-disgħa.
messages.zh: 有，门上有张便条，写着九点开门。
messages.en: Yes, there is a note on the door saying it opens at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把门上的营业便条当作一条 indikazzjoni：它提供信息，让你判断店什么时候开门；重点记住“提示情况的迹象”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening or reaching something through another step or means, or expressed without stating the point directly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过其他环节或方式发生、传达或到达的；也指不直接说出意思的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir jew jasal permezz ta' pass jew mezz ieħor, jew li jesprimi ħsieb mingħajr ma jgħidu direttament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 间接的；通过其他环节或方式的；表达时不直说的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħmel riferiment indirett għall-problema mingħajr ma jsemmi l-persuni involuti.
formal.en: The report makes an indirect reference to the problem without naming the people involved.
formal.zh: 报告间接提及了这一问题，没有点名相关人员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan kien kumment indirett fuqi? Pawlu: Le, kont qed nitkellem b'mod ġenerali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was that an indirect comment about me? Pawlu: No, I was speaking in general.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你刚才那句话是在拐着弯说我吗？Pawlu：不是，我是在泛泛地说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你刚才那句话是在拐着弯说我吗？
messages.en: Was that an indirect comment about me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kont qed nitkellem b'mod ġenerali.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kont qed nitkellem b'mod ġenerali.
messages.zh: 不是，我是在泛泛地说。
messages.en: No, I was speaking in general.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象光先照到墙上再反射过来，或说话绕一层才表达意思；两种画面都能帮助记住 indirett 的“间接”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The details that identify where a person lives or where a place is located.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于说明某人住处或某个地点具体位置的信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dettalji li juru fejn tgħix persuna jew fejn jinsab post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地址；住址或某个地点的具体位置资料。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ikteb l-indirizz sħiħ tiegħek fuq il-formola.
formal.en: Please write your full address on the form.
formal.zh: 请在表格上填写您的完整地址。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-indirizz tiegħek? Mark: Triq il-Kbira, numru għaxra. Maja: Grazzi, niġi għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's your address? Mark: 10, Main Street. Maja: Thanks, I'll come tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的地址是什么？Mark：大街十号。Maja：谢谢，我明天过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的地址是什么？
messages.en: What's your address?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 大街十号。
messages.en: 10, Main Street.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我明天过来。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll come tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在信封上逐项填写街名和门牌号，把 indirizz 与完整地址联系起来。

gloss_zh: 向……讲话；在信件上写收件地址

teaching_sense.en_definition: To direct words to a person or group, or to write the recipient's address on a letter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某个人或群体讲话，或在信件上写明收件人的地址。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikellem persuna jew grupp, jew jikteb l-indirizz ta' min se jirċievi ittra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向……讲话；将话语传达给某个人或群体。
在信件上写明收件人的姓名和地址。
正式向某人讲话或致辞。

formal.mt: Id-direttur indirizza lill-impjegati waqt il-laqgħa annwali.
formal.en: The director addressed the employees during the annual meeting.
formal.zh: 主任在年度会议上向员工讲话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lil min indirizzajt l-ittra? Mark: Indirizzajtha lil Marija, fl-uffiċċju tagħha. Maja: Tajjeb, nibgħatha llum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who did you address the letter to? Mark: I addressed it to Marija at her office. Maja: Good, I'll send it today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你把信的收件人写成谁了？Mark：我写的是 Marija，地址是她的办公室。Maja：好，我今天寄出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你把信的收件人写成谁了？
messages.en: Who did you address the letter to?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我写的是 Marija，地址是她的办公室。
messages.en: I addressed it to Marija at her office.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我今天寄出去。
messages.en: Good, I'll send it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 indirizza：对着听众讲话，以及对着信封填写收件地址。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A list that helps locate information, or a numerical measure used to show a level or change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助查找信息的索引，或用于表示某种水平及其变化的指数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lista li tgħin biex issib informazzjoni, jew kejl numeriku li juri livell jew bidla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 索引；用于查找内容的条目表；也指表示某种水平或变化的指数。

formal.mt: L-indiċi fl-aħħar tal-ktieb jgħin lill-qarrej isib is-suġġetti u l-paġni rilevanti.
formal.en: The index at the end of the book helps the reader find the relevant topics and pages.
formal.zh: 书末的索引帮助读者查找相关主题及其所在页码。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nista' nsib il-paġna dwar l-għasafar? Mark: Ħares fl-indiċi taħt il-kelma għasafar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can I find the page about birds? Mark: Look in the index under the word birds.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我怎样才能找到介绍鸟类的那一页？Mark：去索引里查 għasafar，也就是“鸟类”这个词。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nsib il-paġna dwar l-għasafar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nsib il-paġna dwar l-għasafar?
messages.zh: 我怎样才能找到介绍鸟类的那一页？
messages.en: How can I find the page about birds?

messages.speaker: Mark (图书管理员)
messages.zh: 去索引里查 għasafar，也就是“鸟类”这个词。
messages.en: Look in the index under the word birds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indiċi 想成帮助定位的标记：书里定位内容叫索引，数据中标示水平和变化叫指数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Discomfort in the stomach or upper abdomen associated with difficulty digesting food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与食物消化不顺有关的胃部或上腹部不适。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skumdità fl-istonku jew fil-parti ta' fuq taż-żaqq marbuta ma' diffikultà fid-diġestjoni tal-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消化不良；与消化食物有关的胃部或上腹部不适。

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju, il-parteċipant irrapporta indiġestjoni wara l-ikla ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: In the questionnaire, the participant reported indigestion after the evening meal.
formal.zh: 参与者在问卷中报告说，自己晚饭后出现了消化不良。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kilt wisq u issa għandi indiġestjoni. Maja: Trid toqgħod bilqiegħda ftit?
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I ate too much and now I have indigestion. Maja: Would you like to sit down for a while?
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：我吃得太多，现在消化不良。Maja：你想坐一会儿吗？

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kilt wisq u issa għandi indiġestjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Kilt wisq u issa għandi indiġestjoni.
messages.zh: 我吃得太多，现在消化不良。
messages.en: I ate too much and now I have indigestion.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想坐一会儿吗？
messages.en: Would you like to sit down for a while?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用饭后肚子不舒服的画面记忆整句 Għandi indiġestjoni，意思是“我消化不良”，把长词放进实用句子里记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look after someone or something by providing care, watching over them, or supervising them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过提供照料、看护或监督来照顾某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu ħsieb persuna jew ħaġa billi jagħti l-kura meħtieġa, jgħasses jew jissorvelja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 照顾；为某人或某物提供所需的照料。
监督；照看并留意他人的活动或情况。
看护；守护并保护。
照料；照看并满足日常需要。
看守、守护或监督；持续留意以确保安全或秩序。

formal.mt: Il-persunal taċ-ċentru jindokra lill-anzjani u jgħinhom fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The centre's staff care for elderly people and help them in daily life.
formal.zh: 中心的工作人员照料老年人，并帮助他们处理日常生活事务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tindokra l-qattus tiegħi għada? Mark: Iva, nagħtih l-ikel u l-ilma. Maja: Grazzi, inħallilek iċ-ċavetta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you look after my cat tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I'll give him food and water. Maja: Thanks, I'll leave you the key.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明天能照看一下我的猫吗？Mark：可以，我会给它喂食和添水。Maja：谢谢，我会把钥匙留给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你明天能照看一下我的猫吗？
messages.en: Can you look after my cat tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 可以，我会给它喂食和添水。
messages.en: Yes, I'll give him food and water.

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我会把钥匙留给你。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll leave you the key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 indokra 记成照护者的一整天：喂饭、陪伴、留意安全，串起照料与看护。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become aware of something by noticing it or understanding that it is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过观察而注意到某事，或通过理解而意识到某个情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintebaħ b'xi ħaġa jew jifhem li xi ħaġa hija vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 注意到；察觉到某个事物或变化。
意识到；明白或认识到某个事实。
察觉到、意识到；开始注意或理解某个情况。

collocations.en: to realise that he has arrived late

formal.mt: Waqt il-verifika, l-uffiċjal induna li kien hemm żball fid-data.
formal.en: During the check, the official realised that there was an error in the date.
formal.zh: 核查时，工作人员发现日期有误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Indunajt li ħallejt it-telefon id-dar? Mark: Iva, indunajt meta wasalt hawn. Maja: Tista' tuża tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you realise you left your phone at home? Mark: Yes, I realised when I got here. Maja: You can use mine.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你发现自己把手机落在家里了吗？Mark：发现了，我到这里时才意识到。Maja：你可以用我的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你发现自己把手机落在家里了吗？
messages.en: Did you realise you left your phone at home?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 发现了，我到这里时才意识到。
messages.en: Yes, I realised when I got here.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你可以用我的。
messages.en: You can use mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象摸口袋后突然发现手机没带，把 induna 与脑中亮起的提醒灯联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Economic activity that produces goods, or a particular sector of businesses providing goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生产商品的工业活动，也指提供某类商品或服务的产业或行业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività ekonomika li tipproduċi oġġetti, jew settur ta' negozji li joffru prodotti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工业；产业；从事某类生产或服务活动的行业。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-ħtiġijiet tat-taħriġ fl-industrija tal-ikel.
formal.en: The report examines training needs in the food industry.
formal.zh: 这份报告研究食品行业的培训需求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema industrija taħdem? Mark: Naħdem fl-industrija tat-turiżmu, f'lukanda żgħira. Maja: U x'tagħmel hemm?
colloquial.en: Maja: Which industry do you work in? Mark: I work in the tourism industry, at a small hotel. Maja: And what do you do there?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在哪个行业工作？Mark：我从事旅游业，在一家小酒店工作。Maja：那你在那里做什么工作？

messages.speaker: Maja (新朋友)
messages.zh: 你在哪个行业工作？
messages.en: Which industry do you work in?

messages.speaker: Mark (新朋友)
messages.zh: 我从事旅游业，在一家小酒店工作。
messages.en: I work in the tourism industry, at a small hotel.

messages.speaker: Maja (新朋友)
messages.zh: 那你在那里做什么工作？
messages.en: And what do you do there?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 industrija 放在职业分类表的栏目上：食品业、旅游业，记住它是行业名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to industry, factories, or the production of goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与工业、工厂或商品生产有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-industrija, mal-fabbriki jew mal-produzzjoni tal-oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工业的；与工业生产或工厂有关的。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi titjib fit-toroq taż-żona industrijali.
formal.en: The plan includes improvements to the roads in the industrial area.
formal.zh: 该计划包括改善工业区内的道路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tinsab il-fabbrika l-ġdida? Mark: Fiż-żona industrijali, ħdejn il-garaxx. Maja: Tajjeb, naf fejn hi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the new factory? Mark: In the industrial area, next to the garage. Maja: Good, I know where it is.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新工厂在哪里？Mark：在工业区，汽车修理厂旁边。Maja：好，我知道在哪里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 新工厂在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the new factory?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 在工业区，汽车修理厂旁边。
messages.en: In the industrial area, next to the garage.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我知道在哪里了。
messages.en: Good, I know where it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给地图上的工厂区域贴上 industrijali 标签，用它修饰区域和生产活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hell as a place of punishment after death in religious belief; figuratively, a situation of extreme suffering or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教信仰中死后受惩罚的地狱；也可比喻极其痛苦或难熬的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post ta' kastig wara l-mewt fit-twemmin reliġjuż; b'mod figurattiv, sitwazzjoni ta' tbatija kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地狱；也用于比喻极其痛苦、混乱或难以忍受的处境。

formal.mt: Fil-poeżija, l-awtur jiddeskrivi l-infern bħala post ta' tbatija kbira.
formal.en: In the poem, the author describes hell as a place of great suffering.
formal.zh: 在这首诗中，作者将地狱描写成充满巨大痛苦的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-vjaġġ? Mark: Kien infern! Qattajna tliet sigħat fit-traffiku. Maja: Mela żgur għajjejt.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the journey? Mark: It was hell! We spent three hours in traffic. Maja: Then you must be tired.
colloquial.zh: Maja：路上怎么样？Mark：简直像地狱一样！我们堵了三个小时。Maja：那你肯定累了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 路上怎么样？
messages.en: How was the journey?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien infern! Qattajna tliet sigħat fit-traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Kien infern! Qattajna tliet sigħat fit-traffiku.
messages.zh: 简直像地狱一样！我们堵了三个小时。
messages.en: It was hell! We spent three hours in traffic.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那你肯定累了。
messages.en: Then you must be tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infern 配上地狱烈火的画面，再联想到堵车时夸张地说难熬得像地狱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which harmful microorganisms enter and multiply in the body or a part of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有害微生物进入身体或身体某个部位并繁殖所形成的感染状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha mikroorganiżmi li jagħmlu l-ħsara jidħlu fil-ġisem jew f'parti minnu u jimmultiplikaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感染；病原微生物侵入身体或局部组织并繁殖的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-pazjent għandu infezzjoni fil-widna.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the patient has an ear infection.
formal.zh: 医疗报告显示，该患者有耳部感染。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma mortx għax-xogħol illum? Mark: Għandi infezzjoni fil-widna, u mort għand it-tabib. Maja: Nispera li tfiq malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you go to work today? Mark: I have an ear infection, and I went to the doctor. Maja: I hope you get well soon.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天为什么没去上班？Mark：我耳部感染了，去看了医生。Maja：希望你早日康复。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你今天为什么没去上班？
messages.en: Why didn't you go to work today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi infezzjoni fil-widna, u mort għand it-tabib.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi infezzjoni fil-widna, u mort għand it-tabib.
messages.zh: 我耳部感染了，去看了医生。
messages.en: I have an ear infection, and I went to the doctor.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 希望你早日康复。
messages.en: I hope you get well soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 infezzjoni 写在身体示意图旁，再标出耳朵等部位，练习表达哪里发生感染。

gloss_zh: 无限的；无穷的；不定式的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having no end or limit; in grammar, describing the infinitive form of a verb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有尽头或限制的；在语法中也指动词不定式的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma għandux tmiem jew limitu; fil-grammatika, li jirreferi għall-forma infinitiva ta' verb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无限的；无穷的。
无限的；不受限制的。
不定式的；属于动词不定式形式的。

collocations.zh: 无穷大的数；无限的数量

formal.mt: Fil-matematika, nitkellmu dwar numru infinit ta' punti fuq linja.
formal.en: In mathematics, we speak of an infinite number of points on a line.
formal.zh: 在数学中，我们说一条直线上有无穷多个点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ħin infinit biex tagħmel dan? | Mark: Le, irrid inlestih sal-lejla!
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have unlimited time to do this? | Mark: No, I have to finish it by this evening!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你做这件事有无限的时间吗？ | Mark：没有，我今晚之前就得完成！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ħin infinit biex tagħmel dan?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ħin infinit biex tagħmel dan?
messages.zh: 你做这件事有无限的时间吗？
messages.en: Do you have unlimited time to do this?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，我今晚之前就得完成！
messages.en: No, I have to finish it by this evening!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条永远画不到头的线，把 infinit 和“无限”联系起来；遇到语法语境，再切换到“不定式的”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Facts or details that help someone understand a subject or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助人了解某个主题或情况的事实、信息或资料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħrif jew dettalji li jgħinu lil xi ħadd jifhem suġġett jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信息；资料；有关某事的情况或知识。
询问；查询；为了解情况而进行的查问。

collocations.zh: 索取资料；请求提供信息

formal.mt: Għal aktar informazzjoni dwar il-kors, jekk jogħġbok ikkuntattja lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: For more information about the course, please contact the office.
formal.zh: 如需了解更多课程信息，请联系办公室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek xi informazzjoni dwar il-kors? | Pawlu: Iva, jibda t-Tnejn u l-lezzjonijiet ikunu filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have any information about the course? | Pawlu: Yes, it starts on Monday and the lessons are in the evening.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你有关于这门课程的信息吗？ | Pawlu：有，课程周一开始，晚上上课。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你有关于这门课程的信息吗？
messages.en: Do you have any information about the course?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jibda t-Tnejn u l-lezzjonijiet ikunu filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jibda t-Tnejn u l-lezzjonijiet ikunu filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 有，课程周一开始，晚上上课。
messages.en: Yes, it starts on Monday and the lessons are in the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 informazzjoni 放进“课程几点开始”的查询场景：你询问情况，得到的时间、地点等资料就是 informazzjoni。

gloss_zh: 英格兰人；英语；英格兰的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person from England; also, the English language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自英格兰的人；也指英语这门语言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mill-Ingilterra; ukoll, il-lingwa Ingliża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英格兰人。
英语。
英格兰的；英语的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to England
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自英格兰的；与英格兰有关的。
英格兰的；属于英格兰或与英格兰有关的。
英格兰男子；男性英格兰人。
英语这门语言。

formal.mt: L-istudenti jistudjaw l-Ingliż u jaqraw xogħlijiet ta' kittieb Ingliż.
formal.en: The students study English and read works by an English writer.
formal.zh: 学生们学习英语，并阅读一位英格兰作家的作品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tom huwa Ingliż? | Maja: Iva, ġej minn Londra, u nitkellmu bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is Tom an Englishman? | Maja: Yes, he comes from London, and we speak English together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Tom 是英格兰人吗？ | Maja：是的，他来自伦敦，我们用英语交谈。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Tom 是英格兰人吗？
messages.en: Is Tom an Englishman?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej minn Londra, u nitkellmu bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej minn Londra, u nitkellmu bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 是的，他来自伦敦，我们用英语交谈。
messages.en: Yes, he comes from London, and we speak English together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“人、语言、修饰语”三个位置记忆：Tom huwa Ingliż 说人，bl-Ingliż 说语言，kittieb Ingliż 修饰作家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of fabric worn around the neck and tied at the front, usually with a shirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在颈部并在前面打结、通常搭配衬衫佩戴的领带或领巾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tintlibes madwar l-għonq u tintrabat fuq quddiem, ġeneralment ma' qmis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 领带。
领带；系在颈部的领巾。

formal.mt: Għal-laqgħa uffiċjali, huwa libes qmis bajda u ingravata blu.
formal.en: For the official meeting, he wore a white shirt and a blue tie.
formal.zh: 参加正式会议时，他穿了一件白衬衫，戴了一条蓝领带。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema ingravata taqbel ma' din il-qmis? | Sara: Il-blu taqbel sew. Ilbisha!
colloquial.en: Mark: Which tie goes with this shirt? | Sara: The blue one goes well. Wear it!
colloquial.zh: Mark：哪条领带配这件衬衫？ | Sara：蓝色那条很配，就戴它吧！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ingravata taqbel ma' din il-qmis?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ingravata taqbel ma' din il-qmis?
messages.zh: 哪条领带配这件衬衫？
messages.en: Which tie goes with this shirt?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 蓝色那条很配，就戴它吧！
messages.en: The blue one goes well. Wear it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前在镜子里挑选蓝领带，再练习“戴领带”和“打领带”两个动作，把 ingravata 和实物一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A restriction that prevents an action, including a legal injunction or an inner feeling that holds someone back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阻止某种行为的限制，可指法律上的禁令，也可指使人不敢行动或表达的心理抑制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Restrizzjoni li twaqqaf azzjoni, bħal projbizzjoni legali jew sensazzjoni li żżomm persuna lura milli taġixxi jew tesprimi ruħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁令；法院要求停止或不得进行某种行为的命令。
抑制；使人难以自在行动或表达的拘谨、顾虑。

collocations.zh: 禁止实施某种行为的法院禁令
毫无拘束地；没有心理顾虑地
克服拘谨；克服心理障碍

formal.mt: Il-qorti ħarġet mandat ta' inibizzjoni biex twaqqaf ix-xogħol fuq is-sit.
formal.en: The court issued a prohibitory injunction to stop work on the site.
formal.zh: 法院发出禁令，要求停止该场地上的施工。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tkantax magħna? | Sara: Inħoss inibizzjoni meta nkanta quddiem in-nies, imma se nipprova.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you sing with us? | Sara: I feel inhibited when I sing in front of people, but I'll try.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么不和我们一起唱？ | Sara：在人前唱歌我会觉得拘谨，不过我会试试。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不和我们一起唱？
messages.en: Why don't you sing with us?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħoss inibizzjoni meta nkanta quddiem in-nies, imma se nipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Inħoss inibizzjoni meta nkanta quddiem in-nies, imma se nipprova.
messages.zh: 在人前唱歌我会觉得拘谨，不过我会试试。
messages.en: I feel inhibited when I sing in front of people, but I'll try.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两道刹车”记忆：法院禁令像外部刹车，心理拘谨像内心刹车；这是区分两个义项的学习比喻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hard material from trees, especially when used for building or making objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 树木提供的坚硬材料，尤其指用于建筑或制作物品的木材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-materjal iebes mis-siġar, speċjalment meta jintuża għall-bini jew biex isiru oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木材；供建筑或加工使用的木料。
木头；木质材料。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa għażel injam b'saħħtu biex jagħmel il-mejda.
formal.en: The carpenter chose strong wood to make the table.
formal.zh: 木匠选用了坚固的木材来制作这张桌子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-mejda tal-injam? | Mark: Iva, u għamilha missieri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this table made of wood? | Mark: Yes, and my father made it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这张桌子是木头做的吗？ | Mark：是的，而且是我爸爸做的。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 这张桌子是木头做的吗？
messages.en: Is this table made of wood?

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 是的，而且是我爸爸做的。
messages.en: Yes, and my father made it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 摸一摸木桌，想象它从木料变成家具：材料叫 injam，“木制的桌子”说 mejda tal-injam。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collection of papers or documents kept together about a particular person, case, or subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集中保存的、涉及某个人、案件或主题的一组文件或档案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' karti jew dokumenti miżmuma flimkien dwar persuna, każ jew suġġett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一组文书；相关书面材料。
文件；记录有关事项的正式材料。
档案；集中整理保存的文件资料。
卷宗；围绕某个人或事项汇集的整套材料。

formal.mt: L-inkartament fih id-dokumenti kollha meħtieġa għall-eżami tal-każ.
formal.en: The file contains all the documents needed to examine the case.
formal.zh: 这份卷宗包含审查该案件所需的全部文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt l-inkartament tal-każ? | Pawlu: Fuq l-iskrivanija, ħdejn il-kompjuter.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the case file? | Pawlu: On the desk, next to the computer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你把案件卷宗放哪儿了？ | Pawlu：在书桌上，电脑旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你把案件卷宗放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the case file?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 在书桌上，电脑旁边。
messages.en: On the desk, next to the computer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把同一案件的表格、信件和报告装进一个文件夹；把整套材料作为一个整体，记作 inkartament。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Otherwise; used to introduce what will happen if an action is not taken or a condition is not met.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 否则；用来引出不采取某项行动或不满足某个条件时会出现的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi x'jiġri jekk ma ssirx azzjoni jew ma tintlaħaqx kundizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 否则；不然。
不然；否则。

collocations.en: Hurry up, otherwise you will arrive late.
Write everything down, otherwise you will forget.
collocations.zh: 把所有内容记下来，不然你会忘记。

formal.mt: Il-formola trid tasal sal-Ġimgħa, inkella l-applikazzjoni ma tiġix aċċettata.
formal.en: The form must arrive by Friday; otherwise, the application will not be accepted.
formal.zh: 表格必须在星期五之前送达，否则申请将不获受理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ejja nitilqu issa, inkella nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja. Mark: Sewwa, lest. Ejja mmorru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Let's leave now, otherwise we'll miss the bus. Mark: All right, I'm ready. Let's go.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们现在走吧，不然会赶不上公交车。马克：好，我准备好了。走吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nitilqu issa, inkella nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nitilqu issa, inkella nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 我们现在走吧，不然会赶不上公交车。
messages.en: Let's leave now, otherwise we'll miss the bus.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我准备好了。走吧。
messages.en: All right, I'm ready. Let's go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkella 放在提醒与后果之间来记：快出门，inkella 就赶不上车；它像连接“不这样做”与“后果”的小桥。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without making a sound, or in a quiet way intended to avoid being noticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不发出声响地，或为了不被注意而悄悄地进行某个动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla ma tagħmel ħoss, jew b'mod kwiet biex ħadd ma jinduna bik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无声地；不发出声响地。
悄悄地；偷偷地，尽量不引起注意。

formal.mt: L-istudent daħal inkiss fil-librerija biex ma jfixkilx lill-qarrejja.
formal.en: The student entered the library silently so as not to disturb the readers.
formal.zh: 那名学生悄无声息地走进图书馆，以免打扰读者。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dħalt inkiss? Pawlu: It-tarbija kienet rieqda u ma ridtx inqajjimha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you come in so quietly? Pawlu: The baby was asleep, and I didn't want to wake her.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么悄悄地进来？保罗：宝宝睡着了，我不想把她吵醒。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 你为什么悄悄地进来？
messages.en: Why did you come in so quietly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarbija kienet rieqda u ma ridtx inqajjimha.
messages.mt_standard: It-tarbija kienet rieqda u ma ridtx inqajjimha.
messages.zh: 宝宝睡着了，我不想把她吵醒。
messages.en: The baby was asleep, and I didn't want to wake her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 inkiss 时想象自己踮脚经过熟睡宝宝的房门：脚步没有声音，也尽量不让人察觉，便能同时记住“无声”和“悄悄”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Trouble or difficulty, or the worry and distress caused by a problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 麻烦、困难，或某个问题引起的担忧与苦恼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Problemi jew diffikultajiet, jew it-tħassib u n-niket li jġibu magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麻烦；困境；令人难以应付的问题。
苦恼；悲愁；不幸带来的痛苦。
担忧；忧虑。
忧虑；各种烦心事；麻烦。

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' informazzjoni dwar il-bidliet ħoloq ħafna inkwiet fost il-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The lack of information about the changes caused considerable worry among the workers.
formal.zh: 有关这些变动的信息不足，使员工产生了许多忧虑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi ħafna inkwiet dwar l-eżami ta' għada. Mark: Nistgħu nistudjaw flimkien illejla.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm very worried about tomorrow's exam. Mark: We can study together this evening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我很担心明天的考试。马克：我们今晚可以一起复习。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna inkwiet dwar l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna inkwiet dwar l-eżami ta' għada.
messages.zh: 我很担心明天的考试。
messages.en: I'm very worried about tomorrow's exam.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我们今晚可以一起复习。
messages.en: We can study together this evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inkwiet 记成一只装着烦心事的书包：包里的问题是“麻烦”，背在心里的重量是“忧虑”，两种意思用同一幅画面串起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel worried about something, or to cause someone to feel worried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某事感到担心，或使某人产生担忧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss tħassib dwar xi ħaġa, jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss tħassib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 担心；忧虑；也可指使人担心。
使某人担忧；让某人感到不安。
感到担忧；为某事忧虑。

formal.mt: Id-dewmien fit-tweġiba jinkwieta lill-applikanti li għandhom bżonn jippjanaw il-vjaġġ tagħhom.
formal.en: The delay in the response worries the applicants who need to plan their journey.
formal.zh: 回复迟迟未到，使需要安排旅程的申请人感到担忧。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tinkwieta? Pawlu: Għada għandi eżami u għadni ma studjajtx biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you worrying? Pawlu: I have an exam tomorrow, and I haven't studied enough yet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么这么担心？保罗：我明天有考试，可是还没复习够。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么担心？
messages.en: Why are you worrying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada għandi eżami u għadni ma studjajtx biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Għada għandi eżami u għadni ma studjajtx biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 我明天有考试，可是还没复习够。
messages.en: I have an exam tomorrow, and I haven't studied enough yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 inkwieta 时画两支箭头：人指向考试，表示“担心考试”；坏消息指向人，表示“使人担心”。用箭头方向区分两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The introduction of a new idea, method, or product, or a new development that improves how something is done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引入新想法、新方法或新产品的创新活动，也指改善做事方式的新成果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-introduzzjoni ta' idea, metodu jew prodott ġdid, jew żvilupp ġdid li jtejjeb il-mod kif issir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创新；革新；新引入的理念、方法或产品。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jinkoraġġixxi l-innovazzjoni billi jagħti lill-istudenti spazju biex jippruvaw ideat ġodda.
formal.en: The project encourages innovation by giving students space to try new ideas.
formal.zh: 该项目为学生提供尝试新想法的空间，以此鼓励创新。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din l-app tfakkarni meta rrid insaqqi l-pjanti. Mark: X'innovazzjoni utli! Jien dejjem ninsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: This app reminds me when I need to water the plants. Mark: What a useful innovation! I always forget.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个应用会提醒我什么时候该给植物浇水。马克：这项创新真有用！我总是忘记。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-app tfakkarni meta rrid insaqqi l-pjanti.
messages.mt_standard: Din l-app tfakkarni meta rrid insaqqi l-pjanti.
messages.zh: 这个应用会提醒我什么时候该给植物浇水。
messages.en: This app reminds me when I need to water the plants.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这项创新真有用！我总是忘记。
messages.en: What a useful innovation! I always forget.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 innovazzjoni 与英语 innovation 并排做识词卡，再画一盏解决实际问题的小灯泡：重点记住“新想法被用起来”的创新画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A song of praise or shared identity, such as a religious hymn or a national or political anthem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达赞颂或共同认同的歌曲，例如宗教赞美诗、国歌或政治颂歌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għanja ta' tifħir jew ta' identità komuni, bħal għanja reliġjuża jew l-għanja uffiċjali ta' pajjiż jew moviment politiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颂歌；代表国家、团体或共同事业的歌曲，语境中可指国歌。
赞美诗；通常用于宗教敬拜的颂歌。
宗教或政治颂歌；表达信仰、赞颂或政治认同的歌曲。

collocations.en: to sing a hymn or anthem

formal.mt: Iċ-ċerimonja bdiet bl-innu nazzjonali, u dawk kollha preżenti qamu bilwieqfa.
formal.en: The ceremony began with the national anthem, and everyone present stood up.
formal.zh: 典礼以国歌开始，全体在场者起立。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se jkanta l-kor fil-knisja llum? Pawlu: Se jkanta innu li tgħallimna l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: What will the choir sing in church today? Pawlu: It will sing a hymn we learned last week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：合唱团今天在教堂要唱什么？保罗：会唱一首我们上周学的赞美诗。

messages.speaker: Sara (合唱团成员)
messages.zh: 合唱团今天在教堂要唱什么？
messages.en: What will the choir sing in church today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (合唱团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jkanta innu li tgħallimna l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Se jkanta innu li tgħallimna l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 会唱一首我们上周学的赞美诗。
messages.en: It will sing a hymn we learned last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个合唱场景记 innu：典礼上大家起立唱国歌，教堂里合唱团唱赞美诗；共同点是以歌声表达赞颂或共同认同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dish of vegetables or other ingredients mixed together, often served cold with a dressing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由蔬菜或其他食材混合而成的菜肴，通常冷食，并可配沙拉汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt ta' ħaxix jew ingredjenti oħra mħallta flimkien, li spiss jittiekel kiesaħ ma' xi zalza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙拉；由蔬菜或其他食材拌成的菜肴。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, ir-ristorant joffri insalata tat-tadam biż-żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: For lunch, the restaurant offers a tomato salad with olive oil.
formal.zh: 午餐时段，餐厅供应配橄榄油的番茄沙拉。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq insalata mal-ħut, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Żgur. Trid insalata tat-tadam jew tal-patata?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a salad with the fish, please. Rita: Certainly. Would you like tomato salad or potato salad?
colloquial.zh: 马克：请给我的鱼配一份沙拉。丽塔：好的。您要番茄沙拉还是土豆沙拉？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我的鱼配一份沙拉。
messages.en: I'd like a salad with the fish, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Trid insalata tat-tadam jew tal-patata?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Trid insalata tat-tadam jew tal-patata?
messages.zh: 好的。您要番茄沙拉还是土豆沙拉？
messages.en: Certainly. Would you like tomato salad or potato salad?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 insalata 时想象菜单上的一大碗沙拉，再往里面分别放番茄和土豆；把词与整碗拌好的菜联系起来，也能记住沙拉不限于绿叶菜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small animal with six legs and a body divided into a head, thorax, and abdomen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种有六条腿、身体分为头部、胸部和腹部的小动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'sitt saqajn u b'ġisem maqsum f'ras, toraċi u addome.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 昆虫；具有六条腿，身体分为头、胸、腹三部分的动物。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw insett fuq werqa u għaddew is-sitt saqajn tiegħu.
formal.en: The students observed an insect on a leaf and counted its six legs.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一只叶片上的昆虫，并数了数它的六条腿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak fuq il-mejda? Mark: Huwa insett żgħir. Ejja niftħu t-tieqa biex joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that on the table? Mark: It's a small insect. Let's open the window so it can get out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上那个是什么？马克：是一只小昆虫。我们打开窗户，让它出去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa insett żgħir. Ejja niftħu t-tieqa biex joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa insett żgħir. Ejja niftħu t-tieqa biex joħroġ.
messages.zh: 是一只小昆虫。我们打开窗户，让它出去吧。
messages.en: It's a small insect. Let's open the window so it can get out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 insett 与英语 insect 并排记，再画一只六条腿的小昆虫；看到词就先数六条腿，用清楚的形象固定“昆虫”的意思。

gloss_zh: 无力偿债的；没有资本的；破产的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to pay debts, lacking capital, or bankrupt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容个人或企业无力偿还债务、缺乏资本或已经破产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax iħallas id-djun tiegħu, li m'għandux kapital jew li falla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无力偿还债务的
没有资本的；缺乏资本的
破产的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-kumpanija hija insolventi u ma tistax tħallas id-djun tagħha.
formal.en: The report indicates that the company is insolvent and cannot pay its debts.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该公司已无力偿债，无法偿还所欠债务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser kumpanija insolventi? Mark: Tfisser kumpanija li ma tistax tħallas id-djun tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does an insolvent company mean? Mark: It means a company that cannot pay its debts.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：无力偿债的公司是什么意思？马克：就是无法偿还自身债务的公司。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 无力偿债的公司是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an insolvent company mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser kumpanija li ma tistax tħallas id-djun tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser kumpanija li ma tistax tħallas id-djun tagħha.
messages.zh: 就是无法偿还自身债务的公司。
messages.en: It means a company that cannot pay its debts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公司面前堆满到期账单，却没有钱支付；用这个画面记住 insolventi 描述无力偿债的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being unable to pay debts; bankruptcy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指无法偿还债务的状态，也可指破产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min ma jistax iħallas id-djun tiegħu; falliment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无力偿债的状态
破产

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju juri li ż-żieda fid-djun tista' twassal għal insolvenza.
formal.en: The financial report shows that rising debts may lead to insolvency.
formal.zh: 财务报告显示，债务增加可能导致无力偿债。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi l-insolvenza? Pawlu: Hija s-sitwazzjoni meta persuna jew kumpanija ma tistax tħallas id-djun tagħha.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is insolvency? Paul: It is the situation in which a person or company cannot pay their debts.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：什么是无力偿债？保罗：就是个人或公司无法偿还自身债务的情况。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是无力偿债？
messages.en: What is insolvency?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija s-sitwazzjoni meta persuna jew kumpanija ma tistax tħallas id-djun tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hija s-sitwazzjoni meta persuna jew kumpanija ma tistax tħallas id-djun tagħha.
messages.zh: 就是个人或公司无法偿还自身债务的情况。
messages.en: It is the situation in which a person or company cannot pay their debts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 insolvenza 当作账单付不出来这一状态的名称；配合形容词 insolventi 一起记，区分状态名称与状态描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Impossible to solve or find a solution to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容问题、难题等无法得到解决或没有解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jissolva jew li ma teżistix soluzzjoni għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法解决的
无解的；不可解决的

formal.mt: L-ekwazzjoni hija insolvibbli għax ma jeżisti ebda numru li jissodisfa ż-żewġ kundizzjonijiet.
formal.en: The equation has no solution because no number satisfies both conditions.
formal.zh: 这个方程无解，因为没有任何数能同时满足这两个条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-problema tidher insolvibbli! David: Ejja naqraw il-kundizzjonijiet mill-ġdid qabel naqtgħu qalbna.
colloquial.en: Maya: This problem looks impossible to solve! David: Let's read the conditions again before we give up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道题看起来根本解不出来！戴维：我们先重新读一遍条件，再决定要不要放弃。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这道题看起来根本解不出来！
messages.en: This problem looks impossible to solve!

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw il-kundizzjonijiet mill-ġdid qabel naqtgħu qalbna.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw il-kundizzjonijiet mill-ġdid qabel naqtgħu qalbna.
messages.zh: 我们先重新读一遍条件，再决定要不要放弃。
messages.en: Let's read the conditions again before we give up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一道条件互相冲突的题，怎么计算都找不到答案；用这个无解画面记住 insolvibbli。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The property of having no solution; in a financial context, inability to pay debts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指问题没有解这一性质；在财务语境中，也可指无力偿还债务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proprjetà ta' problema li ma għandhiex soluzzjoni; f'kuntest finanzjarju, in-nuqqas ta' ħila li jitħallsu d-djun.

sense_translations.en_definition: the property of having no solution
sense_translations.zh_definition: 无解性；没有解这一性质
无力偿债的状态

formal.mt: L-istudju juri l-insolvibilità tal-problema taħt il-kundizzjonijiet mogħtija.
formal.en: The study demonstrates that the problem has no solution under the given conditions.
formal.zh: 该研究证明了这个问题在给定条件下的无解性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser l-insolvibilità ta' problema? Nina: Tfisser li l-problema ma għandhiex soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the unsolvability of a problem mean? Nina: It means that the problem has no solution.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：问题的无解性是什么意思？妮娜：意思就是这个问题没有解。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 问题的无解性是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the unsolvability of a problem mean?

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-problema ma għandhiex soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-problema ma għandhiex soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 意思就是这个问题没有解。
messages.en: It means that the problem has no solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 insolvibilità 准备两张语境卡：数学题配无解性，财务账本配无力偿债；看到上下文再选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning so-so when giving an evaluation; also used to introduce a summary meaning in short.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用作独立评价语，表示一般般、马马虎虎；也可用来引出总结，表示总之。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tista' tfisser hekk u hekk meta tagħti ġudizzju; tintuża wkoll biex tintroduċi taqsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一般般；马马虎虎
总之；简而言之

formal.mt: Insomma, ir-riżultati juru li l-proġett laħaq l-għanijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: In sum, the results show that the project achieved its objectives.
formal.zh: 总之，结果表明该项目达到了预定目标。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif kien il-film? Lara: Insomma. Kellu xi xeni sbieħ, imma kien twil wisq.
colloquial.en: Mark: How was the film? Lara: So-so. It had some nice scenes, but it was too long.
colloquial.zh: 马克：电影怎么样？拉拉：一般般。有些场景不错，但太长了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影怎么样？
messages.en: How was the film?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Insomma. Kellu xi xeni sbieħ, imma kien twil wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Insomma. Kellu xi xeni sbieħ, imma kien twil wisq.
messages.zh: 一般般。有些场景不错，但太长了。
messages.en: So-so. It had some nice scenes, but it was too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 insomma 放进两个场景记忆：评价电影时耸肩说一般般，结束报告时收拢要点说总之。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attract someone's interest, concern someone, or express having an interest in something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示引起某人的兴趣、与某人有关，或表示对某事感兴趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem interess f'xi ħadd, jolqot lil xi ħadd jew juri interess f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使感兴趣；引起兴趣
涉及；与……有关
引起……的兴趣；使产生兴趣

sense_translations.en_definition: to be interested; have an interest
sense_translations.zh_definition: 感兴趣；对某事有兴趣

formal.mt: Is-suġġett interessa lill-istudenti u ħeġġiġhom jagħmlu aktar riċerka.
formal.en: The topic interested the students and encouraged them to do more research.
formal.zh: 这个话题引起了学生们的兴趣，并鼓励他们开展更多研究。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-film interessak? Pawlu: Iva, interessani ħafna, speċjalment il-parti dwar il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did the film interest you? Paul: Yes, it interested me a lot, especially the part about the sea.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这部电影让你感兴趣吗？保罗：是的，我很感兴趣，尤其是关于海洋的那一部分。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影让你感兴趣吗？
messages.en: Did the film interest you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, interessani ħafna, speċjalment il-parti dwar il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, interessani ħafna, speċjalment il-parti dwar il-baħar.
messages.zh: 是的，我很感兴趣，尤其是关于海洋的那一部分。
messages.en: Yes, it interested me a lot, especially the part about the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用兴趣箭头记 interessa：话题指向学生表示引起兴趣；搭配 ruħu 时，记成某人自己对某事产生兴趣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving, relating to, or shared by two or more countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及两个或多个国家，或与多个国家之间的事务有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi żewġ pajjiżi jew aktar jew li għandu x'jaqsam mar-relazzjonijiet bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国际的；涉及多个国家的

formal.mt: Il-konferenza internazzjonali se tlaqqa' riċerkaturi minn diversi pajjiżi.
formal.en: The international conference will bring together researchers from several countries.
formal.zh: 这场国际会议将汇聚来自多个国家的研究人员。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan festival lokali? David: Le, huwa festival internazzjonali, b'artisti minn ħafna pajjiżi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a local festival? David: No, it is an international festival, with artists from many countries.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是本地的艺术节吗？戴维：不是，这是国际艺术节，有来自许多国家的艺术家。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是本地的艺术节吗？
messages.en: Is this a local festival?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa festival internazzjonali, b'artisti minn ħafna pajjiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa festival internazzjonali, b'artisti minn ħafna pajjiżi.
messages.zh: 不是，这是国际艺术节，有来自许多国家的艺术家。
messages.en: No, it is an international festival, with artists from many countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会场挂着多国国旗，把 internazzjonali 贴在会议、合作、机场这些名词旁，记住它表示国际的。

gloss_zh: 在国际上；在国际范围内

teaching_sense.en_definition: Across countries or at an international level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种活动、影响或认可发生在多个国家之间或国际范围内。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'diversi pajjiżi jew fuq livell internazzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在国际上；在国际范围内

formal.mt: L-istitut huwa rikonoxxut internazzjonalment għall-kontribut tiegħu fir-riċerka.
formal.en: The institute is internationally recognized for its contribution to research.
formal.zh: 该研究所因其科研贡献而得到国际认可。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kantant magħruf Malta biss? Mark: Le, huwa magħruf internazzjonalment u jagħti kunċerti f'ħafna pajjiżi.
colloquial.en: Maya: Is this singer known only in Malta? Mark: No, he is known internationally and gives concerts in many countries.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这位歌手只在马耳他出名吗？马克：不是，他在国际上也很知名，还在许多国家举办演唱会。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这位歌手只在马耳他出名吗？
messages.en: Is this singer known only in Malta?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa magħruf internazzjonalment u jagħti kunċerti f'ħafna pajjiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa magħruf internazzjonalment u jagħti kunċerti f'ħafna pajjiżi.
messages.zh: 不是，他在国际上也很知名，还在许多国家举办演唱会。
messages.en: No, he is known internationally and gives concerts in many countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象歌手的名声传到多个国家：internazzjonalment 回答在哪个范围内知名，记成在国际上，并与国际的形容词区分。

gloss_zh: 你（第二人称单数主语代词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The subject pronoun used when speaking directly to one person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接对一个人说话时使用的主语代词，表示“你”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pronom personali li jintuża bħala suġġett meta tkellem persuna waħda direttament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你。

sense_translations.en_definition: you (second-person singular subject pronoun) (generally distinguished as being feminine version of int)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 你（第二人称单数主语代词；通常被区分为 int 的女性形式）。

formal.mt: Bħala rappreżentanta tal-klassi, inti għandek tippreżenta l-proposti tal-istudenti.
formal.en: As the class representative, you should present the students' proposals.
formal.zh: 作为班级代表，你应当提出同学们的建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inti ġejja magħna għada? Sara: Iva, u inti se ġġib l-ikel?
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you coming with us tomorrow? Sara: Yes, and are you bringing the food?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天跟我们一起去吗？萨拉：去呀，那你会带吃的吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u inti se ġġib l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u inti se ġġib l-ikel?
messages.zh: 去呀，那你会带吃的吗？
messages.en: Yes, and are you bringing the food?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面对面指着对方说“你”：inti 指一个听话的人；把 inti wkoll 连成“你也一样”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An opening explanation that presents a topic, or the act of making someone or something known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始时用于介绍主题的说明或引言，也指把某人或某事介绍给别人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni tal-bidu li tippreżenta suġġett, jew l-att li tagħmel lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 介绍；引言；对主题的入门说明。

collocations.zh: 简短的介绍；简短的引言

formal.mt: L-introduzzjoni tar-rapport tispjega l-għanijiet tal-istudju u l-metodu użat.
formal.en: The introduction to the report explains the aims of the study and the method used.
formal.zh: 报告的引言说明了研究目标和所采用的方法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid taqra l-introduzzjoni qabel nibdew? Maja: Iva, hija qasira u tgħinna nifhmu s-suġġett.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to read the introduction before we start? Maja: Yes, it is short and helps us understand the topic.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：开始前，你想读一下引言吗？玛雅：想，它很短，也能帮助我们理解这个主题。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 开始前，你想读一下引言吗？
messages.en: Do you want to read the introduction before we start?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija qasira u tgħinna nifhmu s-suġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija qasira u tgħinna nifhmu s-suġġett.
messages.zh: 想，它很短，也能帮助我们理解这个主题。
messages.en: Yes, it is short and helps us understand the topic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 introduzzjoni 想成文章入口处的一段说明：先告诉你要谈什么，再带你进入正文，便能记住“引言、介绍”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a person, topic, or new idea known to others, or to bring something into use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某个人、话题或新想法介绍给别人，或把某事物引入使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel persuna, suġġett jew idea ġdida magħrufa lil oħrajn, jew idaħħal xi ħaġa fl-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 介绍；引入。
介绍某人或某事；引入某种事物或做法。

formal.mt: Il-kap tal-iskola introduċa sistema ġdida biex titjieb il-komunikazzjoni mal-ġenituri.
formal.en: The head of the school introduced a new system to improve communication with parents.
formal.zh: 校长引入了一套新系统，以改善与家长的沟通。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min introduċa lil Sara fil-grupp? Mark: Jien. Hi taħdem miegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who introduced Sara to the group? Mark: I did. She works with me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把萨拉介绍给这个小组的？马克：是我。她和我一起工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (小组成员)
messages.zh: 谁把萨拉介绍给这个小组的？
messages.en: Who introduced Sara to the group?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 是我。她和我一起工作。
messages.en: I did. She works with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把新面孔或新办法带到大家面前”的画面记 introduċa：介绍人物、引入系统都可以套用这个场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A new device, method, or idea that someone creates, or the act of creating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人创造出来的新装置、新方法或新想法，也指创造这些事物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat, metodu jew idea ġdida li xi ħadd joħloq, jew l-att li joħloqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发明；新创造的装置、方法或想法。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ppreżentaw invenzjoni li tnaqqas il-ħela tal-ilma fid-dar.
formal.en: The students presented an invention that reduces water waste in the home.
formal.zh: 学生们展示了一项能够减少家庭用水浪费的发明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'taħseb dwar l-invenzjoni tiegħi? Sara: Togħġobni! Kif taħdem?
colloquial.en: Mark: What do you think of my invention? Sara: I like it! How does it work?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得我的发明怎么样？萨拉：我喜欢！它是怎么工作的？

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 你觉得我的发明怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of my invention?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我喜欢！它是怎么工作的？
messages.en: I like it! How does it work?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同学举着自己设计的新装置说“这是我的发明”：把这个展示场景和 invenzjoni 绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 枕套（名词）；投资、投入；撞击、撞倒；正式授予权力（动词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fabric cover put over a pillow to protect it and keep it clean.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 套在枕头外面，用来保护枕头并保持清洁的布套。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata tad-drapp li titqiegħed fuq imħadda biex tipproteġiha u żżommha nadifa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枕套；套在枕头外面的布套。

sense_translations.en_definition: to invest (to spend money, time, or energy on something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 投资；把金钱、时间或精力投入某事。

sense_translations.en_definition: to collide, crash (into), run over (in a car, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 碰撞；撞上；用汽车等撞倒或碾过。

sense_translations.en_definition: to invest (to formally give power or authority to someone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式授予某人权力或职权。

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu jibdel l-investa u l-lożor qabel jasal il-mistieden li jmiss.
formal.en: Staff should change the pillowcase and the sheets before the next guest arrives.
formal.zh: 工作人员应在下一位客人到达前更换枕套和床单。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-investa nadifa? Omm: Fil-kexxun, ħdejn il-lożor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the clean pillowcase? Mum: In the drawer, next to the sheets.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：干净的枕套在哪里？妈妈：在抽屉里，床单旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 干净的枕套在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the clean pillowcase?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 在抽屉里，床单旁边。
messages.en: In the drawer, next to the sheets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“换床单也换枕套”的生活画面记名词 investa；再把动词义分别放进投资、交通碰撞和授职场景，按词性分开记。

gloss_zh: 投资；投入；撞击、撞倒事件

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money, time, or effort put into something with the aim of gaining a benefit, or the act of making that commitment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获得某种收益或好处而投入的金钱、时间或精力，也指进行这种投入的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus, ħin jew sforz li jitqiegħdu f'xi ħaġa bil-għan li jinkiseb benefiċċju, jew l-att ta' dan l-impenn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投资；为获得收益或好处而作出的投入。
撞击；碾过；撞倒，亦指这类事件。

formal.mt: L-investiment fl-edukazzjoni jista' jtejjeb il-ħiliet tal-ħaddiema u joħloq opportunitajiet ġodda.
formal.en: Investment in education can improve workers' skills and create new opportunities.
formal.zh: 教育投入可以提升劳动者的技能，并创造新的机会。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-kors jiswa ħafna. Sara: Veru, imma huwa investiment fil-futur tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: This course costs a lot. Sara: True, but it is an investment in your future.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这门课程很贵。萨拉：确实，不过这是对你未来的投资。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这门课程很贵。
messages.en: This course costs a lot.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, imma huwa investiment fil-futur tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, imma huwa investiment fil-futur tiegħek.
messages.zh: 确实，不过这是对你未来的投资。
messages.en: True, but it is an investment in your future.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 investiment 放进“今天投入，期待将来受益”的画面，记住投资义；遇到交通语境时，再单独识别撞击或撞倒义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unexpected event, especially an accident or an occurrence involving a problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意外发生的事情，尤其指事故或涉及问题的事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja mhux mistennija, speċjalment waħda li tinvolvi ħsara jew xi problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事故；造成损坏或伤害的意外。
事件；发生的一件事情，常指异常或引起关注的情况。

formal.mt: Il-pulizija ħejjiet rapport dwar l-inċident li seħħ ħdejn l-istazzjon.
formal.en: The police prepared a report on the incident that occurred near the station.
formal.zh: 警方就车站附近发生的事件编写了报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasalt tard? Pawlu: Kien hemm inċident tat-traffiku u l-karozzi tal-linja damu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you arrive late? Pawlu: There was a traffic accident and the buses were delayed.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么迟到了？Pawlu：发生了交通事故，公交车都晚点了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm inċident tat-traffiku u l-karozzi tal-linja damu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm inċident tat-traffiku u l-karozzi tal-linja damu.
messages.zh: 发生了交通事故，公交车都晚点了。
messages.en: There was a traffic accident and the buses were delayed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inċident 放进两个场景：道路碰撞是事故，报告记录的异常情况是事件；根据上下文选择中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To freeze or turn into ice; also, to feel extremely cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结冰或冻住；也可指感到非常寒冷，像要冻僵一样。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir silġ jew jiffriża; ukoll, iħoss kesħa kbira ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结冰；冻结；冻住。

sense_translations.en_definition: to freeze; to turn in to ice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 冻结；变成冰。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be or feel very cold; to be freezing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常冷；感到极冷；冷得像要冻僵一样。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, l-ilma fil-kontenitur inġazza minħabba t-temperatura baxxa.
formal.en: During the night, the water in the container froze because of the low temperature.
formal.zh: 夜间，由于温度低，容器里的水结冰了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-ilma fil-flixkun inġazza? | Mark: Iva, ħallejtu fil-friża għal żmien twil wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the water in the bottle freeze? | Mark: Yes, I left it in the freezer for too long.
colloquial.zh: Maja：瓶子里的水结冰了吗？ | Mark：是啊，我把它放在冷冻室里太久了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 瓶子里的水结冰了吗？
messages.en: Did the water in the bottle freeze?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħallejtu fil-friża għal żmien twil wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħallejtu fil-friża għal żmien twil wisq.
messages.zh: 是啊，我把它放在冷冻室里太久了。
messages.en: Yes, I left it in the freezer for too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象瓶里的水冻成冰，再想象人冷得直发抖；用这两个画面分别记住“结冰”和“感到极冷”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in an activity, event, or discussion with other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他人一起参加某项活动、事件或讨论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu sehem f'attività, avveniment jew diskussjoni ma' nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加；参与某项活动或讨论。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of pparteċipa
sense_translations.zh_definition: pparteċipa 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式，意为“参加、参与”。

formal.mt: Mark ipparteċipa f'diskussjoni dwar kif l-iskola tista' tnaqqas il-ħela tal-ikel.
formal.en: Mark participated in a discussion about how the school could reduce food waste.
formal.zh: 马克参与了一场讨论，探讨学校如何减少食物浪费。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark ipparteċipa fil-kompetizzjoni lbieraħ? Maja: Iva, u ħa gost ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark participate in the competition yesterday? Maja: Yes, and he really enjoyed it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克昨天参加比赛了吗？玛雅：参加了，而且他玩得很开心。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 马克昨天参加比赛了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark participate in the competition yesterday?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 参加了，而且他玩得很开心。
messages.en: Yes, and he really enjoyed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己走进讨论圈，主动说上一句：这就是“参与”。把 ipparteċipa f'diskussjoni 整块记成“参与了讨论”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass into or through a material, surface, or space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入某种材料、表面或空间的内部，或从中穿过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol ġewwa materjal jew spazju, jew jgħaddi minn ġo wiċċ jew saff.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿透；渗入；进入内部。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of ppenetra
sense_translations.zh_definition: ppenetra 的辅音后形式及另一基本形式，意为“穿透、渗入”。

formal.mt: Waqt it-test, il-likwidu ippenetra fis-saff ta' barra tal-materjal.
formal.en: During the test, the liquid penetrated the outer layer of the material.
formal.zh: 测试过程中，液体渗入了材料的外层。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif daħal dan it-trab fil-kaxxa? Sara: Ippenetra minn fetħa żgħira fl-għatu.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did this dust get into the box? Sara: It got in through a small opening in the lid.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些灰尘是怎么进到盒子里的？萨拉：从盖子上的一个小口子钻进来的。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这些灰尘是怎么进到盒子里的？
messages.en: How did this dust get into the box?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 从盖子上的一个小口子钻进来的。
messages.en: It got in through a small opening in the lid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一滴水慢慢进入土壤，或灰尘钻进盒子：抓住“由外到内”的方向，就能记住 ippenetra 的渗入、穿透义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large, heavy animal that spends much of its time in water; a hippopotamus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 河马，一种体形庞大、常在水中活动的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal kbir u tqil li jqatta' ħafna ħin fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 河马。
河马。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher ippopotamu ħdejn ix-xmara.
formal.en: The picture shows a hippopotamus beside the river.
formal.zh: 图片中有一只河马在河边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara l-ippopotamu? Mark: Iva, hemm fl-ilma!
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the hippopotamus? Mark: Yes, there in the water!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到那只河马了吗？马克：看到了，就在那边水里！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那只河马了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the hippopotamus?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，就在那边水里！
messages.en: Yes, there in the water!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ippopotamu 写在河马泡水的简笔画旁，配合 fl-ilma（水中）一起朗读，用画面记住整词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially forbid an action or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过规定、命令等方式禁止某种行为或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jħallix li ssir xi ħaġa permezz ta' regola jew ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止；不准进行某种行为或活动。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of pprojbixxa
sense_translations.zh_definition: pprojbixxa 在辅音后使用的形式，也是其另一基本形式。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ipprojbixxa l-parkeġġ quddiem id-daħla tal-iskola.
formal.en: The council prohibited parking in front of the school entrance.
formal.zh: 议会禁止在学校入口前停车。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' npejjep hawn? Pawlu: Le, is-sid ipprojbixxa t-tipjip ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I smoke here? Pawlu: No, the owner prohibited smoking indoors.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以在这里吸烟吗？保罗：不可以，店主禁止在室内吸烟。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 我可以在这里吸烟吗？
messages.en: Can I smoke here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 不可以，店主禁止在室内吸烟。
messages.en: No, the owner prohibited smoking indoors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象入口处画着禁止停车的标志，把 ipprojbixxa 与“不准做”的动作连起来，再用“禁止吸烟、禁止停车”两组搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To help something develop or become better known, or to raise someone to a higher position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促进事物发展、推广某项事物，或将某人提升到更高职位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħin biex xi ħaġa tiżviluppa jew issir aktar magħrufa, jew jagħti lil xi ħadd kariga ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促进；推广、宣传；使某人晋升。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of ppromwova
sense_translations.zh_definition: ppromwova 在辅音后使用的形式，也是其另一基本形式。

formal.mt: Il-proġett ippromwova l-qari fost it-tfal permezz ta' attivitajiet fil-librerija.
formal.en: The project promoted reading among children through activities in the library.
formal.zh: 该项目通过图书馆活动向儿童推广阅读。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark għandu uffiċċju ġdid? David: Id-direttur ippromwova lil Mark għal maniġer.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does Mark have a new office? David: The director promoted Mark to manager.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么有了新办公室？戴维：主管把马克提拔为经理了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么有了新办公室？
messages.en: Why does Mark have a new office?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-direttur ippromwova lil Mark għal maniġer.
messages.mt_standard: Id-direttur ippromwova lil Mark għal maniġer.
messages.zh: 主管把马克提拔为经理了。
messages.en: The director promoted Mark to manager.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两支向上的箭头：一支表示阅读活动得到推广，一支表示员工职位上升；把 ippromwova 放在中间，联记推广与晋升。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attempt something, test how something works, or show that something is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尝试做某事、测试某物的表现，或证明某事属实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel tentattiv, jara jekk xi ħaġa taħdimx, jew juri li xi ħaġa hija vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尝试；试着做某事。
证明；用证据或论证说明某事属实。
测试；检验某物的功能、表现或效果。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of pprova
sense_translations.zh_definition: pprova 在辅音后使用的形式，也是其另一基本形式。

formal.mt: It-tekniku ipprova l-apparat qabel l-użu u rreġistra r-riżultati.
formal.en: The technician tested the device before use and recorded the results.
formal.zh: 技术员在使用前测试了设备，并记录了结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark irnexxielu jiftaħ il-bieb? Lara: Le, ipprova darbtejn, imma l-bieb baqa' magħluq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark manage to open the door? Lara: No, he tried twice, but the door stayed shut.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克成功把门打开了吗？拉拉：没有，他试了两次，但门还是关着。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克成功把门打开了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark manage to open the door?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ipprova darbtejn, imma l-bieb baqa' magħluq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ipprova darbtejn, imma l-bieb baqa' magħluq.
messages.zh: 没有，他试了两次，但门还是关着。
messages.en: No, he tried twice, but the door stayed shut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个学习画面记 ipprova：推门是尝试，检查设备是测试，拿出证据是证明；读句子时根据宾语和语境选择中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The joint in the leg where the upper and lower parts meet and bend.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 膝盖，即大腿与小腿连接、能弯曲的关节部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġog bejn il-koxxa u l-parti t'isfel tas-sieq, fejn is-sieq titgħawweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 膝盖；膝关节。

sense_translations.en_definition: post-consonantal and alternative basic form of rkoppa
sense_translations.zh_definition: rkoppa 在辅音后使用的形式，也是其另一基本形式。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-pazjent iddeskriva uġigħ fl-irkoppa tal-lemin waqt il-mixi.
formal.en: In the report, the patient described pain in the right knee while walking.
formal.zh: 在报告中，患者描述了走路时右膝疼痛的情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod? Mark: Għandi uġigħ fl-irkoppa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you walking slowly? Mark: My knee hurts.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么走得这么慢？马克：我的膝盖疼。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的膝盖疼。
messages.en: My knee hurts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 irkoppa 时轻指自己的膝盖，再做一次弯膝动作；把身体位置、动作和词形一起记住，不必猜测词源。

gloss_zh: 爱尔兰的；爱尔兰男子；爱尔兰语

teaching_sense.en_definition: From Ireland or connected with Ireland, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自爱尔兰的，或与爱尔兰、爱尔兰人及其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Irlanda jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Irlanda, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱尔兰的；爱尔兰人的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Ireland
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自爱尔兰的；与爱尔兰有关的。
爱尔兰男子。
爱尔兰语。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Irlandiż ta taħdita dwar il-letteratura u l-lingwa ta' pajjiżu.
formal.en: The Irish writer gave a talk about the literature and language of his country.
formal.zh: 这位爱尔兰作家就本国的文学与语言作了一场演讲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liam huwa Irlandiż? Pawlu: Iva, u qed jgħallimni ftit Irlandiż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Liam an Irishman? Pawlu: Yes, and he is teaching me a little Irish.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利亚姆是爱尔兰人吗？保罗：是的，他还在教我一点爱尔兰语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 利亚姆是爱尔兰人吗？
