messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你的文章打算写什么？
messages.en: What are you going to write your essay about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 写资本主义和利润的作用。
messages.en: About capitalism and the role of profit.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibda b'eżempju ta' negozju privat.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibda b'eżempju ta' negozju privat.
messages.zh: 你可以先举一个私营企业的例子。
messages.en: You could start with an example of a private business.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kapitaliżmu 放进经济制度的记忆格，联想“私人企业、资本、利润”三个关键词来记住资本主义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outer garment worn over other clothes, such as an overcoat or a cloak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在其他衣服外面的外衣，可指大衣或斗篷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies ta' barra li jintlibes fuq ħwejjeġ oħra, bħal kowt jew mantell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大衣；穿在其他衣服外面、通常用于御寒的外套。
斗篷；披在肩上、覆盖身体的宽松外衣。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-kesħa, il-viżitatur libes kapott tas-suf qabel ħareġ mill-lukanda.
formal.en: Because of the cold, the visitor put on a woollen overcoat before leaving the hotel.
formal.zh: 由于天气寒冷，这位旅客离开酒店前穿上了一件羊毛大衣。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ħu l-kapott miegħek, għax barra qed jagħmel il-bard. David: Fejn qiegħed? Marija: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Take your overcoat with you, because it is cold outside. David: Where is it? Marija: On the chair by the door.
colloquial.zh: Marija：把大衣带上，外面很冷。David：大衣在哪儿？Marija：在门边的椅子上。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu l-kapott miegħek, għax barra qed jagħmel il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu l-kapott miegħek, għax barra qed jagħmel il-bard.
messages.zh: 把大衣带上，外面很冷。
messages.en: Take your overcoat with you, because it is cold outside.

messages.speaker: David (儿子)
messages.zh: 大衣在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is it?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 在门边的椅子上。
messages.en: On the chair by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前把 kapott 披在最外层：有袖大衣或披肩斗篷，都放进“外层衣物”的记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item worn on the head for protection, decoration, or as part of an outfit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在头上，用于保护、装饰或搭配服装的帽子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintlibes fuq ir-ras għall-protezzjoni, għat-tiżjin jew bħala parti mill-ilbies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帽子；戴在头上的服饰。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-ġnien, it-tfal libsu kappell biex jipproteġu rashom mix-xemx.
formal.en: During the visit to the garden, the children wore hats to protect their heads from the sun.
formal.zh: 参观花园时，孩子们戴着帽子，保护头部免受日晒。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kappell jogħġbok? Mark: Iva, imma pprova l-ieħor ukoll. Nina: Se nieħu dan; huwa aktar komdu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you like this hat? Mark: Yes, but try the other one too. Nina: I'll take this one; it is more comfortable.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你喜欢这顶帽子吗？Mark：喜欢，不过也试试另一顶吧。Nina：我要这顶，它更舒服。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这顶帽子吗？
messages.en: Do you like this hat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过也试试另一顶吧。
messages.en: Yes, but try the other one too.

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nieħu dan; huwa aktar komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Se nieħu dan; huwa aktar komdu.
messages.zh: 我要这顶，它更舒服。
messages.en: I'll take this one; it is more comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kappell 固定在头顶的画面里，配合 tilbes kappell“戴帽子”一起记，避免和穿在身上的大衣混淆。

gloss_zh: 婴儿兜帽；婴儿洗礼小帽；大麻鳽

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hood or small close-fitting cap for a baby, especially a cap worn during baptism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 婴儿戴的兜帽或贴头小帽，尤其可指婴儿接受洗礼时所戴的小帽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Barnuża jew għata żgħira li toqgħod qrib ras tarbija, speċjalment waqt il-magħmudija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿兜帽；罩住婴儿头部的帽子。

sense_translations.en_definition: skullcap used for infants during baptism
sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿接受洗礼时所戴的贴头小帽。
大麻鳽，学名 Botaurus stellaris，一种鸟。

collocations.en: a Eurasian bittern among the reeds

formal.mt: Il-kappun abjad li libset it-tarbija waqt il-magħmudija nżamm bħala tifkira tal-okkażjoni.
formal.en: The white cap that the baby wore during baptism was kept as a memento of the occasion.
formal.zh: 婴儿接受洗礼时戴的那顶白色小帽被保留下来，作为这次仪式的纪念。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn poġġejt il-kappun tat-tarbija? Rita: Fil-borża, ħdejn il-ħwejjeġ tal-magħmudija. Anna: Tajjeb, se noħorġu dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you put the baby's cap? Rita: In the bag, next to the baptismal clothes. Anna: Good, we're leaving soon.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你把宝宝的小帽放哪儿了？Rita：在包里，就在洗礼服旁边。Anna：好，我们马上就出门。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 你把宝宝的小帽放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the baby's cap?

messages.speaker: Rita (外祖母)
messages.zh: 在包里，就在洗礼服旁边。
messages.en: In the bag, next to the baptismal clothes.

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 好，我们马上就出门。
messages.en: Good, we're leaving soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kappun 做两张画面卡：一张是宝宝的兜帽或洗礼小帽，一张是大麻鳽；看婴儿或观鸟语境来选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person in command of a ship or boat, or the leader of a team.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责指挥船只的人，或带领一支队伍的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi vapur jew dgħajsa, jew li tkun il-mexxej ta' tim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船长；队长；负责指挥船只或带领队伍的人。
船长；艇长；负责驾驶和指挥船艇的人。

formal.mt: Il-kaptan tal-vapur informa lill-passiġġieri li l-wasla fil-port kienet se tittardja.
formal.en: The ship's captain informed the passengers that arrival at the port would be delayed.
formal.zh: 船长通知乘客，抵达港口的时间将会推迟。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Min hu l-kaptan tat-tim illum? Sara: Illum il-kaptan huwa Mark. Ben: Mela nistaqsih x'ħin tibda l-logħba.
colloquial.en: Ben: Who is the team captain today? Sara: Mark is the captain today. Ben: Then I'll ask him what time the match starts.
colloquial.zh: Ben：今天谁是队长？Sara：今天的队长是 Mark。Ben：那我去问他比赛几点开始。

messages.speaker: Ben (队员)
messages.zh: 今天谁是队长？
messages.en: Who is the team captain today?

messages.speaker: Sara (队友)
messages.zh: 今天的队长是 Mark。
messages.en: Mark is the captain today.

messages.speaker: Ben (队员)
messages.zh: 那我去问他比赛几点开始。
messages.en: Then I'll ask him what time the match starts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaptan 想成发出指挥的人：站在船上是船长，站在球队前面是队长，用所在场景帮助选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a low sound expressing pain, discomfort, or distress; also to complain, beg, or cry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因疼痛、不适或悲苦而发出低沉的呻吟声；也可表示抱怨、乞求或哭泣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel ħoss baxx minħabba wġigħ, skumdità jew dwejjaq; jista' jfisser ukoll li tilmenta, titlob bil-ħerqa jew tibki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟；因疼痛或不适而发出低沉的声音。
抱怨；诉说不满或苦处。
乞求；恳切地请求。
呻吟，哼叫；因疼痛、不适或苦恼而发出低沉的声音。
哭泣；因悲伤或痛苦而哭。

formal.mt: Meta pprova jqum mis-sodda, ir-raġel karab bl-uġigħ, u l-infermiera resqet lejh biex tgħinu.
formal.en: When he tried to get out of bed, the man groaned in pain, and the nurse approached him to help.
formal.zh: 那名男子试着起床时痛得呻吟起来，护士走近他，准备提供帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex karab Mark meta qam mis-siġġu? Toni: Għax għadu juġgħu dahru. Maja: Ejja naraw jekk għandux bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark groan when he got up from the chair? Toni: Because his back still hurts. Maja: Let's see whether he needs help.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 从椅子上站起来时为什么呻吟？Toni：因为他的背还疼。Maja：我们去看看他需不需要帮助吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex karab Mark meta qam mis-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex karab Mark meta qam mis-siġġu?
messages.zh: Mark 从椅子上站起来时为什么呻吟？
messages.en: Why did Mark groan when he got up from the chair?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他的背还疼。
messages.en: Because his back still hurts.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw jekk għandux bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw jekk għandux bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 我们去看看他需不需要帮助吧。
messages.en: Let's see whether he needs help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“痛得呻吟、心里抱怨、开口乞求、难过哭泣”四幅画面记 karab，再靠句中情境判断具体意思。

gloss_zh: 性格；人物角色；笔迹；字体

teaching_sense.en_definition: The qualities that shape a person's personality and usual behaviour; also a person represented in a story or performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成一个人的性格和日常行为特点的特质；也指故事或表演中的人物角色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalitajiet li jsawru l-personalità u l-imġiba ta' persuna; ukoll persuna rrappreżentata fi storja jew f'xi rappreżentazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性格；品格，指一个人较稳定的行为和道德特质。
个性；人格特点，指一个人与他人有所区别的性情和行为方式。
戏剧中的人物角色。
性格、本性、性情或脾气。
戏剧、节目或电影中的人物角色。
笔迹；个人书写文字的字形和风格。
印刷字体、字形或印刷文字的样式。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-dramm, l-istudenti għandhom jiddeskrivu l-karattru prinċipali u jispjegaw il-motivi tiegħu.
formal.en: In their analysis of the play, students should describe the main character and explain his motives.
formal.zh: 在戏剧分析中，学生应描述主要角色并解释他的动机。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'taħseb dwar Pawlu? Rita: Għandu karattru kalm u jaf jisma'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think of Pawlu? Rita: He has a calm personality and knows how to listen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得保罗怎么样？丽塔：他性格沉稳，也很会倾听。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得保罗怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu karattru kalm u jaf jisma'.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu karattru kalm u jaf jisma'.
messages.zh: 他性格沉稳，也很会倾听。
messages.en: He has a calm personality and knows how to listen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进四格记忆卡：真人看性格，舞台看角色，手写看笔迹，印刷看字体；用语境选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Peanuts: edible seeds often eaten roasted as a snack or used in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花生，常经烘烤后作为零食食用，也可用于烹饪的可食用种子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żrieragħ li jittieklu, spiss inkaljati bħala ikla ħafifa jew użati fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花生；一粒花生。
花生，指多粒花生或作为食品的花生。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li dan il-prodott fih il-karawett.
formal.en: The label indicates that this product contains peanuts.
formal.zh: 标签注明本产品含有花生。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek xi karawett? Lara: Iva, għandi karawett inkaljat mingħajr melħ. Trid ftit?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have any peanuts? Lara: Yes, I have unsalted roasted peanuts. Would you like some?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有花生吗？拉拉：有，我有无盐烤花生。要来一点吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有花生吗？
messages.en: Do you have any peanuts?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi karawett inkaljat mingħajr melħ. Trid ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi karawett inkaljat mingħajr melħ. Trid ftit?
messages.zh: 有，我有无盐烤花生。要来一点吗？
messages.en: Yes, I have unsalted roasted peanuts. Would you like some?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象零食碗里装着烤花生，旁边放着花生酱；把 karawett 与这两种熟悉的食物一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element carbon, represented by the symbol C, which occurs in substances such as graphite and diamond.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 碳，化学符号为 C 的元素，存在于石墨、金刚石等物质中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku bis-simbolu C, li jinsab f'sustanzi bħall-grafit u d-djamant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碳，化学元素，符号为 C。

formal.mt: Il-grafit u d-djamant huma żewġ forom differenti tal-karbonju.
formal.en: Graphite and diamond are two different forms of carbon.
formal.zh: 石墨和金刚石是碳的两种不同形态。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu s-simbolu tal-karbonju? Pawlu: C. Ftakar fil-grafit tal-lapes.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the symbol for carbon? Pawlu: C. Think of the graphite in a pencil.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：碳的符号是什么？保罗：C。想想铅笔里的石墨。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 碳的符号是什么？
messages.en: What is the symbol for carbon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: C。想想铅笔里的石墨。
messages.en: C. Think of the graphite in a pencil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡中央写 C，左边画铅笔石墨，右边画金刚石；两幅图都连到 karbonju，帮助记住“碳”。

gloss_zh: 谷糠；糠秕；贬称平民或没教养的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: The light husks and other material separated from grain; figuratively, a disparaging term for ordinary people or people considered uneducated and ill-mannered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从谷物中分离出来的轻薄外壳等杂物，即谷糠或糠秕；比喻用法带贬义，可指平民大众或被认为缺乏教育、举止粗鲁的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qxur ħfief u fdalijiet oħra li jinfirdu mill-qamħ; figurattivament, kelma ta' disprezz għall-poplu komuni jew għal nies meqjusa bla tagħlim u bla manjieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谷糠；糠秕，指谷物脱粒等过程中分离出的轻薄外壳和碎屑。
平民大众；底层民众，此处用作带轻蔑意味的称呼。
缺乏教育、没有礼貌的人，属于贬义的人群称呼。

collocations.en: to separate the wheat from the chaff

formal.mt: Matul id-dris, il-qamħ jinfired mill-karfa.
formal.en: During threshing, the wheat is separated from the chaff.
formal.zh: 脱粒过程中，麦粒与谷糠被分离。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak li qed itir mar-riħ? Ġanni: Dik il-karfa, il-qxur ħfief li jinfirdu mill-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that blowing in the wind? Ġanni: That is chaff, the light husks separated from the wheat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那些随风飘的是什么？詹尼：那是谷糠，就是从麦粒上分离出来的轻薄外壳。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak li qed itir mar-riħ?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak li qed itir mar-riħ?
messages.zh: 那些随风飘的是什么？
messages.en: What is that blowing in the wind?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik il-karfa, il-qxur ħfief li jinfirdu mill-qamħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dik il-karfa, il-qxur ħfief li jinfirdu mill-qamħ.
messages.zh: 那是谷糠，就是从麦粒上分离出来的轻薄外壳。
messages.en: That is chaff, the light husks separated from the wheat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记农场画面：麦粒留下，轻糠随风飘走，飘走的是 karfa；再单独标记其指人用法带有贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intended to help people in need, especially by raising or providing money, goods, or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在帮助有需要的人的，尤其通过筹集或提供金钱、物资或服务来开展慈善救助的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħsub biex jgħin lil min hu fil-bżonn, speċjalment billi jiġbor jew jipprovdi flus, oġġetti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慈善的；以帮助有需要的人或提供救济为目的的。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill organizza avveniment karitattiv biex jiġbor fondi għall-familji fil-bżonn.
formal.en: The council organised a charitable event to raise funds for families in need.
formal.zh: 议会组织了一场慈善活动，为有需要的家庭筹款。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tiġi għall-kunċert karitattiv is-Sibt? Pawlu: Iva, nixtieq ngħin. Fejn nista' nixtri biljett?
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you coming to the charity concert on Saturday? Pawlu: Yes, I would like to help. Where can I buy a ticket?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你周六会来参加慈善音乐会吗？保罗：会，我想出一份力。在哪里可以买票？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你周六会来参加慈善音乐会吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the charity concert on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq ngħin. Fejn nista' nixtri biljett?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq ngħin. Fejn nista' nixtri biljett?
messages.zh: 会，我想出一份力。在哪里可以买票？
messages.en: Yes, I would like to help. Where can I buy a ticket?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 karitattiv 当作活动旁的“慈善的”标签：贴在音乐会上是慈善音乐会，贴在工作上是慈善工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Help given to people in need, especially through donations; also money or goods given as alms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向有需要的人提供帮助的慈善行为，尤其指捐赠；也指施舍或救济的钱物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajnuna mogħtija lil min hu fil-bżonn, speċjalment permezz ta' donazzjonijiet; ukoll flus jew oġġetti mogħtija bħala għajnuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慈善；为帮助有需要的人而给予援助或进行捐赠的行为。
施舍；给予贫困者的救济钱物。

formal.mt: Il-flus kollha miġbura waqt il-kunċert se jingħataw għall-karità.
formal.en: All the money collected during the concert will be donated to charity.
formal.zh: 音乐会期间筹得的全部款项将捐作慈善用途。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għal xiex qed tiġbru l-flus? Mark: Għall-karità, biex ngħinu lill-familji fil-bżonn.
colloquial.en: Rita: What are you collecting money for? Mark: For charity, to help families in need.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你们筹钱做什么？马克：做慈善，帮助有需要的家庭。

messages.speaker: Rita (路人)
messages.zh: 你们筹钱做什么？
messages.en: What are you collecting money for?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.zh: 做慈善，帮助有需要的家庭。
messages.en: For charity, to help families in need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把钱投入慈善捐款箱：帮助他人的行为和送出的救济钱物，都可以用 karità 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pull something along a surface; also to make an activity or discussion continue longer than necessary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物沿着表面拖动；也指把活动或讨论拖长，使其持续超过必要的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed xi ħaġa tul wiċċ; ukoll itawwal attività jew diskussjoni aktar milli jkun hemm bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖；拖动，使某物贴着地面等表面移动。
拖长；延长，使某个过程或活动持续更久。

collocations.en: he dragged the chair along the floor
collocations.zh: 他把椅子沿着地面拖动

formal.mt: Il-kelliem karkar id-diskussjoni billi rrepeta l-istess argument diversi drabi.
formal.en: The speaker drew out the discussion by repeating the same argument several times.
formal.zh: 发言者多次重复同一论点，把讨论拖长了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min karkar is-siġġu mal-art? Mark: Jien. Id-darba li jmiss nerfgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who dragged the chair along the floor? Mark: I did. Next time I will lift it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把椅子在地板上拖了？马克：是我。下次我会把它抬起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把椅子在地板上拖了？
messages.en: Who dragged the chair along the floor?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是我。下次我会把它抬起来。
messages.en: I did. Next time I will lift it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个“拖”连接意思：椅子在地上拖着走，讨论在时间上拖得长；两幅画面一起记 karkar。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light, usually open shoe such as a flip-flop, sandal, or slipper, worn for comfort or informal use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种轻便、通常露脚的鞋，如人字拖、凉鞋或拖鞋，供舒适或日常休闲穿着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żarbun ħafif, ġeneralment miftuħ, bħal sandla jew papoċċ, li jintlibes għall-kumdità jew f'okkażjonijiet informali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人字拖；以夹趾鞋带固定的轻便拖鞋。
凉鞋；拖鞋，指轻便、便于穿脱的鞋。

formal.mt: Il-karkur tal-gomma muri fil-katalgu għandu qiegħ flessibbli u ċinga bejn is-swaba'.
formal.en: The rubber flip-flop shown in the catalogue has a flexible sole and a strap between the toes.
formal.zh: 目录中展示的橡胶人字拖有柔软的鞋底和夹在脚趾之间的鞋带。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Sibt karkur wieħed biss. Fejn hu l-ieħor? Lara: Taħt is-sodda, ħdejn il-basket.
colloquial.en: Nina: I found only one slipper. Where is the other one? Lara: Under the bed, next to the basket.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我只找到一只拖鞋。另一只在哪里？拉拉：在床底下，篮子旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt karkur wieħed biss. Fejn hu l-ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt karkur wieħed biss. Fejn hu l-ieħor?
messages.zh: 我只找到一只拖鞋。另一只在哪里？
messages.en: I found only one slipper. Where is the other one?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 在床底下，篮子旁边。
messages.en: Under the bed, next to the basket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前只找到一只人字拖，弯腰寻找另一只；把手里那只轻便鞋标成 karkur，记住它是鞋类名词。

gloss_zh: 未熟的果实；未熟的无花果

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fruit that is not yet ripe, especially an unripe fig.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未成熟的果实，尤指还没有熟的无花果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta li għadha mhix misjura, speċjalment tina li għadha ma saritx.

sense_translations.en_definition: a fruit that is not ripe
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尚未成熟的果实。
尚未成熟的无花果。

collocations.en: it is still an unripe fruit
to leave the unripe fruit on the tree
collocations.zh: 把未熟的果实留在树上

formal.mt: Dan għadu karmus; għandu jitħalla fuq is-siġra sakemm isir.
formal.en: This fruit is still unripe; it should be left on the tree until it ripens.
formal.zh: 这颗果实还没有成熟，应留在树上，等它熟了再摘。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' naqta' din it-tina? Pawlu: Le, dak għadu karmus. Ħallih fuq is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I pick this fig? Pawlu: No, that one is still unripe. Leave it on the tree.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以摘这颗无花果吗？保罗：不行，那颗还没熟。把它留在树上吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我可以摘这颗无花果吗？
messages.en: Can I pick this fig?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak għadu karmus. Ħallih fuq is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak għadu karmus. Ħallih fuq is-siġra.
messages.zh: 不行，那颗还没熟。把它留在树上吧。
messages.en: No, that one is still unripe. Leave it on the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一颗还硬着的无花果挂在树上，把 karmus 与“还没熟，先别摘”这个画面绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A carnival celebration with costumes, parades, and public entertainment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有化装、巡游和公众娱乐活动的狂欢节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Festa b'kostumi, sfilati u divertiment fit-toroq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂欢节。

formal.mt: L-iskola se torganizza sfilata tal-karnival, u l-istudenti jistgħu jilbsu kostumi.
formal.en: The school will organize a carnival parade, and students may wear costumes.
formal.zh: 学校将举办狂欢节巡游，学生可以穿化装服参加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tiġi għall-karnival għada? Mark: Iva! Se nilbes kostum ta' pirata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you coming to the carnival tomorrow? Mark: Yes! I'm going to wear a pirate costume.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天来参加狂欢节吗？马克：来！我要穿海盗服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天来参加狂欢节吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the carnival tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Se nilbes kostum ta' pirata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Se nilbes kostum ta' pirata.
messages.zh: 来！我要穿海盗服。
messages.en: Yes! I'm going to wear a pirate costume.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 karnival 和英语 carnival 配对记，再想象彩色服装与街头巡游，牢牢记住“狂欢节”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A motor vehicle, usually with four wheels, used to carry a small number of people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常有四个车轮、用于搭载少量乘客的汽车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura bil-mutur, ġeneralment b'erba' roti, li tintuża biex iġġorr numru żgħir ta' nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽车；轿车。
汽车，与 car 同义。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq għandu jipparkja l-karozza fil-post indikat.
formal.en: The driver should park the car in the designated space.
formal.zh: 驾驶员应将汽车停在指定位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn ħallejt il-karozza? David: Quddiem il-ħanut. Ejja, immorru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you leave the car? David: In front of the shop. Come on, let's go.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你把车停在哪里了？戴维：商店前面。走吧，我们出发。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把车停在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you leave the car?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店前面。走吧，我们出发。
messages.en: In front of the shop. Come on, let's go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 karozza 放进“开车、停车、找车”的日常画面中，连着记 issuq karozza，表示驾驶汽车。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bus that carries passengers along a regular public transport route.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿固定公共交通线路搭载乘客的公共汽车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura tat-trasport pubbliku li ġġorr il-passiġġieri fuq rotta regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共汽车；公交车。

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom jistennew il-karozza tal-linja fil-waqfa u jitilgħu fuqha meta tieqaf.
formal.en: Passengers should wait for the bus at the stop and board it when it stops.
formal.zh: 乘客应在车站等候公交车，待车辆停稳后上车。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-karozza tal-linja tmur il-Belt? Luqa: Iva, tista' titla' hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this bus go to Valletta? Luqa: Yes, you can get on here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这辆公交车去瓦莱塔吗？卢卡：去，你可以在这里上车。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.zh: 这辆公交车去瓦莱塔吗？
messages.en: Does this bus go to Valletta?

messages.speaker: Luqa (司机)
messages.zh: 去，你可以在这里上车。
messages.en: Yes, you can get on here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 karozza 是汽车，再把完整短语 karozza tal-linja 与“沿线路行驶的公交车”画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: 破旧车辆；卡拉克帆船；挖泥船；老旧、不可靠或笨重之物

teaching_sense.en_definition: An old, unreliable, or unwieldy thing, especially a worn-out car.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 老旧、不可靠或笨重难用的东西，尤指破旧的汽车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa qadima li ma taħdimx sew jew li diffiċli tużaha, speċjalment karozza mkissra jew mikula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破旧且运转不佳的车辆或机器。
破旧的老爷车；破汽车。
卡拉克帆船，一种大型帆船。
挖泥船；用于清挖水底泥沙的船。
任何老旧、不可靠或笨重难用的东西。

collocations.zh: 一艘张有船帆的卡拉克帆船

collocations.en: a dredger that dredges the harbour
collocations.zh: 一艘疏浚港口的挖泥船

formal.mt: Il-vettura ġiet deskritta bħala karrakka minħabba l-ħsarat frekwenti u l-kundizzjoni ħażina tagħha.
formal.en: The vehicle was described as a clunker because of its frequent breakdowns and poor condition.
formal.zh: 由于故障频发且车况很差，这辆车被形容为一辆破汽车。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-karozza reġgħet waqfet? Rita: Iva, din il-karrakka dejjem tagħtini l-problemi!
colloquial.en: Mark: Has the car broken down again? Rita: Yes, this clunker is always giving me trouble!
colloquial.zh: 马克：车又抛锚了？丽塔：是啊，这辆破车总给我添麻烦！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 车又抛锚了？
messages.en: Has the car broken down again?

messages.speaker: Rita (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din il-karrakka dejjem tagħtini l-problemi!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din il-karrakka dejjem tagħtini l-problemi!
messages.zh: 是啊，这辆破车总给我添麻烦！
messages.en: Yes, this clunker is always giving me trouble!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“老车又坏了”的场景记住 karrakka 的常见贬义，再分别给卡拉克帆船和挖泥船建立图片卡，按语境辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To handle or manipulate playing cards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手拿取、移动或摆弄游戏用的纸牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimmaniġġja jew iċaqlaq il-karti tal-logħob bl-idejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拿取、操作或摆弄纸牌。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliem karrat il-karti bil-mod biex l-istudenti jaraw il-movimenti ta' jdejh.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the teacher handled the cards slowly so that the students could see his hand movements.
formal.zh: 示范时，老师缓慢地操作纸牌，让学生看清他的手部动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min karrat il-karti qabel il-logħba? Toni: Jien. Għaliex qed tistaqsi?
colloquial.en: Maja: Who handled the cards before the game? Toni: I did. Why do you ask?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：游戏开始前是谁动过这些牌？托尼：是我。你为什么这么问？

messages.speaker: Maja (牌友)
messages.zh: 游戏开始前是谁动过这些牌？
messages.en: Who handled the cards before the game?

messages.speaker: Toni (牌友)
messages.zh: 是我。你为什么这么问？
messages.en: I did. Why do you ask?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手正在拿取和移动纸牌，连着记 karrat il-karti；这里记的是操作纸牌的动作，不必限定为某一种手法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A root vegetable, usually orange, eaten raw or cooked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通常呈橙色、可以生吃或煮熟食用的根菜，即胡萝卜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa b'għerq li jittiekel, ġeneralment oranġjo, li tista' tittiekel nejja jew imsajra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡萝卜。

collocations.en: to cut a carrot into slices

formal.mt: Qaxxar karrotta, aħsilha u aqtagħha fi flieli qabel iżżidha mas-soppa.
formal.en: Peel a carrot, wash it, and cut it into slices before adding it to the soup.
formal.zh: 将一根胡萝卜削皮、洗净并切片，然后加入汤中。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Trid karrotta mas-sandwich? Ben: Iva, imma aqtagħhieli f'biċċiet żgħar, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Elena: Would you like a carrot with your sandwich? Ben: Yes, but please cut it into small pieces for me.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你想配着三明治吃根胡萝卜吗？本：想，不过请帮我切成小块。

messages.speaker: Elena (母亲)
messages.zh: 你想配着三明治吃根胡萝卜吗？
messages.en: Would you like a carrot with your sandwich?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma aqtagħhieli f'biċċiet żgħar, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma aqtagħhieli f'biċċiet żgħar, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，不过请帮我切成小块。
messages.en: Yes, but please cut it into small pieces for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 karrotta 与英语 carrot 对照记忆，再想象橙色胡萝卜被削皮切片；用厨房动作巩固词义和拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Paper as a material, or an individual sheet used for writing, printing, or drawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于书写、印刷或绘画的纸，也可指单独的一张纸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jintuża biex tikteb, tistampa jew tpinġi fuqu, jew folja waħda minn dan il-materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸，指这种材料。

sense_translations.en_definition: paper; piece of paper, sheet of paper
sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸；一片纸；一张纸。
卡片；卡。
文件；文书材料。

formal.mt: Ikteb ismek u n-numru tat-telefon fuq folja karta u agħtiha lir-receptionist.
formal.en: Write your name and telephone number on a sheet of paper and give it to the receptionist.
formal.zh: 请将姓名和电话号码写在一张纸上，交给接待员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek karta u pinna? Irrid nikteb l-indirizz. Mark: Iva, hawn folja karta u pinna blu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have some paper and a pen? I want to write down the address. Mark: Yes, here's a sheet of paper and a blue pen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有纸和笔吗？我想记下地址。马克：有，这里有一张纸和一支蓝色笔。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek karta u pinna? Irrid nikteb l-indirizz.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek karta u pinna? Irrid nikteb l-indirizz.
messages.zh: 你有纸和笔吗？我想记下地址。
messages.en: Do you have some paper and a pen? I want to write down the address.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn folja karta u pinna blu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn folja karta u pinna blu.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一张纸和一支蓝色笔。
messages.en: Yes, here's a sheet of paper and a blue pen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 karta 画四张记忆图：纸张材料、一张白纸、一张卡片、一叠文件；看到搭配后再判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official card that identifies its holder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于证明持有人身份的官方卡片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karta uffiċjali li turi l-identità tal-persuna li tkun tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身份证；用于证明个人身份的证件卡

formal.mt: Mal-formola tal-applikazzjoni għandha tintbagħat kopja tal-karta tal-identità.
formal.en: A copy of the identity card must be sent with the application form.
formal.zh: 申请表须附上身份证副本一并寄送。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek il-karta tal-identità miegħek? Mark: Iva, qiegħda fil-kartiera. Nurihielek issa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you have your identity card with you? Mark: Yes, it's in my wallet. I'll show it to you now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你带身份证了吗？马克：带了，在钱包里。我现在拿给你看。

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 你带身份证了吗？
messages.en: Do you have your identity card with you?

messages.speaker: Mark (来访者)
messages.zh: 带了，在钱包里。我现在拿给你看。
messages.en: Yes, it's in my wallet. I'll show it to you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“柜台前出示身份证”的动作绑定记忆，再搭配“卡号”和“副本”两个使用场景练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk while wearing slippers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脚上穿着拖鞋行走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi waqt li jkun liebes il-papoċċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着自己的拖鞋走路
穿着拖鞋行走

collocations.en: walked to the kitchen in slippers
walked along the corridor in slippers

formal.mt: Wara li qam mis-sodda, Pawlu kartab sal-kċina biex jipprepara t-te.
formal.en: After getting out of bed, Pawlu walked to the kitchen in his slippers to prepare tea.
formal.zh: 保罗起床后，穿着拖鞋走到厨房去泡茶。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif mar Pawlu sal-bieb? Anna: Kartab sal-bieb; kien għadu bil-papoċċi.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did Pawlu get to the door? Anna: He walked there in his slippers; he still had them on.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗是怎么走到门口的？安娜：他穿着拖鞋走过去的，当时还没换鞋。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗是怎么走到门口的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get to the door?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 他穿着拖鞋走过去的，当时还没换鞋。
messages.en: He walked there in his slippers; he still had them on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上“起床后穿拖鞋走进厨房”的画面记忆，重点记住行走时脚上穿着拖鞋。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small barrel or cask; in other contexts, a sheet of paper or a cartel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指小桶，也可在其他语境中指一张纸或企业联合形成的卡特尔，须根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bettija żgħira; f'kuntesti oħra, folja tal-karta jew grupp ta' kumpaniji li jiftiehmu biex jikkontrollaw il-prezzijiet jew is-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小桶；小型贮存桶
一张纸；纸张
卡特尔；企业为控制价格或市场而组成的联合组织
小桶

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif kartell ta' kumpaniji ftiehem biex iżomm il-prezzijiet għoljin.
formal.en: The report describes how a cartel of companies agreed to keep prices high.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一个企业卡特尔如何通过协商维持高价。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi dan il-kartell tal-injam? Toni: Ħallih fil-kantina, ħdejn il-bettija l-kbira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put this small wooden barrel? Toni: Leave it in the cellar, next to the large barrel.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这个木制小桶放哪里？托尼：放在地窖里，靠着那个大桶。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 这个木制小桶放哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this small wooden barrel?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 放在地窖里，靠着那个大桶。
messages.en: Leave it in the cellar, next to the large barrel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给同一个词画三张语境卡：地窖里的小桶、桌上的一张纸、商场中的企业联盟；依靠搭配选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small case used to carry money, cards, and similar personal items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随身存放现金、卡片等个人物品的小型夹包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li fih jinżammu l-flus, il-karti tal-bank u karti personali oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钱包；用于随身存放现金和卡片的小包或夹子

formal.mt: Il-kartiera misjuba fuq il-karozza tal-linja kien fiha flus u karta tal-identità.
formal.en: The wallet found on the bus contained money and an identity card.
formal.zh: 在公共汽车上捡到的钱包里装有现金和一张身份证。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt il-kartiera tiegħi? Naħseb li ħallejtha hawn. Sara: Iva, qiegħda fuq il-mejda, ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you seen my wallet? I think I left it here. Sara: Yes, it's on the table, next to the keys.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你看到我的钱包了吗？我想我把它放在这里了。萨拉：看到了，在桌子上，钥匙旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-kartiera tiegħi? Naħseb li ħallejtha hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-kartiera tiegħi? Naħseb li ħallejtha hawn.
messages.zh: 你看到我的钱包了吗？我想我把它放在这里了。
messages.en: Have you seen my wallet? I think I left it here.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda fuq il-mejda, ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda fuq il-mejda, ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 看到了，在桌子上，钥匙旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the table, next to the keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前检查“钱包、钥匙、手机”，轮到钱包时说出 kartiera，并在脑中打开它看见现金和卡片。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study and practice of designing and making maps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究地图设计与制作的方法，并实际绘制地图的学科和活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju u l-prattika tat-tfassil u l-produzzjoni tal-mapep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地图学；地图设计与绘制的学问和实践

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-kartografija jgħallem lill-istudenti kif jirrappreżentaw it-terren u t-toroq fuq mappa.
formal.en: The cartography course teaches students how to represent terrain and roads on a map.
formal.zh: 地图学课程教授学生如何在地图上表示地形和道路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed titgħallem fil-kors tal-kartografija? Luqa: Kif nagħmel mapep ċari u nagħżel simboli li jinftiehmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you learning in the cartography course? Luqa: How to make clear maps and choose symbols that people can understand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在地图学课程里学些什么？卢卡：学习怎样制作清晰的地图，以及选择容易理解的符号。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在地图学课程里学些什么？
messages.en: What are you learning in the cartography course?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nagħmel mapep ċari u nagħżel simboli li jinftiehmu.
messages.mt_standard: Kif nagħmel mapep ċari u nagħżel simboli li jinftiehmu.
messages.zh: 学习怎样制作清晰的地图，以及选择容易理解的符号。
messages.en: How to make clear maps and choose symbols that people can understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kartografija 放进课程表里记忆：这一课研究怎样把道路、地形和符号画成地图，表示的是学问与活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who designs and makes maps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事地图设计与绘制的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfassal u tagħmel il-mapep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地图绘制者；从事地图设计和制作的制图师

formal.mt: Il-kartografu ħejja mappa ġdida li turi t-toroq u l-konfini taż-żona.
formal.en: The cartographer prepared a new map showing the roads and boundaries of the area.
formal.zh: 制图师制作了一张新地图，标示该地区的道路和边界。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min għamel din il-mappa? Adam: Ħija. Hu kartografu u jħobb jagħmel mapep tal-irħula.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who made this map? Adam: My brother. He's a cartographer and enjoys making maps of villages.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张地图是谁做的？亚当：我哥哥。他是制图师，喜欢绘制村庄地图。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张地图是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this map?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. Hu kartografu u jħobb jagħmel mapep tal-irħula.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. Hu kartografu u jħobb jagħmel mapep tal-irħula.
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他是制图师，喜欢绘制村庄地图。
messages.en: My brother. He's a cartographer and enjoys making maps of villages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kartografu 写在一位正在画地图的人的名牌上，再与表示学科的 kartografija 配对，分别记住“人”和“学问”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Writing and office supplies, or a shop that sells them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 书写和办公用的文具用品，也可指销售这些用品的文具店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti għall-kitba u għall-uffiċċju, jew ħanut li jbigħ dawn l-oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文具；书写及办公用的纸张、笔等用品
文具店；销售纸张、笔和其他文具的商店

formal.mt: L-iskola xtrat oġġetti tal-kartolerija, fosthom pitazzi, lapsijiet u envelops.
formal.en: The school bought stationery items, including exercise books, pencils, and envelopes.
formal.zh: 学校采购了文具用品，包括练习本、铅笔和信封。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nista' nixtri pitazz u pinna? Ben: Fil-kartolerija ħdejn l-iskola. Għadha miftuħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I buy an exercise book and a pen? Ben: At the stationery shop next to the school. It's still open.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：哪里可以买到练习本和笔？本：学校旁边的文具店。那家店还开着。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nixtri pitazz u pinna?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nixtri pitazz u pinna?
messages.zh: 哪里可以买到练习本和笔？
messages.en: Where can I buy an exercise book and a pen?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 学校旁边的文具店。那家店还开着。
messages.en: At the stationery shop next to the school. It's still open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一家摆满纸笔的文具店：货架上的用品和出售用品的店铺都能对应这个词，靠句中动作区分所指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A card sent by post, often with a picture on one side and a short message on the other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过邮寄传递的卡片，通常一面有图片，另一面写简短留言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karta li tintbagħat bil-posta, spiss bi stampa fuq naħa u messaġġ qasir fuq in-naħa l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明信片；可书写简短留言并直接邮寄的卡片

collocations.en: a postcard with a sea view

formal.mt: Matul il-vjaġġ tagħha, Elena bagħtet kartolina lill-familja biex tiddeskrivi l-post li kienet qed iżżur.
formal.en: During her trip, Elena sent her family a postcard describing the place she was visiting.
formal.zh: 旅行期间，埃琳娜给家人寄了一张明信片，描述她正在游览的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kartolina se tibgħat lin-nanna? Luqa: Din bil-baħar. Se nikteb messaġġ qasir fuq wara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which postcard are you going to send to Grandma? Luqa: This one with the sea. I'll write a short message on the back.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算寄哪张明信片给奶奶？卢卡：这张有海景的。我会在背面写一段简短留言。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你打算寄哪张明信片给奶奶？
messages.en: Which postcard are you going to send to Grandma?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Din bil-baħar. Se nikteb messaġġ qasir fuq wara.
messages.mt_standard: Din bil-baħar. Se nikteb messaġġ qasir fuq wara.
messages.zh: 这张有海景的。我会在背面写一段简短留言。
messages.en: This one with the sea. I'll write a short message on the back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kartolina 和旅行寄卡片的动作连起来：正面看风景，背面写问候，贴好邮票寄给家人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of using cards to predict the future or interpret a person's situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用纸牌预测未来或解读个人处境的占卜活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed juża l-karti biex ibassar il-futur jew jinterpreta s-sitwazzjoni ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸牌占卜；用纸牌预测或解读事情的做法。

collocations.zh: 一本关于纸牌占卜的书

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi l-kartomanzija bħala prattika li tuża l-karti biex tbassar il-futur.
formal.en: The article describes cartomancy as a practice that uses cards to predict the future.
formal.zh: 这篇文章将纸牌占卜描述为一种用纸牌预测未来的活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Lara: Ktieb dwar il-kartomanzija. Maja: Jiġifieri dwar kif jaqraw il-karti? Lara: Iva, proprju hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Lara: A book about cartomancy. Maja: You mean about reading cards? Lara: Yes, exactly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在读什么？Lara：一本关于纸牌占卜的书。Maja：就是讲怎么看牌占卜的？Lara：对，就是这个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 一本关于纸牌占卜的书。
messages.en: A book about cartomancy.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 就是讲怎么看牌占卜的？
messages.en: You mean about reading cards?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，就是这个。
messages.en: Yes, exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和桌上一排用于占卜的纸牌画面绑定，看到纸牌便回想“纸牌占卜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin cardboard, especially a sheet used to make posters, charts, or classroom displays.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 薄卡纸，尤其指用于制作海报、图表或课堂展示材料的卡纸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kartun irqiq, speċjalment folja li tintuża biex isiru posters, tabelli jew xogħol għall-wiri fil-klassi.

sense_translations.en_definition: thin cardboard sheet used for posters and charts
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于制作海报和图表的薄卡纸。
薄纸板；薄卡纸。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jużaw folja kartonċin biex jippreżentaw it-tabella tar-riżultati.
formal.en: The students should use a sheet of thin cardboard to present the results chart.
formal.zh: 学生应使用一张薄卡纸展示结果图表。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek kartonċin għall-poster? Mark: Iva, għandi folja blu. Sara: Tajjeb, nistgħu niktbu t-titlu fuqha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have some thin cardboard for the poster? Mark: Yes, I have a blue sheet. Sara: Good, we can write the title on it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你有做海报用的薄卡纸吗？Mark：有，我有一张蓝色的。Sara：好，我们可以把标题写在上面。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你有做海报用的薄卡纸吗？
messages.en: Do you have some thin cardboard for the poster?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 有，我有一张蓝色的。
messages.en: Yes, I have a blue sheet.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 好，我们可以把标题写在上面。
messages.en: Good, we can write the title on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象美术课上那张蓝色海报卡纸，用“薄、能写字、做图表”三个特点记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slipper, or slippers as footwear, typically worn indoors for comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拖鞋，通常指为舒适而在室内穿的鞋；可依语境表示单只或泛指这种鞋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żarbun komdu li normalment jintlibes ġewwa d-dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖鞋，指这一类鞋履。
一只拖鞋。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-prodott, dan il-kartub huwa ppreżentat bħala żarbun komdu għall-użu fid-dar.
formal.en: In the product description, this slipper is presented as comfortable footwear for use at home.
formal.zh: 产品说明将这款拖鞋介绍为适合居家穿着的舒适鞋履。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn hu l-kartub l-ieħor? Anna: Taħt is-sodda, ħdejn il-borża. Pawlu: Sibtha, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where is the other slipper? Anna: Under the bed, next to the bag. Pawlu: I found it, thanks!
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：另一只拖鞋在哪里？Anna：床底下，袋子旁边。Pawlu：找到了，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Pawlu (兄弟)
messages.zh: 另一只拖鞋在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the other slipper?

messages.speaker: Anna (姐妹)
messages.zh: 床底下，袋子旁边。
messages.en: Under the bed, next to the bag.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (兄弟)
messages.zh: 找到了，谢谢！
messages.en: I found it, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词和“床底下少了一只的拖鞋”联系起来，用寻找另一只拖鞋的生活场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sells stationery, such as paper, pens, and notebooks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 销售纸张、笔、笔记本等文具的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbigħ oġġetti tal-kartolerija, bħal karti, pinen u pitazzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文具商；经营或销售文具的人。

collocations.zh: 在文具商那里；在文具店

formal.mt: L-iskola talbet lill-kartularju jipprovdi l-pinen u l-pitazzi għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The school asked the stationer to supply pens and notebooks for the students.
formal.zh: 学校请文具商为学生供应笔和笔记本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn sejjer? Mark: Għand il-kartularju biex nixtri pitazz. Nina: Ġibli pinna wkoll, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are you going? Mark: To the stationer's to buy a notebook. Nina: Get me a pen too, please.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你去哪里？Mark：去文具店买一本笔记本。Nina：请也帮我带一支笔。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 去文具店买一本笔记本。
messages.en: To the stationer's to buy a notebook.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 请也帮我带一支笔。
messages.en: Get me a pen too, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象柜台后卖笔和本子的店主，把这个词牢牢记作“卖文具的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cardboard as a material; also a humorous drawing or comic strip, or an animated cartoon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指纸板这种材料，也可指幽默漫画、连环漫画或动画片，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal magħmul minn karta ħoxna; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll tpinġija umoristika, sensiela ta' tpinġijiet jew film animat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸板；用于制作盒子等物品的厚纸质材料。
漫画；幽默图画或连环漫画。
动画片；以活动画面呈现的卡通作品。

collocations.en: a humorous cartoon in the newspaper
to watch a cartoon on television

formal.mt: Il-kelma kartun tista' tirreferi għall-materjal ta' kaxxa, għal tpinġija umoristika jew għal film animat.
formal.en: The word kartun can refer to the material of a box, a humorous drawing, or an animated cartoon.
formal.zh: kartun 一词可以指箱子所用的纸板材料、幽默漫画或动画片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi trid tagħmel wara l-ikel? Ben: Irrid nara kartun fuq it-televiżjoni. Maja: Tajjeb, nagħżlu wieħed flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you want to do after eating? Ben: I want to watch a cartoon on television. Maja: Okay, let's choose one together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：吃完饭你想做什么？Ben：我想在电视上看动画片。Maja：好，我们一起选一部。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 吃完饭你想做什么？
messages.en: What do you want to do after eating?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我想在电视上看动画片。
messages.en: I want to watch a cartoon on television.

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 好，我们一起选一部。
messages.en: Okay, let's choose one together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象纸板箱、报纸漫画和电视动画三个画面，用周围的词判断 kartun 在说哪一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cardboard used as a material for making or supporting objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纸板，可用作制作物品或提供支撑的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal tal-karta li jintuża biex isiru oġġetti jew biex jingħatalhom appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸板；纸质板材。

formal.mt: Għall-mudell, aqta' biċċa kartunett u użaha bħala bażi.
formal.en: For the model, cut a piece of cardboard and use it as a base.
formal.zh: 制作模型时，裁一块纸板作为底座。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek biċċa kartunett? Toni: Iva, hemm waħda fuq il-mejda. Lara: Perfett, nużaha għall-bażi tal-mudell.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a piece of cardboard? Toni: Yes, there's one on the table. Lara: Perfect, I'll use it for the model's base.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有一块纸板吗？Toni：有，桌上有一块。Lara：太好了，我用它做模型底座。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你有一块纸板吗？
messages.en: Do you have a piece of cardboard?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 有，桌上有一块。
messages.en: Yes, there's one on the table.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 太好了，我用它做模型底座。
messages.en: Perfect, I'll use it for the model's base.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一块纸板裁成模型底座，让“拿纸板、裁纸板、垫底座”的动作帮助记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small container used to save money, especially coins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于积攒钱币的小容器，尤其用来存放硬币。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur żgħir li fih wieħed jiġma' u jfaddal il-flus, speċjalment il-muniti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储蓄罐；用来积攒硬币的存钱罐。
存钱罐；用于储存零用钱的小容器。

collocations.en: to drop a coin into the piggy bank
collocations.zh: 往存钱罐里投一枚硬币

collocations.en: a piggy bank full of coins

formal.mt: It-tifel ipoġġi munita fil-karus kull ġimgħa biex ifaddal għal ktieb ġdid.
formal.en: The boy puts a coin into his piggy bank every week to save for a new book.
formal.zh: 这个男孩每周往存钱罐里放一枚硬币，攒钱买一本新书。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se tpoġġi din il-munita? Ben: Fil-karus tiegħi. Anna: Għal xiex qed tfaddal? Ben: Għal rota ġdida.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are you going to put this coin? Ben: In my piggy bank. Anna: What are you saving for? Ben: A new bicycle.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你要把这枚硬币放在哪里？Ben：放进我的存钱罐。Anna：你在攒钱买什么？Ben：一辆新自行车。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 你要把这枚硬币放在哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going to put this coin?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 放进我的存钱罐。
messages.en: In my piggy bank.

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 你在攒钱买什么？
messages.en: What are you saving for?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 一辆新自行车。
messages.en: A new bicycle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每天往小罐里投一枚硬币，听见叮当声便联想到 karus 和攒钱目标。

gloss_zh: 虐待；压迫；强暴；亵渎；玷污

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mistreat or oppress someone; in other contexts, to rape or violate a person, or to desecrate or sully something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 虐待或压迫某人；在其他语境中也可指强暴、侵犯某人，或亵渎、玷污某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ittratta lil xi ħadd ħażin jew oppressah; f'kuntesti oħra, stupra jew vjola persuna, jew ipprofana jew tebbagħ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虐待；恶劣地对待某人。
压迫；以权力或强制手段欺压他人。
虐待、压迫；使他人遭受恶劣待遇或欺压。
强奸、强暴；对某人实施性侵犯。
亵渎、玷污；损害神圣事物或使某物蒙污。

collocations.en: he mistreated or oppressed the workers

collocations.zh: 他亵渎了一处神圣场所

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif is-sid kasbar lill-ħaddiema billi ġegħelhom jaħdmu sigħat twal mingħajr mistrieħ.
formal.en: The report describes how the owner oppressed the workers by forcing them to work long hours without rest.
formal.zh: 报告描述了业主如何强迫工人长时间工作且不得休息，以此压迫他们。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex telaq Mark minn dak ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Is-sid kasbar lill-ħaddiema u ma tahomx ħin għall-mistrieħ. Lara: Issa nifhem għaliex telaq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark leave that job? Pawlu: The owner mistreated the workers and gave them no time to rest. Lara: Now I understand why he left.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 为什么辞掉那份工作？Pawlu：业主虐待工人，连休息时间都不给他们。Lara：现在我明白他为什么走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex telaq Mark minn dak ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex telaq Mark minn dak ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: Mark 为什么辞掉那份工作？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave that job?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sid kasbar lill-ħaddiema u ma tahomx ħin għall-mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sid kasbar lill-ħaddiema u ma tahomx ħin għall-mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 业主虐待工人，连休息时间都不给他们。
messages.en: The owner mistreated the workers and gave them no time to rest.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在我明白他为什么走了。
messages.en: Now I understand why he left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“严重侵害”的记忆格：对人可指虐待、压迫或性侵犯，对神圣事物可指亵渎；阅读时结合宾语和情境辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Water that falls from a higher level to a lower level, especially over a steep rock face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水从高处沿陡峭岩壁等落向低处形成的瀑布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma li jaqa' minn għoli għal livell aktar baxx, speċjalment minn fuq wiċċ wieqaf tal-blat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瀑布。
飞瀑；水逐级倾泻而下的瀑流。
瀑流；瀑布。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija twassal għal kaskata għolja mdawra bis-siġar.
formal.en: The path leads to a high waterfall surrounded by trees.
formal.zh: 这条小路通向一处四周树木环绕的高瀑布。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' dak il-ħoss? Mark: Iva, hemm kaskata wara dawk is-siġar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that sound? Mark: Yes, there's a waterfall behind those trees.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到那个声音了吗？Mark：听到了，那些树后面有一处瀑布。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm kaskata wara dawk is-siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm kaskata wara dawk is-siġar.
messages.zh: 听到了，那些树后面有一处瀑布。
messages.en: Yes, there's a waterfall behind those trees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaskata 和水从岩壁倾泻而下的画面绑定，再用“瀑布的水声”这个短语帮助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large fortified building with strong walls, built for protection and sometimes used as a residence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有坚固围墙、用于防御且有时兼作住所的大型建筑，即城堡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini kbir b'ħitan sodi, mibni għad-difiża u xi drabi użat ukoll bħala residenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 城堡；具有防御设施的大型建筑。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jidħlu fil-bitħa tal-kastell matul il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: Visitors may enter the castle courtyard during opening hours.
formal.zh: 游客可在开放时间内进入城堡的庭院。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Immorru naraw il-kastell illum? Pawlu: Iva, irrid nieħu ritratt quddiem il-bieb tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we go and see the castle today? Pawlu: Yes, I want to take a photo in front of its gate.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们今天去看城堡好吗？Pawlu：好，我想在城堡大门前拍张照片。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天去看城堡好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go and see the castle today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid nieħu ritratt quddiem il-bieb tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid nieħu ritratt quddiem il-bieb tiegħu.
messages.zh: 好，我想在城堡大门前拍张照片。
messages.en: Yes, I want to take a photo in front of its gate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kastell 时想象一座有高墙和大门的城堡，把“城堡—围墙—大门”串成完整画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A penalty imposed on someone because they have done something wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人做错事而对其施加的处罚或惩罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Piena mogħtija lil xi ħadd minħabba li jkun għamel xi ħaġa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惩罚；艰难、充满苦难的生活。
惩罚；处罚。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier ta kastig lil ibnu talli kiser il-wegħda tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the father punished his son for breaking his promise.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，父亲因儿子违背承诺而惩罚了他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tistax toħroġ illum? Ben: Bħala kastig, illum ma nistax niltaqa' ma' sħabi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't you go out today? Ben: As punishment, I can't meet my friends today.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你今天为什么不能出门？Ben：作为惩罚，我今天不能和朋友见面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天为什么不能出门？
messages.en: Why can't you go out today?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħala kastig, illum ma nistax niltaqa' ma' sħabi.
messages.mt_standard: Bħala kastig, illum ma nistax niltaqa' ma' sħabi.
messages.zh: 作为惩罚，我今天不能和朋友见面。
messages.en: As punishment, I can't meet my friends today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kastig 放进“做错事后受到惩罚”的情境记忆；遇到生活语境时，再联想到苦日子的意思。

gloss_zh: 加泰罗尼亚的；加泰罗尼亚人；加泰罗尼亚语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Catalonia, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与加泰罗尼亚、当地居民或加泰罗尼亚语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-Katalonja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加泰罗尼亚的；加泰罗尼亚人的；加泰罗尼亚语的。
加泰罗尼亚语；用于指称该语言的义项。
加泰罗尼亚人。
加泰罗尼亚语。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Katalan ippreżenta l-ktieb tiegħu waqt laqgħa letterarja.
formal.en: The Catalan writer presented his book at a literary gathering.
formal.zh: 这位加泰罗尼亚作家在一次文学聚会上介绍了自己的书。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kittieb huwa Katalan? Mark: Iva, u dan il-ktieb tiegħu huwa bil-Katalan.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this writer Catalan? Mark: Yes, and this book of his is in Catalan.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这位作家是加泰罗尼亚人吗？Mark：是的，而且他的这本书是用加泰罗尼亚语写的。

messages.speaker: Nina (读者)
messages.zh: 这位作家是加泰罗尼亚人吗？
messages.en: Is this writer Catalan?

messages.speaker: Mark (书店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u dan il-ktieb tiegħu huwa bil-Katalan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u dan il-ktieb tiegħu huwa bil-Katalan.
messages.zh: 是的，而且他的这本书是用加泰罗尼亚语写的。
messages.en: Yes, and this book of his is in Catalan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“加泰罗尼亚作家写加泰罗尼亚语的书”串联记忆，再根据句子区分形容词、人物名词和语言名词。

gloss_zh: 链条；项链；手链；丁砖；舱口围板

teaching_sense.en_definition: A series of connected rings or links, often made of metal, used for fastening, pulling, or decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由彼此连接的环节组成、常为金属制成并用于固定、牵拉或装饰的链条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' ħoloq magħqudin ma' xulxin, spiss tal-metall, użata biex torbot, tiġbed jew iżżejjen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 链；链条。

sense_translations.en_definition: chain (series of interconnected rings or links)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 链条，指由相互连接的环或链节组成的物件。
项链；戴在颈部的链饰。
手链；戴在手腕上的链饰。
丁砖；横向砌入墙体、以短端露在墙面的砖。

sense_translations.en_definition: coaming (the vertical side of the hatch on a boat)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 舱口围板；船上舱口边缘竖起的围挡。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rabat il-bieb b'katina tal-ħadid biex iżommu magħluq.
formal.en: The worker secured the gate with an iron chain to keep it closed.
formal.zh: 工人用一条铁链拴住大门，使其保持关闭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn xtrajt dik il-katina tad-deheb? Sara: Kienet rigal mingħand ommi; nilbisha ma' għonqi kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you buy that gold chain? Sara: It was a gift from my mother; I wear it around my neck every day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你那条金链在哪里买的？Sara：是我妈妈送的礼物，我每天都戴在脖子上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你那条金链在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy that gold chain?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet rigal mingħand ommi; nilbisha ma' għonqi kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet rigal mingħand ommi; nilbisha ma' għonqi kuljum.
messages.zh: 是我妈妈送的礼物，我每天都戴在脖子上。
messages.en: It was a gift from my mother; I wear it around my neck every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用一环扣一环的画面记住 katina 的链条义，再分别配上颈部、手腕、砖墙和船舱图片记其他义项。

gloss_zh: 增加；传播；使增多；增加或繁殖事物的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause something to become greater in amount or number.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物的数量或程度增加，使其变得更多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żied l-għadd jew il-kwantità ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加某事物；使某事物的数量或程度提高。
传播、散布或扩展某事物。
使某事物成倍增加；使其繁殖增多。
使事物增加、增多或繁殖的人。
使增多；使数量增加或成倍增长。

formal.mt: Il-programm edukattiv kattar l-interess tal-istudenti fil-qari.
formal.en: The educational programme increased the students' interest in reading.
formal.zh: 这项教育计划提高了学生对阅读的兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-taħriġ kattar il-fiduċja tiegħi. Ben: Tiegħi wkoll; issa nħossni lest biex nitkellem quddiem il-klassi.
colloquial.en: Lara: This training increased my confidence. Ben: Mine too; now I feel ready to speak in front of the class.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这次训练增强了我的信心。Ben：我的也是，现在我觉得自己准备好在全班面前发言了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这次训练增强了我的信心。
messages.en: This training increased my confidence.

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiegħi wkoll; issa nħossni lest biex nitkellem quddiem il-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Tiegħi wkoll; issa nħossni lest biex nitkellem quddiem il-klassi.
messages.zh: 我的也是，现在我觉得自己准备好在全班面前发言了。
messages.en: Mine too; now I feel ready to speak in front of the class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kattar 记成“让某样东西变多”的动作：财富变多、兴趣变浓、信心增强，都可帮助抓住使增加的核心义。

gloss_zh: 坏人；残忍的；恶毒的；难缠的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cruel or evil person, especially a villain in a story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 残忍或邪恶的人，尤其指故事中的坏人或反派。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ħażina jew bla ħniena, speċjalment karattru ħażin fi storja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 残忍或邪恶者；坏人。
残忍的；凶暴的；刻薄恶毒的。
难缠的；讨厌的；令人不快的。

formal.mt: Il-kattiv tar-rakkont juża l-biża' biex jikkontrolla lin-nies tar-raħal.
formal.en: The villain in the story uses fear to control the villagers.
formal.zh: 故事中的反派利用恐惧控制村民。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu l-kattiv f'dan il-film? Mark: Dak ir-raġel bil-kappell iswed; dejjem jhedded lill-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who's the villain in this film? Mark: That man in the black hat; he's always threatening the others.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这部电影里的反派是谁？Mark：那个戴黑帽子的男人，他总是威胁别人。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影里的反派是谁？
messages.en: Who's the villain in this film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel bil-kappell iswed; dejjem jhedded lill-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel bil-kappell iswed; dejjem jhedded lill-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 那个戴黑帽子的男人，他总是威胁别人。
messages.en: That man in the black hat; he's always threatening the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用电影反派的画面记 kattiv：指人时可记“坏人”，修饰人时可记“残忍的、恶毒的”，留意词性区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hollow pipe or tube that carries water or another substance, often as part of a drainage system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 输送水或其他物质的中空管子，常指排水系统中的管道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajp vojt minn ġewwa li minnu jgħaddi l-ilma jew materjal ieħor, spiss bħala parti minn sistema tad-drenaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排水管；用于排走废水或积水的通道。
管子；中空的管状物。
水管；输送水的管道。
管道；导管；输送水或其他物质的通道。

formal.mt: Il-katusa tad-drenaġġ għandha titnaddaf sabiex l-ilma jkun jista' jgħaddi minnha.
formal.en: The drainage pipe should be cleaned so that water can flow through it.
formal.zh: 应清理排水管，使水能够顺畅通过。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-ilma mhux nieżel? Pawlu: Il-katusa hi misduda; irridu nnaddfuha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why isn't the water draining away? Pawlu: The pipe is blocked; we need to clean it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：水为什么排不下去？Pawlu：管道堵了，我们得把它清理一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 水为什么排不下去？
messages.en: Why isn't the water draining away?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 管道堵了，我们得把它清理一下。
messages.en: The pipe is blocked; we need to clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水沿中空管道流走，再想象管道堵住的情景，把 katusa 与“水管、排水管”一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Care taken to avoid danger or mistakes; also, the act of making excuses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为避免危险或错误而采取的谨慎态度；也可指找借口、作推托。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attenzjoni biex wieħed jevita periklu jew żbalji; tista' wkoll tfisser li wieħed iġib l-iskużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 找借口；作推托。
谨慎；小心防范的态度。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema għandhom jimxu bil-kawtiela fuq l-art imxarrba.
formal.en: Workers should walk with caution on the wet floor.
formal.zh: 工人应在湿滑地面上小心行走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex miexi daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: Qed nimxi bil-kawtiela għax l-art tiżloq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you walking so slowly? Mark: I'm walking carefully because the floor is slippery.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么走得这么慢？马克：地面很滑，我得小心走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nimxi bil-kawtiela għax l-art tiżloq.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nimxi bil-kawtiela għax l-art tiżloq.
messages.zh: 地面很滑，我得小心走。
messages.en: I'm walking carefully because the floor is slippery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进湿地慢行的画面，先记住“谨慎”；遇到推托语境，再联想到“找借口”这一义项。

gloss_zh: 拖拽；拖着走；大胜；筛得过度

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pull something along a surface; also, to defeat an opponent decisively or to sift something excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体沿着地面等表面拖动；也可指击败对手、取得压倒性胜利，或把东西筛得过度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġibed xi ħaġa fuq wiċċ; jista' wkoll ifisser li għeleb avversarju b'differenza kbira jew li għarbel iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖；拽着物体沿某个表面移动。
大败对手；以明显优势获胜。

sense_translations.en_definition: to defeat dramatically (e.g. at sport or in a poll)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以压倒性优势击败，例如在体育比赛或投票中大胜。
拖着走；拉着某人或某物一起移动。
击败；战胜对手。
筛得过度；过分筛滤。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kaxkar il-kaxxa sal-bieb għax kienet tqila wisq biex jerfagħha.
formal.en: The worker dragged the box to the door because it was too heavy to lift.
formal.zh: 工人把箱子拖到门口，因为箱子太重，搬不起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar it-tim tiegħek ilbieraħ? Pawlu: Kaxkar lit-tim l-ieħor! Rebaħ ħamsa b'xejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did your team do yesterday? Pawlu: It thrashed the other team! It won five-nil.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你支持的球队昨天踢得怎么样？保罗：把对方打得落花流水！五比零赢了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你支持的球队昨天踢得怎么样？
messages.en: How did your team do yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Kaxkar lit-tim l-ieħor! Rebaħ ħamsa b'xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Kaxkar lit-tim l-ieħor! Rebaħ ħamsa b'xejn.
messages.zh: 把对方打得落花流水！五比零赢了。
messages.en: It thrashed the other team! It won five-nil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景并排记忆：工人拖箱子对应“拖拽”，球队五比零获胜对应“大胜”；筛得过度另作一张义项卡。

gloss_zh: 箱子；盒子；匣子；共同资金；小块地

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container such as a box, case, or chest; in other contexts, a shared pool of money or a small plot of land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于装东西的箱、盒、匣等容器；在其他语境中也可指共同筹集的资金或一小块地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur li fih jitqiegħdu oġġetti; f'kuntesti oħra, flus miġbura flimkien jew biċċa art żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盒子；箱子。
用于收纳或保护物品的盒、匣或箱。
箱、盒、匣；储物用的大箱子。
共同筹集或保管的一笔钱；公用钱款或共同彩池。
小块地；划出的一块土地。

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti għandhom jitqiegħdu f'kaxxa tal-kartun u jinżammu f'post niexef.
formal.en: The documents should be placed in a cardboard box and kept in a dry place.
formal.zh: 文件应放入纸箱，并存放在干燥处。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kotba? Mark: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb; għad hemm ħafna spazju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where should I put these books? Mark: In the box by the door; there's still plenty of room.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些书放哪儿？马克：放门边的箱子里，里面还空着不少地方。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 这些书放哪儿？
messages.en: Where should I put these books?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb; għad hemm ħafna spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb; għad hemm ħafna spazju.
messages.zh: 放门边的箱子里，里面还空着不少地方。
messages.en: In the box by the door; there's still plenty of room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象门边装书的纸箱，固定“箱盒”义；再用“大家的钱放在一起”和“一块土地”分别记住另外两个语境。

gloss_zh: 深锅；炖锅；泥瓦匠的抹刀

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deep vessel used for cooking, such as a saucepan or casserole pot; also, a mason's trowel used to apply or spread mortar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于烹饪的深锅或炖锅；也指泥瓦匠用来涂抹、摊铺砂浆的抹刀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borma fonda għat-tisjir; ukoll għodda tal-bennej biex iqiegħed jew iwitti t-tajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深身煮锅；用于加热或烹煮食物的锅。
炖锅；用于慢炖或焖煮食物的深锅。
抹刀；泥瓦作业中用来涂抹砂浆的工具。
深煮锅；锅身较深的烹饪容器。
泥瓦匠的抹刀；用于铺抹或整平砂浆。

formal.mt: Il-bennej uża kazzola biex iwitti t-tajn bejn il-ġebel.
formal.en: The mason used a trowel to smooth the mortar between the stones.
formal.zh: 泥瓦匠用抹刀抹平石块之间的砂浆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fiex insajjar iz-zalza? Rita: Uża dik il-kazzola ż-żgħira; hi biżżejjed għal tnejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: What should I cook the sauce in? Rita: Use that small saucepan; it's big enough for two.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：酱汁用什么锅煮？丽塔：用那个小深锅吧，做两个人的份量够了。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 酱汁用什么锅煮？
messages.en: What should I cook the sauce in?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża dik il-kazzola ż-żgħira; hi biżżejjed għal tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Uża dik il-kazzola ż-żgħira; hi biżżejjed għal tnejn.
messages.zh: 用那个小深锅吧，做两个人的份量够了。
messages.en: Use that small saucepan; it's big enough for two.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词配两张图：厨房里煮酱汁的深锅，工地上抹砂浆的抹刀；靠场景区分，不要把工具义漏掉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of pursuing wild animals or birds to catch or kill them; also the animals or birds hunted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 追踪并捕捉或猎杀野生动物、鸟类的活动；也可指被猎捕的动物或鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha wieħed ifittex u jiġri wara annimali jew għasafar biex jaqbadhom jew joqtolhom; ukoll l-annimali jew l-għasafar li jiġu kkaċċjati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次狩猎或猎捕行动。
猎物，即作为狩猎对象的动物或鸟类。
狩猎活动；对猎物的追逐。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effett tal-kaċċa fuq il-popolazzjonijiet tal-għasafar.
formal.en: The report describes the effect of hunting on bird populations.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了狩猎对鸟类种群的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-ħarġa hija għall-kaċċa? Mark: Le, sejrin biss naraw l-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a hunting trip? Mark: No, we're only going to watch the birds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这次出去是去打猎吗？马克：不是，我们只是去观鸟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这次出去是去打猎吗？
messages.en: Is this a hunting trip?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，我们只是去观鸟。
messages.en: No, we're only going to watch the birds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaċċa 放进一幅狩猎图中记忆：追捕的活动和追捕的猎物都可以用它表示，具体意思看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who hunts wild animals or birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事狩猎、捕猎野生动物或鸟类的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmur għall-kaċċa u tfittex annimali jew għasafar biex taqbadhom jew toqtolhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猎人；捕猎野生动物或鸟类的人。
猎人；从事狩猎的人。

formal.mt: Il-kaċċatur ippreżenta l-liċenzja tiegħu lill-uffiċjal waqt il-kontroll.
formal.en: The hunter presented his licence to the officer during the inspection.
formal.zh: 检查时，猎人向工作人员出示了自己的执照。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel huwa kaċċatur? Toni: Iva, imma llum ħareġ biss jimxi magħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that man a hunter? Toni: Yes, but today he only came out to walk with us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个男人是猎人吗？托尼：是的，不过他今天只是出来和我们散步。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人是猎人吗？
messages.en: Is that man a hunter?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma llum ħareġ biss jimxi magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma llum ħareġ biss jimxi magħna.
messages.zh: 是的，不过他今天只是出来和我们散步。
messages.en: Yes, but today he only came out to walk with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaċċa 的狩猎画面与 kaċċatur 的人物形象配对记忆：前者想到活动或猎物，后者想到拿着装备的猎人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a blue tint or appearing somewhat blue, especially of the sea or sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有蓝色调或显得略微发蓝的，尤其可用于描述海洋或天空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn ħafif ta' blu jew jidher xi ftit blu, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-baħar jew għas-sema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带蓝色色调的；泛蓝的。
略带蓝色的；透着一点蓝色的。

sense_translations.en_definition: bluish; tinted in blue (of something not always blue, especially the sea and sky)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 泛蓝的；带蓝色调的，用于并非总呈蓝色的事物，尤其是海洋和天空。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, il-baħar jidher kaħlani fid-dawl ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: In the photograph, the sea looks bluish in the morning light.
formal.zh: 照片中，海面在晨光下显得微微泛蓝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illum il-baħar jidher kaħlani, hux? Maja: Iva, speċjalment fejn qed jolqtu d-dawl.
colloquial.en: Lara: The sea looks bluish today, doesn't it? Maja: Yes, especially where the light is hitting it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天海面看起来有点泛蓝，对吧？玛雅：是啊，尤其是光照到的地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天海面看起来有点泛蓝，对吧？
messages.en: The sea looks bluish today, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment fejn qed jolqtu d-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment fejn qed jolqtu d-dawl.
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是光照到的地方。
messages.en: Yes, especially where the light is hitting it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaħlani 写在海天照片旁，想象光线让景物蒙上一层淡蓝；重点记“带一点蓝色”，而不是要求整片颜色完全一致。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a blue tint or being somewhat blue in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有蓝色调、颜色略微发蓝的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn blu jew jidher xi ftit blu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微蓝的；略带蓝色的；泛蓝的。

formal.mt: Id-dawl kaħli tal-lampa jagħti lewn differenti lill-ħitan tal-kamra.
formal.en: The lamp's bluish light gives the room's walls a different hue.
formal.zh: 灯发出的微蓝光线使房间墙壁呈现出不同的色调。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-drapp jidher kaħli ħdejn it-tieqa. Lara: Iva, ejja narawh ukoll taħt il-lampa.
colloquial.en: Maja: This fabric looks bluish by the window. Lara: Yes, let's also look at it under the lamp.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布在窗边看起来有点泛蓝。拉拉：是啊，我们也拿到灯下看看吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp jidher kaħli ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp jidher kaħli ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 这块布在窗边看起来有点泛蓝。
messages.en: This fabric looks bluish by the window.

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja narawh ukoll taħt il-lampa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja narawh ukoll taħt il-lampa.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们也拿到灯下看看吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's also look at it under the lamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kaħli 配一块微微泛蓝的布，再用 lewn kaħli 和 dawl kaħli 反复造句，把“蓝色调”的视觉印象与词形一起记住。

gloss_zh: 给墙抹灰；给墙缝勾缝；抹灰工；涂成蓝色

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a wall with plaster or pack mortar into the gaps between its stones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在墙面上抹灰，或将砂浆填入石墙的石块缝隙中进行勾缝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi ħajt bit-tikħil jew jimla t-toqob u l-fili bejn il-ġebel tiegħu bit-tajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给墙面抹灰。

sense_translations.en_definition: to apply pointing to a wall (by packing crevices between stones with mortar)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给墙勾缝，即用砂浆填实石块之间的缝隙。
抹灰工；从事墙面抹灰工作的工匠。
涂成蓝色；着以蓝色。

collocations.en: pointed the joints between the stones
collocations.zh: 给石块之间的接缝勾了缝

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kaħħal il-ħajt u ħallieh jinxef qabel ma żebgħu.
formal.en: The worker plastered the wall and left it to dry before painting it.
formal.zh: 工人给墙面抹灰，待其干燥后才刷漆。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min kaħħal dan il-ħajt? Pawlu: Jien kaħħaltu lbieraħ; issa rridu nħalluh jinxef.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who plastered this wall? Pawlu: I plastered it yesterday; now we need to let it dry.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这面墙是谁抹的灰？保罗：我昨天抹的；现在得让它干透。

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.zh: 这面墙是谁抹的灰？
messages.en: Who plastered this wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien kaħħaltu lbieraħ; issa rridu nħalluh jinxef.
messages.mt_standard: Jien kaħħaltu lbieraħ; issa rridu nħalluh jinxef.
messages.zh: 我昨天抹的；现在得让它干透。
messages.en: I plastered it yesterday; now we need to let it dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kaħħal 做两张情景卡：一张画工人抹墙、填石缝，另一张画涂蓝色；名词义另配“抹灰工”，避免把不同词性混在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of satisfaction in oneself or an achievement; also, excessive concern with one's own importance or appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己、他人或某项成就而产生的自豪感；也可指过分看重自身地位或外表的骄傲、虚荣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' sodisfazzjon bik innifsek jew b'xi kisba; tista' wkoll tfisser li tagħti importanza żejda lilek innifsek jew lid-dehra tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自豪；骄傲，具体褒贬取决于语境。
虚荣；过度在意自身外表、地位或他人的赞赏。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ppreżentaw il-proġett tagħhom b'kburija wara xhur ta' ħidma.
formal.en: The students presented their project with pride after months of work.
formal.zh: 经过数月的努力，学生们自豪地展示了自己的项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fl-aħħar spiċċajt il-kors! Lara: Prosit! Żgur li qed tħoss ħafna kburija.
colloquial.en: Maja: I've finally finished the course! Lara: Well done! You must be feeling very proud.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我终于完成这门课程了！劳拉：真棒！你一定很自豪吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 我终于完成这门课程了！
messages.en: I've finally finished the course!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Prosit! Żgur li qed tħoss ħafna kburija.
messages.mt_standard: Prosit! Żgur li qed tħoss ħafna kburija.
messages.zh: 真棒！你一定很自豪吧。
messages.en: Well done! You must be feeling very proud.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象完成课程后挺起胸膛的自豪感；再把“过分在意别人夸奖”放在旁边，提醒自己这个词也能表示虚荣。

gloss_zh: 点燃；燃起；激发热情；煽动情绪

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause something to start burning; figuratively, to inspire enthusiasm or stir up someone's emotions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物开始燃烧，即点燃、引火；比喻激发热情、鼓舞他人，或使人的情绪激动起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qabbad in-nar f'xi ħaġa; b'mod figurattiv, qanqal entużjażmu jew emozzjonijiet f'xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引燃；使火开始燃烧。
点着；使某物燃烧起来。
激发热情；使人充满干劲。
使某人的情绪激动起来；煽起某人的情绪。
点燃；引火。
鼓舞；激发人的想法、感情或行动意愿。

formal.mt: Id-diskors tal-għalliem kebbes l-entużjażmu tal-istudenti għall-qari.
formal.en: The teacher's speech sparked the students' enthusiasm for reading.
formal.zh: 老师的讲话激发了学生们的阅读热情。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadu kiesaħ hawn? Mark: Le, Pawlu kebbes in-nar u issa ssaħħan il-post.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is it still cold in here? Mark: No, Pawlu lit the fire and the room has warmed up now.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这里还冷吗？马克：不冷了，保罗生了火，现在屋里暖和了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这里还冷吗？
messages.en: Is it still cold in here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu kebbes in-nar u issa ssaħħan il-post.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu kebbes in-nar u issa ssaħħan il-post.
messages.zh: 不冷了，保罗生了火，现在屋里暖和了。
messages.en: No, Pawlu lit the fire and the room has warmed up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“点燃炉火”和“点燃热情”这组中文搭配帮助记忆；前者是真火，后者是情绪被激发的比喻。

gloss_zh: 拈花惹草；对配偶或伴侣不忠

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pursue casual romantic or sexual relationships, especially while being unfaithful to a spouse or partner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意与人发展暧昧或性关系，尤其指已有配偶或伴侣时仍拈花惹草、对其不忠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fittex relazzjonijiet romantiċi jew sesswali każwali, speċjalment meta ma baqax fidil lejn il-konjuġi jew is-sieħeb tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拈花惹草；随意与他人发展情爱或性关系。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be unfaithful to one's spouse or partner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己的配偶或伴侣不忠；与别人发生感情或性关系。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be unfaithful to one’s spouse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己的配偶不忠；有婚外情。

collocations.en: was unfaithful behind his wife's back

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jirrakkonta kif raġel miżżewweġ kebbex ma' nisa oħra u tilef il-fiduċja ta' martu.
formal.en: The novel recounts how a married man philandered with other women and lost his wife's trust.
formal.zh: 这部小说讲述了一名已婚男子与其他女人拈花惹草，最终失去妻子信任的故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telqitu l-mara fil-film? Lara: Għax kebbex ma' mara oħra, u hi saret taf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the woman in the film leave him? Lara: Because he cheated with another woman, and she found out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里那个女人为什么离开他？劳拉：因为他跟另一个女人出轨了，被她发现了。

messages.speaker: Maja (观影的朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里那个女人为什么离开他？
messages.en: Why did the woman in the film leave him?

messages.speaker: Lara (观影的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kebbex ma' mara oħra, u hi saret taf.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kebbex ma' mara oħra, u hi saret taf.
messages.zh: 因为他跟另一个女人出轨了，被她发现了。
messages.en: Because he cheated with another woman, and she found out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词记在电影人物关系卡上：已有伴侣却与别人发展情爱关系。它指感情上的不忠，不是一般的失信或考试作弊。

gloss_zh: 使烦恼；使担忧；使疲惫；烦扰

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone distress, irritation or worry, or to wear someone out mentally or physically.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人烦恼、恼怒或担忧，也可指使人在精神或身体上疲惫不堪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss dwejjaq, irritazzjoni jew tħassib, jew tgħajjih mentalment jew fiżikament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人烦恼或苦恼。
使某人恼火或感到不耐烦。
使某人担忧或心神不安。
使某人疲惫不堪，也包括身体上的疲劳。
因受到刺激或打扰而产生的烦躁、恼怒。
令人不快的烦扰，或由此产生的烦恼。
对某事感到不安的忧虑、担心。
使某人耗尽精力、十分疲惫。

formal.mt: Id-dewmien fit-tweġiba kedd lill-applikant, li baqa' jistenna aħbar dwar it-talba tiegħu.
formal.en: The delay in replying distressed the applicant, who continued waiting for news about his application.
formal.zh: 答复迟迟未到，使申请人烦忧；他仍在等待有关申请的消息。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex tidher daqshekk inkwetat? Mark: Dan id-dewmien keddni. Għadni bla tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why do you look so worried? Mark: This delay has really troubled me. I still haven't had an answer.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你怎么显得这么担心？马克：一直拖着真让我烦心。我到现在还没收到答复。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么显得这么担心？
messages.en: Why do you look so worried?

messages.speaker: Mark (等待答复的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dewmien keddni. Għadni bla tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dewmien keddni. Għadni bla tweġiba.
messages.zh: 一直拖着真让我烦心。我到现在还没收到答复。
messages.en: This delay has really troubled me. I still haven't had an answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把等待答复的画面连起来记：事情拖延，让人烦心、担忧，久了又身心疲惫。kedd 作动词时记“使人受折磨”，作名词时记“烦恼、忧虑”；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cloth used to wrap a dead person's body, especially for burial; also a wrap or covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于包裹死者遗体、尤其用于安葬的布；也可指包裹用的布或覆盖物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp li jintuża biex jitgeżwer fih il-ġisem ta' persuna mejta, speċjalment għad-difna; ukoll għata jew drapp għat-tgeżwir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于包裹死者遗体的裹尸布。
用于包裹的布或覆盖物。
裹尸布，尤指安葬时包裹遗体的布。

formal.mt: Il-ġisem tal-mejjet tgeżwer f'kefen abjad qabel id-difna.
formal.en: The deceased person's body was wrapped in a white shroud before burial.
formal.zh: 安葬前，死者的遗体被裹上了白色裹尸布。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'kefen' f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser id-drapp li jitgeżwer fih il-ġisem ta' persuna mejta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'kefen' mean in this text? Pawlu: Here it means the cloth used to wrap a dead person's body.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章里的 kefen 是什么意思？保罗：这里指包裹死者遗体的布。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 kefen 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'kefen' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser id-drapp li jitgeżwer fih il-ġisem ta' persuna mejta.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser id-drapp li jitgeżwer fih il-ġisem ta' persuna mejta.
messages.zh: 这里指包裹死者遗体的布。
messages.en: Here it means the cloth used to wrap a dead person's body.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“白布包裹”的画面记 kefen：先记安葬语境中的“裹尸布”，再联系较宽泛的“包裹用布”。读到它时结合上下文选择含义；这是情境记忆，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 给衣物缝折边；衣物折边；手掌内侧；秤盘

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fold the edge of a garment or piece of fabric and sew it in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣物或布料的边缘折起并缝牢，形成折边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titwi t-tarf ta' libsa jew biċċa drapp u tħitu biex jibqa' f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给衣物缝折边。
衣物边缘折起并缝牢的部分。

sense_translations.en_definition: one of a pair of weighing scales
sense_translations.zh_definition: 天平两侧秤盘中的一个。
手的内侧，即掌心一面。

sense_translations.en_definition: palm of the hand; or the inner part of the hand (including the fingers)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 手掌；或包括手指在内的手部内侧。
秤上承放被称物品或砝码的秤盘。
把布料边缘折起并缝牢；缝折边。

formal.mt: Keff it-tarf tad-drapp b'punti żgħar u regolari.
formal.en: Hem the edge of the fabric with small, even stitches.
formal.zh: 用细小、均匀的针脚把布料边缘折起缝牢。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Keff it-tarf ta' din il-falda, jekk jogħġbok. Pawlu: Żgur. Tridha b'dan it-tul?
colloquial.en: Marija: Please hem the edge of this skirt. Pawlu: Of course. Would you like it at this length?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：请把这条裙子的边缘折起缝牢。保罗：当然。你想要这个长度吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Keff it-tarf ta' din il-falda, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Keff it-tarf ta' din il-falda, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把这条裙子的边缘折起缝牢。
messages.en: Please hem the edge of this skirt.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (裁缝)
