colloquial.en: Mark: I'm starving! Is there anything to eat? Sara: Yes, there's some soup and bread. Mark: Great, I'll have a bowl of soup.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我饿极了！有什么吃的吗？萨拉：有，有些汤和面包。马克：好，我来一碗汤。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien klubi! Hemm xi ħaġa x'niekol?
messages.mt_standard: Jien klubi! Hemm xi ħaġa x'niekol?
messages.zh: 我饿极了！有什么吃的吗？
messages.en: I'm starving! Is there anything to eat?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit soppa u ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit soppa u ħobż.
messages.zh: 有，有些汤和面包。
messages.en: Yes, there's some soup and bread.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我来一碗汤。
messages.en: Great, I'll have a bowl of soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 klubi 记成强烈的饥饿感：肚子饿时想吃饭，求知时想读书，两种画面都突出渴望的强度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instruction given with authority that someone is expected to obey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由具有权威的人发出、要求他人遵从的命令或指令。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ordni mogħtija minn min għandu l-awtorità, li min jirċeviha huwa mistenni jobdi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 命令；指挥，即发出指令或行使指挥权。
训令；要求遵守的准则或教诫。
命令；由有权者发出、要求执行的指示。
指挥官；负责发号施令、统率人员的人。

collocations.en: under the command of an officer

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal ta l-kmand biex il-grupp jieqaf ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: The officer gave the command for the group to stop near the entrance.
formal.zh: 军官下令让队伍在入口附近停下。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'kien il-kmand tal-kowċ? Lara: Qalilna biex nieqfu u nistennew hawn. Pawlu: Mela nistennew.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What was the coach's command? Lara: He told us to stop and wait here. Pawlu: Then let's wait.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：教练下了什么指令？拉拉：他让我们停下，在这里等。保罗：那我们就等吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队员)
messages.zh: 教练下了什么指令？
messages.en: What was the coach's command?

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalilna biex nieqfu u nistennew hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Qalilna biex nieqfu u nistennew hawn.
messages.zh: 他让我们停下，在这里等。
messages.en: He told us to stop and wait here.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队员)
messages.zh: 那我们就等吧。
messages.en: Then let's wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用发令场景记 kmand：有人下达命令，队伍听令行动；再结合上下文区分命令、指挥和指挥官。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rule or instruction, especially a religious one, that people are expected to obey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求人们遵守的命令或准则，尤指宗教中的诫命。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola jew ordni li wieħed għandu jobdi, speċjalment fit-tagħlim reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诫命；尤指宗教中要求信徒遵守的戒律。

formal.mt: Fl-esej tagħha, l-istudenta spjegat kif dan il-kmandament jiggwida l-imġiba tal-bniedem.
formal.en: In her essay, the student explained how this commandment guides human behaviour.
formal.zh: 这名学生在论文中解释了这条诫命如何指导人的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser dan il-kmandament? Pawlu: Ifisser li għandna nħobbu lill-proxxmu tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does this commandment mean? Pawlu: It means that we should love our neighbour.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这条诫命是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是我们应该爱自己的邻人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这条诫命是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this commandment mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandna nħobbu lill-proxxmu tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandna nħobbu lill-proxxmu tagħna.
messages.zh: 意思是我们应该爱自己的邻人。
messages.en: It means that we should love our neighbour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kmandament 写在“必须遵守的宗教准则”卡片上，再配对记忆“遵守诫命”和“违反诫命”，帮助理解它的约束含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening near the beginning of a period or before the usual or expected time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生在某段时间较早的时候，或早于通常、预期时间的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ fil-bidu ta' perjodu jew qabel il-ħin tas-soltu jew dak mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早的；处于某段时间初期的；早于通常或预期时间的。
早；提早；在较早的时候，或在通常、预期时间之前。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ġiet skedata għal ħin kmieni biex il-parteċipanti jkunu jistgħu jlestu x-xogħol qabel nofsinhar.
formal.en: The meeting was scheduled for an early hour so that participants could finish the work before noon.
formal.zh: 会议安排在较早的时刻，以便与会者能在中午之前完成工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasalt daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Ridt insib post tajjeb qabel jasal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you arrive so early? Mark: I wanted to find a good seat before everyone arrived.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么这么早就到了？Mark：我想在大家到来之前找个好座位。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么早就到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ridt insib post tajjeb qabel jasal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ridt insib post tajjeb qabel jasal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 我想在大家到来之前找个好座位。
messages.en: I wanted to find a good seat before everyone arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条时间线，把 kmieni 放在预定时刻左边；搭配 ħin 表示“早的时刻”，搭配 jasal 表示“早到”，同时记住形容词和副词两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ball made by winding wool, string, or thread together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由毛线、细绳或其他线状材料缠绕而成的团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suf, spag jew ħajt imkebbeb f'forma ta' ballun.

sense_translations.en_definition: a ball of wool, string or thread
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一团缠绕起来的毛线、细绳或线。

sense_translations.en_definition: a ball of wool (other other thread-like material)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛线团，或由其他线状材料绕成的团。

formal.mt: Għall-attività tal-ħjata, kull parteċipant għandu jġib kobba ħajt u labra.
formal.en: For the sewing activity, each participant should bring a ball of thread and a needle.
formal.zh: 参加缝纫活动时，每位参与者应带上一团线和一根针。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-kobba suf blu tiegħi? Rita: Iva, qiegħda fil-qoffa ħdejn is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you seen my ball of blue wool? Rita: Yes, it is in the basket next to the sofa.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看到我那团蓝色毛线了吗？Rita：看到了，在沙发旁边的篮子里。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 你看到我那团蓝色毛线了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my ball of blue wool?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 看到了，在沙发旁边的篮子里。
messages.en: Yes, it is in the basket next to the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一根长线不断绕成圆团，在圆团旁写 kobba；再分别加上 suf 和 spag，记成“毛线团”和“细绳团”。

gloss_zh: 大小；体量之大；重要性；高龄

teaching_sense.en_definition: The size or largeness of something; also its importance or a person's advanced age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物的大小或庞大程度；也可指重要性，或人的高龄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-daqs jew kemm tkun kbira xi ħaġa; jista' jfisser ukoll importanza jew età avvanzata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 较大的体积或规模；体量之大。
重要性；意义或影响的重大程度。
大；庞大程度；事物具有较大体量的性质。
高龄；年老的阶段。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-kobor tar-responsabbiltà li għandu kull min jieħu din id-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The report emphasises the magnitude of the responsibility borne by anyone making this decision.
formal.zh: 报告强调，作出这项决定的人承担着重大的责任。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Il-kobor ta' din il-kaxxa hu biżżejjed għall-kotba kollha? Sara: Iva, iżda tkun tqila wisq biex iġġorrha waħdek.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Is this box big enough for all the books? Sara: Yes, but it will be too heavy for you to carry on your own.
colloquial.zh: Daniel：这个箱子的大小足够装下所有的书吗？Sara：够，不过装好后会太重，你一个人搬不动。

messages.speaker: Daniel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kobor ta' din il-kaxxa hu biżżejjed għall-kotba kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kobor ta' din il-kaxxa hu biżżejjed għall-kotba kollha?
messages.zh: 这个箱子的大小足够装下所有的书吗？
messages.en: Is this box big enough for all the books?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda tkun tqila wisq biex iġġorrha waħdek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda tkun tqila wisq biex iġġorrha waħdek.
messages.zh: 够，不过装好后会太重，你一个人搬不动。
messages.en: Yes, but it will be too heavy for you to carry on your own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kobor 配三幅学习图：大建筑表示体量，重大责任表示重要性，年长者表示高龄；用不同语境区分这些义项，不把它只记成尺寸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system of symbols used to represent information, a sequence used for access, or a set of rules governing conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表示信息的符号系统、用于访问的代码，或规定行为的一套准则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' sinjali biex tirrappreżenta informazzjoni, sekwenza li tagħti aċċess, jew ġabra ta' regoli tal-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代码或编码；也可指一套行为准则或规则。

formal.mt: Kull impjegat għandu jaqra l-kodiċi ta' kondotta qabel jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: Every employee should read the code of conduct before starting work.
formal.zh: 每位员工都应在开始工作之前阅读行为准则。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn insib il-kodiċi biex nidħol fil-bini? Lara: Fuq il-konferma tal-prenotazzjoni tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where can I find the code to enter the building? Lara: On your booking confirmation.
colloquial.zh: Mark：在哪里可以找到进入大楼的代码？Lara：在你的预订确认单上。

messages.speaker: Mark (住客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib il-kodiċi biex nidħol fil-bini?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib il-kodiċi biex nidħol fil-bini?
messages.zh: 在哪里可以找到进入大楼的代码？
messages.en: Where can I find the code to enter the building?

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.zh: 在你的预订确认单上。
messages.en: On your booking confirmation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kodiċi 放在两张卡片上：门锁旁是“进入码”，员工手册旁是“行为准则”；结合后面的搭配判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准备食材并烹饪食物的人，尤指以此为职业的厨师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipprepara u ssajjar l-ikel, speċjalment bħala xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厨师；以专业烹饪为职业的人。
厨师；负责做饭的人。
做饭的人；从事烹饪的人，不一定是职业厨师。

collocations.zh: 担任厨师；以做厨师为职业

formal.mt: Ir-restorant qed ifittex kok ta' esperjenza biex jipprepara l-ikliet ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The restaurant is looking for an experienced cook to prepare the evening meals.
formal.zh: 这家餐厅正在招聘一名经验丰富的厨师，负责准备晚餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int sajjart din is-soppa? Pawlu: Iva, illum jien il-kok tad-dar!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you cook this soup? Pawlu: Yes, today I am the cook at home!
colloquial.zh: Maja：这汤是你煮的吗？Pawlu：是啊，今天我是家里的厨师！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这汤是你煮的吗？
messages.en: Did you cook this soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，今天我是家里的厨师！
messages.en: Yes, today I am the cook at home!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kok 就想象一个正在锅前做饭的人；餐厅里的职业厨师和家里临时掌勺的人都能帮助你记住这个名词的核心意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An owl: a bird with large eyes that is typically active at night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猫头鹰，一种眼睛较大、通常在夜间活动的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur b'għajnejn kbar li normalment ikun attiv billejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猫头鹰。
蹲着地；以蹲伏的姿势。

collocations.zh: 夜里听见猫头鹰的叫声

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, il-grupp ra kokka fuq fergħa qrib it-triq.
formal.en: During the birdwatching session, the group saw an owl on a branch near the road.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，小组看到一只猫头鹰停在路边的树枝上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dik kokka fuq is-siġra? Daniel: Iva, ħares lejn għajnejha, imma tagħmilx storbju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is that an owl in the tree? Daniel: Yes, look at its eyes, but do not make any noise.
colloquial.zh: Nina：树上那是只猫头鹰吗？Daniel：是啊，看看它的眼睛，不过别出声。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 树上那是只猫头鹰吗？
messages.en: Is that an owl in the tree?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħares lejn għajnejha, imma tagħmilx storbju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħares lejn għajnejha, imma tagħmilx storbju.
messages.zh: 是啊，看看它的眼睛，不过别出声。
messages.en: Yes, look at its eyes, but do not make any noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 kokka 和树枝上的猫头鹰配图记忆；另做一张“蹲姿”卡记录副词义。两张卡明确标注词性，避免把同形词的意思混在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sticky substance, such as glue or paste, used to attach materials to one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来把材料粘在一起的黏性物质，如胶水或浆糊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li twaħħal, użata biex tgħaqqad biċċiet jew materjali flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胶水；用于粘合物品的胶。
胶水或浆糊；用于粘贴的黏性材料。

formal.mt: Applika saff irqiq ta' kolla fuq il-kartun u ħallih jinxef qabel tkompli.
formal.en: Apply a thin layer of glue to the cardboard and let it dry before continuing.
formal.zh: 在硬纸板上涂一层薄薄的胶水，待其干燥后再继续操作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tgħaddili l-kolla? Għandi nwaħħal dan ir-ritratt. Mark: Żgur, hawn hi. Uża ftit biss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you pass me the glue? I need to stick this photo on. Mark: Sure, here it is. Use just a little.
colloquial.zh: Sara：能把胶水递给我吗？我得把这张照片贴上去。Mark：当然，给你。用一点点就好。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħaddili l-kolla? Għandi nwaħħal dan ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħaddili l-kolla? Għandi nwaħħal dan ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 能把胶水递给我吗？我得把这张照片贴上去。
messages.en: Can you pass me the glue? I need to stick this photo on.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, hawn hi. Uża ftit biss.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, hawn hi. Uża ftit biss.
messages.zh: 当然，给你。用一点点就好。
messages.en: Sure, here it is. Use just a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用 kolla 把照片贴进相册，边做动作边说“涂胶、粘上、等干”；再用纸胶和木工胶两种搭配巩固“粘合材料”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who works with others on a shared task or project.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人共同完成某项任务或项目的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem ma' oħrajn fuq xogħol jew proġett komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合作者；共同参与某项工作的人。

formal.mt: Kull kollaboratur fil-proġett għandu jippreżenta rapport qasir dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: Each collaborator on the project should submit a short report on their work.
formal.zh: 项目中的每位合作者都应提交一份关于自己工作的简短报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgħinek bil-proġett? Mark: Għandi kollaboratur ġdid; se naħdmu flimkien fuq ir-ritratti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to help you with the project? Mark: I have a new collaborator; we are going to work together on the photos.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁会帮你做这个项目？马克：我有一位新的合作者，我们会一起处理照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁会帮你做这个项目？
messages.en: Who is going to help you with the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi kollaboratur ġdid; se naħdmu flimkien fuq ir-ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi kollaboratur ġdid; se naħdmu flimkien fuq ir-ritratti.
messages.zh: 我有一位新的合作者，我们会一起处理照片。
messages.en: I have a new collaborator; we are going to work together on the photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与项目里一起干活的伙伴联系起来，记住它指的是参与合作的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of working together to achieve a shared result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了取得共同成果而一起工作的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma flimkien biex jintlaħaq riżultat komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合作；协作；共同开展工作的过程。

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat il-wirja f'kollaborazzjoni mal-librerija lokali.
formal.en: The school organized the exhibition in collaboration with the local library.
formal.zh: 学校与当地图书馆合作举办了这次展览。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għamiltu l-vidjow flimkien? Pawlu: Iva, kienet kollaborazzjoni bejn il-klassi tagħna u l-klassi ta' Maja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you make the video together? Pawlu: Yes, it was a collaboration between our class and Maja's class.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个视频是你们一起做的吗？保罗：对，是我们班和玛雅的班级合作完成的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个视频是你们一起做的吗？
messages.en: Did you make the video together?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet kollaborazzjoni bejn il-klassi tagħna u l-klassi ta' Maja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet kollaborazzjoni bejn il-klassi tagħna u l-klassi ta' Maja.
messages.zh: 对，是我们班和玛雅的班级合作完成的。
messages.en: Yes, it was a collaboration between our class and Maja's class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个班级共同制作一个视频：这个词指合作这件事，可与指合作者的词配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people who work or act together for a shared purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为共同目的而一起工作或行动的一群人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jaħdmu jew jaġixxu flimkien għal għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集体；为共同目的而协作的团体。

sense_translations.en_definition: the morphological collective (a feature of words that denote groups or sets)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形态学上的集合形式或集合范畴，指词语表示群体或集合的特征。
集体的；共同的；涉及一个群体整体的。

formal.mt: Il-kollettiv ta' artisti ppreżenta proposta għal wirja fil-librerija.
formal.en: The artists' collective submitted a proposal for an exhibition at the library.
formal.zh: 这个艺术家集体提交了一份在图书馆举办展览的提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħdem waħdek fuq dawn il-posters? Mark: Le, jien parti minn kollettiv ta' artisti; naħdmu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you work on these posters by yourself? Mark: No, I am part of an artists' collective; we work together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些海报是你一个人做的吗？马克：不是，我属于一个艺术家集体，我们一起做。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些海报是你一个人做的吗？
messages.en: Do you work on these posters by yourself?

messages.speaker: Mark (艺术家)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien parti minn kollettiv ta' artisti; naħdmu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien parti minn kollettiv ta' artisti; naħdmu flimkien.
messages.zh: 不是，我属于一个艺术家集体，我们一起做。
messages.en: No, I am part of an artists' collective; we work together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住整体这一画面：名词可指一个集体，形容词表示集体的，语法术语则表示词所指的集合。

gloss_zh: 收藏；藏品；收集的一组物品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of objects gathered or kept together, often because they share a type or theme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收集或保存在一起的一组物品，通常具有相同类别或共同主题。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' oġġetti miġbura jew miżmuma flimkien, spiss tal-istess tip jew dwar l-istess tema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收藏；藏品；收集在一起的一组物品。

formal.mt: Il-mużew se jesebixxi kollezzjoni privata ta' kotba antiki.
formal.en: The museum will exhibit a private collection of old books.
formal.zh: 博物馆将展出一批私人收藏的古旧书籍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex iżżomm dawn il-bolol kollha? Pawlu: Għandi kollezzjoni ta' bolol, u kull wieħed ifakkarni f'post differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you keep all these stamps? Pawlu: I have a stamp collection, and each one reminds me of a different place.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么留着这么多邮票？保罗：我集邮，每一枚都会让我想起一个不同的地方。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么留着这么多邮票？
messages.en: Why do you keep all these stamps?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (集邮爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi kollezzjoni ta' bolol, u kull wieħed ifakkarni f'post differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi kollezzjoni ta' bolol, u kull wieħed ifakkarni f'post differenti.
messages.zh: 我集邮，每一枚都会让我想起一个不同的地方。
messages.en: I have a stamp collection, and each one reminds me of a different place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本放满邮票的收藏册，把这个词记成按主题收在一起的一整组东西。

gloss_zh: 一切；所有东西；所有事情

teaching_sense.en_definition: All the things or matters being referred to, considered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所谈范围内的所有东西或事情的总称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-affarijiet kollha li wieħed ikun qed jirreferi għalihom, meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一切；所指范围内全部事物的总称。
一切；所有东西或事情，用来整体指代所谈的事物。

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-laqgħa, is-segretarju għandu jiżgura li kollox ikun lest.
formal.en: Before the meeting begins, the secretary should make sure that everything is ready.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，秘书应确保一切准备就绪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kollox sew? Mark: Iva, kollox sew; għadni kemm spiċċajt ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is everything all right? Mark: Yes, everything is fine; I have just finished work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：一切都好吗？马克：对，一切都好，我刚做完工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 一切都好吗？
messages.en: Is everything all right?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kollox sew; għadni kemm spiċċajt ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kollox sew; għadni kemm spiċċajt ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 对，一切都好，我刚做完工作。
messages.en: Yes, everything is fine; I have just finished work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把眼前所有事情一起圈进一个大圆，圆里的全部就是 kollox；先熟记问候语 Kollox sew?

teaching_sense.en_definition: The whole of something being referred to, with no part left out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所指事物的整体或全部，没有任何部分被排除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħaġa kollha li wieħed ikun qed jirreferi għaliha, mingħajr ma titħalla barra ebda parti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全部；所有；整个。
完全地；彻底地。

sense_translations.en_definition: This quantifier consists of the stem 'koll-' with a bound pronoun.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这个量词由词干 'koll-' 加上一个附着代词构成。
全部；他们、她们或它们全体。

sense_translations.en_definition: the whole; all the; all of it
sense_translations.zh_definition: 整个；全部的；它的全部。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina r-rapport kollu qabel ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee examined the whole report before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会审阅了整份报告后才作出决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qrajt il-ktieb kollu? Pawlu: Iva, qrajtu kollu lbieraħ; għoġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you read the whole book? Pawlu: Yes, I read all of it yesterday; I really liked it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你把整本书都看完了吗？保罗：对，我昨天全看完了，非常喜欢。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你把整本书都看完了吗？
messages.en: Did you read the whole book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qrajtu kollu lbieraħ; għoġobni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qrajtu kollu lbieraħ; għoġobni ħafna.
messages.zh: 对，我昨天全看完了，非常喜欢。
messages.en: Yes, I read all of it yesterday; I really liked it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从书的第一页读到最后一页，一页也没漏：il-ktieb kollu 就是整本书，重点是完整覆盖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A territory governed or controlled by another country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受另一个国家统治或控制的领土。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Territorju mmexxi jew ikkontrollat minn pajjiż ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 殖民地；受另一个国家统治或控制的地区。

formal.mt: It-test jispjega x'inhi kolonja u kif tista' titmexxa minn pajjiż ieħor.
formal.en: The text explains what a colony is and how it can be governed by another country.
formal.zh: 这篇文章解释了什么是殖民地，以及殖民地如何由另一个国家治理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser kolonja f'dan il-kapitlu? Mark: Tfisser territorju li jkun taħt il-kontroll ta' pajjiż ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does colony mean in this chapter? Mark: It means a territory that is under another country's control.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一章里的殖民地是什么意思？马克：指处于另一个国家控制之下的领土。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这一章里的殖民地是什么意思？
messages.en: What does colony mean in this chapter?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser territorju li jkun taħt il-kontroll ta' pajjiż ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser territorju li jkun taħt il-kontroll ta' pajjiż ieħor.
messages.zh: 指处于另一个国家控制之下的领土。
messages.en: It means a territory that is under another country's control.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在示意地图上画出一块由别国控制的领土，把 kolonja 与这块具体的殖民地联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system or practice in which a country establishes and maintains control over other territories and their populations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个国家对其他领土及其居民建立并维持控制的制度或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema jew prattika li biha pajjiż jistabbilixxi u jżomm kontroll fuq territorji oħra u fuq in-nies li jgħixu fihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 殖民主义；一个国家对其他领土及其居民实行控制和统治的制度或做法。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jiddiskutu l-kolonjaliżmu u l-effetti tiegħu fuq is-soċjetà.
formal.en: Students should discuss colonialism and its effects on society.
formal.zh: 学生应讨论殖民主义及其对社会的影响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se tikteb fl-esej tal-istorja? Pawlu: Se nikteb dwar il-kolonjaliżmu u kif pajjiż jista' jikkontrolla territorji oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you going to write about in the history essay? Pawlu: I am going to write about colonialism and how a country can control other territories.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的历史作文准备写什么？保罗：我准备写殖民主义，以及一个国家如何控制其他领土。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你的历史作文准备写什么？
messages.en: What are you going to write about in the history essay?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nikteb dwar il-kolonjaliżmu u kif pajjiż jista' jikkontrolla territorji oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Se nikteb dwar il-kolonjaliżmu u kif pajjiż jista' jikkontrolla territorji oħra.
messages.zh: 我准备写殖民主义，以及一个国家如何控制其他领土。
messages.en: I am going to write about colonialism and how a country can control other territories.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地图上的殖民地与控制它的整套制度配对记忆：kolonjaliżmu 指殖民主义这一制度和做法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Compassion: sympathetic concern for someone who is suffering, often accompanied by a wish to help; the word functions as a noun in the examples.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同情、怜悯：关切他人的痛苦，并常有帮助对方的愿望；本词在例句中作名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' tħassib u mogħdrija għal min qed ibati, spiss bix-xewqa li tgħinu; il-kelma tintuża bħala nom fl-eżempji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同情；怜悯，指对他人痛苦的关切。
怜悯；同情；对受苦者的体恤。

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera għandhom juru kompassjoni lejn il-persuni li jkunu għaddejjin minn żmien diffiċli.
formal.en: Volunteers should show compassion towards people who are going through a difficult time.
formal.zh: 志愿者应当体恤正在经历困难时期的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft titkellem miegħu? Luka: Għax deher imdejjaq. Ħassejt kompassjoni għalih u ridt nisma' x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop to talk to him? Luka: Because he looked upset. I felt compassion for him and wanted to hear what had happened.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么停下来和他说话？卢卡：因为他看起来很难过。我很同情他，想听听发生了什么事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么停下来和他说话？
messages.en: Why did you stop to talk to him?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax deher imdejjaq. Ħassejt kompassjoni għalih u ridt nisma' x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Għax deher imdejjaq. Ħassejt kompassjoni għalih u ridt nisma' x'ġara.
messages.zh: 因为他看起来很难过。我很同情他，想听听发生了什么事。
messages.en: Because he looked upset. I felt compassion for him and wanted to hear what had happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kompassjoni 联想到看见别人难过时递上一杯热茶：先体会痛苦，再表达同情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To continue an activity or carry on doing something, including after a pause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 继续某项活动或接着做某事，也可指暂停后继续。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibqa' tagħmel xi ħaġa jew terġa' tagħmilha wara waqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继续某事；使某项活动持续下去。
继续做某事；接着进行某项动作。
继续；接着往下进行。

formal.mt: Wara waqfa qasira, it-tim kompla x-xogħol fuq ir-rapport.
formal.en: After a short break, the team continued working on the report.
formal.zh: 短暂休息后，团队继续编写报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Wara li daqq it-telefon, Pawlu waqaf jaqra? Mark: Għal ftit biss. Imbagħad kompla jaqra.
colloquial.en: Sara: After the phone rang, did Pawlu stop reading? Mark: Only briefly. Then he continued reading.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：电话响后，保罗停止看书了吗？马克：只停了一小会儿，然后就继续看书了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara li daqq it-telefon, Pawlu waqaf jaqra?
messages.mt_standard: Wara li daqq it-telefon, Pawlu waqaf jaqra?
messages.zh: 电话响后，保罗停止看书了吗？
messages.en: After the phone rang, did Pawlu stop reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal ftit biss. Imbagħad kompla jaqra.
messages.mt_standard: Għal ftit biss. Imbagħad kompla jaqra.
messages.zh: 只停了一小会儿，然后就继续看书了。
messages.en: Only briefly. Then he continued reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kompla 和书里的书签联系起来：休息后翻回书签所在页，接着读下去，就是继续。

gloss_zh: 共谋；串通；参与不法行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involvement with others in a wrongful or illegal act, especially by knowingly helping it happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人共同参与不当或违法行为，尤其指明知而协助实施的共谋或串通。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Involviment ma' oħrajn f'għemil ħażin jew illegali, speċjalment billi tgħinhom b'mod konxju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共谋；串通；明知而参与或协助不当、违法行为。

collocations.zh: 参与犯罪；在犯罪中的共谋行为

formal.mt: Ir-rapport eżamina l-allegata kompliċità ta' diversi persuni fil-frodi.
formal.en: The report examined the alleged complicity of several people in the fraud.
formal.zh: 报告审查了数人涉嫌共同参与该诈骗行为的情况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tfisser kompliċità f'din l-istorja? David: Tfisser li xi ħadd għen lill-oħrajn jagħmlu xi ħaġa ħażina, u kien jaf x'qed jagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does complicity mean in this story? David: It means that someone helped the others do something wrong and knew what they were doing.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个故事里的“共谋”是什么意思？戴维：意思是有人明知其他人在做坏事，还帮助他们去做。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的“共谋”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does complicity mean in this story?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li xi ħadd għen lill-oħrajn jagħmlu xi ħaġa ħażina, u kien jaf x'qed jagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li xi ħadd għen lill-oħrajn jagħmlu xi ħaġa ħażina, u kien jaf x'qed jagħmlu.
messages.zh: 意思是有人明知其他人在做坏事，还帮助他们去做。
messages.en: It means that someone helped the others do something wrong and knew what they were doing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kompliċità 记成一幅场景：一人做坏事，另一人知情并帮忙；抓住共同参与的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musical work, the arrangement or makeup of something, or the act of creating a work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指一首音乐作品、事物的组成或安排方式，也可指创作这一过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa mużika, il-mod kif xi ħaġa tkun magħmula jew irranġata, jew l-att li toħloq xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乐曲；音乐作品。

sense_translations.en_definition: the way in which sth. is constructed or designed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 构成；构造或设计方式；各部分的安排。
组成；构成；创作，具体含义依语境而定。

formal.mt: Din il-kompożizzjoni mużikali nkitbet għal pjanu u vjolin.
formal.en: This musical composition was written for piano and violin.
formal.zh: 这首乐曲是为钢琴和小提琴而创作的。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Din il-kompożizzjoni tiegħek? Toni: Iva, ktibtha għall-pjanu. Trid tismagħha?
colloquial.en: Elena: Is this composition yours? Toni: Yes, I wrote it for the piano. Would you like to hear it?
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这首曲子是你创作的吗？托尼：是的，我是为钢琴写的。你想听听吗？

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 这首曲子是你创作的吗？
messages.en: Is this composition yours?

messages.speaker: Toni (音乐创作者)
messages.zh: 是的，我是为钢琴写的。你想听听吗？
messages.en: Yes, I wrote it for the piano. Would you like to hear it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用排列音符的画面记 kompożizzjoni：音符安排成乐曲，各种部分安排成整体，分别对应乐曲和构成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sharing of information or ideas, or the field of telecommunications and media.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信息或想法的传递与交流，也可统指电信和传媒领域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iskambju jew it-twassil ta' informazzjoni u ideat, jew il-qasam tat-telekomunikazzjoni u l-midja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沟通；交流；信息传递。

sense_translations.en_definition: communications (generic term for telecommunications and the media)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通信与传媒的统称，包括电信和媒体。

formal.mt: Komunikazzjoni ċara bejn l-għalliema u l-ġenituri tgħin lill-istudenti jitgħallmu aħjar.
formal.en: Clear communication between teachers and parents helps students learn better.
formal.zh: 教师与家长之间清晰的沟通有助于学生更好地学习。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex it-tim tagħna jaħdem daqshekk tajjeb? Samwel: Għax għandna komunikazzjoni tajba. Kulħadd jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does our team work so well? Samwel: Because we have good communication. Everyone knows what they need to do.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：为什么我们团队合作得这么好？萨姆韦尔：因为我们沟通顺畅。每个人都知道自己该做什么。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tim tagħna jaħdem daqshekk tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tim tagħna jaħdem daqshekk tajjeb?
messages.zh: 为什么我们团队合作得这么好？
messages.en: Why does our team work so well?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandna komunikazzjoni tajba. Kulħadd jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandna komunikazzjoni tajba. Kulħadd jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
messages.zh: 因为我们沟通顺畅。每个人都知道自己该做什么。
messages.en: Because we have good communication. Everyone knows what they need to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 komunikazzjoni 想成两个人互传消息：面对面是沟通，经电话和媒体传递则联系到通信与传媒。

gloss_zh: 共产主义的；共产主义者

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to communism or supporting its ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与共产主义有关的，或支持共产主义思想的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-komuniżmu jew li jappoġġa l-ideat tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共产主义的；支持共产主义的。
共产主义者；支持共产主义的人。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-ideat ta' moviment komunist u l-mod kif jiġu ppreżentati fil-kitbiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The study analyses the ideas of a communist movement and how they are presented in its writings.
formal.zh: 该研究分析一个共产主义运动的思想，以及这些思想在其文献中的呈现方式。

colloquial.mt: Rita: F'din is-sentenza, komunist jiddeskrivi l-moviment? Ben: Iva. Jekk ngħidu li xi ħadd huwa komunist, inkunu qed insemmu persuna li tappoġġa l-komuniżmu.
colloquial.en: Rita: In this sentence, does communist describe the movement? Ben: Yes. If we say that someone is a communist, we are referring to a person who supports communism.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：在这个句子里，komunist 是用来描述这个运动的吗？本：是的。如果说某人是共产主义者，就是指一个支持共产主义的人。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 在这个句子里，komunist 是用来描述这个运动的吗？
messages.en: In this sentence, does communist describe the movement?

messages.speaker: Ben (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Jekk ngħidu li xi ħadd huwa komunist, inkunu qed insemmu persuna li tappoġġa l-komuniżmu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Jekk ngħidu li xi ħadd huwa komunist, inkunu qed insemmu persuna li tappoġġa l-komuniżmu.
messages.zh: 是的。如果说某人是共产主义者，就是指一个支持共产主义的人。
messages.en: Yes. If we say that someone is a communist, we are referring to a person who supports communism.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 komunist 配两张学习卡：描述运动时读作共产主义的，指一个人时读作共产主义者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people connected by the place where they live, shared interests, or a shared identity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因共同居住地、共同兴趣或共同身份而联系在一起的人群；社区或共同体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies marbuta mill-post fejn jgħixu, minn interessi komuni jew minn identità komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 社区；社群；因居住地、兴趣或身份等联系而形成的共同体。

formal.mt: Il-librerija torganizza attivitajiet għall-membri kollha tal-komunità lokali.
formal.en: The library organises activities for all members of the local community.
formal.zh: 图书馆为当地社区的所有成员组织活动。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadek ma taf lil ħadd hawn? Ġużi: Naf ftit nies biss. Anna: Ejja għall-festa tal-komunità nhar is-Sibt; hemm tiltaqa' ma' ħafna ġirien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you still not know anyone here? Ġużi: I only know a few people. Anna: Come to the community celebration on Saturday; you will meet lots of neighbours there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你在这里还不认识什么人吗？朱齐：我只认识几个人。安娜：星期六来参加社区庆祝活动吧，你会在那里认识很多邻居。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek ma taf lil ħadd hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek ma taf lil ħadd hawn?
messages.zh: 你在这里还不认识什么人吗？
messages.en: Do you still not know anyone here?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (新居民)
messages.zh: 我只认识几个人。
messages.en: I only know a few people.

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja għall-festa tal-komunità nhar is-Sibt; hemm tiltaqa' ma' ħafna ġirien.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja għall-festa tal-komunità nhar is-Sibt; hemm tiltaqa' ma' ħafna ġirien.
messages.zh: 星期六来参加社区庆祝活动吧，你会在那里认识很多邻居。
messages.en: Come to the community celebration on Saturday; you will meet lots of neighbours there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 komunità 放进邻里聚会的画面：住得近、彼此有联系的人组成社区，有共同兴趣的人也能组成社群。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Communism: a political and economic ideology advocating common ownership of the means of production and a classless society; the word functions as a noun in the examples.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 共产主义：主张生产资料共同所有和无阶级社会的政治经济思想；本词在例句中作名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ideoloġija politika u ekonomika li tħaddan is-sjieda komuni tal-mezzi tal-produzzjoni u soċjetà mingħajr klassijiet; il-kelma tintuża bħala nom fl-eżempji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共产主义，指一种政治经济思想。
共产主义。
共产主义（英语释义采用大写形式）。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jispjega l-kunċetti ewlenin tal-komuniżmu u jqabbilhom ma' dawk ta' ideoloġiji oħra.
formal.en: This chapter explains the main concepts of communism and compares them with those of other ideologies.
formal.zh: 本章解释共产主义的主要概念，并将其与其他思想体系的概念进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tistudja llum? Pietru: Il-komuniżmu. Għandi naqra kapitlu u nispjega l-ideat ewlenin tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you studying today? Pietru: Communism. I have to read a chapter and explain its main ideas.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你今天在学什么？彼得：共产主义。我得读一章内容，并解释其中的主要思想。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying today?

messages.speaker: Pietru (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-komuniżmu. Għandi naqra kapitlu u nispjega l-ideat ewlenin tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-komuniżmu. Għandi naqra kapitlu u nispjega l-ideat ewlenin tiegħu.
messages.zh: 共产主义。我得读一章内容，并解释其中的主要思想。
messages.en: Communism. I have to read a chapter and explain its main ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 komuniżmu 写在思想概念卡上，把 komunist 写在人物卡上：前者记共产主义，后者可指共产主义者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized meeting for discussion, or a talk given to an audience on a particular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为讨论某个主题而组织的会议，也可指向听众讲解某个主题的讲座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqgħa organizzata biex jiġi diskuss suġġett, jew taħdita dwar suġġett partikolari quddiem udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会议；围绕特定主题进行交流和讨论的正式集会。
讲座；由讲者向听众系统讲解某个主题的活动。

collocations.en: to attend a conference or lecture

formal.mt: L-università se torganizza konferenza internazzjonali dwar it-tagħlim tal-lingwi.
formal.en: The university will organize an international conference on language teaching.
formal.zh: 大学将组织一场关于语言教学的国际会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tiġi għall-konferenza dwar l-istorja ta' Malta? Pawlu: Iva, nixtieq nisma' t-taħdita u nistaqsi xi mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you coming to the lecture on Malta's history? Pawlu: Yes, I'd like to listen to the talk and ask a few questions.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会来听关于马耳他历史的讲座吗？保罗：会，我想听听讲解，再问几个问题。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tiġi għall-konferenza dwar l-istorja ta' Malta?
messages.mt_standard: Se tiġi għall-konferenza dwar l-istorja ta' Malta?
messages.zh: 你会来听关于马耳他历史的讲座吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the lecture on Malta's history?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nisma' t-taħdita u nistaqsi xi mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nisma' t-taħdita u nistaqsi xi mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 会，我想听听讲解，再问几个问题。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to listen to the talk and ask a few questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张活动海报：多人交流是会议，一人主讲是讲座；konferenza 的具体意思由活动形式判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An additional idea, feeling, or association suggested by a word or expression beyond its basic meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词语或表达在基本意义之外引起的附加观念、感受或联想。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idea, sensazzjoni jew assoċjazzjoni li tqajjem kelma jew espressjoni lil hinn mit-tifsira bażika tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐含意义；词语除基本意义之外所带来的感情色彩或联想。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma 'dar' għandha konnotazzjoni ta' sigurtà u mħabba.
formal.en: In this text, the word 'home' has a connotation of safety and love.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，“家”这个词带有安全与关爱的联想。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-kelma tinstema' ftit kerha, hux? Mark: Iva, għandha konnotazzjoni negattiva; aħjar nużaw kelma oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: This word sounds a little unpleasant, doesn't it? Mark: Yes, it has a negative connotation; we'd better use another word.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个词听起来有点不好听，对吧？马克：是的，它带有负面色彩；我们最好换个词。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kelma tinstema' ftit kerha, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kelma tinstema' ftit kerha, hux?
messages.zh: 这个词听起来有点不好听，对吧？
messages.en: This word sounds a little unpleasant, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha konnotazzjoni negattiva; aħjar nużaw kelma oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha konnotazzjoni negattiva; aħjar nużaw kelma oħra.
messages.zh: 是的，它带有负面色彩；我们最好换个词。
messages.en: Yes, it has a negative connotation; we'd better use another word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词语想成一杯茶：字面意义是茶水，听后留下的情感余味就是 konnotazzjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An account used to record money or access a service, or a document stating an amount to be paid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于记录资金或使用服务的账户，也可指列明应付金额的账单或发票。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġistru biex jinżammu flus jew jintuża servizz, jew dokument li juri l-ammont li għandu jitħallas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 账户；用于存取资金、记录交易或使用某项服务的个人或机构记录。
账单；列明商品或服务费用以及应付金额的单据。
发票；由卖方开具、列明交易项目及应付金额的商业单据。

collocations.en: to issue an invoice to the client

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija bagħtet kont lill-klijent għas-servizzi mogħtija matul ix-xahar.
formal.en: The company sent the client an invoice for the services provided during the month.
formal.zh: 公司向客户发送了发票，列明该月所提供服务的费用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' jkolli l-kont, jekk jogħġbok? Rita: Żgur, inġiblek il-kont issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Could I have the bill, please? Rita: Certainly, I'll bring you the bill now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：麻烦给我账单，好吗？丽塔：当然，我现在就把账单拿来。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 麻烦给我账单，好吗？
messages.en: Could I have the bill, please?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.zh: 当然，我现在就把账单拿来。
messages.en: Certainly, I'll bring you the bill now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景记 kont：银行里是账户，餐桌上是账单，商业交易中可以是发票。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Opposed to a person, idea, or action, or facing an opponent in a contest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示持反对立场的，或在比赛中与对手相对的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi oppożizzjoni għal persuna, idea jew azzjoni, jew li jindika min qed jiffaċċja avversarju f'kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反对的；处于不赞成或与之对立的立场。
对阵的；表示比赛或较量中双方相对。
反对；与……对抗，连接所反对或对抗的对象。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ivvota kontra l-proposta minħabba l-ispejjeż għoljin.
formal.en: The committee voted against the proposal because of the high costs.
formal.zh: 委员会因成本过高而投票反对该提议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kontra min se nilagħbu għada? Ben: Kontra t-tim tal-iskola l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who are we playing against tomorrow? Ben: Against the team from the other school.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们明天和谁比赛？本：和另一所学校的队伍比赛。

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.zh: 我们明天和谁比赛？
messages.en: Who are we playing against tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ben (队友)
messages.zh: 和另一所学校的队伍比赛。
messages.en: Against the team from the other school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人面对面站在两边：讨论时表示反对，赛场上表示对阵，都可用 kontra 联系记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something given or done to help a person, project, activity, or shared purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为帮助他人、项目、活动或共同目标而提供的事物或付出的努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tingħata jew issir biex tgħin persuna, proġett, attività jew għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贡献；为某项事业或共同目标提供的帮助、投入或成果。

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera taw kontribut importanti għat-titjib tal-ġnien pubbliku.
formal.en: The volunteers made an important contribution to improving the public garden.
formal.zh: 志愿者为改善公共花园作出了重要贡献。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif nista' nagħti kontribut għall-proġett? David: Tista' tgħinna tiġbor l-ideat u tikteb ir-rapport.
colloquial.en: Anna: How can I contribute to the project? David: You can help us collect ideas and write the report.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我能为这个项目作些什么贡献？戴维：你可以帮我们收集想法并撰写报告。

messages.speaker: Anna (项目组成员)
messages.zh: 我能为这个项目作些什么贡献？
messages.en: How can I contribute to the project?

messages.speaker: David (项目组长)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinna tiġbor l-ideat u tikteb ir-rapport.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinna tiġbor l-ideat u tikteb ir-rapport.
messages.zh: 你可以帮我们收集想法并撰写报告。
messages.en: You can help us collect ideas and write the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把共同项目想成拼图，每个人放上的一块都是 kontribut；时间、想法和劳动都能成为贡献。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money, goods, or other support given to help a person, organization, activity, or shared purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为帮助个人、组织、活动或共同目标而给予的钱款、物品或其他支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus, oġġetti jew għajnuna oħra li jingħataw biex jgħinu persuna, għaqda, attività jew għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捐款；捐赠；为支持他人或某项事业而自愿给予的钱款或物品。
贡献；为某项活动或共同目标提供的资金、物品或其他支持。

collocations.en: to make a donation or contribution

formal.mt: L-għaqda rċeviet kontribuzzjoni finanzjarja biex tixtri kotba għat-tfal.
formal.en: The organization received a financial contribution to buy books for children.
formal.zh: 该组织收到了一笔用于为儿童购买图书的捐助。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nista' nagħmel kontribuzzjoni żgħira għall-ġbir tal-fondi? Ġużeppi: Dażgur, kull kontribuzzjoni tgħin.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can I make a small donation to the fundraiser? Ġużeppi: Of course, every contribution helps.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我可以为这次筹款捐一点钱吗？朱塞佩：当然，每一份捐助都有帮助。

messages.speaker: Marija (捐赠者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nagħmel kontribuzzjoni żgħira għall-ġbir tal-fondi?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nagħmel kontribuzzjoni żgħira għall-ġbir tal-fondi?
messages.zh: 我可以为这次筹款捐一点钱吗？
messages.en: Can I make a small donation to the fundraiser?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (筹款志愿者)
messages.zh: 当然，每一份捐助都有帮助。
messages.en: Of course, every contribution helps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把钱款或物品交到筹款桌上，这份支持就是 kontribuzzjoni；再把画面扩展到其他形式的贡献。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Financial protection provided by insurance, or something that covers or protects a surface or object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保险提供的经济保障，也可指用于覆盖或保护表面、物体的覆盖物或遮盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Protezzjoni finanzjarja mogħtija minn assigurazzjoni, jew xi ħaġa li tgħatti jew tipproteġi wiċċ jew oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保险保障；保险在约定范围内为损失提供的经济保障。
覆盖物；覆盖层；铺设或附着在某物表面以遮盖或保护它的材料。
遮盖；罩子或其他用于覆盖、保护物体的东西。

formal.mt: Il-polza tipprovdi kopertura kontra s-serq skont il-kundizzjonijiet imniżżla fid-dokument.
formal.en: The policy provides cover against theft under the conditions stated in the document.
formal.zh: 该保险单按照文件列明的条件提供盗窃损失保障。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandna kopertura għall-mejda li hemm barra? Toni: Iva, hemm waħda fil-garaxx; ejja ngħattuha qabel tagħmel ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do we have a cover for the table outside? Toni: Yes, there's one in the garage; let's cover it before it rains.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们有罩子可以盖住外面的桌子吗？托尼：有，车库里有一个；趁还没下雨，我们把桌子盖起来吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna kopertura għall-mejda li hemm barra?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna kopertura għall-mejda li hemm barra?
messages.zh: 我们有罩子可以盖住外面的桌子吗？
messages.en: Do we have a cover for the table outside?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda fil-garaxx; ejja ngħattuha qabel tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda fil-garaxx; ejja ngħattuha qabel tagħmel ix-xita.
messages.zh: 有，车库里有一个；趁还没下雨，我们把桌子盖起来吧。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in the garage; let's cover it before it rains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅保护画面记 kopertura：罩子覆盖桌面，保险承担约定损失；借助场景区分实物覆盖与经济保障。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Two people considered together as a pair, especially two people in a romantic relationship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被看作一对的两个人，尤其指有恋爱或婚姻关系的两个人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żewġ persuni meqjusa flimkien bħala par, speċjalment żewġ persuni f'relazzjoni ta' mħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 情侣；夫妻；有恋爱或婚姻关系的一对人。
一对人；被一起考虑或安排在一起的两个人。

formal.mt: Kull koppja ta' żeffiena għandha tippreżenta żifna qasira quddiem il-ġurija.
formal.en: Each pair of dancers must perform a short dance before the judging panel.
formal.zh: 每对舞者都须在评审团面前表演一段短舞。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dawk it-tnejn huma koppja? Luqa: Iva, ilhom flimkien sentejn.
colloquial.en: Elena: Are those two a couple? Luqa: Yes, they've been together for two years.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：那两个人是一对吗？卢卡：是的，他们在一起两年了。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 那两个人是一对吗？
messages.en: Are those two a couple?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他们在一起两年了。
messages.en: Yes, they've been together for two years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 koppja 就想象两个人并肩站着：可以是情侣夫妻，也可以是在活动中组成一对的两个人。

gloss_zh: 覆盖；承担费用；占一定份额

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something over a surface, or to provide enough to meet a cost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用某物盖住表面，或支付、承担某项费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għatta wiċċ b'xi ħaġa, jew ħallas l-ammont meħtieġ għal spiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 覆盖；盖住；支付或承担费用。
占总数、总额或整体中的某一部分。

formal.mt: Il-finanzjament kopra l-ispejjeż kollha tal-proġett.
formal.en: The funding covered all the project's expenses.
formal.zh: 这笔资助承担了项目的全部费用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min kopra l-mejda b'dan id-drapp? Mark: Jien, biex nipproteġiha waqt ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who covered the table with this cloth? Mark: I did, to protect it while we work.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁用这块布把桌子盖起来了？马克：我盖的，为了在我们干活时保护桌子。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁用这块布把桌子盖起来了？
messages.en: Who covered the table with this cloth?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我盖的，为了在我们干活时保护桌子。
messages.en: I did, to protect it while we work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把盖住桌面和承担账单连成两幅画面：一块布覆盖桌子，一笔钱覆盖费用；本词条的 kopra 可放进过去发生的事件中记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very strong feeling of anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈的愤怒情绪，常指盛怒或暴怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabja qawwija ħafna li persuna tħoss jew turi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛怒；强烈的愤怒。
暴怒；怒火；盛怒。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, ir-raġel esprima l-korla tiegħu dwar it-trattament inġust.
formal.en: In his letter, the man expressed his anger about the unfair treatment.
formal.zh: 这名男子在信中表达了对不公待遇的愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titkellem bil-korla? Pawlu: Għax ħadu l-affarijiet tiegħi mingħajr ma staqsewni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you speaking so angrily? Pawlu: Because they took my things without asking me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么这么生气地说话？保罗：因为他们没问过我就拿走了我的东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么生气地说话？
messages.en: Why are you speaking so angrily?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħadu l-affarijiet tiegħi mingħajr ma staqsewni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħadu l-affarijiet tiegħi mingħajr ma staqsewni.
messages.zh: 因为他们没问过我就拿走了我的东西。
messages.en: Because they took my things without asking me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人怒气冲冲地开口，把 korla 与强烈怒火相连；再整组记住 bil-korla，表示带着怒气地说话或做事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Right or accurate, with no mistake in the relevant detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合事实、规则或要求的；有关细节没有错误、准确无误的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaqbel mal-fatti jew mar-regoli u ma fihx żball.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正确的；没有错误的。
精确的；准确的。
对的；正确的；符合要求的。

formal.mt: Qabel tibgħat il-formola, ivverifika li n-numru ta' referenza huwa korrett.
formal.en: Before sending the form, verify that the reference number is correct.
formal.zh: 发送表格前，请核实参考编号是否正确。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan hu n-numru korrett? David: Iva, ċempiltlu dalgħodu u weġibni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this the correct number? David: Yes, I called him this morning and he answered.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个号码对吗？戴维：对，我今天早上打给他，他接了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这个号码对吗？
messages.en: Is this the correct number?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 对，我今天早上打给他，他接了。
messages.en: Yes, I called him this morning and he answered.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 korrett 想成作业旁的一个对勾：号码对、答案对、测量准确都可联系这一形容词；可借英语 correct 的外形辅助记忆。

gloss_zh: 课程；进程；事态发展过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized programme of study, or the course in which events develop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有组织的学习课程，也可指事件发展所经历的过程或进程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Programm organizzat ta' tagħlim, jew il-mod kif jiżviluppaw il-ġrajjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 课程；过程或进程，具体含义由语境决定。
事件的发展过程；事态的进程。
课程；作为学习项目的科目。

formal.mt: Dan il-kors jinkludi lezzjonijiet tal-grammatika u eżerċizzji ta' konversazzjoni.
formal.en: This course includes grammar lessons and conversation exercises.
formal.zh: 这门课程包括语法课和会话练习。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema kors se tieħu? Mark: Se nieħu kors tal-Malti għax irrid nitkellem aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which course are you going to take? Mark: I'm going to take a Maltese course because I want to speak better.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你打算上哪门课？马克：我打算上马耳他语课，因为我想说得更好。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你打算上哪门课？
messages.en: Which course are you going to take?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nieħu kors tal-Malti għax irrid nitkellem aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Se nieħu kors tal-Malti għax irrid nitkellem aħjar.
messages.zh: 我打算上马耳他语课，因为我想说得更好。
messages.en: I'm going to take a Maltese course because I want to speak better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kors 画成一条依次前进的学习线：一节接一节是课程，一件接一件是事态进程；用相同的顺序画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A track used for racing, especially horse racing; also a trip by sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供竞赛使用的赛道，尤指赛马跑道；也可指一次海上航程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mogħdija għat-tiġrijiet, speċjalment taż-żwiemel; ukoll vjaġġ bil-baħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: racing track (often in the context of horse racing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞赛跑道；赛道，常用于赛马语境。
海上旅行；一次海上航程。
跑道；供运动或竞赛使用的路线。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tiġrija, l-organizzaturi spezzjonaw il-korsa biex jiżguraw is-sigurtà taż-żwiemel.
formal.en: Before the race, the organizers inspected the track to ensure the horses' safety.
formal.zh: 比赛前，组织者检查了赛道，以确保马匹的安全。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se naraw iż-żwiemel jiġru? Toni: Ħdejn il-korsa; minn hemm narawhom sew.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are we going to watch the horses race? Toni: Beside the track; we'll have a good view from there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们要在哪里看赛马？托尼：在赛道旁边；从那里看得清楚。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们要在哪里看赛马？
messages.en: Where are we going to watch the horses race?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-korsa; minn hemm narawhom sew.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-korsa; minn hemm narawhom sew.
messages.zh: 在赛道旁边；从那里看得清楚。
messages.en: Beside the track; we'll have a good view from there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 korsa 配两张记忆卡：一张画马沿赛道奔跑，另一张画船完成海上航程；读句子时用赛马或海船的场景判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lane or passage for movement; also the current of a river.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供车辆或人通行的车道、通道；也可指河流中的水流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti tat-triq għall-vetturi jew passaġġ għan-nies; ukoll il-kurrent ta' xmara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车道；道路上划分出的行驶通道。
河流的水流；河中的流动水体。
供人通过的通道、过道。

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom iżommu l-korsija bejn is-siġġijiet ħielsa mill-bagalji.
formal.en: Passengers should keep the aisle between the seats clear of luggage.
formal.zh: 乘客应保持座位之间的过道畅通，不要放置行李。

colloquial.mt: Sara: F'liema korsija għandi nibqa'? David: Ibqa' fil-korsija tax-xellug sa ma naslu fid-dawra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which lane should I stay in? David: Stay in the left lane until we reach the bend.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我应该保持在哪条车道上？戴维：保持在左侧车道，直到我们到达弯道。

messages.speaker: Sara (驾驶学员)
messages.zh: 我应该保持在哪条车道上？
messages.en: Which lane should I stay in?

messages.speaker: David (驾驶教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibqa' fil-korsija tax-xellug sa ma naslu fid-dawra.
messages.mt_standard: Ibqa' fil-korsija tax-xellug sa ma naslu fid-dawra.
messages.zh: 保持在左侧车道，直到我们到达弯道。
messages.en: Stay in the left lane until we reach the bend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象三条流动的线：车沿车道走、人沿过道走、水沿河流动；把三个画面并列在 korsija 旁，分别记住它的三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coriander, an aromatic plant whose leaves and seeds are used in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 芫荽，也叫香菜，是叶和种子可用于烹饪调味的芳香植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta aromatika li l-weraq u ż-żrieragħ tagħha jintużaw fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芫荽；香菜，也可依烹饪语境指其叶或种子。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li jiżdiedu l-weraq tal-kosbor fl-aħħar tat-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe calls for coriander leaves to be added at the end of cooking.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在烹饪结束时加入香菜叶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit kosbor fuq is-soppa? Pawlu: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some coriander on the soup? Pawlu: Yes, but just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：汤上要加一点香菜吗？保罗：要，不过请只加一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 汤上要加一点香菜吗？
messages.en: Would you like some coriander on the soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，不过请只加一点。
messages.en: Yes, but just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kosbor 写在香菜的厨房标签上，旁边画绿叶和小种子；用 weraq 记叶、żrieragħ 记种子，帮助区分菜谱中的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way something is constituted, or the fundamental legal rules by which a state is governed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物的组成方式或组织结构；也指规定国家基本制度的宪法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif xi ħaġa hija magħmula jew organizzata, jew il-liġi fundamentali ta' stat.

sense_translations.en_definition: constitution (manner in which sth. is constituted)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 构成；某事物的组成方式或组织结构。
宪法；规定国家基本制度和治理原则的根本法律。
构成、组织结构；在国家法律语境中指宪法。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kostituzzjoni tal-kumitat hija deskritta permezz tar-rwoli u l-għadd tal-membri tiegħu.
formal.en: In the report, the committee's constitution is described in terms of its members' roles and number.
formal.zh: 报告通过成员的职责和人数描述了委员会的组成结构。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tistudja llum? Mark: Il-Kostituzzjoni ta' Malta; għada għandna diskussjoni fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you studying today? Mark: The Constitution of Malta; we have a class discussion tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天在学什么？马克：马耳他宪法；我们明天要在课堂上讨论。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Kostituzzjoni ta' Malta; għada għandna diskussjoni fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-Kostituzzjoni ta' Malta; għada għandna diskussjoni fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 马耳他宪法；我们明天要在课堂上讨论。
messages.en: The Constitution of Malta; we have a class discussion tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kostituzzjoni 配上两幅图：成员组成表帮助记构成，国家根本法律的书本帮助记宪法；先看语境，再选择对应的中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become greater in number or amount, or to multiply and spread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量或程度增加；也可指生物繁殖增多或逐渐蔓延。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fl-għadd jew fil-kwantità, jew jitkattar u jinfirex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；增多。
蔓延；扩散开来。
繁殖；成倍增多。
繁殖增多；数量变得更多。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xahar li għadda, kotor ix-xogħol fl-uffiċċju.
formal.en: During the past month, the workload in the office increased.
formal.zh: 过去一个月，办公室的工作量增加了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tasal id-dar daqshekk tard? Toni: Kotor ix-xogħol din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you getting home so late? Toni: The workload has increased this week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么这么晚才到家？托尼：这星期工作量增加了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tasal id-dar daqshekk tard?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tasal id-dar daqshekk tard?
messages.zh: 你怎么这么晚才到家？
messages.en: Why are you getting home so late?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 这星期工作量增加了。
messages.en: The workload has increased this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把工作单越堆越高的画面与 kotor 联系起来，记住核心是数量变多，再联想到繁殖和蔓延。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large group of people, or ordinary people considered collectively as the general public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚集在一起的一大群人；也指作为整体的普通民众或社会大众。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp kbir ta' nies, jew in-nies b'mod ġenerali meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人群；聚集在一起的许多人。
公众；社会大众。
广大民众；普通大众。

formal.mt: Kotra ta' nies inġabret fil-pjazza biex tisma' d-diskors.
formal.en: A crowd of people gathered in the square to listen to the speech.
formal.zh: 一大群人聚集在广场上聆听演讲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu? Mark: Hemm kotra ta' nies quddiem il-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we get through? Mark: There's a crowd of people in front of the shop.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们怎么过不去？马克：商店前面有一大群人。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们怎么过不去？
messages.en: Why can't we get through?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kotra ta' nies quddiem il-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kotra ta' nies quddiem il-ħanut.
messages.zh: 商店前面有一大群人。
messages.en: There's a crowd of people in front of the shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广场挤满人的画面，用 kotra 指这一整群人；把镜头拉远，就能联想到社会大众。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outer garment worn over other clothes for warmth or protection from the weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在其他衣服外面，用来保暖或抵御风雨的外套、大衣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Libsa li tintlibes fuq ħwejjeġ oħra biex iżżomm is-sħana jew tipproteġi mit-temp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外套；大衣，通常穿在其他衣服外面。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-kesħa, kull student għandu jġib kowt sħun għall-ħarġa.
formal.en: Because of the cold, every student should bring a warm coat for the outing.
formal.zh: 由于天气寒冷，每位学生都应为此次出游带上一件保暖外套。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ħu l-kowt miegħek; barra qed jagħmel il-bard. Ben: Sewwa, se nilbsu qabel noħroġ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Take your coat with you; it's cold outside. Ben: Okay, I'll put it on before I go out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：带上外套，外面很冷。本：好，我出门前就穿上。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu l-kowt miegħek; barra qed jagħmel il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu l-kowt miegħek; barra qed jagħmel il-bard.
messages.zh: 带上外套，外面很冷。
messages.en: Take your coat with you; it's cold outside.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，我出门前就穿上。
messages.en: Okay, I'll put it on before I go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kowt 与英语 coat 配成一张双语衣物卡，画上出门前披外套的动作，帮助记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the leg between the hip and the knee; also an upright side of a door or window frame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 髋部与膝盖之间的大腿部分；也指门框或窗框直立的侧边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tas-sieq bejn il-ġenbejn u l-irkoppa; ukoll il-ġenb wieqaf tal-qafas ta' bieb jew tieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大腿；髋部至膝盖之间的腿部。

sense_translations.en_definition: the jamb of a door or window
sense_translations.zh_definition: 门框或窗框的直立侧边；门侧框或窗侧框。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa kejjel il-koxxa tal-bieb qabel beda t-tiswija.
formal.en: The carpenter measured the door jamb before starting the repair.
formal.zh: 木匠开始修理前测量了门框的侧边。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn weġġajt meta waqajt? Pawlu: Fil-koxxa, eżatt fuq l-irkoppa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did you hurt yourself when you fell? Pawlu: On my thigh, just above the knee.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你摔倒时伤到哪里了？保罗：大腿，就在膝盖上方。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你摔倒时伤到哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you hurt yourself when you fell?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 大腿，就在膝盖上方。
messages.en: On my thigh, just above the knee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 koxxa 画两张词义卡：一张标出膝盖上方的大腿，一张标出门框侧边，用不同场景区分两义。

gloss_zh: 后颈；腰脊肉；另有一义原文不可辨

teaching_sense.en_definition: The back of the neck; in a meat-cutting context, a loin cut.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颈部的后侧，即后颈；在肉类分割语境中，也指腰脊部位的肉块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' wara tal-għonq; fil-kuntest tal-laħam, qatgħa mill-parti tal-ġenbejn tal-annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原始释义文字不可辨认，无法确定此义的中文释义。
后颈；颈部的后侧。
腰脊肉；取自动物腰脊部位的肉块。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla, il-kok ipprepara kozz tal-majjal bil-ħaxix.
formal.en: For the meal, the chef prepared pork loin with vegetables.
formal.zh: 厨师为这顿饭准备了配蔬菜的猪腰脊肉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qed tħoss l-uġigħ? Toni: Fil-kozz, fuq wara ta' għonqi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you feel the pain? Toni: In my nape, at the back of my neck.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哪里疼？托尼：后颈，就是脖子后面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哪里疼？
messages.en: Where do you feel the pain?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 后颈，就是脖子后面。
messages.en: In my nape, at the back of my neck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 kozz 时分开画人体后颈和肉铺腰脊肉两张卡；不可辨认的释义留空，不凭想象补义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bony structure of the head that surrounds and protects the brain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成头部、包围并保护大脑的骨性结构，即颅骨或头骨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istruttura tal-għadam tar-ras li ddawwar u tipproteġi l-moħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头骨；构成头部骨架的骨性结构。
颅骨；包围并保护脑部的骨性结构。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tax-xjenza, l-għalliema użat mudell tal-kranju biex turi kif il-moħħ huwa protett.
formal.en: During the science lesson, the teacher used a skull model to show how the brain is protected.
formal.zh: 科学课上，老师用颅骨模型展示大脑如何受到保护。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-mudell fuq il-mejda? Leo: Huwa mudell tal-kranju; nużawh fil-lezzjoni tax-xjenza.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that model on the table? Leo: It's a skull model; we use it in science class.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：桌上那个是什么模型？利奥：是颅骨模型，我们科学课上会用到。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 桌上那个是什么模型？
messages.en: What's that model on the table?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mudell tal-kranju; nużawh fil-lezzjoni tax-xjenza.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mudell tal-kranju; nużawh fil-lezzjoni tax-xjenza.
messages.zh: 是颅骨模型，我们科学课上会用到。
messages.en: It's a skull model; we use it in science class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kranju 想成保护大脑的硬壳，在头部示意图上圈出骨骼，记住它指头骨而不是大脑本身。

gloss_zh: 有创造力的；富有创意的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to produce original ideas, or showing imagination in making or solving something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够提出新颖想法的；或在创作、制作及解决问题时表现出想象力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li kapaċi joħroġ b'ideat oriġinali jew juża l-immaġinazzjoni biex joħloq xi ħaġa jew isolvi problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有创造力的；富有创意或想象力的。

collocations.zh: 创意工作；富有创意的作品

formal.mt: Il-proġett jinkoraġġixxi ħsieb kreattiv biex l-istudenti jsibu soluzzjonijiet ġodda.
formal.en: The project encourages creative thinking so that students can find new solutions.
formal.zh: 这个项目鼓励创造性思维，帮助学生找到新的解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kartellun għamiltu int? Mark: Iva, ridt nagħmel xi ħaġa kreattiva b'karti qodma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you make this poster? Mark: Yes, I wanted to make something creative with old paper.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张海报是你做的吗？马克：是的，我想用旧纸做点有创意的东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这张海报是你做的吗？
messages.en: Did you make this poster?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ridt nagħmel xi ħaġa kreattiva b'karti qodma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ridt nagħmel xi ħaġa kreattiva b'karti qodma.
messages.zh: 是的，我想用旧纸做点有创意的东西。
messages.en: Yes, I wanted to make something creative with old paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kreattiv 与旧纸变海报的创作画面相连；同时记住修饰 xi ħaġa 时，例句使用 kreattiva。

gloss_zh: 信用；赊购额度；账户余额

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement allowing payment later, or an amount available in an account to pay for goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 允许先取得商品或服务、以后付款的信用安排；也指账户中可用于支付的额度或余额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li jippermetti ħlas aktar tard, jew ammont disponibbli f'kont biex jitħallsu prodotti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信用；赊购或延期付款的额度，也可指账户中可使用的余额，如手机话费余额。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut jippermetti lill-klijenti jixtru bil-kreditu u jħallsu fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The shop allows customers to buy on credit and pay at the end of the month.
formal.zh: 这家商店允许顾客赊购，并在月底付款。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma ċempiltlix? Ben: Ma kellix kreditu fuq il-mowbajl, imma issa żidt ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why didn't you call me? Ben: I had no credit on my phone, but I've topped it up now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么没给我打电话？本：我手机没话费了，不过现在已经充了一点。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么没给我打电话？
messages.en: Why didn't you call me?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma kellix kreditu fuq il-mowbajl, imma issa żidt ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ma kellix kreditu fuq il-mowbajl, imma issa żidt ftit.
messages.zh: 我手机没话费了，不过现在已经充了一点。
messages.en: I had no credit on my phone, but I've topped it up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kreditu 配两幅消费画面：商店先买后付、手机充值后通话；借场景区分信用付款与可用余额。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cream used in food or skin care; also a pale creamy colour or, figuratively, the best part of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于食品的奶油或用于护肤的乳霜；也可指奶油色，或比喻某事物中最优秀的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott tal-ħalib jew preparazzjoni għall-ġilda; ukoll kulur ċar jew, b'mod figurattiv, l-aħjar parti ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奶油；乳霜，具体含义由食品或护肤等语境决定。
奶油；牛奶中富含脂肪的部分。
奶油色；带淡黄色的乳白色。
精华；某个群体或事物中最优秀的部分。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob mitejn millilitru ta' krema friska, li għandha tiżdied lejn l-aħħar tat-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe calls for two hundred millilitres of fresh cream, which should be added towards the end of cooking.
formal.zh: 食谱需要二百毫升鲜奶油，应在烹饪接近结束时加入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit krema mal-kejk? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma ftit biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some cream with the cake? Mark: Yes, please, but just a little.
colloquial.zh: Maja：蛋糕要配点奶油吗？Mark：好的，谢谢，不过一点点就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 蛋糕要配点奶油吗？
messages.en: Would you like some cream with the cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma ftit biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma ftit biss.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，不过一点点就够了。
messages.en: Yes, please, but just a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅画记 krema：蛋糕上的奶油、手上的乳霜、奶油色墙壁，以及代表群体精华的最佳成员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become ugly in appearance or despicable in character or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外表变得丑陋，或品性、行为变得卑劣可鄙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ikrah fid-dehra jew jistmerr fil-karattru jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变丑；外观变得难看。
变得丑陋，或变得卑劣、令人鄙视。

collocations.zh: 随着时间推移变得难看
因疏于照料而变得难看

formal.mt: Il-ġnien pubbliku krieh minħabba t-telqa u n-nuqqas ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The public garden became ugly through neglect and a lack of maintenance.
formal.zh: 这座公共花园因无人照料、缺乏维护而变得难看。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħajt krieh maż-żmien. Pawlu: Veru, għandu bżonn ftit żebgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: This wall has become ugly over time. Pawlu: True, it needs some paint.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这面墙年久变难看了。Pawlu：确实，需要刷点漆了。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 这面墙年久变难看了。
messages.en: This wall has become ugly over time.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 确实，需要刷点漆了。
messages.en: True, it needs some paint.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象墙壁从整洁变成斑驳：krieh 强调发生了“变丑”的变化；用于品行时，则是变得可鄙。

gloss_zh: 克罗地亚的；克罗地亚人；克罗地亚语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Croatia, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自克罗地亚的，或与克罗地亚及其人民、文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Kroazja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Kroazja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 克罗地亚的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Croatia
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自克罗地亚的；与克罗地亚有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Croatian (of, from or relating to Croatia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 克罗地亚的、来自克罗地亚的，或与克罗地亚相关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Croatian (native or inhabitant of Croatia) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 克罗地亚人；克罗地亚本地人或居民，通常指男性。
克罗地亚语。

formal.mt: Il-mużew organizza taħdita dwar ix-xogħol ta' kittieb kroat u l-kuntest kulturali tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum organised a lecture on the work of a Croatian writer and his cultural context.
formal.zh: 博物馆举办了一场讲座，介绍一位克罗地亚作家的作品及其文化背景。

colloquial.en: Sara: Are you learning Croatian? Ivan: Yes, because a friend of mine is Croatian and I want to speak to him in his language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕克罗地亚画三个格子：修饰作家时是形容词，指当地人时是人名词，指所学语言时是语言名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A leafy vegetable referred to as kale or cabbage, according to the sense intended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种食用叶菜；按具体词义可指羽衣甘蓝或卷心菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix li jittiekel għall-weraq tiegħu u li jista' jkollu weraq miftuħ jew miġbur f'ras.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羽衣甘蓝；食用其展开叶片的甘蓝类蔬菜。
卷心菜；叶片紧密包成菜球的甘蓝。

collocations.zh: 羽衣甘蓝叶或卷心菜叶
羽衣甘蓝汤或卷心菜汤
水煮羽衣甘蓝或卷心菜

formal.mt: Aħsel il-weraq tal-kromb sew, qattgħu f'biċċiet żgħar u żidu mas-soppa.
formal.en: Wash the cabbage leaves thoroughly, cut them into small pieces and add them to the soup.
formal.zh: 将卷心菜叶彻底洗净，切成小块，再加入汤中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nsajru bil-kromb? Toni: Nagħmlu soppa bil-patata u l-karrotti.
colloquial.en: Nina: What shall we cook with the cabbage? Toni: Let's make soup with potatoes and carrots.

messages.zh: 这些卷心菜拿来做什么好？
messages.en: What shall we cook with the cabbage?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 我们加土豆和胡萝卜煮汤吧。
messages.en: Let's make soup with potatoes and carrots.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Arranged or presented in the order in which events happened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照事件发生的先后时间排列或叙述的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsegwi l-ordni taż-żmien li fih seħħew il-ġrajjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按时间先后顺序的；编年的。

collocations.zh: 按时间顺序撰写的报告

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta l-avvenimenti f'ordni kronoloġiku, mill-ewwel laqgħa sal-ftehim finali.
formal.en: The report presents the events in chronological order, from the first meeting to the final agreement.
formal.zh: 报告按时间顺序叙述各项事件，从首次会议一直写到最终协议达成。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: F'ordni kronoloġiku, mill-eqdem sal-aktar wieħed riċenti.

gloss_zh: 丑陋；丑恶或可鄙的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ugliness, or something that is ugly or despicable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丑陋这种性质；也可指某个难看、丑恶或可鄙的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' dak li hu ikrah, jew xi ħaġa kerha jew ta' min jistmerrha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丑陋；外观难看或品性丑恶的性质。
丑陋或可鄙的东西；令人厌恶的事物。

formal.mt: Il-kruha tal-bini abbandunat tnaqqas mill-ġmiel tal-pjazza.
formal.en: The ugliness of the abandoned buildings detracts from the beauty of the square.
formal.zh: 废弃建筑的丑陋外观损害了广场的美感。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'taħseb dwar dik l-istatwa? Ben: Għalija hija kruha, imma nifhem li lilek togħġbok.
colloquial.en: Rita: What do you think of that statue? Ben: To me, it's an ugly thing, but I understand that you like it.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你觉得那座雕像怎么样？Ben：我觉得它很难看，不过我理解你喜欢它。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得那座雕像怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of that statue?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija hija kruha, imma nifhem li lilek togħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija hija kruha, imma nifhem li lilek togħġbok.
messages.zh: 我觉得它很难看，不过我理解你喜欢它。
messages.en: To me, it's an ugly thing, but I understand that you like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个名词框记 kruha：一个框装抽象的“丑陋”，另一个框装具体的“难看东西”，两义都能落到名词位置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cold or a chill experienced as low temperature or a feeling of coldness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低温带来的寒冷，或身体感受到的寒意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kesħa jew is-sensazzjoni ta' bard li wieħed iħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒冷；低温所带来的冷。
寒意；一阵令人觉得冷的感觉。

formal.mt: Il-ksieħ ta' filgħodu kien jinħass anki ġewwa l-bini, u għalhekk inżammu t-twieqi magħluqa.
formal.en: The morning chill could be felt even inside the building, so the windows were kept closed.
formal.zh: 即使在楼内也能感到清晨的寒意，因此窗户一直关着。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed inħoss il-ksieħ hawn ġew. Ġużeppi: Nagħlaq it-tieqa u nġiblek kutra.
colloquial.en: Marija: I can feel the chill in here. Ġużeppi: I'll close the window and get you a blanket.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这里面让我觉得冷。Ġużeppi：我把窗户关上，再给你拿条毯子。

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.zh: 这里面让我觉得冷。
messages.en: I can feel the chill in here.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (丈夫)
messages.zh: 我把窗户关上，再给你拿条毯子。
messages.en: I'll close the window and get you a blanket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清晨窗缝吹来冷风，你伸手拿毯子：把 ksieħ 与“寒冷、寒意”这种可感受到的状态连起来记。

gloss_zh: 做作的举动；傻话；愚蠢的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: An affected action, or a silly remark or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装腔作势、不自然的举动，或令人觉得愚蠢的言语、行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni magħmula b'mod affettwat, jew rimarka jew azzjoni bla għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做作的举动；装腔作势、不自然的行为。
傻话或蠢举；欠考虑、显得愚蠢的言行。

collocations.en: to do something silly or affected
collocations.zh: 做出愚蠢或做作的举动

formal.mt: Il-kumment tiegħu tqies bħala ksuħata, għax ma kienx xieraq għal diskussjoni serja.
formal.en: His comment was regarded as a silly remark because it was inappropriate for a serious discussion.
formal.zh: 他的评论被视为傻话，因为它不适合严肃的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Għaliex ma dħaqtx biċ-ċajta tiegħi? Anna: Għax dehritli ksuħata; konna qed nitkellmu fuq xi ħaġa serja.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Why didn't you laugh at my joke? Anna: Because I thought it was silly; we were talking about something serious.
colloquial.zh: Daniel：你为什么没笑我讲的笑话？Anna：因为我觉得那是傻话；我们当时在谈正经事。

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么没笑我讲的笑话？
messages.en: Why didn't you laugh at my joke?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dehritli ksuħata; konna qed nitkellmu fuq xi ħaġa serja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dehritli ksuħata; konna qed nitkellmu fuq xi ħaġa serja.
messages.zh: 因为我觉得那是傻话；我们当时在谈正经事。
messages.en: Because I thought it was silly; we were talking about something serious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象严肃讨论中有人故意摆姿势、又插入一句傻话：把 ksuħata 同时连到“做作举动”和“愚蠢言行”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coldness, especially cold weather; also affected or artificial behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寒冷，通常指天气冷；也可指行为上的矫揉造作、装腔作势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesħa, speċjalment fit-temp; tista' tfisser ukoll imġiba artifiċjali jew affettata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒冷，通常指天气寒冷。
行为上的矫揉造作；装腔作势。
与 ksuħ 同义，表示寒冷。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-ksuħija kbira, l-attività saret ġewwa.
formal.en: Because of the intense cold, the activity took place indoors.
formal.zh: 由于天气严寒，活动在室内举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ksuħija hawn barra! Pawlu: Ejja nidħlu ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: It's so cold out here! Pawlu: Let's go inside.
colloquial.zh: Lara：外面真冷啊！Pawlu：我们进去吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 外面真冷啊！
messages.en: It's so cold out here!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们进去吧。
messages.en: Let's go inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ksuħija 放进“冬天冷得想进屋”的画面记忆；遇到描写人的行为时，再联想到“装腔作势”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element sulfur, also spelled sulphur and known as brimstone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素硫，日常也称硫磺；对应英语 sulfur、sulphur 和 brimstone。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala sulfur jew sulphur, u wkoll bħala brimstone.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硫磺。
硫；硫磺，英语拼写为 sulphur。
硫，化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tintroduċi l-kubrit bħala element kimiku.
formal.en: The lesson introduces sulfur as a chemical element.
formal.zh: 本课介绍硫这一化学元素。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser kubrit bl-Ingliż? David: Sulfur, jew sulphur.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does kubrit mean in English? David: Sulfur, or sulphur.
colloquial.zh: Marta：kubrit 用英语怎么说？David：Sulfur，也可以拼作 sulphur。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: kubrit 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: What does kubrit mean in English?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: Sulfur，也可以拼作 sulphur。
messages.en: Sulfur, or sulphur.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象化学课上的一张标签：kubrit＝硫；把 sulfur、sulphur、brimstone 三个英语名称连到同一张卡片上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A solid geometric shape with six equal square faces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由六个大小相等的正方形面围成的立体图形，即正方体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Korp ġeometriku b'sitt uċuħ kwadri ndaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立方体；正方体。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom ipinġu kubu u jgħoddu l-uċuħ tiegħu.
formal.en: The students should draw a cube and count its faces.
formal.zh: 学生应画出一个正方体，并数出它的面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid kubu tas-silġ fl-ilma? Mark: Iva, wieħed biss, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like an ice cube in your water? Mark: Yes, just one, thanks.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你的水里要加一块冰吗？Mark：要，一块就好，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的水里要加一块冰吗？
messages.en: Would you like an ice cube in your water?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，一块就好，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, just one, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kubu 就在脑中转动一块正方体积木，数出六个正方形面；再用 kubu tas-silġ 联想到杯中的方冰块。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large reptile with a long body, a strong tail and large jaws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鳄鱼，一种身体长、尾巴有力、上下颚较大的爬行动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rettili kbir b'ġisem twil, denb b'saħħtu u ħalq kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鳄鱼。

formal.mt: L-istampa turi kukkudrill ħdejn ix-xmara.
formal.en: The picture shows a crocodile beside the river.
formal.zh: 图片上是一条河边的鳄鱼。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Ara l-kukkudrill fl-istampa! Sam: Kemm għandu denbu twil!
colloquial.en: Ella: Look at the crocodile in the picture! Sam: What a long tail it has!
colloquial.zh: Ella：看图片里的鳄鱼！Sam：它的尾巴真长啊！

messages.speaker: Ella (同学)
messages.zh: 看图片里的鳄鱼！
messages.en: Look at the crocodile in the picture!

messages.speaker: Sam (同学)
messages.zh: 它的尾巴真长啊！
messages.en: What a long tail it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把较长的词 kukkudrill 写在一条长尾鳄鱼的图下，朗读时用手画出长嘴和长尾，让词形与动物形象相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In or to any place, or wherever something happens or someone goes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在任何地方或到任何地方；也可引出“无论在哪里、无论到哪里”的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi kwalunkwe post jew lejn kwalunkwe post; ukoll kull fejn jiġri xi ħaġa jew tmur persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在任何地方；到任何地方。
无论在哪里；无论到哪里。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti jistgħu jaqraw il-materjal kulfejn ikunu.
formal.en: Participants can read the material wherever they are.
formal.zh: 参与者无论身在何处，都可以阅读这些材料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn nistgħu noqogħdu? Ninu: Kulfejn trid; hawn ħafna siġġijiet vojta.
