colloquial.en: Rita: Where can we sit? Ninu: Wherever you want; there are plenty of empty chairs here.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我们可以坐哪里？Ninu：你想坐哪里都行，这里有很多空椅子。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们可以坐哪里？
messages.en: Where can we sit?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulfejn trid; hawn ħafna siġġijiet vojta.
messages.mt_standard: Kulfejn trid; hawn ħafna siġġijiet vojta.
messages.zh: 你想坐哪里都行，这里有很多空椅子。
messages.en: Wherever you want; there are plenty of empty chairs here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上每个地点都可以选择，用 kulfejn trid 记“想去哪儿都行”，再用 kulfejn tmur 记“无论去哪里”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Daily or everyday, describing something that belongs to ordinary life or happens each day, commonly in the phrase ta' kuljum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 每日的；日常的。用于描述每天发生的事情或日常生活中的事物，常见于 ta' kuljum 这一表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel parti mill-ħajja tas-soltu jew li jiġri kull ġurnata, spiss fl-espressjoni ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每日的；每天发生或进行的。
日常的；属于平常生活的。
每天；每一天。
每天；每日，用于说明行为或事件发生的频率。

formal.mt: Il-kors jgħin lill-istudenti jużaw il-Malti fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The course helps students use Maltese in everyday life.
formal.zh: 这门课程帮助学生在日常生活中使用马耳他语。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taqra bil-Malti kuljum? Pawlu: Iva, naqra ftit kuljum qabel norqod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you read in Maltese every day? Pawlu: Yes, I read a little every day before I go to sleep.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你每天都读马耳他语吗？Pawlu：是的，我每天睡前都会读一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你每天都读马耳他语吗？
messages.en: Do you read in Maltese every day?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naqra ftit kuljum qabel norqod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naqra ftit kuljum qabel norqod.
messages.zh: 是的，我每天睡前都会读一点。
messages.en: Yes, I read a little every day before I go to sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上每天都画一个阅读勾，记住 kuljum 是“每天”。再整块记忆 il-ħajja ta' kuljum，把“每天”连接到“日常生活”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Each or every, used before a noun to include all members of a group or all occurrences of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 每一；每个。放在名词前，表示某一群体的每个成员或某类事情的每一次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża qabel nom biex jinkludi l-membri kollha ta' grupp jew id-drabi kollha li tiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每一；各个，着眼于逐个成员。
每个；所有成员中的任意一个都包括在内。
每一；每个，用在名词前表示逐一涵盖。

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jikteb ismu fuq il-formola qabel ma jagħtiha lill-għalliem.
formal.en: Each student must write their name on the form before handing it to the teacher.
formal.zh: 每位学生都必须先在表格上写下姓名，再交给老师。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kull meta niġi hawn, insibek taqra! David: Iva, niġi hawn kull nhar ta' Sibt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Every time I come here, I find you reading! David: Yes, I come here every Saturday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：每次来这里，我都看到你在读书！David：是啊，我每个星期六都来这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kull meta niġi hawn, insibek taqra!
messages.mt_standard: Kull meta niġi hawn, insibek taqra!
messages.zh: 每次来这里，我都看到你在读书！
messages.en: Every time I come here, I find you reading!

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi hawn kull nhar ta' Sibt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi hawn kull nhar ta' Sibt.
messages.zh: 是啊，我每个星期六都来这里。
messages.en: Yes, I come here every Saturday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kull 想成中文名词前的“每”：人、次、周前面都能放一个“每”。连读记住 kull persuna、kull darba、kull ġimgħa 三组搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of jewellery worn around the neck; also a collection or series of related works, such as books.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在脖子上的首饰，即项链；也可指由相关作品组成的丛书或系列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġojjellerija li tintlibes madwar l-għonq; ukoll ġabra jew sensiela ta' xogħlijiet relatati, bħal kotba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 项链；佩戴在颈部的首饰。
丛书；系列；由相关作品组成的集合。

formal.mt: Dan il-volum jagħmel parti minn kullana ta' kotba dwar l-istorja ta' Malta.
formal.en: This volume forms part of a series of books about the history of Malta.
formal.zh: 本卷属于一套介绍马耳他历史的丛书。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-kullana tal-perli kemm tiswa? Marija: Tiswa tletin ewro. Trid tipprovaha?
colloquial.en: Anna: How much does this pearl necklace cost? Marija: It costs thirty euros. Would you like to try it on?
colloquial.zh: Anna：这条珍珠项链多少钱？Marija：三十欧元。你想试戴一下吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这条珍珠项链多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this pearl necklace cost?

messages.speaker: Marija (店员)
messages.zh: 三十欧元。你想试戴一下吗？
messages.en: It costs thirty euros. Would you like to try it on?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面联想两个义项：珍珠一颗颗排成项链，书籍一本本排成系列。两幅画面都贴上 kullana；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In, at, or to every place, or throughout the area being discussed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在所有地方；到处。也可表示遍及当前谈论的整个范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'kull post, jew fil-postijiet kollha tal-inħawi li qed nitkellmu dwarhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到处；处处；在所有地方。

formal.mt: Wara l-maltemp, il-ħaddiema sabu friegħi miksura kullimkien fil-park.
formal.en: After the storm, the workers found broken branches everywhere in the park.
formal.zh: 暴风雨过后，工人们发现公园里到处都是折断的树枝。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fittixt iċ-ċwievet kullimkien u ma sibthomx. Lara: Ħares fuq il-mejda tal-kċina; rajthom hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: I looked everywhere for the keys and couldn't find them. Lara: Look on the kitchen table; I saw them there.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我到处找钥匙，还是没找到。Lara：看看厨房桌子上，我在那里见过。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittixt iċ-ċwievet kullimkien u ma sibthomx.
messages.mt_standard: Fittixt iċ-ċwievet kullimkien u ma sibthomx.
messages.zh: 我到处找钥匙，还是没找到。
messages.en: I looked everywhere for the keys and couldn't find them.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares fuq il-mejda tal-kċina; rajthom hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares fuq il-mejda tal-kċina; rajthom hemm.
messages.zh: 看看厨房桌子上，我在那里见过。
messages.en: Look on the kitchen table; I saw them there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象找钥匙时检查桌上、床下和门边，地图上的每个地点都打勾。用 kullimkien 给“到处都找过”的整幅画面命名，记住它回答地点问题。

gloss_zh: 所……的一切；凡是……的；无论什么

teaching_sense.en_definition: Whatever or everything that, introducing all the things covered by the following statement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所……的一切；凡是……的。引出后续描述所涵盖的全部事物，也可按语境理解为“无论什么”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak kollu li; tintuża biex tirreferi għall-affarijiet kollha li tkopri l-parti tas-sentenza li tiġi warajha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凡是……的；无论什么。
此义项未提供明确释义，具体含义待确定。
无论什么；任何符合后续描述的事物。
凡是……的；所……的一切。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiġbor kulma nafu dwar il-proġett sa issa.
formal.en: The report brings together everything we know about the project so far.
formal.zh: 这份报告汇总了我们目前对该项目所了解的一切。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi nġib xi ħaġa għall-ikla? Toni: Le, għandna kulma għandna bżonn. Ġib lilek innifsek biss!
colloquial.en: Nina: Should I bring anything for the meal? Toni: No, we have everything we need. Just bring yourself!
colloquial.zh: Nina：聚餐需要我带点什么吗？Toni：不用，我们需要的东西都有了。你人来就行！

messages.speaker: Nina (受邀的朋友)
messages.zh: 聚餐需要我带点什么吗？
messages.en: Should I bring anything for the meal?

messages.speaker: Toni (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandna kulma għandna bżonn. Ġib lilek innifsek biss!
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandna kulma għandna bżonn. Ġib lilek innifsek biss!
messages.zh: 不用，我们需要的东西都有了。你人来就行！
messages.en: No, we have everything we need. Just bring yourself!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kulma 想成一个大篮子，后面的描述决定篮子里装什么：kulma naf 装“我知道的一切”，kulma trid 装“你想要的一切”。整块记忆，不把它单独当作疑问词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sometimes or occasionally; on some occasions, rather than regularly or all the time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有时；偶尔。表示某事只在部分时候发生，并非一直发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi drabi; f'ċerti okkażjonijiet, iżda mhux dejjem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偶尔；间或。
有时；在某些时候。

formal.mt: Kultant l-istudenti jkollhom bżonn aktar ħin biex itemmu dan l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: Students sometimes need more time to complete this exercise.
formal.zh: 学生有时需要更多时间来完成这道练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tmur il-baħar kull tmiem il-ġimgħa? Ben: Le, immur kultant, meta jkun sabiħ it-temp.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you go to the seaside every weekend? Ben: No, I go occasionally, when the weather is nice.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你每个周末都去海边吗？Ben：不，天气好的时候偶尔去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你每个周末都去海边吗？
messages.en: Do you go to the seaside every weekend?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, immur kultant, meta jkun sabiħ it-temp.
messages.mt_standard: Le, immur kultant, meta jkun sabiħ it-temp.
messages.zh: 不，天气好的时候偶尔去。
messages.en: No, I go occasionally, when the weather is nice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一页日历上只有零星几天画着去海边的小太阳，用 kultant 表示“偶尔”。与每天都有标记的 kuljum 对照，记住两者频率不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to culture, including the arts, traditions, and shared ways of life of a community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文化的；与某个群体的艺术、传统及共同生活方式有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-kultura, bħall-arti, it-tradizzjonijiet u l-mod ta' ħajja ta' komunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文化的；与艺术、传统、习俗等文化内容有关的。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jorganizza attivitajiet kulturali biex jgħin lill-viżitaturi jifhmu t-tradizzjonijiet lokali.
formal.en: The museum organises cultural activities to help visitors understand local traditions.
formal.zh: 博物馆举办文化活动，帮助参观者了解当地传统。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tiġi miegħi ċ-ċentru kulturali llejla? Pawlu: Iva! X'hemm? Sara: Kunċert u wirja tar-ritratti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like to come with me to the cultural centre tonight? Pawlu: Yes! What's on? Sara: A concert and a photography exhibition.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今晚想和我一起去文化中心吗？Pawlu：好啊！有什么活动？Sara：有音乐会和摄影展。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi miegħi ċ-ċentru kulturali llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi miegħi ċ-ċentru kulturali llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚想和我一起去文化中心吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come with me to the cultural centre tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊！有什么活动？
messages.en: Yes! What's on?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有音乐会和摄影展。
messages.en: A concert and a photography exhibition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kulturali 和英语 cultural 并排做一张词卡，配上音乐会、传统节庆与博物馆三幅图，记住它描述“与文化有关的”，再连读 ċentru kulturali。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A color that something has, or a dye used to give something a color.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体呈现的颜色，也可指用来给物品染色的染料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lewn ta' xi ħaġa, jew sustanza li tintuża biex tagħtiha lewn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颜色；物体呈现的色彩。
染料；用来给头发、布料等染色的物质。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok indika l-kulur tal-prodott fil-formola tal-ordni.
formal.en: Please indicate the color of the product on the order form.
formal.zh: 请在订购表上注明产品的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Liema kulur tippreferi għall-kamra? Pawlu: Nippreferi l-blu, għax ifakkarni fil-baħar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which color do you prefer for the room? Pawlu: I prefer blue because it reminds me of the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你喜欢房间用什么颜色？保罗：我喜欢蓝色，因为它让我想起大海。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢房间用什么颜色？
messages.en: Which color do you prefer for the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢蓝色，因为它让我想起大海。
messages.en: I prefer blue because it reminds me of the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kulur 放在调色盘旁记忆：眼睛看到的是颜色，瓶子里用来染色的则是染料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Everyone in a group, with no person excluded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某一群体中的所有人，强调没有任何人被排除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nies kollha fi grupp, mingħajr ma jitħalla barra ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全体；所有人。
每个人；大家。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa hija miftuħa għal kulħadd, u kull parteċipant jista' jagħmel mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The meeting is open to everyone, and each participant may ask questions.
formal.zh: 会议向所有人开放，每位参与者都可以提问。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kulħadd lest biex nitilqu? Mark: Iva, kulħadd qed jistenniek ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is everyone ready to leave? Mark: Yes, everyone is waiting for you by the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：大家都准备好出发了吗？Mark：是的，大家都在门边等你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家都准备好出发了吗？
messages.en: Is everyone ready to leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd qed jistenniek ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd qed jistenniek ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 是的，大家都在门边等你。
messages.en: Yes, everyone is waiting for you by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出发前逐一点名，一个人也没漏掉，再说 kulħadd。把它和“大家都……”整句联想；例句中用 kulħadd jaf 表示“大家都知道”。

gloss_zh: 委任；委员会；佣金；手续费

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official group appointed to carry out a particular task; also a fee charged for arranging a sale or providing a service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受正式委派执行特定任务的委员会，也可指促成交易或提供服务所收取的佣金、手续费。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies maħtur biex iwettaq xogħol partikolari; ukoll ħlas għal servizz jew talli wieħed jgħin biex isir bejgħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 委任、委员会或佣金；具体含义需结合上下文判断。

sense_translations.en_definition: commission, committee, board (a body or group of people, officially tasked with carrying out a particular function)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 委员会；受正式委派履行某项特定职能的机构或人员群体。
佣金；因提供中介或其他服务而收取的费用。

formal.mt: Il-kummissjoni se teżamina l-proposti u tippreżenta rapport lill-kunsill.
formal.en: The commission will examine the proposals and submit a report to the council.
formal.zh: 委员会将审查这些提案，并向议会提交报告。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm titlob kummissjoni fuq il-bejgħ? Rita: Nitlob tnejn fil-mija tal-prezz tal-bejgħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much commission do you charge on the sale? Rita: I charge two percent of the sale price.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这笔交易你收多少佣金？丽塔：我收成交价的百分之二。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这笔交易你收多少佣金？
messages.en: How much commission do you charge on the sale?

messages.speaker: Rita (经纪人)
messages.zh: 我收成交价的百分之二。
messages.en: I charge two percent of the sale price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 kummissjoni 配两幅图：一桌人开会表示委员会，一张按成交额收费的账单表示佣金。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A requirement or term that must be met, or the state that someone or something is in.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 必须满足的条件或约定条款，也指人或事物所处的状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rekwiżit jew klawżola li trid tiġi rispettata, jew l-istat li fih tkun persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 条款；协议或安排中规定的要求。
条件；须满足的要求；也可指人或事物的状况。

formal.mt: Kundizzjoni tal-ftehim hija li l-ħlas isir qabel il-kunsinna.
formal.en: One condition of the agreement is that payment must be made before delivery.
formal.zh: 协议的一项条件是必须在交货前付款。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din ir-rota għadha f'kundizzjoni tajba? Toni: Iva, kollox jaħdem u t-tajers huma ġodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this bicycle still in good condition? Toni: Yes, everything works and the tires are new.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这辆自行车的状况还好吗？托尼：好，所有部件都能正常使用，轮胎也是新的。

messages.speaker: Lara (买家)
messages.zh: 这辆自行车的状况还好吗？
messages.en: Is this bicycle still in good condition?

messages.speaker: Toni (卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kollox jaħdem u t-tajers huma ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kollox jaħdem u t-tajers huma ġodda.
messages.zh: 好，所有部件都能正常使用，轮胎也是新的。
messages.en: Yes, everything works and the tires are new.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kundizzjoni 时并排想两句话：签约要满足条件，买旧车要查看状况；用场景区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 姻亲；配偶的父亲或母亲

teaching_sense.en_definition: A relative connected to someone through marriage, including a parent-in-law in the supplied senses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过婚姻关系形成的亲属；所给义项也包括配偶的父亲或母亲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qarib permezz taż-żwieġ; fit-tifsiriet mogħtija, ukoll missier jew omm il-konjuġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配偶的父亲或母亲，即公公、婆婆、岳父或岳母。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. related to one by dint of marriage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 姻亲；因婚姻关系而与某人成为亲属的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: a parent in-law, i.e. related by way of marriage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过婚姻关系成为亲属的父辈，即配偶的父亲或母亲。

formal.mt: Il-kunjat tiegħi se jattendi l-laqgħa tal-familja nhar il-Ħadd.
formal.en: My relative by marriage will attend the family gathering on Sunday.
formal.zh: 我的姻亲将参加星期日的家庭聚会。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu Pawlu? Marija: Huwa l-kunjat tiegħi; illum ġie jżurna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is Pawlu? Marija: He is my relative by marriage; he came to visit us today.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗是谁？玛丽娅：他是我的姻亲，今天来我们家做客。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗是谁？
messages.en: Who is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-kunjat tiegħi; illum ġie jżurna.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-kunjat tiegħi; illum ġie jżurna.
messages.zh: 他是我的姻亲，今天来我们家做客。
messages.en: He is my relative by marriage; he came to visit us today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在家庭关系图上用婚姻连线记 kunjat，先记住姻亲关系，再按所给具体义项辨认亲属身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The family name used to identify which family a person belongs to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示一个人所属家族的姓氏，与个人的名字相区别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-familja li persuna ġġorr, distint mill-isem personali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓；英语姓名表达中所称的姓氏。
家族姓氏；表示家族归属的姓名部分。
姓氏；与个人名字相区别的家族名称。

formal.mt: Ikteb ismek u kunjomok b'mod ċar fil-parti ta' fuq tal-formola.
formal.en: Write your first name and surname clearly at the top of the form.
formal.zh: 请在表格上方清楚地填写你的名字和姓氏。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhu kunjomok? Mark: Borg. Tridni niktbu għalik?
colloquial.en: Rita: What is your surname? Mark: Borg. Would you like me to write it down for you?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你姓什么？马克：博尔格。要我写给你吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What is your surname?

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 博尔格。要我写给你吗？
messages.en: Borg. Would you like me to write it down for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象填写姓名表格：isem 对应名字，kunjom 对应姓氏；用两栏表格帮助固定区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people who meet to discuss matters and make decisions for a community or organization; also advice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为社区或机构讨论事务、作出决定的议会或委员会；也可表示忠告、建议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jiltaqgħu biex jiddiskutu u jieħdu deċiżjonijiet għal komunità jew organizzazzjoni; ukoll parir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 议会；理事会；负责商议和决策的组织。
忠告；建议；为帮助他人作判断而提出的意见。
委员会；负责商议或处理特定事务的人员团体。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill lokali approva l-proposta biex jitjieb id-dawl fit-toroq.
formal.en: The local council approved the proposal to improve street lighting.
formal.zh: 地方议会批准了改善街道照明的提案。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lil min ngħidu dwar il-bank miksur fil-ġnien? David: Nistgħu nċemplu lill-kunsill lokali.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who should we tell about the broken bench in the garden? David: We can call the local council.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：花园里的长椅坏了，我们该告诉谁？戴维：我们可以打电话给地方议会。

messages.speaker: Nina (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min ngħidu dwar il-bank miksur fil-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min ngħidu dwar il-bank miksur fil-ġnien?
messages.zh: 花园里的长椅坏了，我们该告诉谁？
messages.en: Who should we tell about the broken bench in the garden?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.zh: 我们可以打电话给地方议会。
messages.en: We can call the local council.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kunsill 想成围桌商议的一群人，先记议会和委员会；另用一张写着建议的便条记住忠告义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling satisfied, pleased, or happy about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某事感到满意、欣喜或快乐的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss sodisfazzjon, pjaċir jew ferħ minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满意的；对现有情况感到满足的。
高兴的；因某件事而感到欣喜的。
快乐的；心情愉快的。

formal.mt: Id-direttur qal li kien kuntent bil-progress tal-proġett.
formal.en: The director said that he was pleased with the project's progress.
formal.zh: 主管表示，他对项目的进展感到满意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mort fl-eżami? Mark: Għaddejt! Ninsab kuntent ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did your exam go? Mark: I passed! I'm very happy.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你考试考得怎么样？马克：我通过了！我非常高兴。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你考试考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did your exam go?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 我通过了！我非常高兴。
messages.en: I passed! I'm very happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收到合格成绩后露出笑容，用 kuntent 同时连接对结果满意和心里高兴这两种感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement between parties that creates legally binding rights and obligations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 当事人之间订立、规定具有法律约束力的权利和义务的合同或契约。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim bejn partijiet li jistabbilixxi drittijiet u obbligi li jorbtu legalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同；契约；当事人之间订立的约定。
具有法律约束力的协议；规定当事人权利和义务的合同。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jistabbilixxi d-dmirijiet taż-żewġ partijiet u d-data tal-ħlas.
formal.en: The contract sets out the duties of both parties and the payment date.
formal.zh: 合同规定了双方的义务和付款日期。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Qrajt il-kuntratt qabel tiffirma? Mark: Iva, u tlabt spjegazzjoni dwar il-ħinijiet tax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Julia: Did you read the contract before signing? Mark: Yes, and I asked for an explanation of the working hours.
colloquial.zh: 朱莉娅：你签字前读过合同了吗？马克：读过了，我还请对方解释了工作时间的规定。

messages.speaker: Julia (朋友)
messages.zh: 你签字前读过合同了吗？
messages.en: Did you read the contract before signing?

messages.speaker: Mark (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u tlabt spjegazzjoni dwar il-ħinijiet tax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u tlabt spjegazzjoni dwar il-ħinijiet tax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 读过了，我还请对方解释了工作时间的规定。
messages.en: Yes, and I asked for an explanation of the working hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuntratt 和签字场景一起记：桌上放着写明双方权利、义务与日期的合同，签前逐条阅读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building where a religious community of friars, monks, or nuns lives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供修士或修女组成的宗教团体共同居住的建筑，即修道院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini fejn tgħix komunità reliġjuża ta' patrijiet jew sorijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修道院，尤指修女共同生活的院舍。
修道院；也可指修道院内围绕庭院的回廊。
修道院，供修女或修士共同居住和修行的院舍。

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara edukattiva, l-istudenti raw il-bitħa tal-kunvent u tgħallmu dwar il-ħajja tal-komunità reliġjuża.
formal.en: During the educational visit, the students saw the convent courtyard and learned about the life of the religious community.
formal.zh: 在教学参观期间，学生们参观了修道院的庭院，并了解了该宗教团体的生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-kunvent? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-knisja, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the convent? Pawlu: Next to the church, on the left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：修道院在哪里？保罗：在教堂旁边，左手边。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 修道院在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the convent?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.zh: 在教堂旁边，左手边。
messages.en: Next to the church, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用场景记忆：想象教堂旁一座带安静庭院的修道院，把整座建筑与 kunvent 联系起来，再用庭院里的回廊辅助记住相关义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The strength to face fear, danger, or difficulty and act despite it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对恐惧、危险或困难时，仍能采取行动的精神力量，即勇气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qawwa li tiffaċċja l-biża', il-periklu jew id-diffikultajiet u taġixxi minkejja kollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勇气，面对恐惧或困难时仍敢于行动的精神力量。
英勇，尤指面对危险时表现出的勇敢。
勇气；勇敢，面对困难或危险时不退缩的品质。

formal.mt: L-għalliema tat kuraġġ lill-istudent biex jitkellem quddiem il-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher encouraged the student to speak in front of the class.
formal.zh: 老师鼓励那名学生在全班面前发言。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi ftit biża' mill-eżami. Lara: Agħmel kuraġġ! Studjajt sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm a little afraid of the exam. Lara: Take heart! You've studied well.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我有点害怕考试。拉拉：鼓起勇气！你已经认真复习过了。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 我有点害怕考试。
messages.en: I'm a little afraid of the exam.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 鼓起勇气！你已经认真复习过了。
messages.en: Take heart! You've studied well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuraġġ 记成心里的一股力量：上台前虽然紧张，仍迈出第一步，那股支持你行动的勇气就是 kuraġġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing courage when facing fear, danger, or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对恐惧、危险或困难时表现出勇气的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri kuraġġ meta jiffaċċja l-biża', il-periklu jew id-diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有勇气的，能够勇敢面对困难或危险的。
勇敢的，面对恐惧或危险时敢于行动的。
有胆量的；勇敢的，遇到困难或危险仍敢于面对的。

formal.mt: Il-voluntier kuraġġuż għen lin-nies joħorġu mill-bini waqt l-emerġenza.
formal.en: The courageous volunteer helped people leave the building during the emergency.
formal.zh: 在紧急情况下，那名勇敢的志愿者帮助人们离开了大楼。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nibża' nitkellem quddiem il-klassi. Lara: Int kuraġġuż, Mark. Tista' tagħmilha!
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm afraid to speak in front of the class. Lara: You're brave, Mark. You can do it!
colloquial.zh: 马克：我害怕在全班面前发言。拉拉：你很勇敢，马克。你能做到的！

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 我害怕在全班面前发言。
messages.en: I'm afraid to speak in front of the class.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你很勇敢，马克。你能做到的！
messages.en: You're brave, Mark. You can do it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物标签记忆：给敢于上台发言的人贴上“勇敢的”标签，再配读 bniedem kuraġġuż，记住这个词用来描述品质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vegetable with long green leaves and a white lower part, used in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种具有长绿叶和白色下部、常用于烹饪的蔬菜，即韭葱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa bi weraq ħodor twal u parti bajda li tintuża fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 韭葱，一种叶片长而绿色、下部呈白色的食用蔬菜。

formal.mt: Għal din is-soppa, aħsel il-kurrat sew u aqta' l-parti bajda f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: For this soup, wash the leek thoroughly and cut the white part into small pieces.
formal.zh: 制作这道汤时，先把韭葱洗净，再将白色部分切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għandna bżonn għas-soppa? Pawlu: Kurrat, patata u ftit melħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do we need for the soup? Pawlu: Leek, potatoes, and a little salt.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：做汤需要什么？保罗：韭葱、土豆和少许盐。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 做汤需要什么？
messages.en: What do we need for the soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 韭葱、土豆和少许盐。
messages.en: Leek, potatoes, and a little salt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房画面记忆：想象一根上绿下白的韭葱被切成小块放进汤锅，边看边念 kurrat，把词和食材直接联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object worn on the head as a sign of power or honour, or a ring of flowers used for decoration or remembrance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在头上表示权力或荣誉的冠饰；也指用于装饰或纪念的环形花饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintlibes fuq ir-ras bħala sinjal ta' poter jew unur, jew ċirku ta' fjuri għal tiżjin jew tifkira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 王冠；冠冕，戴在头上表示身份、权力或荣誉的冠饰。
花环，用花或枝叶编成的环形饰物，也可用于纪念或悼念。

formal.mt: Fiċ-ċerimonja ta' tifkira, tqiegħdet kuruna tal-fjuri quddiem il-monument.
formal.en: At the remembrance ceremony, a wreath of flowers was placed in front of the monument.
formal.zh: 在纪念仪式上，人们将一个花环放在纪念碑前。

colloquial.mt: Ġulja: Għaliex ir-re jilbes kuruna? Marija: Il-kuruna turi li hu r-re.
colloquial.en: Ġulja: Why does the king wear a crown? Marija: The crown shows that he is the king.
colloquial.zh: 朱莉娅：国王为什么戴王冠？玛丽亚：王冠表明他是国王。

messages.speaker: Ġulja (孩子)
messages.zh: 国王为什么戴王冠？
messages.en: Why does the king wear a crown?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 王冠表明他是国王。
messages.en: The crown shows that he is the king.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅环形图记忆：一幅是国王头上的金王冠，一幅是纪念碑前的花环；给两幅图都标上 kuruna，分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small balls of dough used as an ingredient in soups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入汤中食用的小颗粒状面食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġin f'forma ta' boċċi żgħar li jintuża fis-sopop.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 库斯库斯，一种细小颗粒状面食。

sense_translations.en_definition: small balls of dough, used as a solid in soups
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用作汤中固体配料的小面团颗粒。

collocations.en: small dough balls with broad beans

formal.mt: Għalli l-kusksu fil-brodu sakemm jirtab, imbagħad żid il-ful imsajjar.
formal.en: Boil the small dough balls in the broth until tender, then add the cooked broad beans.
formal.zh: 将小面粒放入高汤中煮至软熟，然后加入煮好的蚕豆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Poġġejt il-kusksu fis-soppa? Pawlu: Iva, u żidt il-ful ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you put the small dough balls in the soup? Pawlu: Yes, and I added the broad beans too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你把小面粒放进汤里了吗？保罗：放了，还加了蚕豆。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你把小面粒放进汤里了吗？
messages.en: Did you put the small dough balls in the soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 放了，还加了蚕豆。
messages.en: Yes, and I added the broad beans too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用餐勺画面记忆：想象勺子从汤里舀起一粒粒小面团，给这些小面粒标上 kusksu，再连同 soppa 一起复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the curved bones along the sides of the chest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于胸部两侧的弯曲骨骼中的一根，即肋骨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mill-għadam mgħawweġ fil-ġnub tas-sider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肋骨，胸部两侧的弯曲骨骼。

sense_translations.en_definition: rib (bone on the side of the upper body)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 肋骨，位于上半身侧面的骨骼。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-pazjent għandu kustilja miksura.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the patient has a broken rib.
formal.zh: 医疗报告显示，该患者有一根肋骨骨折。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn qed tħoss l-uġigħ? Pawlu: Hawn, ħdejn din il-kustilja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do you feel the pain? Pawlu: Here, near this rib.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哪里疼？保罗：这里，这根肋骨附近。

messages.speaker: Sara (医生)
messages.zh: 你哪里疼？
messages.en: Where do you feel the pain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (患者)
messages.zh: 这里，这根肋骨附近。
messages.en: Here, near this rib.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人体示意图上圈出胸部侧面的一根弯骨，旁边写 kustilja；用明确的位置和形状把这个词与“肋骨”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large covering used to keep the body warm, especially in bed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盖在身上保暖的大块覆盖物，尤其指睡觉时使用的毯子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata kbira li tintuża biex iżżomm il-ġisem sħun, speċjalment fis-sodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毯子，用于盖在身上保暖的覆盖物。

formal.mt: Qabel ma waslu l-mistednin, tpoġġiet kutra nadifa fuq kull sodda.
formal.en: Before the guests arrived, a clean blanket was placed on each bed.
formal.zh: 客人到达之前，每张床上都放好了一条干净的毯子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed inħoss il-bard. Tista' tagħtini kutra? Marija: Żgur, hawn kutra sħuna għalik.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm feeling cold. Can you give me a blanket? Marija: Of course, here's a warm blanket for you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我觉得冷。能给我一条毯子吗？玛丽亚：当然，给你一条暖和的毯子。

messages.speaker: Lara (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss il-bard. Tista' tagħtini kutra?
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss il-bard. Tista' tagħtini kutra?
messages.zh: 我觉得冷。能给我一条毯子吗？
messages.en: I'm feeling cold. Can you give me a blanket?

messages.speaker: Marija (主人)
messages.zh: 当然，给你一条暖和的毯子。
messages.en: Of course, here's a warm blanket for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用触觉场景记忆：想象天气转凉时，把一条柔软的毯子盖到腿上，同时念 kutra，让保暖的感觉帮助记住“毯子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The inner sense of right and wrong that guides how a person acts and feels about their actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内心判断行为是非的意识，会影响人的行动以及对自己行为的感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sens ġewwieni ta' x'inhu tajjeb u x'inhu ħażin, li jiggwida l-imġiba u kif wieħed iħossu dwar għemilu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 良心；判断行为是非的内在意识。

sense_translations.en_definition: conscience (inner sense of morality; the attitude to one’s actions that it creates)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 良心，即内在的道德意识，以及这种意识使人对自身行为产生的态度。

formal.mt: Il-kuxjenza għandha tiggwida d-deċiżjonijiet tagħna anki meta ħadd ma jkun qed josservana.
formal.en: Our conscience should guide our decisions even when no one is watching us.
formal.zh: 即使无人监督，良心也应当指引我们的决定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sibt kartiera fit-triq. Il-kuxjenza ma tħallinix inżommha. Mark: Mela ejja nieħduha l-għassa.
colloquial.en: Lara: I found a wallet in the street. My conscience won't let me keep it. Mark: Then let's take it to the police station.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我在街上捡到一个钱包。良心不允许我把它据为己有。Mark：那我们把它送到警察局吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt kartiera fit-triq. Il-kuxjenza ma tħallinix inżommha.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt kartiera fit-triq. Il-kuxjenza ma tħallinix inżommha.
messages.zh: 我在街上捡到一个钱包。良心不允许我把它据为己有。
messages.en: I found a wallet in the street. My conscience won't let me keep it.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们把它送到警察局吧。
messages.en: Then let's take it to the police station.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuxjenza 想成心里提醒你判断对错的小声音：捡到钱包时，它提醒你归还；做对了，就能拥有 kuxjenza safja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The European honey buzzard, a bird of prey with the scientific name Pernis apivorus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欧洲蜂鹰，一种猛禽，学名为 Pernis apivorus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Pernis apivorus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜂鹰，一种猛禽。
欧洲蜂鹰，学名 Pernis apivorus。

collocations.en: a honey buzzard in the air

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-osservazzjoni ta' kuċċarda waqt it-titjira.
formal.en: The report describes the observation of a honey buzzard in flight.
formal.zh: 报告描述了对一只飞行中的欧洲蜂鹰的观察。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dik kuċċarda? Toni: Iva, ħares kif qed ittir!
colloquial.en: Sara: Is that a honey buzzard? Toni: Yes, look at it flying!
colloquial.zh: Sara：那是欧洲蜂鹰吗？Toni：是啊，快看它飞翔的样子！

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟爱好者)
messages.zh: 那是欧洲蜂鹰吗？
messages.en: Is that a honey buzzard?

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟向导)
messages.zh: 是啊，快看它飞翔的样子！
messages.en: Yes, look at it flying!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kuċċarda 配一张空中猛禽的识鸟卡，卡上同时写“欧洲蜂鹰”和 Pernis apivorus，把词形与鸟名一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large, deep spoon with a handle, used for serving soup or other liquids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来舀取或盛出汤等液体的深口大勺，通常有长柄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mgħarfa kbira u fonda b'manku, li tintuża biex isservi s-soppa jew likwidi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汤勺；用于舀汤等液体的长柄深口大勺。

formal.mt: Uża kuċċarun biex isservi s-soppa fl-iskutelli.
formal.en: Use a ladle to serve the soup into the bowls.
formal.zh: 用汤勺把汤盛入碗中。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tgħaddili l-kuċċarun, jekk jogħġbok? Luqa: Hawn hu, ħdejn il-borma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Could you pass me the ladle, please? Luqa: Here it is, next to the pot.
colloquial.zh: Marija：请把汤勺递给我，好吗？Luqa：在这儿，就在锅旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 请把汤勺递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the ladle, please?

messages.speaker: Luqa (儿子)
messages.zh: 在这儿，就在锅旁边。
messages.en: Here it is, next to the pot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuċċarun 想成锅旁的一把长柄深口大汤勺，边想象舀汤动作，边念 kuċċarun tas-soppa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male cousin: the son of one's aunt or uncle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姑、舅、姨、叔或伯的儿子，即男性的堂亲或表亲；年龄大小由语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iben iz-ziju jew iz-zija ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堂亲或表亲；此词形通常指男性。
男性堂亲或表亲，即堂兄、堂弟、表兄或表弟。

collocations.zh: 与堂兄弟或表兄弟见面

formal.mt: Il-kuġin tiegħi, iben iz-zija tiegħi, se jattendi ċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: My cousin, the son of my aunt, will attend the ceremony.
formal.zh: 我的表兄弟，也就是我姨妈的儿子，将出席典礼。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu dak miegħek? Ben: Dan il-kuġin tiegħi, Adam.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is that with you? Ben: This is my cousin, Adam.
colloquial.zh: Anna：和你在一起的那位是谁？Ben：这是我的堂兄弟或表兄弟 Adam。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 和你在一起的那位是谁？
messages.en: Who is that with you?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是我的堂兄弟或表兄弟 Adam。
messages.en: This is my cousin, Adam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在家谱中圈出叔伯姑舅姨的儿子，旁边标 kuġin；记住它指男性堂表亲，具体称兄还是弟要看年龄。

gloss_zh: 平方的；正方形的；已装框之物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used of a number multiplied by itself, or of something having a square shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示一个数自乘所得的平方，或表示某物具有正方形形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi numru mmultiplikat bih innifsu, jew xi ħaġa li għandha forma ta' kwadru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平方的；在数学中表示一个数与自身相乘。
已装框的物件。
正方形的；具有四条等长边和四个直角的。

formal.mt: L-erja tal-pannell hija ta' metru kwadrat.
formal.en: The area of the panel is one square metre.
formal.zh: 这块面板的面积为一平方米。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm jagħmel tlieta kwadrat? Pawlu: Disgħa, għax tlieta darbiet tlieta jagħmlu disgħa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is three squared? Pawlu: Nine, because three times three is nine.
colloquial.zh: Nina：三的平方是多少？Pawlu：九，因为三乘三等于九。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 三的平方是多少？
messages.en: What is three squared?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Disgħa, għax tlieta darbiet tlieta jagħmlu disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Disgħa, għax tlieta darbiet tlieta jagħmlu disgħa.
messages.zh: 九，因为三乘三等于九。
messages.en: Nine, because three times three is nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个三乘三的方格记 kwadrat：九个小格帮助你连接“平方”与“正方形”。另把名词义单独配上一幅已装框物件的图来记。

gloss_zh: 图画；绘画作品；正方形；正方形的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A picture or painting; also a geometric shape with four equal sides and four right angles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一幅图画或绘画作品；也指具有四条等长边和四个直角的正方形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stampa jew pittura; ukoll figura ġeometrika b'erba' naħat indaqs u erba' angoli retti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 图画；供观看的画面或图像。
正方形，即四条边等长、四个角均为直角的图形。
正方形的；呈正方形形状的。
图画；绘画作品。

formal.mt: Il-kwadru espost fis-sala juri xena mill-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The painting displayed in the hall depicts a scene from everyday life.
formal.zh: 大厅里展出的这幅画描绘了一个日常生活场景。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-kwadru jogħġbok? Toni: Iva, speċjalment il-kuluri. Ejja ndendluh mal-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you like this painting? Toni: Yes, especially the colours. Let's hang it on the wall.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你喜欢这幅画吗？Toni：喜欢，尤其喜欢它的颜色。我们把它挂到墙上吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这幅画吗？
messages.en: Do you like this painting?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment il-kuluri. Ejja ndendluh mal-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment il-kuluri. Ejja ndendluh mal-ħajt.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其喜欢它的颜色。我们把它挂到墙上吧。
messages.en: Yes, especially the colours. Let's hang it on the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kwadru 制作两张图卡：一张是墙上的画，一张是数学正方形。用“欣赏画”和“画方形”两个动作区分它的常用名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The degree of excellence or standard of a product, service, or piece of work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产品、服务或工作成果的优劣程度及其达到的水准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-livell ta' kemm prodott, servizz jew xogħol huwa tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 质量；品质；某物所达到的优良程度或水准。

formal.mt: Il-kontroll tal-kwalità jsir qabel ma l-prodotti jintbagħtu lill-klijenti.
formal.en: Quality control is carried out before the products are sent to customers.
formal.zh: 产品发给客户之前会进行质量控制。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-flokk jiswa ftit aktar. David: Iva, imma l-kwalità tad-drapp hija aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marija: This T-shirt costs a little more. David: Yes, but the fabric is of better quality.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这件T恤贵一点。David：是的，不过面料的质量更好。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件T恤贵一点。
messages.en: This T-shirt costs a little more.

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-kwalità tad-drapp hija aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-kwalità tad-drapp hija aħjar.
messages.zh: 是的，不过面料的质量更好。
messages.en: Yes, but the fabric is of better quality.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kwalità 时想象挑选两件衣服：摸面料、看做工，再判断品质高低。把它和 kwalità għolja“高质量”一起朗读。

gloss_zh: 四分之一；一刻钟；夸脱；二百五十克的分量

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of four equal parts of a whole, including a quarter of an hour; also a measure used for a quart or an amount weighing 250 grams.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 整体四等份中的一份，也可指一小时的四分之一，即一刻钟；另可表示夸脱这一容积单位或二百五十克的分量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda minn erba' partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa, ukoll ħmistax-il minuta; jista' wkoll jindika miżura ta' volum jew ammont li jiżen 250 gramma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四分之一；四等份中的一份；用于时间时可指一刻钟。
夸脱，一种容积单位。
重量为二百五十克的分量。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jaslu kwart ta' siegħa qabel il-bidu tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: Participants should arrive a quarter of an hour before the meeting begins.
formal.zh: 参加者应在会议开始前十五分钟到达。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nixtieq kwart ġobon, jekk jogħġbok. Ġużeppi: Mela, niżen 250 gramma għalik.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'd like 250 grams of cheese, please. Ġużeppi: Certainly, I'll weigh out 250 grams for you.
colloquial.zh: Anna：请给我二百五十克奶酪。Ġużeppi：好的，我给你称二百五十克。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我二百五十克奶酪。
messages.en: I'd like 250 grams of cheese, please.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (店员)
messages.zh: 好的，我给你称二百五十克。
messages.en: Certainly, I'll weigh out 250 grams for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“四等分”记 kwart：钟面四等分得到十五分钟，一千克四等分得到二百五十克；遇到容积义“夸脱”时另看单位语境，不把它直接换成重量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very close to being true, happening, or reaching an amount, but not completely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种情况、事件或数量已非常接近实现或达到，但还没有完全如此。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħaġa hija qrib ħafna li sseħħ jew tilħaq ċertu livell, iżda mhux għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 几乎；差一点就；接近某种状态或结果而尚未完全达到。
将近；差不多；接近某个数量、程度或完成点。
几乎；差不多；将近，表示非常接近而并未完全达到。

formal.mt: Kważi l-parteċipanti kollha wieġbu l-mistoqsijiet tal-istħarriġ.
formal.en: Almost all the participants answered the survey questions.
formal.zh: 几乎所有参加者都回答了调查问卷中的问题。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għadek qed tipprepara? Luqa: Kważi lest. Agħtini minuta oħra.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are you still getting ready? Luqa: I'm almost ready. Give me one more minute.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你还在准备吗？Luqa：差不多好了。再给我一分钟。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在准备吗？
messages.en: Are you still getting ready?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 差不多好了。再给我一分钟。
messages.en: I'm almost ready. Give me one more minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kważi 配上一条快到终点、还差一点的进度条：接近完成就是 kważi lest。记住“几乎”仍保留一点未达到的距离。

gloss_zh: 安静的；平静的；无声的；寂静；秘密的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having little or no noise or disturbance; calm and peaceful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音很少或没有声音、少受打扰的；也指平静安宁的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ftit jew xejn storbju jew taqlib; kalm u fil-paċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安宁的；平和的；没有纷扰的。
安静的；声音很小或没有喧闹的。
无声的；不作声的。
寂静；无声的状态。
安静的；平静的；宁静安详的。
秘密的；不公开的。

formal.mt: Il-kwiet fil-kamra tal-qari jgħin lill-istudenti jikkonċentraw.
formal.en: The silence in the reading room helps students concentrate.
formal.zh: 阅览室里的安静环境有助于学生集中注意力。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn nistgħu noqogħdu nitkellmu? Samwel: Hawnhekk hemm ħafna storbju. Naf post kwiet fil-qrib.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where can we sit and talk? Samwel: It's very noisy here. I know a quiet place nearby.
colloquial.zh: Elena：我们可以坐在哪里聊天？Samwel：这里太吵了。我知道附近有个安静的地方。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们可以坐在哪里聊天？
messages.en: Where can we sit and talk?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk hemm ħafna storbju. Naf post kwiet fil-qrib.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk hemm ħafna storbju. Naf post kwiet fil-qrib.
messages.zh: 这里太吵了。我知道附近有个安静的地方。
messages.en: It's very noisy here. I know a quiet place nearby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用安静房间和平静海面记 kwiet 的形容词义，用 il-kwiet 记“寂静”这一名词义；“秘密的”另配封好的信封作提示，按语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A matter or issue to consider or discuss; also a disagreement or dispute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要考虑、讨论或处理的事情或问题；也可指人与人之间的争执或争议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suġġett jew problema li jeħtieġ ħsieb jew diskussjoni; ukoll nuqqas ta' qbil jew tilwima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事情；需要关注或处理的事项。
问题；有待考虑、讨论或解决的疑问。
要点；议题；讨论中需要关注的问题。
争吵；争执；各方存在分歧的争议。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat se jiddiskuti l-kwistjoni tat-trasport pubbliku fil-laqgħa li jmiss.
formal.en: The committee will discuss the issue of public transport at its next meeting.
formal.zh: 委员会将在下次会议上讨论公共交通问题。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ġara bejnek u bejn Paul? Mario: Kellna kwistjoni dwar il-flus, imma issa solvejnieha.
colloquial.en: Rita: What happened between you and Paul? Mario: We had a dispute about money, but we've resolved it now.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你和Paul之间发生什么事了？Mario：我们为了钱的事起了争执，不过现在已经解决了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和Paul之间发生什么事了？
messages.en: What happened between you and Paul?

messages.speaker: Mario (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellna kwistjoni dwar il-flus, imma issa solvejnieha.
messages.mt_standard: Kellna kwistjoni dwar il-flus, imma issa solvejnieha.
messages.zh: 我们为了钱的事起了争执，不过现在已经解决了。
messages.en: We had a dispute about money, but we've resolved it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kwistjoni 放在会议桌中央：平和讨论时是“议题、问题”，双方起争执时是“争议”。用同一件待处理的事串起不同语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short test or question game used to check knowledge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过少量问题检验知识的小测验，也可指知识问答游戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Test qasir jew logħba ta' mistoqsijiet biex jiġi ċċekkjat l-għarfien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小测验；知识问答。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti għamlu kwiżż qasir biex jiċċekkjaw kemm fehmu s-suġġett.
formal.en: At the end of the lesson, the students took a short quiz to check how well they understood the topic.
formal.zh: 课程结束时，学生们做了一份简短的小测验，检查自己对主题的理解程度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tieħu sehem fil-kwiżż illejla? Pawlu: Iva! X'tip ta' mistoqsijiet se jkun hemm?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to take part in the quiz tonight? Pawlu: Yes! What kind of questions will there be?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想参加今晚的知识问答吗？Pawlu：想！会有什么类型的问题？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想参加今晚的知识问答吗？
messages.en: Do you want to take part in the quiz tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! X'tip ta' mistoqsijiet se jkun hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Iva! X'tip ta' mistoqsijiet se jkun hemm?
messages.zh: 想！会有什么类型的问题？
messages.en: Yes! What kind of questions will there be?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kwiżż 和一张只有几道题的小测验纸联系起来，也可想象朋友围桌抢答的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fixed amount or share allocated to someone, required from someone, or permitted within a limit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分配给某人、要求某人承担或在限额内允许使用的固定数量或份额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont jew sehem stabbilit li jingħata lil xi ħadd, jintalab mingħandu jew jitħalla taħt limitu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配额；规定的限额或应完成的数量。
份额；金额或数量；分得或承担的一部分。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat stabbilixxa kwota ta' għoxrin parteċipant għal kull skola.
formal.en: The committee set a quota of twenty participants for each school.
formal.zh: 委员会为每所学校规定了二十名参与者的名额。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm hi l-kwota tiegħi għall-ikla? Mark: Għaxar ewro; qsamna l-kont bejnietna.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much is my share for the meal? Mark: Ten euros; we split the bill among us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这顿饭我分摊多少钱？Mark：十欧元；我们把账单分摊了。

messages.speaker: Sara (聚餐朋友)
messages.zh: 这顿饭我分摊多少钱？
messages.en: How much is my share for the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (聚餐朋友)
messages.zh: 十欧元；我们把账单分摊了。
messages.en: Ten euros; we split the bill among us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kwota 时想象一块分好的蛋糕：分给你的那一份是份额，预先规定的数量则是配额。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room where food is prepared and cooked; also, a particular tradition or style of cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准备和烹煮食物的房间，即厨房；也指某个地区、文化或传统的菜系与烹饪风格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra fejn jitħejja u jissajjar l-ikel; ukoll tradizzjoni jew stil partikolari ta' tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厨房；准备和烹煮食物的房间。
菜系；某一地区或文化的烹饪传统。
菜系；烹饪方式或风格。

formal.mt: Il-kors jintroduċi lill-istudenti għal diversi platti tal-kċina Maltija.
formal.en: The course introduces students to various dishes from Maltese cuisine.
formal.zh: 这门课程向学生介绍马耳他菜系中的多种菜肴。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn ħallejt iċ-ċwievet? Nina: Fuq il-mejda tal-kċina, ħdejn it-tazza tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where did you leave the keys? Nina: On the kitchen table, next to your cup.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你把钥匙放哪儿了？妮娜：厨房的桌子上，就在你的杯子旁边。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 你把钥匙放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you leave the keys?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda tal-kċina, ħdejn it-tazza tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda tal-kċina, ħdejn it-tazza tiegħek.
messages.zh: 厨房的桌子上，就在你的杯子旁边。
messages.en: On the kitchen table, next to your cup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“做饭的地方”和“做饭的风格”连着记：钥匙放在厨房，菜单介绍马耳他菜系；一个词对应两个清楚场景。

gloss_zh: 用针固定；用针刺穿；针具商贩

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fasten or hold something in place using pins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用别针或大头针将东西别住，使其固定在适当位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li twaħħal jew iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha bil-labar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用针别住；用别针固定。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pierce with a pin or needle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用别针或针刺穿。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who sells needles or pins
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖针或别针的人；针具商贩。
用别针或大头针加以固定。

collocations.zh: 用针固定了衣物的折边

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat labbar id-drapp qabel beda jħit biex iżomm iż-żewġ biċċiet f'posthom.
formal.en: The tailor pinned the fabric before starting to sew to keep the two pieces in place.
formal.zh: 裁缝在开始缝制前用针固定了布料，使两块布保持在适当位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex labbart id-drapp? Sara: Labbartu biex ma jiċċaqlaqx waqt il-ħjata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you pin the fabric? Sara: I pinned it so it would not move during sewing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么用针把布别住？Sara：我把它别住，免得缝的时候移动。

messages.speaker: Maja (缝纫学员)
messages.zh: 你为什么用针把布别住？
messages.en: Why did you pin the fabric?

messages.speaker: Sara (缝纫老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Labbartu biex ma jiċċaqlaqx waqt il-ħjata.
messages.mt_standard: Labbartu biex ma jiċċaqlaqx waqt il-ħjata.
messages.zh: 我把它别住，免得缝的时候移动。
messages.en: I pinned it so it would not move during sewing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 labbar 记成裁缝拿针固定布料的动作；遇到名词用法时，再换成站在针具摊后面的卖针人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk a great deal, often idly or about things of little importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说很多话，常指漫无边际地闲聊或喋喋不休。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li titkellem ħafna, spiss dwar affarijiet ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说很多话；不停地说。
叽叽喳喳地说；闲聊。
健谈的人；话多的人。
话匣子；喋喋不休的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to babble, chatter, talk much and idly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 絮絮叨叨；漫无边际地闲聊；喋喋不休。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti lablab bla waqfien u ħalla ftit ħin għall-oħrajn.
formal.en: During the meeting, one participant chattered nonstop and left little time for the others.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一位参与者说个不停，留给其他人的时间很少。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm lablab Pawlu llum! Mark: Iva, tkellem il-ħin kollu dwar il-vaganza tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu really talked a lot today! Mark: Yes, he talked about his holiday the whole time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu今天可真能说！Mark：是啊，他一直在讲他的假期。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu今天可真能说！
messages.en: Pawlu really talked a lot today!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkellem il-ħin kollu dwar il-vaganza tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkellem il-ħin kollu dwar il-vaganza tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他一直在讲他的假期。
messages.en: Yes, he talked about his holiday the whole time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借 lablab 重复的字形，想象一句接一句停不下来的聊天；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pointed tool used for sewing, or a pin used to fasten or decorate something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于缝纫的细尖针，也可指固定物品的别针或装饰用的胸针。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda żgħira bil-ponta li tintuża għall-ħjata, biex twaħħal xi ħaġa jew bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针；缝纫针。
胸针；别在衣服上的装饰针。
别针；大头针。
别针；针。

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata għaddiet il-ħajta minn għajn il-labra qabel bdiet tħit.
formal.en: The seamstress passed the thread through the eye of the needle before starting to sew.
formal.zh: 女裁缝在开始缝制前，将线穿过了针眼。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek labra? Għandi bżonn inħit buttuna. Maja: Iva, hawn labra u ftit ħajt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have a needle? I need to sew on a button. Maja: Yes, here is a needle and some thread.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你有针吗？我需要缝一颗纽扣。Maja：有，这里有一根针和一些线。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek labra? Għandi bżonn inħit buttuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek labra? Għandi bżonn inħit buttuna.
messages.zh: 你有针吗？我需要缝一颗纽扣。
messages.en: Do you have a needle? I need to sew on a button.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn labra u ftit ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn labra u ftit ħajt.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一根针和一些线。
messages.en: Yes, here is a needle and some thread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 labra 画三幅小图：穿线的缝纫针、固定布料的别针、衣领上的胸针，用用途区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large body of water surrounded by land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 四周被陆地围住的大片水域，即湖泊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda kbira ta' ilma mdawra bl-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 湖；湖泊。

formal.mt: Il-kampjuni tal-ilma nġabru minn tliet punti differenti fil-lag.
formal.en: The water samples were collected from three different points in the lake.
formal.zh: 水样取自湖中三个不同的地点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid immorru nimxu ħdejn il-lag? Sara: Iva, nistgħu nieqfu fuq ix-xatt u nieħdu xi ritratti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you want to go for a walk by the lake? Sara: Yes, we can stop on the shore and take some photos.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你想去湖边散步吗？Sara：想，我们可以在湖岸停下来拍几张照片。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去湖边散步吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go for a walk by the lake?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nieqfu fuq ix-xatt u nieħdu xi ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nieqfu fuq ix-xatt u nieħdu xi ritratti.
messages.zh: 想，我们可以在湖岸停下来拍几张照片。
messages.en: Yes, we can stop on the shore and take some photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lag 时想象地图上一片被陆地围住的蓝色水域，再把湖岸散步的画面与这个短词绑定。

gloss_zh: 玩；参加比赛；假装；赌博；摇摆；欺骗；玩家

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in a game, sport, or activity for enjoyment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加游戏、体育运动或娱乐活动；玩耍或比赛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tieħu sehem f'logħba, sport jew attività ta' divertiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩；玩耍；参加游戏或体育比赛。
假装；装作。
表演；扮演角色。
赌博；下注。
摇晃；晃动；不稳。
打一下；击打一记。
欺骗某人；对某人耍诈。
作弊；欺骗；蒙骗。
犹豫；摇摆不定；拿不定主意。
赌徒；参与赌博的人。
游戏玩家；参加游戏或比赛的人。

formal.mt: It-tim lagħab partita ta' ħbiberija biex jiġbor fondi għall-isptar.
formal.en: The team played a friendly match to raise funds for the hospital.
formal.zh: 这支球队踢了一场友谊赛，为医院筹款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' min lagħab ħuk ilbieraħ? Pawlu: Lagħab ma' sħabu fil-grawnd ħdejn l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who did your brother play with yesterday? Pawlu: He played with his friends on the sports ground near the school.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你兄弟昨天和谁一起玩？Pawlu：他和朋友们在学校附近的运动场上玩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟昨天和谁一起玩？
messages.en: Who did your brother play with yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lagħab ma' sħabu fil-grawnd ħdejn l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Lagħab ma' sħabu fil-grawnd ħdejn l-iskola.
messages.zh: 他和朋友们在学校附近的运动场上玩。
messages.en: He played with his friends on the sports ground near the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用足球场记住 lagħab 的“玩、比赛”，再为假装、赌博、摇摆、击打和欺骗分别做情境卡；名词另记人物。

gloss_zh: 爱玩的；顽皮的；好赌的；赌徒；玩家

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fond of play and games; lively and eager to have fun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢玩耍和游戏的；活泼爱闹、乐于嬉戏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb il-logħob u d-divertiment u juri ħeġġa biex jilgħab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱玩的；活泼顽皮的；喜欢嬉戏的。
好赌的；喜欢赌博的。
与 lagħab 同义：赌徒；玩家；参加游戏或比赛的人。

formal.mt: Il-ġeru lagħabi ġera wara l-ballun fil-ġnien u baqa' jġibu lura għand sidu.
formal.en: The playful puppy chased the ball in the garden and kept bringing it back to its owner.
formal.zh: 这只爱玩的小狗在花园里追着球跑，不断把球叼回主人身边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem hekk lagħabi? Mark: Iva, kull meta jara ballun irid jilgħab.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is your dog always this playful? Mark: Yes, whenever he sees a ball, he wants to play.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的狗总是这么爱玩吗？Mark：是啊，每次一看到球，它就想玩。

messages.speaker: Sara (来访朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗总是这么爱玩吗？
messages.en: Is your dog always this playful?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull meta jara ballun irid jilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull meta jara ballun irid jilgħab.
messages.zh: 是啊，每次一看到球，它就想玩。
messages.en: Yes, whenever he sees a ball, he wants to play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lagħabi 贴在追球小狗的图片旁记“爱玩的”；另画赌桌记“好赌的”，并单独标出指人的名词用法。

gloss_zh: 舔；巴结；把食物吃得精光

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass the tongue over something, for example to taste it or clean it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用舌头接触并舔过某物，例如品尝食物或舔干净表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi lsienek fuq xi ħaġa, pereżempju biex idduqha jew tnaddafha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舔；用舌头舔过。

sense_translations.en_definition: to brown-nose or act with servility towards sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴结某人；对某人表现得卑躬屈膝。

sense_translations.en_definition: to eat every last scrap of one's food(used figuratively)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己的食物吃得一干二净，连一点残渣也不剩；用于比喻。
奉承；拍马屁，语气口语化且带贬义。

collocations.en: lick the plate; figuratively, eat every last scrap
collocations.zh: 舔盘子；比喻把食物吃得精光

formal.mt: Wara li kiel, il-kelb lagħaq il-platt sakemm ma baqa' xejn fih.
formal.en: After eating, the dog licked the plate until nothing remained on it.
formal.zh: 吃完后，狗把盘子舔得干干净净，里面什么也没剩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min lagħaq il-ġelat tiegħi? Mark: Il-kelb! Ħallihx fuq il-mejda baxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who licked my ice cream? Mark: The dog! Don't leave it on the low table.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：谁舔了我的冰淇淋？马克：是狗！别把它放在那张矮桌上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁舔了我的冰淇淋？
messages.en: Who licked my ice cream?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是狗！别把它放在那张矮桌上。
messages.en: The dog! Don't leave it on the low table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象小狗舔盘子的动作，记住“舔”；再联想中文“拍马屁”的讨好画面，帮助区分字面义与贬义。

gloss_zh: 阿谀奉承的；卑躬屈膝的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessively flattering or submissive towards someone in order to gain their favour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为讨取某人的欢心而过分奉承或顺从的，通常带贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jfaħħar jew jobdi lil xi ħadd iżżejjed biex jogħġbu jew jikseb xi vantaġġ mingħandu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿谀奉承的；为讨好别人而一味吹捧的。
奴颜婢膝的；过分顺从、缺乏尊严的。

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni, il-kritiku ddeskriva t-ton tal-ittra bħala lagħaqi minħabba t-tifħir eċċessiv tagħha.
formal.en: In the review, the critic described the letter's tone as sycophantic because of its excessive praise.
formal.zh: 评论中，评论者认为这封信吹捧过度，语气显得阿谀奉承。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif deherlek it-ton tal-messaġġ? Pawlu: Ftit lagħaqi; hemm wisq tifħir u ftit li xejn fatti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you think of the message's tone? Pawlu: A bit sycophantic; there's too much praise and hardly any facts.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得那条消息的语气怎么样？保罗：有点谄媚；吹捧太多，事实却几乎没有。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你觉得那条消息的语气怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the message's tone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit lagħaqi; hemm wisq tifħir u ftit li xejn fatti.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit lagħaqi; hemm wisq tifħir u ftit li xejn fatti.
messages.zh: 有点谄媚；吹捧太多，事实却几乎没有。
messages.en: A bit sycophantic; there's too much praise and hardly any facts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在“满口吹捧、点头哈腰”的人物画像旁，连同“语气”和“态度”两个搭配一起记。

gloss_zh: 惯常或成瘾的赌徒；玩家；容易流口水的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gambles habitually or finds it difficult to stop gambling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常赌博的人，尤其指难以控制赌博行为的赌徒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tilgħab il-logħob tal-azzard ta' spiss jew li ssibha diffiċli tieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯常赌博的人；有强迫性赌博行为、难以自控的赌徒。
容易流口水的。
与 lagħab 同义：赌徒；参与游戏的人、玩家。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ewlieni huwa lagħbi kompulsiv li jitlef il-flus kollha tiegħu fl-imħatri.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character is a compulsive gambler who loses all his money betting.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公是个难以自控的赌徒，把所有的钱都输在了下注上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru jerġa' jagħmel imħatra wara kull telfa? Mark: Għax hu lagħbi u jsibha diffiċli jieqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the character place another bet after every loss? Mark: Because he's a gambler and finds it difficult to stop.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：这个人物为什么每次输了还要继续下注？马克：因为他是个赌徒，很难停下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru jerġa' jagħmel imħatra wara kull telfa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru jerġa' jagħmel imħatra wara kull telfa?
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么每次输了还要继续下注？
messages.en: Why does the character place another bet after every loss?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu lagħbi u jsibha diffiċli jieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu lagħbi u jsibha diffiċli jieqaf.
messages.zh: 因为他是个赌徒，很难停下来。
messages.en: Because he's a gambler and finds it difficult to stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张分开的词性卡：名词卡画赌桌旁的人，形容词卡画流口水的嘴；同一拼写也要分别记义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have difficulty producing clear or fluent speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时难以清晰或流畅地表达，包括有言语障碍的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titkellem b'diffikultà jew ma tkunx tista' titkellem b'mod ċar u mexxej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有言语障碍；存在影响正常言语表达的困难。
说话困难；费力地说话。

collocations.en: have difficulty speaking while reading aloud

formal.mt: Waqt il-qari, l-istudent lagħlagħ u kellu bżonn aktar ħin biex itemm is-sentenza.
formal.en: While reading aloud, the student had difficulty speaking and needed more time to finish the sentence.
formal.zh: 朗读时，这名学生说话有些困难，需要更多时间才能把句子读完。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Mark waqaf waqt il-qari? Pawlu: Lagħlagħ ftit; nagħtuh aktar ħin biex ikompli.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Mark stop while reading aloud? Pawlu: He had a little difficulty speaking; let's give him more time to continue.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克朗读时为什么停下来了？保罗：他说话有点困难；我们多给他一点时间，让他继续。

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.zh: 马克朗读时为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop while reading aloud?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Lagħlagħ ftit; nagħtuh aktar ħin biex ikompli.
messages.mt_standard: Lagħlagħ ftit; nagħtuh aktar ħin biex ikompli.
messages.zh: 他说话有点困难；我们多给他一点时间，让他继续。
messages.en: He had a little difficulty speaking; let's give him more time to continue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复的字形当作视觉记号，联想一句话需要停顿后再继续的情景；这只是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slowness or lack of energy, sometimes involving an excessively calm manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行动迟缓、精神懒怠的状态，也可指显得过分镇定、不够积极。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' dewmien jew nuqqas ta' ħeġġa, li jista' jinkludi kalma żejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓慢；行动或进展迟缓。
懒怠；无精打采、缺乏活力的状态。
过分镇定；在需要积极反应时仍显得过于平静。

formal.mt: Il-lajma fil-movimenti tiegħu għamlet ix-xogħol aktar bil-mod.
formal.en: The slowness of his movements made the work proceed more slowly.
formal.zh: 他动作迟缓，使工作进展得更慢。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhi din il-lajma kollha llum? Pawlu: Għadni kemm qomt; agħtini ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you so sluggish today? Pawlu: I've only just got up; give me a little time.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你今天怎么这么没精神、慢吞吞的？Pawlu：我才刚起床，给我一点时间。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么没精神、慢吞吞的？
messages.en: Why are you so sluggish today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kemm qomt; agħtini ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kemm qomt; agħtini ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 我才刚起床，给我一点时间。
messages.en: I've only just got up; give me a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lajma 想成一幅慢动作画面：人懒洋洋，动作拖拉，连该着急时也太平静。它表示这种状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slow in movement or action, or calmer than the situation calls for.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动作或行动缓慢的，也可形容镇定得超过情境所需、显得不够积极的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiċċaqlaq jew jaġixxi bil-mod, jew li jkun kalm iżżejjed għas-sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过分镇定的，或行动过于迟缓的。
缓慢的；行动迟缓的。

collocations.en: a slow or excessively calm man
collocations.zh: 行动迟缓或过分镇定的男人

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kien lajman fil-movimenti tiegħu u dam biex temm ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The worker was slow in his movements and took a long time to finish the work.
formal.zh: 那名工人动作迟缓，花了很长时间才完成工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm int lajman illum! Se nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja. Mark: Għandek raġun; se nħaffef.
colloquial.en: Sara: You're so slow today! We're going to miss the bus. Mark: You're right; I'll hurry up.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天真慢！我们要赶不上公交车了。Mark：你说得对，我会加快脚步。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm int lajman illum! Se nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm int lajman illum! Se nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 你今天真慢！我们要赶不上公交车了。
messages.en: You're so slow today! We're going to miss the bus.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你说得对，我会加快脚步。
messages.en: You're right; I'll hurry up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用赶公交的画面记 lajman：大家加快脚步，他仍慢吞吞。与表示状态的 lajma 对照，lajman 用来描述人或其动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that produces light to illuminate a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出光线、用于照亮某个地方的灯具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jagħti d-dawl biex idawwal post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灯；用于照明的灯具。

formal.mt: L-istudent poġġa lampa fuq il-mejda biex ikollu biżżejjed dawl waqt il-qari.
formal.en: The student placed a lamp on the table to have enough light while reading.
formal.zh: 那名学生在桌上放了一盏灯，以便阅读时有充足的光线。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tixgħel il-lampa? Ma nistax naqra sew. Adam: Iva, issa nixgħelha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you switch on the lamp? I can't read properly. Adam: Yes, I'll switch it on now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你能把灯打开吗？我看不清书上的字。Adam：可以，我现在就开。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tixgħel il-lampa? Ma nistax naqra sew.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tixgħel il-lampa? Ma nistax naqra sew.
messages.zh: 你能把灯打开吗？我看不清书上的字。
messages.en: Can you switch on the lamp? I can't read properly.

messages.speaker: Adam (室友)
messages.zh: 可以，我现在就开。
messages.en: Yes, I'll switch it on now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lampa 与英语 lamp 放在同一张台灯图片旁记忆：两词外形相近，都指灯；这是拼写联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lamp used during sea fishing, especially in the Mediterranean; the word can also refer to a fishing net.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海上捕鱼时使用的灯，尤其用于地中海捕鱼场景；该词也可指捕鱼网。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lampa użata waqt is-sajd fuq il-baħar, speċjalment fil-Mediterran; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal xibka tas-sajd.

sense_translations.en_definition: fishing lamp (used especially in the Mediterranean while fishing out at sea)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鱼灯，尤其指地中海海上捕鱼时使用的灯。
捕鱼灯；捕鱼网。

collocations.en: the light of the fishing lamp

formal.mt: Qabel beda s-sajd bil-lejl, is-sajjied iċċekkja li l-lampara kienet taħdem sew.
formal.en: Before beginning the night's fishing, the fisherman checked that the fishing lamp was working properly.
formal.zh: 开始夜间捕鱼前，渔民检查了捕鱼灯是否正常工作。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Il-lampara lesta għal-lejla? Ġużi: Iva, ippruvajtha u tagħti dawl tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Toni: Is the fishing lamp ready for tonight? Ġużi: Yes, I tested it, and it gives a good light.
colloquial.zh: Toni：今晚用的捕鱼灯准备好了吗？Ġużi：好了，我试过了，照明很好。

messages.speaker: Toni (渔民)
messages.zh: 今晚用的捕鱼灯准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the fishing lamp ready for tonight?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (捕鱼搭档)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ippruvajtha u tagħti dawl tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ippruvajtha u tagħti dawl tajjeb.
messages.zh: 好了，我试过了，照明很好。
messages.en: Yes, I tested it, and it gives a good light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用夜海上的一盏捕鱼灯记 lampara，再在旁边画张渔网提醒另一义。遇到点亮、灯光等语境时，优先理解为捕鱼灯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The common dolphinfish, Coryphaena hippurus, also called dorado.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鲯鳅，学名 Coryphaena hippurus，英语也称 dorado 或 common dolphinfish。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar tal-ispeċi Coryphaena hippurus, magħrufa bl-Ingliż ukoll bħala dorado jew common dolphinfish.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲯鳅。
鲯鳅；此处为同一种鱼的英语名称。
鲯鳅，一种鱼，不是海豚。
鲯鳅，学名 Coryphaena hippurus。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, il-kok ipprepara lampuka moqlija u servieha mal-ħaxix.
formal.en: For lunch, the cook prepared fried dolphinfish and served it with vegetables.
formal.zh: 厨师为午餐准备了煎鲯鳅，并配上蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek lampuka friska llum? Salvu: Iva, għandna. Trid waħda?
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have fresh dolphinfish today? Salvu: Yes, we do. Would you like one?
colloquial.zh: Marija：你今天有新鲜鲯鳅吗？Salvu：有的。你要一条吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 你今天有新鲜鲯鳅吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh dolphinfish today?

messages.speaker: Salvu (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有的。你要一条吗？
messages.en: Yes, we do. Would you like one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lampuka 写在鱼摊上一条鲯鳅的价签上，再配记 friska 新鲜的、moqlija 煎的；英语名称含 dolphin，但这里指鱼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Starch, a substance found in foods such as potatoes and rice and used to thicken sauces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 淀粉，存在于土豆、米等食物中，也可用于使酱汁变稠的物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tinsab f'ikel bħall-patata u r-ross u li tintuża wkoll biex tħaxxen iz-zlazi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淀粉。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li tħallat il-lamtu ma' ftit ilma kiesaħ qabel iżżidu maz-zalza.
formal.en: The recipe asks you to mix the starch with a little cold water before adding it to the sauce.
formal.zh: 食谱要求先用少量冷水调匀淀粉，再将其加入酱汁中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Iz-zalza għadha rqiqa wisq. X'nista' nżid? David: Ħallat ftit lamtu ma' ilma kiesaħ u żidu magħha.
colloquial.en: Rita: The sauce is still too thin. What can I add? David: Mix a little starch with cold water and add it to the sauce.
colloquial.zh: Rita：酱汁还是太稀了。我可以加点什么？David：用冷水调一点淀粉，再加进酱汁里。

messages.speaker: Rita (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-zalza għadha rqiqa wisq. X'nista' nżid?
messages.mt_standard: Iz-zalza għadha rqiqa wisq. X'nista' nżid?
messages.zh: 酱汁还是太稀了。我可以加点什么？
messages.en: The sauce is still too thin. What can I add?

messages.speaker: David (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallat ftit lamtu ma' ilma kiesaħ u żidu magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallat ftit lamtu ma' ilma kiesaħ u żidu magħha.
messages.zh: 用冷水调一点淀粉，再加进酱汁里。
messages.en: Mix a little starch with cold water and add it to the sauce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房勾芡的动作记 lamtu：舀出淀粉、加冷水调匀、倒入酱汁。把词与这一连串具体动作绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to hold food, liquids or other materials, including a metal can or a plastic jerrycan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盛放食物、液体或其他物品的容器，可指金属罐或塑料提桶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur għall-ikel, għal-likwidi jew għal materjali oħra, li jista' jkun tal-metall jew tal-plastik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金属罐；罐头盒
罐；罐装容器
带提手的塑料液体桶
罐；容器

formal.mt: Wara l-użu, agħlaq sew il-landa taż-żebgħa u żommha f'post frisk.
formal.en: After use, close the paint can securely and keep it in a cool place.
formal.zh: 使用后，请将油漆罐盖紧，并存放在阴凉处。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt il-landa taż-żebgħa? Mark: Fil-garaxx, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the paint can? Mark: In the garage, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把油漆罐放哪儿了？马克：在车库里，门旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 你把油漆罐放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the paint can?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 在车库里，门旁边。
messages.en: In the garage, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 landa 想成货架上的容器标签：看到油漆想到金属罐，看到装水的塑料提桶也可联想到这个词，再靠上下文判断材质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craftsperson who makes or repairs objects from tin or tinplate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锡或镀锡薄铁板制作、修理器物的工匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artiġjan li jagħmel jew isewwi oġġetti tal-landa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白铁匠；制作或修理锡器、镀锡薄铁器物的工匠

formal.mt: Il-landier sewwa l-kontenitur tal-landa sabiex ikun jista' jerġa' jintuża.
formal.en: The tinsmith repaired the tin container so that it could be used again.
formal.zh: 白铁匠修好了这个金属容器，使其能够再次使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jsewwi dan il-kontenitur tal-landa? Pawlu: Ħudu għand il-landier ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can repair this tin container? Pawlu: Take it to the tinsmith near the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁能修这个金属容器？保罗：拿去给广场附近的白铁匠吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jsewwi dan il-kontenitur tal-landa?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jsewwi dan il-kontenitur tal-landa?
messages.zh: 谁能修这个金属容器？
messages.en: Who can repair this tin container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 拿去给广场附近的白铁匠吧。
messages.en: Take it to the tinsmith near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物画面记 landier：一位工匠坐在工作台前敲打、修补金属容器；重点记住它指做这门手艺的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to mean 'not even' or to add another negative statement meaning 'nor'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示连某种最低程度或意外情况也不成立，或接续否定，表示也不。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li anki xi ħaġa mhijiex hekk, jew biex iżżid ċaħda oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甚至不；连……也不
也不；用于接续另一项否定

collocations.en: neither do I; neither am I

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ma rċieva l-ebda rapport, u lanqas ma rċieva talba għal aktar żmien.
formal.en: The committee received no report, nor did it receive a request for more time.
formal.zh: 委员会没有收到任何报告，也没有收到延长期限的申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma fhimt xejn minn dik l-ispjegazzjoni. Mark: Lanqas jien. Ejja nitolbu eżempju.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't understand any of that explanation. Mark: Neither did I. Let's ask for an example.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才那段解释我一点也没听懂。马克：我也没懂。我们请对方举个例子吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma fhimt xejn minn dik l-ispjegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ma fhimt xejn minn dik l-ispjegazzjoni.
messages.zh: 刚才那段解释我一点也没听懂。
messages.en: I didn't understand any of that explanation.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我也没懂。我们请对方举个例子吧。
messages.en: Neither did I. Let's ask for an example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lanqas 记成给否定再加一笔：lanqas darba 是连一次也没有，lanqas jien 是我也不；先看它是在强调还是接话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long weapon with a pointed end, used for thrusting or throwing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一端尖锐、用于刺击或投掷的长柄武器，即矛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma twila b'tarf ippuntat, li tintuża biex wieħed iniggeż jew iwaddabha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钓鱼线；钓线
矛；长矛
lanza，原释义仅重复词形，具体所指未说明
钓鱼竿；钓竿

formal.mt: Il-lanza esposta fil-mużew għandha ponta tal-metall u manku twil tal-injam.
formal.en: The spear displayed in the museum has a metal point and a long wooden shaft.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出的这支矛具有金属矛头和长木杆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik lanza jew xabla? Mark: Lanza. Ara kemm hu twil il-manku tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a spear or a sword? Mark: A spear. Look how long its shaft is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是矛还是剑？马克：是矛。你看它的杆有多长。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 那是矛还是剑？
messages.en: Is that a spear or a sword?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lanza. Ara kemm hu twil il-manku tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Lanza. Ara kemm hu twil il-manku tagħha.
messages.zh: 是矛。你看它的杆有多长。
messages.en: A spear. Look how long its shaft is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用博物馆里的长矛记 lanza，再另画钓线和钓竿两张语境卡；这些都是所给义项，阅读时要按场景选择，不能只凭外形判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lunch, especially a meal packed and taken to school or another place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 午餐，尤其指事先装好、带到学校或其他地方吃的午餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikla ta' nofsinhar, speċjalment waħda ppreparata biex tittieħed l-iskola jew f'post ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事先装好并随身携带的午餐；自带盒饭。

sense_translations.en_definition: lunch, especially one that is packed or brought to school
sense_translations.zh_definition: 午餐，尤其指打包好或带到学校吃的午餐。

collocations.en: to take a packed lunch to school

formal.mt: Għall-ħarġa tal-iskola, kull student għandu jġib il-lanċ tiegħu u flixkun ilma.
formal.en: For the school outing, each student should bring their own packed lunch and a bottle of water.
formal.zh: 参加学校出游时，每名学生都应自带午餐和一瓶水。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Ħadt il-lanċ tiegħek? Ben: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket ħdejn il-flixkun tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Mum: Have you taken your packed lunch? Ben: Yes, it's in the bag next to the water bottle.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你带上午餐了吗？Ben：带了，在包里，就在水瓶旁边。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 你带上午餐了吗？
messages.en: Have you taken your packed lunch?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket ħdejn il-flixkun tal-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket ħdejn il-flixkun tal-ilma.
messages.zh: 带了，在包里，就在水瓶旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the bag next to the water bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lanċ 联想到英语 lunch，再想象早晨把午餐装进书包。重点记住它常用于带到学校吃的那份午餐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ferryboat, or a small boat such as a skiff or launch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 渡船，也可指小艇或交通艇一类船只。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħajsa li ġġorr passiġġieri minn post għal ieħor, jew dgħajsa żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渡船；提供渡运服务的船只。
小艇；交通艇，此处指船只。
渡船。

collocations.en: to cross the harbour by ferry

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom jistennew sakemm il-lanċa tieqaf qabel jinżlu.
formal.en: Passengers should wait until the ferry stops before disembarking.
formal.zh: 乘客应等渡船停稳后再下船。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Naqbdu l-lanċa biex naqsmu l-port? Noel: Iva, ejja mmorru naraw meta titlaq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we catch the ferry across the harbour? Noel: Yes, let's go and see when it leaves.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们乘渡船到港口对岸去，好吗？Noel：好，我们去看看它什么时候开。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行的朋友)
messages.zh: 我们乘渡船到港口对岸去，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we catch the ferry across the harbour?

messages.speaker: Noel (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja mmorru naraw meta titlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja mmorru naraw meta titlaq.
messages.zh: 好，我们去看看它什么时候开。
messages.en: Yes, let's go and see when it leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lanċa 放在港口渡船的图片旁，与午餐 lanċ 对照记忆：lanċ 放进书包，lanċa 载人过港；这是辨词联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rain heavily, with a large amount of rain falling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 下大雨，雨量很大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xita qawwija ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下大雨；大雨倾盆
梨；梨子，可表示单数或复数含义

collocations.en: it rained heavily during the night

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl lanġas, u filgħodu xi toroq kienu mgħarrqa.
formal.en: It rained heavily during the night, and some roads were flooded in the morning.
formal.zh: 夜间下了大雨，早晨部分道路出现积水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lanġas dalgħodu? Mark: Iva, u t-triq quddiem id-dar għadha mgħarrqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did it rain heavily this morning? Mark: Yes, and the road outside the house is still flooded.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天早上下大雨了吗？马克：是啊，屋前的路现在还积着水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天早上下大雨了吗？
messages.en: Did it rain heavily this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u t-triq quddiem id-dar għadha mgħarrqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u t-triq quddiem id-dar għadha mgħarrqa.
messages.zh: 是啊，屋前的路现在还积着水。
messages.en: Yes, and the road outside the house is still flooded.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 lanġas 画两张词性卡：动词卡画倾盆大雨，名词卡画一盘梨；同样的拼写要靠句子判断，不能把两个义项混成一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument with a solid core, usually graphite, used for writing or drawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内有固体笔芯、通常以石墨为芯，用来书写或绘画的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'qalba solida, normalment tal-grafit, li tintuża għall-kitba jew għat-tpinġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铅笔

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jużaw lapes biex ipinġu d-dijagramma u gomma biex jikkoreġu l-iżbalji.
formal.en: Students should use a pencil to draw the diagram and an eraser to correct mistakes.
formal.zh: 学生应使用铅笔绘制示意图，并用橡皮擦修改错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' ssellifni lapes? Mark: Iva, ħu dan. Għadni kemm sinne jtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you lend me a pencil? Mark: Yes, take this one. I've just sharpened it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：能借我一支铅笔吗？马克：可以，拿这支吧。我刚削好。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 能借我一支铅笔吗？
messages.en: Can you lend me a pencil?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan. Għadni kemm sinne jtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan. Għadni kemm sinne jtu.
messages.zh: 可以，拿这支吧。我刚削好。
messages.en: Yes, take this one. I've just sharpened it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lapes 放进文具盒画面：拿出来写字，写错用橡皮擦，笔尖钝了再削；连着三个动作记住它是铅笔。

gloss_zh: 接受；接待；欢迎；防护；接住

teaching_sense.en_definition: To welcome or receive someone, or to accept something offered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欢迎、接待到来的人，或接受别人提供的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilqa' persuna li tasal jew jaċċetta xi ħaġa li tiġi offruta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接受；同意接纳
接收；接待
欢迎；迎接

sense_translations.en_definition: to take measures for protection (e.g. against strong winds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 采取防护措施，例如防范强风
欢迎；接待客人
接受，通常指接受别人向自己提供的事物
给人留下深刻印象
采取预防措施；预先防范
拦截；接住

formal.mt: Id-direttur laqa' lill-mistednin fid-daħla tal-bini u spjega l-programm taż-żjara.
formal.en: The director welcomed the guests at the entrance to the building and explained the visit programme.
formal.zh: 主任在大楼入口迎接来宾，并介绍了参观安排。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min laqa' lill-mistednin meta waslu? Mark: Pawlu. Imbagħad daħħalhom ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who welcomed the guests when they arrived? Mark: Pawlu. Then he showed them inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：客人到的时候是谁迎接的？马克：保罗。随后他带他们进去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 客人到的时候是谁迎接的？
messages.en: Who welcomed the guests when they arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗。随后他带他们进去了。
messages.en: Pawlu. Then he showed them inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用迎接客人、接受提议、接住球三个画面练习 laqa'，再把防护和留下印象另列例句记忆；这是学习分组，不是词源推导。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal or additional name used for a person instead of their usual name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来称呼某人的非正式名字或附加称呼，即绰号、外号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem mhux uffiċjali jew isem ieħor li bih tkun magħrufa persuna minflok isimha tas-soltu.
