sense_translations.zh_definition: 绰号；外号
别称；绰号；非正式称呼

formal.mt: Fir-raħal, Pawlu huwa magħruf bil-laqam 'Il-Pittur', iżda fid-dokumenti juża ismu sħiħ.
formal.en: In the village, Pawlu is known by the nickname 'The Painter', but he uses his full name in documents.
formal.zh: 在村里，保罗以“画家”这个绰号为人所知，但在文件中他使用全名。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex issejħulu 'Il-Pittur'? Mark: Dak il-laqam tiegħu. Iħobb ipinġi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you call him 'The Painter'? Mark: That's his nickname. He likes painting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们为什么叫他“画家”？马克：那是他的绰号。他喜欢画画。

messages.speaker: Maja (新邻居)
messages.zh: 你们为什么叫他“画家”？
messages.en: Why do you call him 'The Painter'?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 那是他的绰号。他喜欢画画。
messages.en: That's his nickname. He likes painting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友名牌上写着正式姓名，旁边另贴一张大家常叫的称呼；旁边这张小标签就是 laqam，帮助区分姓名与绰号。

gloss_zh: 击中；擦碰；给人留下印象

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hit or come into contact with something, or figuratively to leave a strong impression on someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 击中或碰到某物；也可比喻某事触动了某人，给人留下深刻印象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot jew imiss ma' xi ħaġa; b'mod figurattiv, iħalli impressjoni qawwija fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 击中；打到。
轻轻擦到；擦碰。
给人留下印象；触动某人。
打；击打；殴打。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hit, strike (with some damaging action)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打击；撞击；以造成损害的动作击中。

formal.mt: Id-diskors tal-għalliema laqat lill-istudenti u qanqal diskussjoni fil-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher's speech made an impression on the students and sparked a classroom discussion.
formal.zh: 老师的讲话给学生留下了深刻印象，并引发了课堂讨论。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-ballun laqat it-tieqa? Pawlu: Le, laqat il-ħajt ħdejha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the ball hit the window? Pawlu: No, it hit the wall beside it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：球打到窗户了吗？保罗：没有，打到了窗户旁边的墙。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 球打到窗户了吗？
messages.en: Did the ball hit the window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，打到了窗户旁边的墙。
messages.en: No, it hit the wall beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面串记：球击中墙，话语击中心；从实际碰撞联想到留下印象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A meeting or encounter between people, or a coming together of things such as lines or rivers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们举行的会议、聚会或一次相遇；也指线条、河流等的汇合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta n-nies jiltaqgħu għal diskussjoni jew biex iqattgħu ħin flimkien; ukoll meta affarijiet bħal linji jew xmajjar jingħaqdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会议；会面。
相遇；邂逅；一次碰面。
汇合；趋于同一点或同一方向。
河流等的汇流；交汇。
一次会议、集会或聚会。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa tal-kumitat se ssir nhar it-Tnejn fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The committee meeting will take place on Monday at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 委员会会议将于星期一上午九点举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek laqgħa llum wara nofsinhar? Mark: Iva, imma wara nista' niltaqa' miegħek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a meeting this afternoon? Mark: Yes, but I can meet you afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天下午有会议吗？马克：有，不过会后我可以和你见面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天下午有会议吗？
messages.en: Do you have a meeting this afternoon?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma wara nista' niltaqa' miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma wara nista' niltaqa' miegħek.
messages.zh: 有，不过会后我可以和你见面。
messages.en: Yes, but I can meet you afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人围桌相聚，再想象两条河流相汇；共同画面都是来到一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak with repeated sounds or interruptions, or to hesitate before speaking or responding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时重复音节、断断续续；也指开口或作答时迟疑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'ripetizzjoni ta' ħsejjes jew b'waqfiet, jew joqgħod lura milli jitkellem jew iwieġeb minnufih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结结巴巴地说话。
口吃；说话时不自主地重复或卡住。
迟疑；犹豫着没有立即开口或回应。
结巴；口吃；说话断续。

formal.mt: L-istudent laqlaq fil-bidu tal-preżentazzjoni, iżda kompla jitkellem bil-kalma.
formal.en: The student stammered at the beginning of the presentation but continued speaking calmly.
formal.zh: 这名学生在展示开始时有些结巴，但随后平静地继续讲了下去。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu laqlaq qabel wieġeb? Nina: Ma kienx ċert x'ried jgħid.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu hesitate before answering? Nina: He wasn't sure what he wanted to say.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么回答前迟疑了？妮娜：他还没想好自己要说什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么回答前迟疑了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu hesitate before answering?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 他还没想好自己要说什么。
messages.en: He wasn't sure what he wanted to say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 laqlaq 的重复字形当作课堂记忆提示，联想到话音重复或开口迟疑；这只是助记。

gloss_zh: 嫁接；接种；给人起绰号；相关从业者或行为者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To graft a plant, administer a vaccine, or give someone a nickname, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按语境分别表示给植物嫁接、给人接种疫苗，或给某人起绰号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad parti minn pjanta ma' oħra biex tikber magħha, jagħti vaċċin, jew jagħti laqam lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to graft (used of trees or plants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 嫁接，指树木或其他植物。
接种疫苗；进行预防接种。
给某人起绰号。
从事植物嫁接的人；嫁接者。
实施疫苗接种的人；接种人员。
给别人起绰号的人。
嫁接；将接穗接到另一株植物上。
给人接种疫苗。

collocations.zh: 给保罗起了“教授”的绰号

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar laqqam is-siġra fir-rebbiegħa u rreġistra d-data tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The gardener grafted the tree in spring and recorded the date of the work.
formal.zh: 园丁在春季给这棵树做了嫁接，并记录了作业日期。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min laqqam lil Pawlu 'il-Professur'? Ġanni: Ħuh, għax dejjem jispjega kollox.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who nicknamed Pawlu 'the Professor'? Ġanni: His brother, because he's always explaining everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：谁给保罗起了“教授”的绰号？詹尼：他哥哥，因为他总爱解释所有事情。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给保罗起了“教授”的绰号？
messages.en: Who nicknamed Pawlu 'the Professor'?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他哥哥，因为他总爱解释所有事情。
messages.en: His brother, because he's always explaining everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张场景卡分记：园丁嫁接、医护接种、朋友起绰号；遇到名词义时再联想到做这些事的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small loose pieces or fragments of material, including scraps, chips, and small stones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料散落的小块或碎片，包括边角碎料、碎屑和小石块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet żgħar ta' materjal, bħal fdalijiet, biċċiet tal-injam jew ġebel żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剩余的碎料；边角料。
零碎物；零零散散的小块。
小石块；碎石。
碎片；碎屑。

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol, il-ħaddiema ġabru l-laqx tal-injam u naddfu l-art tal-ħanut tax-xogħol.
formal.en: After the work, the workers collected the wood chips and cleaned the workshop floor.
formal.zh: 工作结束后，工人们收集了木屑，并清扫了车间地面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm taħt il-mejda? Mark: Laqx tal-injam. Se niġbru issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's under the table? Mark: Wood chips. I'll gather them up now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：桌子下面是什么？马克：木屑。我现在就把它们收起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 桌子下面是什么？
messages.en: What's under the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 木屑。我现在就把它们收起来。
messages.en: Wood chips. I'll gather them up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象扫帚扫起一堆木屑和碎石，把 laqx 记成散落的小碎块，再由材料判断具体译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Latin language or to Latin culture and tradition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与拉丁语或拉丁文化、传统有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-lingwa Latina jew mal-kultura u t-tradizzjoni Latina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉丁的；拉丁语的。
拉丁语。

formal.mt: L-istudenti analizzaw test latin u qabblu t-traduzzjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The students analysed a Latin text and compared its translations.
formal.zh: 学生们分析了一篇拉丁语文本，并比较了它的不同译文。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan it-test latin? David: Iva, u ħdejh hemm traduzzjoni bil-Malti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this text in Latin? David: Yes, and there's a Maltese translation beside it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这篇文本是拉丁语的吗？戴维：是的，旁边还有马耳他语译文。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文本是拉丁语的吗？
messages.en: Is this text in Latin?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ħdejh hemm traduzzjoni bil-Malti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ħdejh hemm traduzzjoni bil-Malti.
messages.zh: 是的，旁边还有马耳他语译文。
messages.en: Yes, and there's a Maltese translation beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 test latin 和 l-Latin 成对记：前者修饰文本，译为拉丁语的；后者直接命名语言，译为拉丁语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Latvia, a country in northeastern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拉脱维亚，位于欧洲东北部的国家名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fil-grigal tal-Ewropa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉脱维亚。
拉脱维亚，欧洲东北部的一个国家。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudenta ddeskriviet il-Latvja bħala pajjiż fil-grigal tal-Ewropa.
formal.en: In the report, the student described Latvia as a country in northeastern Europe.
formal.zh: 这名学生在报告中介绍说，拉脱维亚是欧洲东北部的一个国家。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Pawlu: Se nqatta' ġimgħa fil-Latvja.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where are you going on holiday? Pawlu: I'm going to spend a week in Latvia.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你打算去哪里度假？保罗：我打算在拉脱维亚待一周。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我打算在拉脱维亚待一周。
messages.en: I'm going to spend a week in Latvia.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Latvja 与英语 Latvia、中文拉脱维亚并排做成国家卡，再用 fil-Latvja 练习表达在这个国家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who does manual work, assists another worker, or learns a trade as an apprentice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事体力劳动的人，也可按语境指协助其他工人的帮工，或学习手艺的学徒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel xogħol bl-idejn, tgħin ħaddiem ieħor, jew titgħallem sengħa bħala apprendist.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体力劳动者；从事手工或体力工作的人。
助手；帮工。
学徒；跟随师傅学习手艺的人。
劳工；工人，通常指从事体力劳动的人。

formal.mt: Il-lavrant għen lill-bennej iġorr il-materjal u jħejji l-post tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The labourer helped the builder carry the materials and prepare the work area.
formal.zh: 这名帮工协助建筑工搬运材料，并准备作业场地。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tagħmel fil-ħanut tax-xogħol? Mark: Naħdem bħala lavrant u qed nitgħallem is-sengħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do you do in the workshop? Mark: I work as an assistant and I'm learning the trade.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在车间做什么工作？马克：我做帮工，也在学习这门手艺。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在车间做什么工作？
messages.en: What do you do in the workshop?

messages.speaker: Mark (车间帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħdem bħala lavrant u qed nitgħallem is-sengħa.
messages.mt_standard: Naħdem bħala lavrant u qed nitgħallem is-sengħa.
messages.zh: 我做帮工，也在学习这门手艺。
messages.en: I work as an assistant and I'm learning the trade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象车间里一位搬材料、帮师傅、学手艺的人，分别对应劳工、帮工和学徒三个语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work done to make something, or the skill and quality shown in how it is made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作物品所做的工作，也指制作时体现的技艺和做工质量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li jsir biex tinħadem xi ħaġa, jew is-sengħa u l-kwalità li jidhru fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作；制作或加工所做的劳动。
做工；物品制作时体现的工艺水平。

formal.mt: Il-lavur fin fuq il-bieb tal-injam juri s-sengħa tal-ħaddiem.
formal.en: The fine workmanship on the wooden door shows the worker's skill.
formal.zh: 木门上的精细做工体现了工匠的技艺。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Jogħġbok dan il-mejda? Pawlu: Iva, il-lavur tagħha hu tassew fin.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you like this table? Pawlu: Yes, its workmanship is really fine.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你喜欢这张桌子吗？保罗：喜欢，它的做工真精细。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这张桌子吗？
messages.en: Do you like this table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-lavur tagħha hu tassew fin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-lavur tagħha hu tassew fin.
messages.zh: 喜欢，它的做工真精细。
messages.en: Yes, its workmanship is really fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用手抚过木门上的精细雕刻，把 lavur 与“做了什么工作、做工好不好”两个问题一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cord or string used for tying or fastening something, especially a shoelace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于捆扎或系紧东西的细绳、系带，尤其指鞋带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel irqiq jew qafla li tintuża biex torbot jew tagħlaq xi ħaġa, speċjalment żarbun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细绳；用于系扎的绳带。
鞋带；用于系紧鞋子的带子。
系带；细线或细绳。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, kull parteċipant għandu jiċċekkja li kull lazz taż-żarbun ikun marbut sew.
formal.en: Before departure, every participant should check that each shoelace is securely tied.
formal.zh: 出发前，每位参与者都应检查每根鞋带是否系牢。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek lazz maħlul. Mark: Grazzi, se norbtu issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: You have a loose shoelace. Mark: Thanks, I'll tie it now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有根鞋带松了。马克：谢谢，我现在就把它系好。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有根鞋带松了。
messages.en: You have a loose shoelace.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我现在就把它系好。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll tie it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lazz 放进弯腰系鞋带的画面中：先想到鞋带，再扩展到其他用来系东西的细绳。

gloss_zh: 到达；追上；及时赶到；晋升；达到；成熟；竞争；聪明

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reach a place, person or target, including catching up with someone or arriving in time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 到达某个地方、赶上某人或达到某个目标，也可表示及时赶到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tasal f'post, tilħaq persuna jew mira, jew tasal fil-ħin biex tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到达；达到。
追上；赶上。
刚好及时赶到；恰好来得及。
获晋升；被提拔。

sense_translations.en_definition: to reach, to manage to get to, to catch up with
sense_translations.zh_definition: 到达；设法赶到；追上某人或某物。
总计达到；数量或程度达到。
得到晋升；升职。
成熟；果实等变熟。
竞争；与他人较量。
聪明；机灵。

formal.mt: Il-grupp laħaq il-quċċata qabel nofsinhar u mbagħad waqaf biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: The group reached the summit before noon and then stopped to rest.
formal.zh: 一行人在中午之前到达山顶，随后停下来休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark laħaq ix-xarabank? Pawlu: Iva, wasal eżatt fil-ħin qabel telaq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark catch the bus? Pawlu: Yes, he arrived just in time before it left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克赶上公交车了吗？保罗：赶上了，他在车开走前刚好赶到。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克赶上公交车了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark catch the bus?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wasal eżatt fil-ħin qabel telaq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wasal eżatt fil-ħin qabel telaq.
messages.zh: 赶上了，他在车开走前刚好赶到。
messages.en: Yes, he arrived just in time before it left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“终于赶上公交车”固定到达与及时赶上的画面，再分别用升职、金额、果实三张卡记其他义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wash something briefly with water, especially to remove soap or loose dirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水冲洗某物，尤其指冲掉肥皂或松散污物；也可指漱口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħsel xi ħaġa bl-ilma biex tneħħi s-sapun jew il-ħmieġ, jew tnaddaf ħalqek billi ddawwar l-ilma fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冲洗；漂洗；漱洗。

sense_translations.en_definition: to move around, up and down, to joggle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使来回或上下移动；晃动；颠动。
抖动、抖松或抖蓬被褥等物。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, laħlaħ it-tazza b'ilma nadif biex tneħħi kull traċċa tas-sapun.
formal.en: After washing, rinse the cup with clean water to remove every trace of soap.
formal.zh: 洗涤后，用清水冲洗杯子，除去所有肥皂残留。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nimla l-flixkun bl-ilma? Pawlu: Iva, imma l-ewwel laħlaħ il-flixkun sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I fill the bottle with water? Pawlu: Yes, but rinse the bottle thoroughly first.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以往瓶子里装水吗？保罗：可以，不过先把瓶子冲洗干净。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 我可以往瓶子里装水吗？
messages.en: Can I fill the bottle with water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel laħlaħ il-flixkun sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel laħlaħ il-flixkun sew.
messages.zh: 可以，不过先把瓶子冲洗干净。
messages.en: Yes, but rinse the bottle thoroughly first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着杯子来回晃水，把泡沫冲走，先记“冲洗”；再单独配上抖被子的画面，记住另一组动作义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a substantial amount of flesh or thick, soft tissue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有较多肉或厚实柔软组织的；可形容身体部位或植物的肉质部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna laħam jew tessut oħxon u artab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肉质的；多肉的；组织厚实柔软的。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta għandha zokk laħmi, oħxon u artab meta tmissu.
formal.en: The plant has a fleshy stem that is thick and soft to the touch.
formal.zh: 这种植物的茎呈肉质，粗厚而且摸起来柔软。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan iz-zokk jidher daqshekk oħxon? Mark: Għax hu laħmi; messu bil-mod u tħoss kemm hu artab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this stem look so thick? Mark: Because it's fleshy; touch it gently and you'll feel how soft it is.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：这根茎为什么看起来这么粗厚？马克：因为它是肉质的；轻轻摸一下，就能感觉到它有多柔软。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan iz-zokk jidher daqshekk oħxon?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan iz-zokk jidher daqshekk oħxon?
messages.zh: 这根茎为什么看起来这么粗厚？
messages.en: Why does this stem look so thick?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu laħmi; messu bil-mod u tħoss kemm hu artab.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu laħmi; messu bil-mod u tħoss kemm hu artab.
messages.zh: 因为它是肉质的；轻轻摸一下，就能感觉到它有多柔软。
messages.en: Because it's fleshy; touch it gently and you'll feel how soft it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一片厚厚软软的肉质叶，用触感记住“肉厚、柔软”；再把 zokk laħmi 与 werqa laħmija 成对朗读。

gloss_zh: 使长肉；使具象化；充实；详加阐述

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an animal fatter, or figuratively to give an idea or argument more substance and detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使动物长肉、变肥；也比喻为想法或论证补充实质内容与细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel annimal iżid fil-laħam, jew tagħti aktar sustanza u dettall lil idea jew argument.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使长肉；使变肥；育肥。
使化为肉身；使某种抽象存在获得具体形体。

sense_translations.en_definition: to add substance to an argument or artefact
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为论证或作品增添实质内容，使其更充实。
详加阐述；充分展开说明。
使具象化；体现；使某种观念获得具体形态。

formal.mt: L-awtur laħħam l-argument b'eżempji konkreti u b'analiżi aktar dettaljata.
formal.en: The author fleshed out the argument with concrete examples and more detailed analysis.
formal.zh: 作者通过具体例子和更详细的分析充实了论证。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-argument tiegħi jidher qasir wisq? Mark: Iva, laħħam l-argument b'żewġ eżempji u spjega għaliex huma importanti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does my argument seem too short? Mark: Yes, flesh out the argument with two examples and explain why they matter.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：我的论证是不是显得太简略了？马克：是的，加两个例子充实论证，再解释它们为什么重要。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我的论证是不是显得太简略了？
messages.en: Does my argument seem too short?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, laħħam l-argument b'żewġ eżempji u spjega għaliex huma importanti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, laħħam l-argument b'żewġ eżempji u spjega għaliex huma importanti.
messages.zh: 是的，加两个例子充实论证，再解释它们为什么重要。
messages.en: Yes, flesh out the argument with two examples and explain why they matter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把提纲想成只有骨架的文章，加入例子就像给它添上血肉；用这个画面记“充实”，同时另记“育肥”的字面义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clothes worn on the body, the act of dressing, or the style of clothing chosen for an occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在身上的衣物，也可指穿衣这一行为，或为某种场合选择的着装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħwejjeġ li jintlibsu fuq il-ġisem, l-att li wieħed jilbes, jew it-tip ta' ħwejjeġ magħżul għal okkażjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣服；穿在身上的衣物总称。
衣物；服装。
穿衣；穿戴衣物的行为。
着装；适合某种场合或具有某种风格的服饰。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla uffiċjali, il-mistednin huma mitluba jilbsu lbies formali.
formal.en: For the official dinner, guests are asked to wear formal attire.
formal.zh: 出席正式晚宴的宾客须穿着正装。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għandi nieħu għall-vjaġġ? David: Ħu lbies tax-xitwa, għax hemmhekk jagħmel il-bard.
colloquial.en: Anna: What should I take for the trip? David: Take winter clothing, because it is cold there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这次旅行我该带些什么？戴维：带冬装吧，因为那里很冷。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 这次旅行我该带些什么？
messages.en: What should I take for the trip?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu lbies tax-xitwa, għax hemmhekk jagħmel il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu lbies tax-xitwa, għax hemmhekk jagħmel il-bard.
messages.zh: 带冬装吧，因为那里很冷。
messages.en: Take winter clothing, because it is cold there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开衣柜选择旅行服装：lbies 可以统指衣物，也能把注意力放在穿衣和整套着装上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The direction between south and west, or a wind blowing from that direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 南与西之间的方向，即西南方；也指从西南方吹来的风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-direzzjoni bejn in-Nofsinhar u l-Punent, jew ir-riħ li jonfoħ minn dik id-direzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西南；南与西之间的方向。
西南方；西南部地区。
西南风；从西南方吹来的风。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi triq li tibqa' sejra lejn il-Lbiċ sal-kosta.
formal.en: The map shows a road continuing southwest to the coast.
formal.zh: 地图显示，一条道路向西南方向一直延伸到海岸。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn ġej ir-riħ illum? Toni: Mil-Lbiċ; ara kif qed jiċċaqlaq il-bandiera.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the wind coming from today? Toni: From the southwest; look how the flag is moving.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天的风是从哪边吹来的？托尼：从西南方；你看旗子是怎么飘的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天的风是从哪边吹来的？
messages.en: Where is the wind coming from today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mil-Lbiċ; ara kif qed jiċċaqlaq il-bandiera.
messages.mt_standard: Mil-Lbiċ; ara kif qed jiċċaqlaq il-bandiera.
messages.zh: 从西南方；你看旗子是怎么飘的。
messages.en: From the southwest; look how the flag is moving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在常见的上北地图上，把 Lbiċ 标在左下角；谈风时记住它说的是风从西南方吹来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cry with broken breaths, or to make a low sound expressing pain or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哭泣时因呼吸断续而抽泣、呜咽，也可指因痛苦或难受而呻吟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibki b'nifs imqatta', jew joħroġ ħoss baxx ta' wġigħ jew dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽泣；呜咽着哭。
呻吟；因疼痛或难受而发出低沉的声音。

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-aħbar, ir-raġel lefaq u għal ftit ħin ma setax jitkellem.
formal.en: After hearing the news, the man sobbed and could not speak for a short while.
formal.zh: 听到消息后，那名男子抽泣起来，一时说不出话。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex lefaq it-tifel? Ġużeppi: Tilef il-ġugarell favorit tiegħu, imma issa qed jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did the boy sob? Ġużeppi: He lost his favourite toy, but he is calming down now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：那个男孩为什么抽泣？约瑟夫：他弄丢了最喜欢的玩具，不过现在正慢慢平静下来。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么抽泣？
messages.en: Why did the boy sob?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tilef il-ġugarell favorit tiegħu, imma issa qed jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Tilef il-ġugarell favorit tiegħu, imma issa qed jikkalma.
messages.zh: 他弄丢了最喜欢的玩具，不过现在正慢慢平静下来。
messages.en: He lost his favourite toy, but he is calming down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lefaq 配上一抽一抽哭泣的声音来记；若语境强调疼痛，就转想到低声呻吟。

gloss_zh: 包裹；裹住；击打；披巾；围巾

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wrap something in a covering or to put something around a person or object so that it is covered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用包覆物把东西包起来，或把布等围在某人、某物周围以将其裹住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawwar xi ħaġa b'karta, drapp jew materjal ieħor biex tgħattiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包裹；用纸、布等包住。
打；击打。
披巾或围巾。

sense_translations.en_definition: clothing in which one wraps oneself up
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来裹住身体的衣物。
包好；裹住；覆盖。

collocations.en: wrapped the scarf around his neck

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem leff l-oġġett fid-drapp qabel poġġieh fil-kaxxa.
formal.en: The worker wrapped the object in cloth before placing it in the box.
formal.zh: 工人先用布把物品包好，再将其放入箱子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min leff ir-rigal? Karl: Jien, u żidt żigarella ħamra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who wrapped the gift? Karl: I did, and I added a red ribbon.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁包的礼物？卡尔：我包的，还加了一条红丝带。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁包的礼物？
messages.en: Who wrapped the gift?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 我包的，还加了一条红丝带。
messages.en: I did, and I added a red ribbon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用包礼物的动作记住动词 leff；再单独记名词“披巾、围巾”和另一动词义“击打”，不要混用词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive inspiration or to give someone inspiration to think, create, or act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获得思想或创作上的启发，也可指使别人产生灵感或行动的想法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikseb ispirazzjoni jew jagħti lil xi ħadd ispirazzjoni biex jaħseb, joħloq jew jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到启发；产生灵感。
启发他人；使人产生灵感。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb lehem mill-pajsaġġ u beda jikteb storja dwar il-ħajja fir-raħal.
formal.en: The writer was inspired by the landscape and began writing a story about village life.
formal.zh: 那位作家从风景中获得灵感，开始写一个关于乡村生活的故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif beda jikteb din il-poeżija? Pawlu: Lehem mill-baħar waqt mixja.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he start writing this poem? Pawlu: He was inspired by the sea during a walk.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他是怎么开始写这首诗的？Pawlu：他散步时从大海获得了灵感。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是怎么开始写这首诗的？
messages.en: How did he start writing this poem?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他散步时从大海获得了灵感。
messages.en: He was inspired by the sea during a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lehem 放进“看海后忽然想写诗”的画面：诗人受到启发，大海启发诗人，用同一场景记住灵感的两个方向。

gloss_zh: 喘气；喘鸣；呼吸沉重；渴望

teaching_sense.en_definition: To breathe rapidly, heavily, or with difficulty; also to long strongly for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 急促、沉重或费力地呼吸，也可表示强烈渴望某事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu n-nifs malajr, bil-qawwi jew bit-tbatija; jista' jfisser ukoll li jixtieq xi ħaġa bil-ħerqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喘气；急促地呼吸。
喘鸣；呼吸时发出咝咝或哮鸣声。
沉重地呼吸；大口喘气。

sense_translations.en_definition: to long or lust for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈渴望某事物；对某事物怀有强烈欲望。
呼吸费力；气喘吁吁。

formal.mt: Wara li tela' t-taraġ kollu, ir-raġel leheġ għal ftit ħin qabel kompla jitkellem.
formal.en: After climbing all the stairs, the man panted for a short while before continuing to speak.
formal.zh: 爬完全部楼梯后，那名男子喘了一会儿，才继续说话。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex leheġ il-kelb wara l-mixja? Ben: Kien hemm ħafna sħana; issa qed jistrieħ fid-dell.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did the dog pant after the walk? Ben: It was very hot; now he is resting in the shade.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：狗散步后为什么直喘气？本：天气很热；它现在正在阴凉处休息。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗散步后为什么直喘气？
messages.en: Why did the dog pant after the walk?

messages.speaker: Ben (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna sħana; issa qed jistrieħ fid-dell.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna sħana; issa qed jistrieħ fid-dell.
messages.zh: 天气很热；它现在正在阴凉处休息。
messages.en: It was very hot; now he is resting in the shade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用跑完楼梯后大口喘气的画面记 leheġ；遇到愿望语境时，再联想“迫切想得到某物”的渴望义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inspiration, a particular inspired idea, or an instinctive feeling that guides a response.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创作或思考时产生的灵感、某个具体的灵感，也可指引导反应的本能或直觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ispirazzjoni, idea li tiġi f'moħħ persuna, jew istint li jiggwida r-reazzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灵感；促使人创作或思考的启发。
本能；不经有意识推理而产生的直觉。
一个灵感；一次具体的启发或由此产生的想法。

collocations.zh: 一个好灵感或好的直觉

formal.mt: Il-lehma għall-poeżija ġiet waqt żjara fil-ġnien, fejn l-awtriċi osservat il-kuluri tal-fjuri.
formal.en: The inspiration for the poem came during a visit to the garden, where the author observed the colours of the flowers.
formal.zh: 这首诗的灵感来自一次花园之行，当时作者观察了花朵的色彩。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadni ma nafx kif nibda l-istorja. Lara: Forsi tiġik il-lehma waqt mixja.
colloquial.en: Sara: I still don't know how to begin the story. Lara: Perhaps inspiration will come to you during a walk.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我还是不知道这个故事该怎么开头。Lara：也许散步时你就会有灵感。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx kif nibda l-istorja.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx kif nibda l-istorja.
messages.zh: 我还是不知道这个故事该怎么开头。
messages.en: I still don't know how to begin the story.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 也许散步时你就会有灵感。
messages.en: Perhaps inspiration will come to you during a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lehma 想成脑中亮起的小灯泡：写作时是灵感，迅速判断时是直觉；再用“一盏灯泡”记住一个具体灵感的意思。

gloss_zh: 傍晚；晚上；用于某项活动的一晚

teaching_sense.en_definition: The evening or night, especially an evening or night spent on a particular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 傍晚或夜晚，也可指用于某项活动、具有特定经历的一个晚上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin ta' filgħaxija jew tal-lejl, speċjalment meta jkun iddedikat għal attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傍晚；晚上较早的一段时间。
夜晚；一晚。

sense_translations.en_definition: night (evening or night spent at a particular activity)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于某项活动的一个晚上；围绕特定活动度过的一晚。

collocations.zh: 一个欣赏音乐的晚上；音乐之夜

formal.mt: Il-librerija organizzat lejla ta' qari u diskussjoni biex tlaqqa' flimkien lill-awturi u lill-qarrejja.
formal.en: The library organised an evening of reading and discussion to bring authors and readers together.
formal.zh: 图书馆举办了一个阅读与讨论之夜，让作者和读者相聚交流。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet il-lejla mal-ħbieb? Pawlu: Sabiħa ħafna! Kilna flimkien u lgħabna l-karti.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was your evening with friends? Pawlu: Really lovely! We ate together and played cards.
colloquial.zh: Maja：和朋友们一起度过的那个晚上怎么样？Pawlu：特别愉快！我们一起吃了饭，还玩了纸牌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 和朋友们一起度过的那个晚上怎么样？
messages.en: How was your evening with friends?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sabiħa ħafna! Kilna flimkien u lgħabna l-karti.
messages.mt_standard: Sabiħa ħafna! Kilna flimkien u lgħabna l-karti.
messages.zh: 特别愉快！我们一起吃了饭，还玩了纸牌。
messages.en: Really lovely! We ate together and played cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lejla 想成日历里的一格晚间时光：格子里可以写聚餐、阅读或音乐，既记住晚上，也记住围绕某项活动度过的一晚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the direction of a person, place, or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示朝某个人、地方或事物所在的方向移动或转向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Turi d-direzzjoni ta' moviment jew ħarsa lejn persuna, post jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝；向；表示所趋向的方向。
往；向；引出移动所朝向的地点或对象。

sense_translations.en_definition: to, toward, towards (in the direction of, arriving at)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 往；朝；向；表示朝某处前进，也可在抵达的语境中引出目的地。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom jimxu lejn id-daħla prinċipali tal-mużew.
formal.en: Visitors should walk towards the main entrance of the museum.
formal.zh: 参观者应朝博物馆的正门走。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer? Mark: Sejjer lejn il-pjazza. Trid tiġi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going? Mark: I'm heading towards the square. Do you want to come with me?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你要去哪里？Mark：我正往广场走。你想跟我一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer lejn il-pjazza. Trid tiġi miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer lejn il-pjazza. Trid tiġi miegħi?
messages.zh: 我正往广场走。你想跟我一起去吗？
messages.en: I'm heading towards the square. Do you want to come with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lejn 想成一支指向目标的箭头：走向房子、望向大海，都用它标出方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chrysanthemum flowers, including the yellow flowers of garland chrysanthemum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指菊花，也可指开黄色花朵的茼蒿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjuri tal-krisantemu, fosthom il-fjuri sofor tal-ispeċi Glebionis coronaria.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 园艺菊花；指其花朵。
茼蒿（Glebionis coronaria）；此处指其黄色花朵。

collocations.en: a field full of garland chrysanthemums

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher għalqa mimlija lellux isfar.
formal.en: The photograph shows a field full of yellow garland chrysanthemums.
formal.zh: 照片中是一片开满黄色茼蒿花的田野。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimhom dawk il-fjuri sofor? Pawlu: Dak lellux. Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are those yellow flowers called? Pawlu: Those are garland chrysanthemums. Let's take a photo.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那些黄色的花叫什么？Pawlu：那是黄花茼蒿。我们拍张照片吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那些黄色的花叫什么？
messages.en: What are those yellow flowers called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是黄花茼蒿。我们拍张照片吧。
messages.en: Those are garland chrysanthemums. Let's take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 lellux，就想象田野里一片黄色菊状花；用这幅画面记住花名及其黄色花朵义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give off or reflect a small, brief, or flickering light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出或反射细小、短暂或闪烁的光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti jew jirrifletti dawl ħafif, qasir jew li jteptep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪出一道细小而短暂的光。
闪闪发光；闪烁。
闪烁；闪光；发出微弱的光。

formal.mt: Meta nfetħet il-kaxxa, iċ-ċurkett lema fid-dawl tat-tieqa.
formal.en: When the box was opened, the ring glinted in the light from the window.
formal.zh: 盒子打开时，戒指在窗边透进来的光线中闪了一下。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt xi ħaġa ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Iva, ċavetta. Il-metall lema fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see something near the door? Mark: Yes, a key. The metal glinted in the sunlight.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看到门旁边有什么东西了吗？Mark：看到了，是一把钥匙。金属在阳光下闪了一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你看到门旁边有什么东西了吗？
messages.en: Did you see something near the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 看到了，是一把钥匙。金属在阳光下闪了一下。
messages.en: Yes, a key. The metal glinted in the sunlight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面对照记忆：lema 是戒指闪光，lemaħ 是人瞥见戒指；注意后者末尾多一个 ħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To catch sight of, notice, or discern someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瞥见、注意到或辨认出某个人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jara, jinduna b'xi ħadd jew b'xi ħaġa, jew jagħrafhom, anki b'ħarsa qasira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞥见；短暂地看见。
察觉；感知到。
察觉；辨认出；看见。

collocations.en: spotted a boat in the distance

formal.mt: Mill-gallarija, ir-raġel lemaħ dgħajsa żgħira qrib ix-xatt.
formal.en: From the balcony, the man spotted a small boat near the shore.
formal.zh: 那名男子从阳台上看见了岸边附近的一艘小船。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark għadu ma wasalx? Lara: Wasal! Pawlu lemaħ lil Mark ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Mark still not arrived? Lara: He's here! Pawlu spotted Mark near the door.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 还没到吗？Lara：他到了！Pawlu 在门旁边看见他了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 还没到吗？
messages.en: Has Mark still not arrived?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasal! Pawlu lemaħ lil Mark ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Wasal! Pawlu lemaħ lil Mark ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 他到了！Pawlu 在门旁边看见他了。
messages.en: He's here! Pawlu spotted Mark near the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lemaħ 配上在人群中突然看见朋友的画面：重点是人察觉到了什么，而不是物体发光。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The right-hand side of a person, object, or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人、物体或地点的右边、右侧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-naħa tal-lemin ta' persuna, oġġett jew post, opposta għax-xellug.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 右边；右侧。
右侧；右方。

formal.mt: Id-daħla tal-librerija tinsab fuq il-lemin tal-bini.
formal.en: The library entrance is on the right-hand side of the building.
formal.zh: 图书馆入口位于大楼的右侧。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-ispiżerija? Lara: Dur lejn il-lemin. Tinsab ħdejn il-ħanut tal-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the pharmacy? Lara: Turn right. It's next to the bakery.
colloquial.zh: Mark：药店在哪里？Lara：向右转。它就在面包店旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (问路者)
messages.zh: 药店在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the pharmacy?

messages.speaker: Lara (路人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dur lejn il-lemin. Tinsab ħdejn il-ħanut tal-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Dur lejn il-lemin. Tinsab ħdejn il-ħanut tal-ħobż.
messages.zh: 向右转。它就在面包店旁边。
messages.en: Turn right. It's next to the bakery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 举起右手记 lemin，再配两句话：fuq il-lemin 表示在右边，lejn il-lemin 表示朝右边。

gloss_zh: 使看见；使察觉；使辨认出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to perceive or discern something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人看见、察觉或辨认出某事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jara jew jagħraf xi ħaġa, billi jiġbidlu l-attenzjoni lejha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人察觉到；使某人看见。
使察觉；使辨认出。

collocations.en: made the student perceive the difference
made the reader discern the connection

formal.mt: Permezz tal-eżempji, l-awtur lemmaħ lill-qarrej ir-rabta bejn iż-żewġ ideat.
formal.en: Through the examples, the author made the reader discern the connection between the two ideas.
formal.zh: 作者通过例子使读者看出了这两个观点之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif għaraf Mark id-differenza? Pawlu: L-għalliem lemmaħ lil Mark id-differenza b'eżempju sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark recognize the difference? Pawlu: The teacher made Mark see the difference with a simple example.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 是怎么看出差别的？Pawlu：老师用一个简单的例子让 Mark 看出了差别。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: Mark 是怎么看出差别的？
messages.en: How did Mark recognize the difference?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem lemmaħ lil Mark id-differenza b'eżempju sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem lemmaħ lil Mark id-differenza b'eżempju sempliċi.
messages.zh: 老师用一个简单的例子让 Mark 看出了差别。
messages.en: The teacher made Mark see the difference with a simple example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lemmaħ 放进老师指点学生的画面：有人让另一个人看出来；与 lemaħ“自己察觉”对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brief look or a momentary perception of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短暂的一看，或一瞬间对某事物的察觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħarsa qasira jew perċezzjoni ta' xi ħaġa għal waqt qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一瞥；匆匆的一看。
一次感知或察觉；一瞥。

formal.mt: Qabel beda d-diskors, il-kelliem ta lemħa lejn in-noti tiegħu.
formal.en: Before beginning the speech, the speaker glanced at his notes.
formal.zh: 开始演讲前，演讲者瞥了一眼自己的笔记。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ħarist lejn il-lista? Pawlu: Iva, tajt lemħa lejha. Ismek qiegħed hemm.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you look at the list? Pawlu: Yes, I glanced at it. Your name is there.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你看名单了吗？Pawlu：看了，我瞥了一眼。你的名字在上面。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 你看名单了吗？
messages.en: Did you look at the list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tajt lemħa lejha. Ismek qiegħed hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tajt lemħa lejha. Ismek qiegħed hemm.
messages.zh: 看了，我瞥了一眼。你的名字在上面。
messages.en: Yes, I glanced at it. Your name is there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lemħa 记成可以数出来的“一瞥”：看钟一眼、看名单一眼，都是短暂的一看。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shine brightly or reflect a bright light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 明亮地发光，或反射出耀眼的光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddi b'dawl qawwi jew jirrifletti dawl qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发亮；闪耀。
发光；照耀。

sense_translations.en_definition: to shine brightly, to gleam, glitter
sense_translations.zh_definition: 明亮地发光；闪耀；闪闪发亮。

sense_translations.en_definition: no, nope; an alternative form of le
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不；不是；用于否定回答，是 le 的另一种形式。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, il-wiċċ tal-metall leqq fid-dawl tax-xemx.
formal.en: After cleaning, the metal surface gleamed in the sunlight.
formal.zh: 清洁后，金属表面在阳光下闪闪发亮。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid aktar ilma? Lara: Leqq, grazzi. Għandi biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like more water? Lara: Nope, thanks. I have enough.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你还要水吗？Lara：不了，谢谢。我已经够了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还要水吗？
messages.en: Would you like more water?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。我已经够了。
messages.en: Nope, thanks. I have enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 leqq 准备两张记忆卡：金属闪耀对应动词，回答“不”对应感叹词；用句子语境区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The vocabulary of a language, subject or person, or a collection of words with information about them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种语言、某个领域或个人使用的词汇总和，也可指汇集词语并提供相关说明的词汇集。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġabra ta' kliem ta' lingwa, ta' qasam jew ta' persuna, jew ġabra ta' kliem bi spjegazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词汇系统；词汇集；词库

formal.mt: Dan il-kors jgħin lill-istudenti jkabbru l-lessiku tagħhom permezz tal-qari.
formal.en: This course helps students expand their vocabulary through reading.
formal.zh: 这门课程帮助学生通过阅读扩大词汇量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' nkabbar il-lessiku tiegħi? Pawlu: Aqra ftit kuljum u ikteb il-kliem il-ġdid f'notebook.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I expand my vocabulary? Pawlu: Read a little every day and write the new words in a notebook.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎样才能扩大词汇量？保罗：每天读一点，把新词记在笔记本里。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我怎样才能扩大词汇量？
messages.en: How can I expand my vocabulary?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqra ftit kuljum u ikteb il-kliem il-ġdid f'notebook.
messages.mt_standard: Aqra ftit kuljum u ikteb il-kliem il-ġdid f'notebook.
messages.zh: 每天读一点，把新词记在笔记本里。
messages.en: Read a little every day and write the new words in a notebook.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lessiku 想成脑中的词语书架：每学会一个新词，就往书架上添一本小书，整个书架就是词汇库。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring a task or activity to an end, completing what needs to be done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把任务或活动做到结束，完成需要做的事情，也可表示做完后停止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib xogħol jew attività fi tmiemhom billi jagħmel dak kollu li jkun meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做完；结束
完成；把所需部分全部做完

sense_translations.en_definition: to finish; to complete; to stop because one is ready, done
sense_translations.zh_definition: 做完；完成；因事情已经做好而停止

formal.mt: L-istudent lesta r-rapport u bagħtu lill-għalliem qabel id-data tal-għeluq.
formal.en: The student completed the report and sent it to the teacher before the deadline.
formal.zh: 这名学生完成了报告，并在截止日期前发给了老师。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejt ix-xogħol? Mark: Iva, lestejt kollox. Issa nistgħu noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished the work? Mark: Yes, I've finished everything. We can go out now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把工作做完了吗？马克：做完了，全都完成了。现在我们可以出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把工作做完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lestejt kollox. Issa nistgħu noħorġu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lestejt kollox. Issa nistgħu noħorġu.
messages.zh: 做完了，全都完成了。现在我们可以出去了。
messages.en: Yes, I've finished everything. We can go out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lesta 时想象任务清单上的最后一个方框被打勾：事情全部做完，终于可以收工。这里按动词义记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend or curve something, contort it, or change direction by taking a turn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体弯曲或扭曲，也可指行进或驾驶时改变方向、向左或向右转弯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa mgħawġa jew milwija, jew ibiddel id-direzzjoni billi jdur lejn ix-xellug jew il-lemin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄弯；使弯曲
使呈曲线；弯曲

sense_translations.en_definition: to take a turning (e.g. while driving)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 转弯；拐入岔路，例如驾驶时转向
弯曲；扭曲

sense_translations.en_definition: to turn (left or right on one’s way)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在行进途中向左或向右转弯

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem lewa l-wajer bil-mod biex jagħtih il-forma meħtieġa.
formal.en: The worker slowly bent the wire to give it the required shape.
formal.zh: 工人慢慢地弯折金属丝，使它形成所需的形状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn lewa Mark bil-karozza? Pawlu: Lewa lejn il-lemin wara l-knisja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Mark turn in the car? Pawlu: He turned right after the church.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克开车到哪里转弯了？保罗：他过了教堂后向右转了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克开车到哪里转弯了？
messages.en: Where did Mark turn in the car?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他过了教堂后向右转了。
messages.en: He turned right after the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一条弯起来的线记 lewa：手里的金属丝可以弯，地图上的行进路线也可以拐弯，把两个场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression of objection, blame or reproach concerning someone's conduct or something that has happened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对某人的行为或已经发生的事情表达的异议、责备或责难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' oġġezzjoni, ħtija jew ċanfira dwar l-imġiba ta' xi ħadd jew dwar xi ħaġa li ġrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 异议；反对意见
责备；归咎
责难；指责；表达不满的责备

formal.mt: Il-maniġer spjega l-iżball mingħajr kliem ta' lewm u talab li jiġi kkoreġut.
formal.en: The manager explained the mistake without words of reproach and asked for it to be corrected.
formal.zh: 经理说明了错误，没有使用责备的话，并要求予以改正。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dak it-ton ta' lewm? Mark: Għax il-kċina għadha maħmuġa, u aħna t-tnejn wegħedna li nnaddfuha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why that reproachful tone? Mark: Because the kitchen is still dirty, and we both promised to clean it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么用这种责备的语气？马克：因为厨房还很脏，而我们两个都答应过要打扫。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 怎么用这种责备的语气？
messages.en: Why that reproachful tone?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kċina għadha maħmuġa, u aħna t-tnejn wegħedna li nnaddfuha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kċina għadha maħmuġa, u aħna t-tnejn wegħedna li nnaddfuha.
messages.zh: 因为厨房还很脏，而我们两个都答应过要打扫。
messages.en: Because the kitchen is still dirty, and we both promised to clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lewm 放进责备的语气这个场景来记：一句话的内容可能很平常，语气却在表达不满或归咎。注意词尾是 m。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A colour or particular hue, including a slight trace of colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色或某一种具体色调，也可指淡淡的一层色彩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kulur jew sfumatura partikolari tiegħu, anki meta l-kulur jidher biss ħafif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颜色；色彩
淡淡的一抹颜色；微量的色彩
色调；某一种颜色的具体色相

formal.mt: Id-dawl ta' filgħaxija ta lewn aħmar lill-ħitan tal-bini.
formal.en: The evening light gave the building's walls a red hue.
formal.zh: 傍晚的光线给建筑物的墙壁染上了红色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'lewn trid għall-ħajt? Mark: Irrid lewn blu ċar, bħal dak tas-sema.
colloquial.en: Maja: What colour do you want for the wall? Mark: I want a light blue hue, like the sky.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想把墙弄成什么颜色？马克：我想要浅蓝色，像天空那样。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你想把墙弄成什么颜色？
messages.en: What colour do you want for the wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid lewn blu ċar, bħal dak tas-sema.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid lewn blu ċar, bħal dak tas-sema.
messages.zh: 我想要浅蓝色，像天空那样。
messages.en: I want a light blue hue, like the sky.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lewn 写在一张色卡旁，看到它就想到颜色和色调；再与 lewm 对照：词尾 n 配色卡，词尾 m 配责备的对话。

gloss_zh: 着色；染上某种色调；使色彩丰富

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add colour to something, give it a particular hue, or make it colourful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某物加上颜色，使其呈现某种色调，或使其变得色彩丰富。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti kulur lil xi ħaġa, jagħtiha lewn partikolari jew jagħmilha mimlija kuluri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……着色；涂色
使呈现某种特定色调；染上某种颜色
使色彩丰富；使变得多彩

formal.mt: Id-dawl tax-xemx lewwen is-sema b'kuluri ħomor u oranġjo.
formal.en: The sunlight coloured the sky in shades of red and orange.
formal.zh: 阳光把天空染成了红色和橙色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min lewwen din l-istampa? Pawlu: Ħija ż-żgħir. Uża l-aħmar għall-fjuri u l-aħdar għall-weraq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who coloured this picture? Pawlu: My little brother. He used red for the flowers and green for the leaves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画是谁涂的色？保罗：我弟弟。他把花涂成红色，把叶子涂成绿色。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这幅画是谁涂的色？
messages.en: Who coloured this picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ż-żgħir. Uża l-aħmar għall-fjuri u l-aħdar għall-weraq.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ż-żgħir. Uża l-aħmar għall-fjuri u l-aħdar għall-weraq.
messages.zh: 我弟弟。他把花涂成红色，把叶子涂成绿色。
messages.en: My little brother. He used red for the flowers and green for the leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lewn 和 lewwen 配成学习卡：前者旁边画一块颜色，后者旁边画正在涂色的手，用静态颜色和着色动作区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Almonds considered collectively or as a food or kind of nut; also a general term for nuts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集合意义上的杏仁，也可把杏仁作为食材或一个种类来指称；另可泛指坚果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frott tas-siġra tal-lewż, meqjus flimkien jew bħala ikel jew tip ta' frott; ukoll kelma ġenerali għal frott b'qoxra iebsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杏仁，集合地指若干颗杏仁
坚果的统称；泛指各种坚果

sense_translations.en_definition: almond, almonds (several nuts; almond as a mass or species)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 杏仁；多颗杏仁，或作为食材、整体及种类名称的杏仁

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, itħan il-lewż u ħalltu mad-dqiq qabel iżżid il-bajd.
formal.en: For this recipe, grind the almonds and mix them with the flour before adding the eggs.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，先把杏仁磨碎并与面粉混合，再加入鸡蛋。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit lewż mixwi? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Poġġili ftit fi skutella.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some roasted almonds? Mark: Yes, thanks. Put some in a bowl for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想吃点烤杏仁吗？马克：想，谢谢。帮我放一点在碗里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃点烤杏仁吗？
messages.en: Would you like some roasted almonds?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Poġġili ftit fi skutella.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Poġġili ftit fi skutella.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。帮我放一点在碗里。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Put some in a bowl for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lewż 与一碗杏仁的画面绑定：这张词卡可以指一整碗杏仁或杏仁这种食材，遇到较宽泛语境时再想到坚果总称。

gloss_zh: 用锛修整木材；翻土除草；锄草

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dress timber with an adze or similar tool, or to work the soil with a hoe to remove weeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锛或类似工具削整木材；也可指用锄头翻动土壤、清除杂草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem u jillixxa l-injam b'għodda bħal lexxuna, jew jaqleb il-ħamrija b'mgħażqa biex ineħħi l-ħaxix ħażin.

sense_translations.en_definition: to dress timber (using an adze or similar implement)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锛或类似工具修整木材，削去多余部分并整平表面

sense_translations.en_definition: to turn over soil to remove weeds
sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻动土壤以清除杂草
用锛作业；用锛削整
用锄头锄除杂草

collocations.en: dressed the timber with an adze
hoed the soil to remove weeds

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa lexxen l-injam biex ineħħi l-partijiet żejda u jħejjih għall-użu.
formal.en: The carpenter dressed the timber with an adze to remove excess material and prepare it for use.
formal.zh: 木匠用锛修整木材，削去多余部分，为使用做好准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu fil-ġnien dalgħodu? Mark: Lexxen il-ħamrija biex ineħħi l-ħaxix ħażin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do in the garden this morning? Mark: He hoed the soil to remove the weeds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天早上在花园里做了什么？马克：他锄了土，把杂草清掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 保罗今天早上在花园里做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do in the garden this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Lexxen il-ħamrija biex ineħħi l-ħaxix ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Lexxen il-ħamrija biex ineħħi l-ħaxix ħażin.
messages.zh: 他锄了土，把杂草清掉。
messages.en: He hoed the soil to remove the weeds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 lexxen 画两格动作图：一格用锛削整木头，一格用锄头翻土除草。用两种工具和两种对象记住不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking tool with a blade set across its handle, used to shape or smooth wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种刀刃横向安装在柄上的木工工具，用于削切、修整或刨平木材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tax-xogħol fl-injam b'xafra mqiegħda minn naħa għall-oħra tal-manku, użata biex tagħti forma lill-injam jew twittih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锛；用于削切和修整木材的横刃木工工具。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża l-lexxun biex ineħħi saff irqiq ta' injam u jwitti l-wiċċ tat-travu.
formal.en: The carpenter used the adze to remove a thin layer of wood and smooth the surface of the beam.
formal.zh: 木匠用锛削去一层薄薄的木料，将横梁表面修平。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn poġġejt il-lexxun? Rita: Fuq il-bank tax-xogħol, ħdejn il-martell.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where did you put the adze? Rita: On the workbench, beside the hammer.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：你把锛放在哪里了？Rita：在工作台上，锤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.zh: 你把锛放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the adze?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 在工作台上，锤子旁边。
messages.en: On the workbench, beside the hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lexxun 与木匠横刃削木的画面绑定：看见横梁被一层层削平，就回想这个表示“锛”的词。

gloss_zh: 小锄；除草或刮石用的小锄

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hoe used to remove weeds or scrape stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种小型锄具，可用于除草，也可用于刮削石面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda żgħira bħal mgħażqa, użata biex tneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin jew tobrox il-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small hoe used for weeding or to scrape stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于除草或刮削石头的小锄。
除草锄；用来清除杂草的锄具。

collocations.en: remove weeds with a small hoe
scrape stone with a small hoe

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar uża l-lexxuna biex ineħħi l-ħaxix ħażin bejn ix-xtieli mingħajr ma jagħmel ħsara lill-għeruq tagħhom.
formal.en: The gardener used the small hoe to remove weeds between the seedlings without damaging their roots.
formal.zh: 园丁用小锄清除幼苗之间的杂草，同时避免损伤幼苗的根。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek lexxuna biex inneħħi dan il-ħaxix ħażin? Ġanni: Iva, ħudha mill-barrakka.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have a small hoe so I can remove these weeds? Ġanni: Yes, get it from the shed.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你有小锄吗？我想清除这些杂草。Ġanni：有，去棚屋里拿吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek lexxuna biex inneħħi dan il-ħaxix ħażin?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek lexxuna biex inneħħi dan il-ħaxix ħażin?
messages.zh: 你有小锄吗？我想清除这些杂草。
messages.en: Do you have a small hoe so I can remove these weeds?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.zh: 有，去棚屋里拿吧。
messages.en: Yes, get it from the shed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lexxuna 时想象手持小锄，在幼苗之间轻轻除草，再换到石面上刮削；用两个用途一起记住词义。

gloss_zh: 活跃的；有生气的；活泼的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Full of energy and animation; lively in behaviour or expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 充满活力和生气的；行为或表达活泼、有精神的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mimli ħajja u enerġija; attiv u vivaċi fl-imġiba jew fl-espressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有生气的；神情或表现活跃的。
活泼的；精力充沛的。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa kollha, ir-raġel baqa' leġġ u ħa sehem fid-diskussjoni b'ħafna enerġija.
formal.en: Throughout the meeting, the man remained lively and took part in the discussion with great energy.
formal.zh: 整场会议中，那名男子一直精神饱满，并积极参与讨论。

colloquial.mt: Rita: It-tifel għadu leġġ wara dik il-mixja kollha? Simon: Iva, għadu jrid jilgħab!
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the boy still lively after all that walking? Simon: Yes, he still wants to play!
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：走了那么久，那个男孩还这么有精神吗？西蒙：是啊，他还想玩呢！

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifel għadu leġġ wara dik il-mixja kollha?
messages.mt_standard: It-tifel għadu leġġ wara dik il-mixja kollha?
messages.zh: 走了那么久，那个男孩还这么有精神吗？
messages.en: Is the boy still lively after all that walking?

messages.speaker: Simon (父亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，他还想玩呢！
messages.en: Yes, he still wants to play!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走完长路仍想玩耍的男孩，用 leġġ 给他的活力贴标签，把“有生气、活泼”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sound a person produces when speaking or singing, or the tone in which something is said.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人说话或唱歌时发出的声音、嗓音，也指说话时传达态度或情绪的语气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li persuna tagħmel meta titkellem jew tkanta, jew it-ton li bih tgħid xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人的声音；说话或唱歌时的嗓音。
语气；说话声音所表现出的态度或情绪。

collocations.en: in a calm tone of voice

formal.mt: L-għalliema qrat it-test b'leħen ċar u wieġbet il-mistoqsijiet b'leħen kalm.
formal.en: The teacher read the text in a clear voice and answered the questions in a calm tone.
formal.zh: 老师用清晰的声音朗读课文，并以平静的语气回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed titkellem b'leħen baxx? Mark: It-tarbija rieqda fil-kamra ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you speaking in a low voice? Mark: The baby is asleep in the room next to us.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么这么小声说话？Mark：宝宝正在我们旁边的房间里睡觉。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么小声说话？
messages.en: Why are you speaking in a low voice?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝正在我们旁边的房间里睡觉。
messages.en: The baby is asleep in the room next to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一句话分别轻声说、平静说：听到的嗓音和感到的语气都能用 leħen 表达，把词和耳朵接收声音的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hair growing on the face, including short stubble, hair to be shaved, or a beard worn as a style.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸上生长的毛发，包括短胡茬、剃须时要剃除的胡须，以及作为造型留出的胡须。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xagħar li jikber fuq il-wiċċ, kemm meta jkun qasir u jkun se jitqaxxar, kif ukoll meta jitħalla jikber bħala stil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面部毛发；脸上生长的胡须等毛发。
胡茬；剃须后重新长出的短而硬的胡须。

sense_translations.en_definition: beard as an object of shaving; facial hair; stubbles
sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为剃须对象的胡须；面部毛发；短胡茬。

sense_translations.en_definition: beard in general, as a style
sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡须；泛指作为外观造型而留出的胡子。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, ir-raġel jidher b'leħja twila u bajda li tgħatti parti minn wiċċu.
formal.en: In the photograph, the man has a long white beard covering part of his face.
formal.zh: 照片中的男子留着长长的白胡须，遮住了部分脸庞。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Inqaxxar il-leħja kollha? Toni: Le, ħalliha qasira, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall I shave off the whole beard? Toni: No, leave it short, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：要把胡须全部剃掉吗？Toni：不用，请留成短胡须。

messages.speaker: Mark (理发师)
messages.zh: 要把胡须全部剃掉吗？
messages.en: Shall I shave off the whole beard?

messages.speaker: Toni (顾客)
messages.zh: 不用，请留成短胡须。
messages.en: No, leave it short, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜子里的胡须从短胡茬逐渐长成长胡子：不同长度都可联想到 leħja，再加上剃须刀的画面记住它也是剃须的对象。

gloss_zh: 闪光；骤然燃亮；闪耀；纠缠催问

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flash or flare with light; in another sense, to ask insistently or nag.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出闪光或骤然燃亮；另一个义项指反复要求、纠缠催问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti dawl f'daqqa jew jaqbad b'fjamma qawwija; f'tifsira oħra, jitlob xi ħaġa b'insistenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光；用于描述闪电发出亮光。
骤然燃亮；突然发出强光或旺盛火焰。
闪光；光线闪现的现象或过程。
骤然燃亮；火焰或亮光突然增强的现象。
闪耀；骤然发亮或燃亮。
反复要求；纠缠催问；唠叨着催促。

formal.mt: Matul il-maltemp, is-sajjetti leħħew fis-sema u r-ragħad instema' ftit wara.
formal.en: During the storm, lightning flashed in the sky and thunder was heard shortly afterwards.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，闪电在天空中闪耀，片刻后传来了雷声。

colloquial.mt: Marta: It-tifel talab li joħroġ? David: Iva, leħħ biex joħroġ, imma issa qed jilgħab ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did the boy ask to go out? David: Yes, he kept asking to go out, but now he is playing indoors.
colloquial.zh: Marta：孩子要求出去了吗？David：是啊，他一直缠着要出去，不过现在正在屋里玩。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子要求出去了吗？
messages.en: Did the boy ask to go out?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, leħħ biex joħroġ, imma issa qed jilgħab ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, leħħ biex joħroġ, imma issa qed jilgħab ġewwa.
messages.zh: 是啊，他一直缠着要出去，不过现在正在屋里玩。
messages.en: Yes, he kept asking to go out, but now he is playing indoors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 leħħ 画两张记忆卡：一张是天空突然闪亮，一张是孩子反复催问。两幅画分别对应不同义项，只作学习联想，不推断词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Insistence on a request or course of action; other senses are irritability and a flashcard used for learning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚持某项要求或做法；其他义项包括易怒的状态，以及学习时使用的一张闪卡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insistenza fuq talba jew azzjoni; tfisser ukoll irritabilità jew karta għat-tagħlim li tintwera għal ftit ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚持要求；执意请求或坚持某种做法。
易怒；容易烦躁或被激怒的状态。
一张闪卡；用于快速展示和复习词语、图像等内容的学习卡片。

collocations.en: a flashcard with a word and a picture
collocations.zh: 一张带有单词和图片的闪卡

formal.mt: Għal kull kelma ġdida, l-għalliema ħejjiet leħħa b'definizzjoni qasira u stampa ċara.
formal.en: For each new word, the teacher prepared a flashcard with a short definition and a clear picture.
formal.zh: 老师为每个生词准备了一张闪卡，上面有简短的释义和清晰的图片。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex erġajt ċempilt? Rita: Talabni b'leħħa kbira biex nerġa' nċempel illum.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you call again? Rita: He asked me very insistently to call again today.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么又打电话了？Rita：他再三要求我今天再打一次。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么又打电话了？
messages.en: Why did you call again?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Talabni b'leħħa kbira biex nerġa' nċempel illum.
messages.mt_standard: Talabni b'leħħa kbira biex nerġa' nċempel illum.
messages.zh: 他再三要求我今天再打一次。
messages.en: He asked me very insistently to call again today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格图记 leħħa：第一格反复提出要求，第二格烦躁易怒，第三格展示学习闪卡。分格储存三个义项，避免在句子里混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express a thought, concern, or opinion in words, including speaking one's mind openly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把想法、担忧或意见用言语表达出来，也可指坦率地说出自己的看法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi ħsieb, tħassib jew opinjoni bil-kliem, jew jgħid fil-miftuħ dak li jaħseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说出；以言语表达想法、意见或担忧。
坦陈己见；直率地说出自己的真实想法。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-rappreżentant leħħen it-tħassib tiegħu dwar is-sigurtà tal-bini.
formal.en: During the meeting, the representative voiced his concern about the safety of the building.
formal.zh: 会议期间，代表表达了自己对建筑安全的担忧。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark qabel mal-pjan? Lara: Le, leħħen l-opinjoni tiegħu u spjega għaliex ma qabilx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark agree with the plan? Lara: No, he spoke his mind and explained why he disagreed.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 同意这个计划了吗？Lara：没有，他坦率地说出了自己的看法，并解释了不同意的原因。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: Mark 同意这个计划了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark agree with the plan?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, leħħen l-opinjoni tiegħu u spjega għaliex ma qabilx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, leħħen l-opinjoni tiegħu u spjega għaliex ma qabilx.
messages.zh: 没有，他坦率地说出了自己的看法，并解释了不同意的原因。
messages.en: No, he spoke his mind and explained why he disagreed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leħħen 想成把脑中的想法放进对话气泡：原本只在心里，现在用嘴表达出来；气泡里可以装意见，也可以装担忧。

gloss_zh: 流涎；口水；蜗牛等动物的黏液

teaching_sense.en_definition: Drooling or saliva that runs from the mouth; also the slime produced by a snail or a similar animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指流口水这一现象或流出口外的唾液，也可指蜗牛等动物产生的黏液。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bżieq li joħroġ mill-ħalq jew il-ħruġ tiegħu; ukoll il-likwidu li jwaħħal li jħalli warajh bebbux jew annimal simili.

sense_translations.en_definition: the drooling of children or the elderly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 儿童或老年人的流涎、流口水现象。

sense_translations.en_definition: drool, slobber (excessive saliva as e.g. in babies or old people)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 流出口外的口水、涎液，例如婴儿或老年人过多流出的唾液。

sense_translations.en_definition: the slime of a snail or similar animal
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜗牛或类似动物分泌的黏液。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw li l-bebbux kien ħalla traċċa ta' lgħab fuq il-ġebla.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw that the snail had left a trail of slime on the stone.
formal.zh: 在花园观察时，学生们看到蜗牛在石头上留下了一道黏液痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tarbija għandha l-lgħab fuq il-geddum. Tista' tagħtini ċarruta? David: Iva, hawn waħda nadifa.
colloquial.en: Anna: The baby has drool on her chin. Can you give me a cloth? David: Yes, here's a clean one.
colloquial.zh: Anna：宝宝下巴上有口水。能给我一块布吗？David：可以，这里有一块干净的。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarbija għandha l-lgħab fuq il-geddum. Tista' tagħtini ċarruta?
messages.mt_standard: It-tarbija għandha l-lgħab fuq il-geddum. Tista' tagħtini ċarruta?
messages.zh: 宝宝下巴上有口水。能给我一块布吗？
messages.en: The baby has drool on her chin. Can you give me a cloth?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.zh: 可以，这里有一块干净的。
messages.en: Yes, here's a clean one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 lgħab：宝宝嘴边的口水、蜗牛身后的黏液痕迹；读句子时根据人物或动物判断具体义项。

gloss_zh: 犹太的；犹太人；希伯来语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Jewish people, Judaism, or Jewish culture and traditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与犹太人、犹太教或犹太文化和传统有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-poplu Lhudi, mar-reliġjon Lhudija jew mal-kultura u t-tradizzjonijiet Lhud.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犹太的；与犹太人或犹太教有关的。
与犹太人有关的；属于犹太人的。
一位犹太人。

sense_translations.en_definition: Jew (an adherent of Judaism or a person who claims a tribal or ancestral connection to the Jewish people)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 犹太人：信奉犹太教的人，或认同自己与犹太民族具有族群或祖先联系的人。
希伯来语；此处用作语言名称。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-wirja jiddeskrivi oġġetti marbuta mal-wirt Lhudi u jispjega l-użu tagħhom fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The exhibition catalogue describes objects associated with Jewish heritage and explains their use in everyday life.
formal.zh: 展览目录介绍了与犹太文化遗产有关的物品，并说明它们在日常生活中的用途。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem dwar il-poplu Lhudi? Daniel: Iva, u għandu wkoll kapitlu dwar il-kultura tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this book about the Jewish people? Daniel: Yes, and it also has a chapter about their culture.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这本书讲的是犹太民族吗？Daniel：是的，里面还有一章介绍他们的文化。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem dwar il-poplu Lhudi?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem dwar il-poplu Lhudi?
messages.zh: 这本书讲的是犹太民族吗？
messages.en: Is this book about the Jewish people?

messages.speaker: Daniel (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandu wkoll kapitlu dwar il-kultura tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandu wkoll kapitlu dwar il-kultura tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，里面还有一章介绍他们的文化。
messages.en: Yes, and it also has a chapter about their culture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个词性位置记 Lhudi：修饰民族或文化时是形容词，指一个人时是名词，语言名称义则对应希伯来语。

gloss_zh: 精液（粗俗用语）；初乳；混蛋（辱骂语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar term for semen; separately, the first milk produced after giving birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可作指精液的粗俗用语；另有独立义项，指分娩后最初产生的乳汁，即初乳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari għas-semen; f'tifsira oħra, l-ewwel ħalib prodott wara t-twelid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精液、精子（粗俗用语）。

sense_translations.en_definition: beestings, colostrum (first milk after giving birth)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 初乳，即分娩后最初产生的乳汁。
精液、精子；也用作指射出精液的粗俗称呼。

sense_translations.en_definition: arsehole, asshole, bastard, cunt, dick, dickhead, cruel, contemptible, brutal
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于辱骂残忍、卑鄙或粗暴的人，相当于“混蛋、王八蛋”等强烈粗口。

collocations.zh: 你这个混蛋！（强烈粗俗的辱骂语）

formal.mt: F'dan it-test dwar il-biedja, il-kelma 'liba' tirreferi għall-ewwel ħalib tal-baqra wara t-twelid.
formal.en: In this text about farming, the word 'liba' refers to the cow's first milk after giving birth.
formal.zh: 在这篇关于农业的文章中，liba 一词指母牛分娩后的初乳。

colloquial.mt: Mei: Il-kelma 'liba' hi dejjem vulgari? Pawlu: Le, fil-biedja tista' tfisser l-ewwel ħalib wara t-twelid.
colloquial.en: Mei: Is the word 'liba' always vulgar? Pawlu: No, in farming it can mean the first milk after giving birth.
colloquial.zh: 美：liba 这个词总是粗俗用语吗？保罗：不是，在农业语境中，它可以指分娩后的初乳。

messages.speaker: Mei (学生)
messages.zh: liba 这个词总是粗俗用语吗？
messages.en: Is the word 'liba' always vulgar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (马耳他语教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fil-biedja tista' tfisser l-ewwel ħalib wara t-twelid.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fil-biedja tista' tfisser l-ewwel ħalib wara t-twelid.
messages.zh: 不是，在农业语境中，它可以指分娩后的初乳。
messages.en: No, in farming it can mean the first milk after giving birth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进两张语境卡：农场卡记“初乳”，粗俗口语卡记“精液或辱骂”；理解时先看上下文。

gloss_zh: 给某人穿衣；为某人提供衣物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put clothes on another person or provide someone with clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给另一个人穿上衣服，或为某人提供衣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed il-ħwejjeġ fuq persuna oħra jew jipprovdilha l-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人穿衣服。

sense_translations.en_definition: to clothe, dress (provide clothes for, put clothes on)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人提供衣物；给某人穿上衣服。

formal.mt: L-infermier libbes lill-pazjent qabel ma waslet il-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: The nurse dressed the patient before his family arrived.
formal.zh: 护士在病人的家人到来之前给他穿好了衣服。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min libbes lit-tifel dalgħodu? Mark: Jien. Issa lest biex joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who dressed the boy this morning? Mark: I did. He's ready to go out now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：今天早上是谁给孩子穿的衣服？马克：我。现在他已经准备好出门了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 今天早上是谁给孩子穿的衣服？
messages.en: Who dressed the boy this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 我。现在他已经准备好出门了。
messages.en: I did. He's ready to go out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 libbes 的双写 b 当作“多一双帮忙的手”：记住它常表示给别人穿衣，并与自己穿衣的 libes 对照。

gloss_zh: 自由；不受某种限制的自由

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being free, or the ability to act without a particular restriction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于自由的状态，或不受某项特定限制而行动的自由。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min hu ħieles, jew il-possibbiltà li jaġixxi mingħajr restrizzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自由。
自由；不受束缚的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: freedom; liberty (lack of a specific constraint)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 免受某种特定限制的自由。

formal.mt: Ir-regoli tal-iskola għandhom jirrispettaw il-libertà tal-espressjoni tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The school's rules should respect students' freedom of expression.
formal.zh: 学校的规章应尊重学生的表达自由。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nagħżel is-suġġett tal-proġett? Lara: Iva, għandek il-libertà li tagħżel dak li jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I choose the topic of the project? Lara: Yes, you have the freedom to choose whatever you like.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以自己选项目主题吗？拉拉：可以，你有自由选择自己喜欢的主题。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以自己选项目主题吗？
messages.en: Can I choose the topic of the project?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandek il-libertà li tagħżel dak li jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandek il-libertà li tagħżel dak li jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 可以，你有自由选择自己喜欢的主题。
messages.en: Yes, you have the freedom to choose whatever you like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“表达自由、选择自由”两张卡记 libertà；再与 liberu 对照：libertà 是“自由”这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Free from a restriction or commitment; also unoccupied and available for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不受限制或没有事务占用的；也指位置等空着、可供使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mingħajr restrizzjoni jew impenn; ukoll, mhux okkupat u disponibbli għall-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自由的；不受束缚或有空的。
空着的；无人占用的。
自由的；不受限制或没有事务占用的。

collocations.en: a vacant seat or available place

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant huwa liberu li jagħżel wieħed mit-tliet suġġetti.
formal.en: Each participant is free to choose one of the three topics.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都可以自由选择三个主题中的一个。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-post liberu? Mark: Iva, tista' toqgħod hawn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this seat free? Mark: Yes, you can sit here.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个座位空着吗？马克：是的，你可以坐这里。

messages.speaker: Anna (乘客)
messages.zh: 这个座位空着吗？
messages.en: Is this seat free?

messages.speaker: Mark (同车乘客)
messages.zh: 是的，你可以坐这里。
messages.en: Yes, you can sit here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张空椅子和一段空闲时间：post liberu 是位置空着，ħin liberu 是时间有空，抓住“不被占用”的画面。

gloss_zh: 穿着；穿上；自己穿衣；加入修会

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wear clothes, put them on, or get dressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿着衣服、把衣服穿上，或自己穿好衣服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu l-ħwejjeġ fuqu, iqegħedhom fuqu jew jilbes waħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着；身上穿有某件衣物。
穿上；把衣物穿到身上。
穿衣；把衣服穿好。

sense_translations.en_definition: to join a religious order, becoming a person of the cloth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加入修会，成为修会成员。
穿着衣服。
把衣服穿上。

sense_translations.en_definition: to dress oneself, to get dressed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己穿衣服；穿好衣服。

collocations.zh: 为庆祝活动穿好了衣服

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant libes libsa skura għal-laqgħa uffiċjali.
formal.en: The representative wore a dark suit for the official meeting.
formal.zh: 代表穿了一套深色西装出席正式会议。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tifel diġà libes? Pawlu: Iva, libes il-ġakketta wkoll. Nistgħu nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the boy got dressed already? Pawlu: Yes, he's put his jacket on too. We can leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：孩子已经穿好衣服了吗？保罗：是的，连夹克也穿上了。我们可以走了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子已经穿好衣服了吗？
messages.en: Has the boy got dressed already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, libes il-ġakketta wkoll. Nistgħu nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, libes il-ġakketta wkoll. Nistgħu nitilqu.
messages.zh: 是的，连夹克也穿上了。我们可以走了。
messages.en: Yes, he's put his jacket on too. We can leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作连环画记 libes：拿起夹克、穿上夹克、身上穿着夹克；再与 libbes“给别人穿衣”成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shrink back in fear or flee, especially as an animal reacting to danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因害怕而畏缩、退避或逃跑，尤其可描述动物遇险时的反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġibed lura bil-biża' jew jaħrab, speċjalment meta annimal iħoss il-periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因恐惧而蜷缩、畏缩。
逃跑；跑开。
迅速跑开；溜走。

sense_translations.en_definition: to shrink, draw back, cower fearfully (as in a corner)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因害怕而缩起身子、退缩或蜷伏，例如缩在角落里。

sense_translations.en_definition: to flee, run away (as of an animal with a flight instinct)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃离；逃跑，尤指动物出于逃避危险的本能而跑开。

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-ħoss qawwi, il-kelb libet fil-kantuniera tal-kamra.
formal.en: When it heard the loud noise, the dog cowered in the corner of the room.
formal.zh: 听到巨响时，那只狗畏缩到了房间的角落里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kelb libet fil-kantuniera? Mark: Beża' mill-ħoss. Ejja nitkellmu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the dog cower in the corner? Mark: The noise frightened him. Let's speak softly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：狗为什么缩到角落里了？马克：它被声音吓到了。我们轻声说话吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗为什么缩到角落里了？
messages.en: Why did the dog cower in the corner?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.zh: 它被声音吓到了。我们轻声说话吧。
messages.en: The noise frightened him. Let's speak softly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 libet 配上受惊小动物的画面：先往后缩，再可能逃开；用“恐惧后的退避动作”串起各个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Incense, particularly frankincense, burned to produce a fragrant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燃烧后散发香气的熏香，尤其指乳香。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inċens, b'mod partikolari l-frankinċens, li jinħaraq biex jagħti riħa tfuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熏香；焚烧后散发香气的香料。
熏香；乳香。
无云的；晴朗的。

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, ir-riħa tal-libien imliet is-sala.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the smell of incense filled the hall.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，熏香的气味弥漫了整个大厅。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi din ir-riħa tfuħ? Pawlu: Dik ir-riħa tal-libien. Għadhom kemm ħarqu ftit.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's that lovely smell? Pawlu: That's the smell of incense. They've just burned a little.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这是什么香味？保罗：那是熏香的气味。他们刚刚烧了一点。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 这是什么香味？
messages.en: What's that lovely smell?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ir-riħa tal-libien. Għadhom kemm ħarqu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ir-riħa tal-libien. Għadhom kemm ħarqu ftit.
messages.zh: 那是熏香的气味。他们刚刚烧了一点。
messages.en: That's the smell of incense. They've just burned a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 libien 做两张独立图片卡：名词卡画燃烧的乳香，形容词卡画无云晴空；按词性分别记，避免混为一义。

gloss_zh: 利比亚的；来自利比亚的；利比亚人

teaching_sense.en_definition: From Libya or relating to Libya, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自利比亚的，或与利比亚、其人民及文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mil-Libja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Libja, mal-poplu tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利比亚的；利比亚人的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Libya
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自利比亚的；与利比亚有关的。
利比亚人。

formal.mt: Il-mużew organizza avveniment dwar l-ikel Libjan u t-tradizzjonijiet tal-pajjiż.
formal.en: The museum organized an event about Libyan food and the country's traditions.
formal.zh: 博物馆举办了一场介绍利比亚食物及该国传统的活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-restorant iservi ikel Libjan? Mark: Iva, u s-sid huwa Libjan ukoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this restaurant serve Libyan food? Mark: Yes, and the owner is Libyan too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这家餐馆供应利比亚食物吗？马克：是的，而且老板也是利比亚人。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这家餐馆供应利比亚食物吗？
messages.en: Does this restaurant serve Libyan food?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u s-sid huwa Libjan ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u s-sid huwa Libjan ukoll.
messages.zh: 是的，而且老板也是利比亚人。
messages.en: Yes, and the owner is Libyan too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“利比亚地图＋一盘当地食物＋一个当地人”记忆：修饰食物时是形容词，直接指人时是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item of clothing, especially a dress or a suit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一件衣服，尤其指连衣裙或成套穿着的套装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ħwejjeġ, speċjalment libsa tan-nisa jew sett ta' ħwejjeġ li jintlibsu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连衣裙；上下连为一体的裙装。
套装；配套穿着的一套衣服，如西装。
衣服；一件衣物。
连衣裙；一种上身与裙身连成一体的女装。

collocations.zh: 一件优雅的连衣裙或一套雅致的套装

formal.mt: Għaċ-ċerimonja, Marija għażlet libsa blu twila.
formal.en: For the ceremony, Marija chose a long blue dress.
formal.zh: 玛丽亚为典礼挑选了一条蓝色长连衣裙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema libsa se tilbes illejla? Rita: Il-libsa l-ħadra; togħġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which dress are you going to wear tonight? Rita: The green dress; I really like it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今晚要穿哪条连衣裙？丽塔：绿色那条，我很喜欢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚要穿哪条连衣裙？
messages.en: Which dress are you going to wear tonight?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 绿色那条连衣裙，我很喜欢。
messages.en: The green dress; I really like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把libsa记成衣柜里准备穿的一整件衣服；看到婚礼想到连衣裙，看到正式场合也要想到套装。

gloss_zh: 畏缩的；受责骂后安静下来的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cowering or subdued, especially after being frightened or scolded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因害怕或受到责骂而畏缩、安静、不敢出声的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mimli biża' jew kwiet u bla kuraġġ, speċjalment wara ċanfira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 畏缩的；因害怕而缩着身子、不敢行动的。
安静下来的；尤其指受责骂后不敢出声的。
胆怯畏缩的；因恐惧而退缩的。

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċanfira, it-tifel baqa' liebet u ma qal xejn.
formal.en: After the scolding, the boy remained subdued and said nothing.
formal.zh: 受到责骂后，男孩怯怯地安静下来，一句话也没说。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu qiegħed hemm liebet? Rita: Għadu kemm qala' ċanfira u ma jridx jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu sitting there so subdued? Rita: He has just been scolded and doesn't want to talk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么怯怯地坐在那里？丽塔：他刚挨了骂，不想说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么怯怯地坐在那里？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu sitting there so subdued?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kemm qala' ċanfira u ma jridx jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kemm qala' ċanfira u ma jridx jitkellem.
messages.zh: 他刚挨了骂，不想说话。
messages.en: He has just been scolded and doesn't want to talk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个挨骂后缩着肩膀、低头不语的人，用liebet同时记住畏缩的姿态与安静的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hare, an animal with long ears and powerful hind legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 野兔，一种耳朵长、后腿有力、善于奔跑的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal b'widnejn twal u saqajn ta' wara b'saħħithom li jiġri malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野兔；一种长耳、后腿发达、善于奔跑的动物。
兔尾草；花序绒软、形似兔尾的一种草。

formal.mt: Waqt il-mixja fil-kampanja, il-grupp osserva liebru jiġri minn għalqa għal oħra.
formal.en: During the countryside walk, the group observed a hare running from one field to another.
formal.zh: 在乡间徒步时，大家看到一只野兔从一块田跑向另一块田。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt il-liebru ħdejn il-ħajt? Lara: Iva! Ġera lejn l-għalqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you see the hare beside the wall? Lara: Yes! It ran towards the field.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你看到墙边那只野兔了吗？拉拉：看到了！它朝田里跑去了。

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 你看到墙边那只野兔了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the hare beside the wall?

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 看到了！它朝田里跑去了。
messages.en: Yes! It ran towards the field.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用田间长耳野兔记住liebru；植物语境中再联想绒毛像兔尾的兔尾草，靠上下文区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To let saliva flow out of the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让唾液从嘴里流出来，即流口水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla l-bżieq joħroġ minn ħalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流口水；唾液从嘴里流出。
流口水；口水从嘴角滴落或淌出。

formal.mt: Waqt l-irqad, it-tifel liegħeb u xarrab ftit l-imħadda.
formal.en: While sleeping, the boy drooled and slightly wet the pillow.
formal.zh: 男孩睡觉时流了口水，把枕头弄湿了一点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-imħadda mxarrba? Mark: Iċ-ċkejken liegħeb waqt li kien rieqed.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the pillow wet? Mark: The little one drooled while he was asleep.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：枕头怎么湿了？马克：小家伙睡着时流口水了。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 枕头怎么湿了？
messages.en: Why is the pillow wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċ-ċkejken liegħeb waqt li kien rieqed.
messages.mt_standard: Iċ-ċkejken liegħeb waqt li kien rieqed.
messages.zh: 小家伙睡着时流口水了。
messages.en: The little one drooled while he was asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把liegħeb放进睡醒发现枕头湿了一小块的画面，记住这里的动作是口水从嘴里流出。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scold or reproach someone, or to hold someone responsible for something wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因错误而责骂、责备某人，或认为某人应为不好的事情负责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċanfar lil xi ħadd jew qiesu responsabbli għal xi ħaġa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 责骂；因某人的行为或错误而训斥对方。
责怪；把错误或不良结果归咎于某人。
责备；对某人的过错表示不满。
责怪、责备；认为某人有过错并对此表示不满。

formal.mt: L-għalliem liem lill-istudent għax ma kienx għamel ix-xogħol tad-dar.
formal.en: The teacher scolded the student because he had not done his homework.
formal.zh: 老师责骂了那个学生，因为他没有完成家庭作业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark liem lilu nnifsu? Pawlu: Għax nesa ċ-ċwievet u ħsiebna li tlifniehom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark blame himself? Pawlu: Because he forgot the keys and we thought we had lost them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么责怪自己？保罗：因为他忘了带钥匙，我们还以为把钥匙弄丢了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么责怪自己？
messages.en: Why did Mark blame himself?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nesa ċ-ċwievet u ħsiebna li tlifniehom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nesa ċ-ċwievet u ħsiebna li tlifniehom.
messages.zh: 因为他忘了带钥匙，我们还以为把钥匙弄丢了。
messages.en: Because he forgot the keys and we thought we had lost them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把liem与追问谁犯了错的场景相连：对别人可表示责骂，对自己则可表示自责。
