cognitive_memory_aid: 用一组下降画面记忆：音量下降、情绪平复、风势减弱、船帆降下、劲头消退。

gloss_zh: 一次入水浸没；一次浸水

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of briefly dipping or being plunged into water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短暂钻入水中或被浸入水中的一次动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jidħol jew jitgħaddas għal ftit fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钻入水中；把身体短暂浸入水中的动作。
一次浸水；一次被浸入水中的经历。

collocations.en: a brief dip under the water

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, l-għawwiem għamel majnata qasira fl-ilma u reġa' tela' fil-wiċċ.
formal.en: During training, the swimmer briefly dipped under the water and came back to the surface.
formal.zh: 训练时，游泳者短暂潜入水中，随后重新浮出水面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien l-ilma? Lara: Kiesaħ! Għamilt majnata qasira u ħriġt mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the water like? Lara: Cold! I had a quick dip and got straight out.
colloquial.zh: Maja：水怎么样？Lara：很冷！我只短暂浸了一下就马上出来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 水怎么样？
messages.en: What was the water like?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kiesaħ! Għamilt majnata qasira u ħriġt mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Kiesaħ! Għamilt majnata qasira u ħriġt mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 很冷！我只短暂浸了一下就马上出来了。
messages.en: Cold! I had a quick dip and got straight out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象头和身体没入水中又立即浮起，把这个词记成一次短暂的入水动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clever at understanding situations and gaining an advantage, sometimes in a sly or deceptive way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 善于看清形势并取得优势的；可表示精明机敏，也可带有狡猾、不坦诚的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaf jifhem is-sitwazzjoni u jikseb vantaġġ, xi drabi bil-qerq jew b'mod moħbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敏锐精明的；善于判断形势的。
狡猾的；善于用计谋取得目的的。
精明的；判断实际利益很准确的。
狡黠的；暗中耍心眼的。
狡猾而精明的；机敏、善于盘算的。

formal.mt: In-negozjant kien makakk biżżejjed biex jinduna bl-ispejjeż moħbija qabel ma ffirma l-ftehim.
formal.en: The trader was astute enough to notice the hidden costs before signing the agreement.
formal.zh: 这名商人十分精明，在签署协议前就发现了隐藏费用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Toni dejjem jirbaħ f'din il-logħba! Mark: Hu makakk; jistenna sakemm nagħmlu żball.
colloquial.en: Sara: Toni always wins this game! Mark: He's shrewd; he waits until we make a mistake.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Toni玩这个游戏总是赢！Mark：他很精明，会一直等到我们犯错。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni玩这个游戏总是赢！
messages.en: Toni always wins this game!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu makakk; jistenna sakemm nagħmlu żball.
messages.mt_standard: Hu makakk; jistenna sakemm nagħmlu żball.
messages.zh: 他很精明，会一直等到我们犯错。
messages.en: He's shrewd; he waits until we make a mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个总能看出机会的人：判断准确叫精明，暗中算计别人时就带有狡猾意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being astute or cunning in understanding situations and gaining an advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 看清形势并善于取得优势的精明或机敏，也可指带有算计意味的狡猾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li wieħed jifhem is-sitwazzjonijiet u jikseb vantaġġ, xi drabi bil-qerq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精明；敏锐判断形势的能力。
狡猾；精明机敏；善于盘算的特质。

collocations.zh: 十分狡猾地；极有心计地

formal.mt: In-negozjant wera makakkerija meta qabbel l-offerti kollha u għażel dik bl-inqas spejjeż.
formal.en: The trader showed astuteness by comparing all the offers and choosing the one with the lowest costs.
formal.zh: 这名商人比较了所有报价，并选择成本最低的一项，表现得十分精明。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irnexxielu jġegħelna nagħmlu x-xogħol kollu? Pawlu: Bil-makakkerija tiegħu! Hu baqa' biss jagħti l-pariri.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did he manage to get us to do all the work? Pawlu: With his cunning! He just kept giving advice.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他怎么就让我们把所有活都干了？Pawlu：靠他的狡猾呗！他一直只在旁边出主意。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielu jġegħelna nagħmlu x-xogħol kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielu jġegħelna nagħmlu x-xogħol kollu?
messages.zh: 他怎么就让我们把所有活都干了？
messages.en: How did he manage to get us to do all the work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-makakkerija tiegħu! Hu baqa' biss jagħti l-pariri.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-makakkerija tiegħu! Hu baqa' biss jagħti l-pariri.
messages.zh: 靠他的狡猾呗！他一直只在旁边出主意。
messages.en: With his cunning! He just kept giving advice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它与形容词makakk配对记：一个形容人精明，一个把这种精明或狡猾当作特质来谈。

gloss_zh: 滑稽歌曲；喜剧短剧；小品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A comic song or a short humorous theatrical scene or performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以逗趣为目的的歌曲，或篇幅较短的喜剧场景、短剧、小品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għanja komika jew xena teatrali qasira maħsuba biex iddaħħak.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑稽歌曲；以幽默逗趣为特点的歌曲。
喜剧短剧；简短的幽默表演片段。
幽默小品；篇幅短小的喜剧表演。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ppreżentaw makkjetta dwar il-ħajja fl-iskola waqt is-serata ta' tmiem is-sena.
formal.en: The students performed a sketch about school life during the end-of-year evening event.
formal.zh: 学生们在学年末晚会上表演了一出关于校园生活的喜剧短剧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nagħmlu għall-festa tal-iskola? Toni: Nagħmlu makkjetta dwar żewġ studenti li dejjem jaslu tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we do for the school celebration? Toni: Let's do a skit about two students who always arrive late.
colloquial.zh: Maja：学校庆祝活动上我们表演什么？Toni：演个小品，讲两个总是迟到的学生。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 学校庆祝活动上我们表演什么？
messages.en: What shall we do for the school celebration?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu makkjetta dwar żewġ studenti li dejjem jaslu tard.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu makkjetta dwar żewġ studenti li dejjem jaslu tard.
messages.zh: 演个小品，讲两个总是迟到的学生。
messages.en: Let's do a skit about two students who always arrive late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象校园晚会上的短小搞笑节目：唱出来可以是滑稽歌曲，演出来可以是喜剧小品。

gloss_zh: 导流挡水设施；石砌引水首部

teaching_sense.en_definition: An obstruction built to divert water, or stone headworks used to direct its flow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为改变水流方向而设置的挡水设施，也指用于引导水流的石砌首部工程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ostaklu mibni biex ibiddel id-direzzjoni tal-ilma, jew struttura tal-ġebel fil-bidu ta' sistema li tmexxi l-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: an obstruction used to divert water
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于使水流改道的障碍物或挡水设施。
石砌引水首部工程；位于引水系统起始处的石砌设施。

collocations.en: a stone structure for diverting water

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema bnew maksar tal-ġebel biex jiddevjaw parti mill-ilma lejn l-għalqa.
formal.en: The workers built a stone structure to divert part of the water towards the field.
formal.zh: 工人们修建了一座石砌导流设施，把部分水流引向田地。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex l-ilma qed idur hawn? Pawlu: Minħabba l-maksar. Dan imexxi l-ilma lejn l-għalqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why does the water turn here? Pawlu: Because of the diversion structure. It directs the water towards the field.
colloquial.zh: Mark：水为什么在这里转向？Pawlu：因为这里有导流设施。它把水引向田地。

messages.speaker: Mark (来访者)
messages.zh: 水为什么在这里转向？
messages.en: Why does the water turn here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-maksar. Dan imexxi l-ilma lejn l-għalqa.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-maksar. Dan imexxi l-ilma lejn l-għalqa.
messages.zh: 因为这里有导流设施。它把水引向田地。
messages.en: Because of the diversion structure. It directs the water towards the field.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水遇到一道石砌挡水设施后转弯流向田地，用水流改道的画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The elbow, the joint at which the arm bends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肘，即手臂弯曲处、连接上臂与前臂的关节部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġog fejn id-driegħ jitgħawweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肘；手臂弯曲处的关节部位。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudent għawweġ il-maksra tal-lemin u ressaq idu lejn spalltu.
formal.en: During the exercise, the student bent his right elbow and moved his hand towards his shoulder.
formal.zh: 练习时，学生弯曲右肘，把手移向肩膀。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn ħbatt? Toni: Ħbatt il-maksra mat-tarf tal-mejda. Għadha tuġagħni ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you bump yourself? Toni: I knocked my elbow against the edge of the table. It still hurts a little.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你撞到哪里了？Toni：我的肘部撞到了桌边，现在还有点疼。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你撞到哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you bump yourself?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħbatt il-maksra mat-tarf tal-mejda. Għadha tuġagħni ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ħbatt il-maksra mat-tarf tal-mejda. Għadha tuġagħni ftit.
messages.zh: 我的肘部撞到了桌边，现在还有点疼。
messages.en: I knocked my elbow against the edge of the table. It still hurts a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 边弯曲手臂边指向肘部，把maksra与手臂中间这个会弯曲的关节联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of cloth or paper used for wiping, or a cloth worn over the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于擦拭的小块布或纸，也可指戴在头上的方巾或头巾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira tad-drapp jew tal-karta li tintuża biex timsaħ, jew biċċa drapp li tintlibes fuq ir-ras.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手帕。

sense_translations.en_definition: handkerchief (small towel of cloth or paper)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于擦拭的小方巾，可由布或纸制成。
方巾；包头或遮盖头部的头巾。

collocations.en: a kerchief worn on the head

formal.mt: Hija użat maktur nadif biex timsaħ idejha qabel l-ikel.
formal.en: She used a clean handkerchief to wipe her hands before the meal.
formal.zh: 她在用餐前用一块干净的手帕擦了擦手。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek maktur? Għandi bżonn nimsaħ imnieħri. Nina: Iva, hawn wieħed nadif.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a handkerchief? I need to wipe my nose. Nina: Yes, here's a clean one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有手帕吗？我需要擦一下鼻子。妮娜：有，这里有一块干净的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek maktur? Għandi bżonn nimsaħ imnieħri.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek maktur? Għandi bżonn nimsaħ imnieħri.
messages.zh: 你有手帕吗？我需要擦一下鼻子。
messages.en: Do you have a handkerchief? I need to wipe my nose.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，这里有一块干净的。
messages.en: Yes, here's a clean one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一块小方布：拿在手里擦拭是手帕，戴到头上就是头巾，用这两个画面记住 maktur。

teaching_sense.en_definition: False statements made to damage someone's reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为损害他人名誉而说出的虚假言论，即诽谤或恶意中伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem falz li jingħad biex jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诽谤；以虚假言论恶意损害他人名誉。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jikkundanna l-malafama u jitlob rispett għar-reputazzjoni ta' kull persuna.
formal.en: The article condemns calumny and calls for respect for every person's reputation.
formal.zh: 这篇文章谴责诽谤，并呼吁尊重每个人的名誉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak li qed jgħidu dwar Sara huwa malafama. Mark: Mela ma nxerrdux dak il-kliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What they're saying about Sara is calumny. Mark: Then let's not spread those statements.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们说的那些关于萨拉的话是在诽谤她。马克：那我们就别传播那些话了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li qed jgħidu dwar Sara huwa malafama.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li qed jgħidu dwar Sara huwa malafama.
messages.zh: 他们说的那些关于萨拉的话是在诽谤她。
messages.en: What they're saying about Sara is calumny.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们就别传播那些话了。
messages.en: Then let's not spread those statements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 malafama 联想到一张写着虚假指控的纸正在被传播；重点记住它会恶意损害别人的名誉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a fast speed, without delay, or after only a short time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示动作进行得快、立即发生，或在很短时间后发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'veloċità għolja, bla dewmien, jew wara ftit żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速地；敏捷地。
快速地。
立即；马上。
很快地；迅速地。
不久；很快就。
突然；猛然。
快速地；迅速地。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ibgħat id-dokumenti malajr kemm jista' jkun sabiex inkunu nistgħu nkomplu bil-proċess.
formal.en: Please send the documents as quickly as possible so that we can continue with the process.
formal.zh: 请尽快发送文件，以便我们继续办理。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ejja malajr, il-karozza tal-linja waslet! Pawlu: Ġej! Stennieni ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Come quickly, the bus is here! Pawlu: I'm coming! Wait a moment for me.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：快来，公交车到了！保罗：来了！等我一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 快来，公交车到了！
messages.en: Come quickly, the bus is here!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 来了！等我一下。
messages.en: I'm coming! Wait a moment for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公交车到站时朋友喊 malajr：动作要快，等待时间也短；把“快速”和“很快就”一起记。

gloss_zh: 泳衣；体操服；背心；辫子；渔网网眼宽度

teaching_sense.en_definition: A swimsuit; in other senses, a leotard, a vest, a plait of hair, or the width of a fishing-net mesh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要可指泳衣；在不同语境中也指体操服、背心、发辫或渔网网眼的宽度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies għall-għawm; f'tifsiriet oħra, ilbies tal-ġinnastika, flokk bla kmiem, nisġa tax-xagħar, jew il-wisa' ta' fetħa fix-xibka tas-sajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泳衣；游泳时穿的衣服。
泳装；泳衣。
体操或舞蹈时穿的紧身连体衣。
背心；无袖上衣。
辫子；将头发分股交织而成的发辫。
渔网网眼的宽度。

formal.mt: Għal-lezzjoni tal-għawm, kull student għandu jġib malja tal-għawm u xugaman.
formal.en: For the swimming lesson, every student should bring a swimsuit and a towel.
formal.zh: 每位学生上游泳课时都应带泳衣和毛巾。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt il-malja tal-għawm tiegħi? Irrid immur il-baħar. Omm: Iva, qiegħda fil-borża ħdejn ix-xugaman.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you seen my swimsuit? I want to go to the beach. Mum: Yes, it's in the bag next to the towel.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到我的泳衣了吗？我想去海边。妈妈：看到了，在包里，挨着毛巾。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-malja tal-għawm tiegħi? Irrid immur il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-malja tal-għawm tiegħi? Irrid immur il-baħar.
messages.zh: 你看到我的泳衣了吗？我想去海边。
messages.en: Have you seen my swimsuit? I want to go to the beach.

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 看到了，在包里，挨着毛巾。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the bag next to the towel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用场景卡分别记忆 malja：泳池配泳衣，体操馆配连体衣，镜子前配辫子；看到渔网时再联想到网眼宽度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word used to introduce an event immediately followed by another event, meaning 'as soon as'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出一个事件，表示另一事件紧接着发生，相当于“一……就……”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika li ġrajja sseħħ minnufih wara ġrajja oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不久；很快。
一……就……，连接先后紧接发生的两个事件。

collocations.en: as soon as it is ready

collocations.zh: 我一有条件就；我会尽早

formal.mt: Malli nirċievu d-dokumenti kollha, nibdew neżaminaw it-talba tiegħek.
formal.en: As soon as we receive all the documents, we will begin examining your request.
formal.zh: 我们一收到全部文件，就会开始审核您的申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Malli tasal id-dar, ċempilli. Mark: Tajjeb, inċempillek malli nidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Call me as soon as you get home. Mark: Okay, I'll call you as soon as I get in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你一到家就给我打电话。马克：好的，我一进门就打给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你一到家就给我打电话。
messages.en: Call me as soon as you get home.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好的，我一进门就打给你。
messages.en: Okay, I'll call you as soon as I get in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 malli 想成两张紧挨着的事件卡：第一张是到家，第二张是打电话，对应中文“一到家就打电话”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Mediterranean country and archipelago of Malta, or the largest island in that archipelago.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他，指地中海中的国家及其群岛，也可指该群岛中最大的马耳他岛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż u l-arċipelagu fil-Mediterran, jew l-akbar gżira f'dan l-arċipelagu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他。

sense_translations.en_definition: Malta (an archipelago and country in Southern Europe, in the Mediterranean Sea)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他，位于南欧地中海中的群岛及国家。

sense_translations.en_definition: Malta (the largest island in the Maltese Archipelago)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他岛，马耳他群岛中最大的岛屿。

formal.mt: Malta hija pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Ewropa, fil-Baħar Mediterran.
formal.en: Malta is a country in Southern Europe, in the Mediterranean Sea.
formal.zh: 马耳他是位于南欧地中海中的一个国家。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm se ddum Malta? Leo: Ġimagħtejn. Irrid inżur Għawdex ukoll.
colloquial.en: Anna: How long will you be in Malta? Leo: Two weeks. I want to visit Gozo too.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你会在马耳他待多久？利奥：两周。我还想去戈佐岛看看。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会在马耳他待多久？
messages.en: How long will you be in Malta?

messages.speaker: Leo (游客)
messages.zh: 两周。我还想去戈佐岛看看。
messages.en: Two weeks. I want to visit Gozo too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画两层地图：外层标出国家马耳他，内层圈出最大的马耳他岛；同一个 Malta 可指这两个层级。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bad weather, especially weather with strong wind, heavy rain, or storms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恶劣天气，尤其指伴有强风、大雨或风暴的天气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Temp ħażin, speċjalment b'riħ qawwi, xita qawwija jew burraxki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴风雨天气；风暴天气。
坏天气；恶劣天气。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-maltemp, l-attività fil-beraħ ġiet posposta għal ġurnata oħra.
formal.en: Because of the bad weather, the outdoor activity was postponed to another day.
formal.zh: 由于天气恶劣，户外活动已改日举行。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Se noħorġu xorta b'dan il-maltemp? Rita: Aħjar nibqgħu d-dar u naraw film.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Are we still going out in this bad weather? Rita: We'd better stay home and watch a film.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：天气这么糟，我们还要出去吗？丽塔：最好待在家里看部电影。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 天气这么糟，我们还要出去吗？
messages.en: Are we still going out in this bad weather?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nibqgħu d-dar u naraw film.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nibqgħu d-dar u naraw film.
messages.zh: 最好待在家里看部电影。
messages.en: We'd better stay home and watch a film.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 maltemp 时想象窗外风雨交加、户外活动延期的画面，把这个词整体关联到“恶劣天气”。

gloss_zh: 马耳他的；马耳他语；马耳他人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Malta, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自马耳他的，或与马耳他、马耳他人及其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Malta jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Malta, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的；马耳他人的；马耳他语的。
马耳他语。
马耳他人。
马耳他语。

sense_translations.en_definition: Maltese (of, from or relating to Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的；来自马耳他的；与马耳他有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Maltese (native or inhabitant of Malta) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他本地人或居民，通常指男性。
马耳他语，语言名称。

formal.mt: Il-programm jintroduċi lill-istudenti għall-ikel Malti u għall-kultura ta' Malta.
formal.en: The programme introduces students to Maltese food and the culture of Malta.
formal.zh: 该课程向学生介绍马耳他食物和马耳他文化。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int Malti? Mark: Iva, jien Malti. Anna: Jien qed nitgħallem il-Malti. Nistgħu nitkellmu ftit? Mark: Żgur, bil-qalb!
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you Maltese? Mark: Yes, I'm Maltese. Anna: I'm learning Maltese. Can we talk for a bit? Mark: Of course, gladly!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你是马耳他人吗？马克：是的，我是马耳他人。安娜：我正在学马耳他语。我们可以聊一会儿吗？马克：当然，很乐意！

messages.speaker: Anna (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 你是马耳他人吗？
messages.en: Are you Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (马耳他朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我是马耳他人。
messages.en: Yes, I'm Maltese.

messages.speaker: Anna (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien qed nitgħallem il-Malti. Nistgħu nitkellmu ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Jien qed nitgħallem il-Malti. Nistgħu nitkellmu ftit?
messages.zh: 我正在学马耳他语。我们可以聊一会儿吗？
messages.en: I'm learning Maltese. Can we talk for a bit?

messages.speaker: Mark (马耳他朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，很乐意！
messages.en: Of course, gladly!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个短句区分 Malti：ikel Malti 是马耳他食物，jien Malti 是我是马耳他人，nitgħallem il-Malti 是学习马耳他语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A song thrush, a bird with a spotted breast known for its song.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 歌鸫，一种胸部带有斑点、以鸣唱见长的鸟；也可指鸫鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur b'tikek fuq sidru, magħruf għall-għana tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歌鸫，一种胸部有斑点的鸣禽。
鸫；鸫鸟。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw malvizz fuq fergħa u semgħu l-għana tiegħu.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a thrush on a branch and heard its song.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们看见一只鸫鸟站在树枝上，并听到了它的鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' dak l-għasfur? Toni: Iva, dak malvizz. Ara, qiegħed fuq dik il-fergħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that bird? Toni: Yes, that's a thrush. Look, it's on that branch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那只鸟的叫声了吗？托尼：听见了，那是只鸫鸟。看，它就在那根树枝上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那只鸟的叫声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that bird?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak malvizz. Ara, qiegħed fuq dik il-fergħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak malvizz. Ara, qiegħed fuq dik il-fergħa.
messages.zh: 听见了，那是只鸫鸟。看，它就在那根树枝上。
messages.en: Yes, that's a thrush. Look, it's on that branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 malvizz 和“枝头鸣唱、胸前有斑点的歌鸫”这幅画面一起记忆，再用“听见鸫鸟鸣唱”练习搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ban an activity or forbid someone from doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 禁止某项活动，或不准某人做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma ħalliex li ssir xi ħaġa jew li xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止；下令不许进行某项活动。
禁止；不准；不允许某人做某事。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill mana' l-parkeġġ quddiem l-iskola biex iżomm id-daħla ħielsa.
formal.en: The council banned parking in front of the school to keep the entrance clear.
formal.zh: 委员会禁止在学校前停车，以保持入口畅通。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistgħux nidħlu fil-ġnien? Mark: Is-sid mana' d-dħul għax qed isiru xi xogħlijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we go into the garden? Mark: The owner banned entry because some work is being done.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么不能进花园？马克：园主禁止进入，因为里面正在施工。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能进花园？
messages.en: Why can't we go into the garden?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sid mana' d-dħul għax qed isiru xi xogħlijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sid mana' d-dħul għax qed isiru xi xogħlijiet.
messages.zh: 园主禁止进入，因为里面正在施工。
messages.en: The owner banned entry because some work is being done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mana' 放进“负责人下令禁止进入”的情境记忆；例句中的形式表示已经作出的禁止决定，词尾撇号也要一起记。

gloss_zh: 高台；讲坛；另有大量、大物、分娩椅、审判庭及告解室等义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A raised platform or podium from which someone speaks to an audience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人站在上面向听众讲话的高台、讲台或讲坛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew pjattaforma mgħollija minn fejn persuna titkellem quddiem in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高台；供讲话者或重要出席者使用的台子。
高出周围地面的平台。
讲坛；讲台；布道台。
大量；很多；很大的数目。
很大的东西；大物件。

sense_translations.en_definition: a chair on which pregnant women gave birth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 分娩椅；供孕妇分娩时使用的椅子。
审判庭；法庭。

sense_translations.en_definition: confessional (small room where confession is performed)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 告解室；进行宗教告解的小房间。

collocations.en: to go up onto the podium

formal.mt: Il-kelliem tela' fuq il-manbar u ppreżenta r-riżultati tal-istudju lill-udjenza.
formal.en: The speaker went up onto the podium and presented the study's results to the audience.
formal.zh: 发言人登上讲台，向听众介绍了研究结果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Minn fejn se jitkellem il-mistieden? Pawlu: Minn fuq il-manbar, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jarah.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where will the guest speak from? Pawlu: From the podium, so everyone can see him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：嘉宾会在哪里讲话？保罗：在讲台上，这样大家都能看见他。

messages.speaker: Nina (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 嘉宾会在哪里讲话？
messages.en: Where will the guest speak from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fuq il-manbar, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jarah.
messages.mt_standard: Minn fuq il-manbar, biex kulħadd ikun jista' jarah.
messages.zh: 在讲台上，这样大家都能看见他。
messages.en: From the podium, so everyone can see him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“登上高台面对听众”记住 manbar 的讲台义；其余义项分别配上数量、大物件、分娩椅、法庭和告解室的情境卡，避免混用。

gloss_zh: 杂乱；牲畜围栏；农舍后方地块

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mess or state of disorder; also an enclosure for farm animals or a plot behind a farmhouse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一团乱或杂乱状态；也指圈养家畜的围栏，或农舍后方的一块地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħwid jew nuqqas ta' ordni; ukoll post magħluq għall-annimali tar-razzett jew biċċa art wara razzett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一团乱；乱糟糟的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: a holding pen for domestic or farm animals
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圈养家养动物或农场牲畜的围栏。

sense_translations.en_definition: an outdoors pen, traditionally in the courtyard of a farmhouse, used mostly for small livestock such as chickens, goats, etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 露天畜栏，传统上设在农舍院内，主要用于圈养鸡、山羊等小型家畜家禽。

sense_translations.en_definition: a plot of ground at the back of a farmhouse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 农舍后方的一块地。
杂乱；混乱；缺乏秩序的状态。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żamm il-mogħoż fil-mandra waqt li l-ħaddiema sewwew il-ħajt tar-razzett.
formal.en: The farmer kept the goats in the pen while the workers repaired the farmhouse wall.
formal.zh: 工人修缮农舍围墙期间，农夫把山羊留在畜栏里。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Il-kamra tiegħek saret mandra! Sara: Naf, se niġbor il-ħwejjeġ u npoġġi l-kotba f'posthom.
colloquial.en: Mother: Your room has become a mess! Sara: I know, I'll pick up the clothes and put the books where they belong.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你的房间都乱成一团了！萨拉：我知道，我会收起衣服，把书放回原位。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 你的房间都乱成一团了！
messages.en: Your room has become a mess!

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Naf, se niġbor il-ħwejjeġ u npoġġi l-kotba f'posthom.
messages.mt_standard: Naf, se niġbor il-ħwejjeġ u npoġġi l-kotba f'posthom.
messages.zh: 我知道，我会收起衣服，把书放回原位。
messages.en: I know, I'll pick up the clothes and put the books where they belong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mandra 配两张学习图片：一张是乱糟糟的房间，一张是农舍旁的羊圈；用不同情境区分“杂乱”和“畜栏”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A metal restraint fastened around a wrist; handcuffs are used to restrict the movement of the hands.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扣在手腕上的金属拘束器具；手铐用于限制双手活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċirku tal-metall li jingħalaq madwar il-polz; il-manetti jintużaw biex jillimitaw il-moviment tal-idejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手铐；用于铐住双手的拘束器具。
镣铐；限制肢体活动的金属拘束器具。
单个手铐铐环；扣住一只手腕的铐具。
令、刀等成束纸张的计量称呼；一束纸。

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal iċċekkja li l-manetta ma kinitx issikkata wisq madwar il-polz.
formal.en: The officer checked that the handcuff was not too tight around the wrist.
formal.zh: 警员检查了手铐，确保它没有把手腕铐得过紧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser manetta f'din il-lista tal-karti? Toni: Hawn tfisser mazz karti; f'kuntest ieħor tista' tfisser ħolqa ta' par manetti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does manetta mean in this paper list? Toni: Here it means a bundle of paper; in another context it can mean one cuff of a pair of handcuffs.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份纸张清单里的 manetta 是什么意思？托尼：这里指一束纸；在别的语境中，它也可以指一副手铐中的一个铐环。

messages.speaker: Maja (马耳他语学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser manetta f'din il-lista tal-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser manetta f'din il-lista tal-karti?
messages.zh: 这份纸张清单里的 manetta 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does manetta mean in this paper list?

messages.speaker: Toni (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser mazz karti; f'kuntest ieħor tista' tfisser ħolqa ta' par manetti.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser mazz karti; f'kuntest ieħor tista' tfisser ħolqa ta' par manetti.
messages.zh: 这里指一束纸；在别的语境中，它也可以指一副手铐中的一个铐环。
messages.en: Here it means a bundle of paper; in another context it can mean one cuff of a pair of handcuffs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“手腕上的铐环”和“桌上的一束纸”两张卡分别记 manetta；看到 tal-karti 时优先联想纸束，不自行添加固定张数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An observable expression or appearance of a feeling, quality, or phenomenon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种感情、性质或现象可被观察到的表现、表达或显现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod li bih sentiment, kwalità jew fenomenu jidher jew jiġi espress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现；显现；某种感情、性质或现象的具体表达。

formal.mt: Il-ġbir ta' fondi għall-familji milquta kien manifestazzjoni ta' solidarjetà mill-komunità.
formal.en: The fundraising for the affected families was a manifestation of solidarity from the community.
formal.zh: 为受影响家庭筹款，体现了社区的团结互助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kulħadd ġie jgħin lill-ġirien illum. Mark: Iva, kienet manifestazzjoni sabiħa ta' solidarjetà.
colloquial.en: Lara: Everyone came to help the neighbours today. Mark: Yes, it was a lovely expression of solidarity.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天大家都来帮助邻居了。马克：是啊，这很好地体现了团结互助。

messages.speaker: Lara (社区居民)
messages.zh: 今天大家都来帮助邻居了。
messages.en: Everyone came to help the neighbours today.

messages.speaker: Mark (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet manifestazzjoni sabiħa ta' solidarjetà.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet manifestazzjoni sabiħa ta' solidarjetà.
messages.zh: 是啊，这很好地体现了团结互助。
messages.en: Yes, it was a lovely expression of solidarity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manifestazzjoni 记成“内在感情变成看得见的行动”：例如大家一起帮助邻居，就是团结互助的一种表现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person responsible for organizing and directing the work of a business, department, or team.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责组织和管理企业、部门或团队工作的人员，即经理或管理者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna responsabbli mill-organizzazzjoni u t-tmexxija tax-xogħol ta' negozju, dipartiment jew tim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经理；负责管理业务或团队的人。
经理；管理者；负责组织和领导工作的人。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer tal-proġett ippreżenta l-pjan tax-xogħol u qassam ir-responsabbiltajiet fost il-membri tat-tim.
formal.en: The project manager presented the work plan and allocated responsibilities among the team members.
formal.zh: 项目经理介绍了工作计划，并向团队成员分配了职责。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nitkellem mal-maniġer, jekk jogħġbok? Pawlu: Żgur, se nsejjaħlu. Stenna hawn ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Could I speak to the manager, please? Pawlu: Of course, I'll get him. Please wait here a moment.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：请问我可以和经理谈谈吗？保罗：当然，我去叫他。请在这里稍等。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 请问我可以和经理谈谈吗？
messages.en: Could I speak to the manager, please?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, se nsejjaħlu. Stenna hawn ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, se nsejjaħlu. Stenna hawn ftit.
messages.zh: 当然，我去叫他。请在这里稍等。
messages.en: Of course, I'll get him. Please wait here a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maniġer 与英语 manager 对照记忆，再想象店员去请经理的场景；同时练习 tal-ħanut 和 tal-proġett 两种搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to magnets or magnetism, or having the ability to attract materials such as iron.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与磁铁或磁性有关的；具有吸引铁等材料的磁性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kalamiti jew mal-manjetiżmu, jew li għandu l-ħila jiġbed materjali bħall-ħadid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磁的；磁性的；与磁铁或磁性有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudenti użaw boxxla biex jistudjaw il-kamp manjetiku madwar kalamita.
formal.en: The students used a compass to study the magnetic field around a magnet.
formal.zh: 学生们用指南针研究磁铁周围的磁场。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-klipp manjetiku? Toni: Iva, jeħel mal-bord tal-ħadid. Nistgħu nżommu n-noti bih.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this clip magnetic? Toni: Yes, it sticks to the iron board. We can use it to hold our notes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个夹子有磁性吗？托尼：有，它能吸在铁板上。我们可以用它固定便条。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 这个夹子有磁性吗？
messages.en: Is this clip magnetic?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jeħel mal-bord tal-ħadid. Nistgħu nżommu n-noti bih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jeħel mal-bord tal-ħadid. Nistgħu nżommu n-noti bih.
messages.zh: 有，它能吸在铁板上。我们可以用它固定便条。
messages.en: Yes, it sticks to the iron board. We can use it to hold our notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manjetiku 与英语 magnetic 并排记，再想象磁性夹子吸住铁板；用 kamp manjetiku 进一步记住“磁场”这个搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A way of doing something or behaving; in the plural, socially appropriate or inappropriate behavior.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事或待人的方式、态度；复数形式也可指礼貌和行为举止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif tagħmel xi ħaġa jew iġġib ruħek; fil-plural, l-imġiba tiegħek ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做事或表现自己的方式、态度。
进行某件事的方法或方式。
礼貌；与人相处时表现出的行为举止。

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega r-regoli b'manjiera ċara u wera rispett lejn l-istudenti.
formal.en: The teacher explained the rules clearly and showed respect toward the students.
formal.zh: 老师清楚地解释了规则，并对学生表现出尊重。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex int irrabjata? Nina: Ma għoġbitnix il-manjiera kif kellimni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you angry? Nina: I didn't like the way he spoke to me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么生气？妮娜：我不喜欢他跟我说话的方式。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么生气？
messages.en: Why are you angry?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我不喜欢他跟我说话的方式。
messages.en: I didn't like the way he spoke to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一句话用温柔和粗鲁两种方式说出：manjiera关注怎么做、怎么说；manjieri tajbin则联想到有礼貌的举止。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cutting tool with a heavy blade fixed to a handle, used especially for chopping wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带柄和厚重刀刃的砍劈工具，尤其用于劈木头；也可指小斧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'xafra mwaħħla ma' manku, li tintuża l-aktar biex tqatta' jew taqsam l-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斧头，尤其指用于砍劈木材的工具。
小斧；通常可用单手操作的斧头。
斧头或小斧，用于砍削、劈开木材。

collocations.en: to split wood with an axe

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża mannara biex jaqsam l-injam qabel ma poġġieh fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The worker used an axe to split the wood before putting it in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 工人先用斧头劈开木材，再把它放进储藏室。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-mannara? Pawlu: Fil-garaxx, ħdejn l-injam.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where's the axe? Pawlu: In the garage, next to the wood.
colloquial.zh: 马克：斧头在哪儿？保罗：在车库里，木头旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 斧头在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's the axe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 在车库里，木头旁边。
messages.en: In the garage, next to the wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把mannara和一幅劈柴画面一起记：长柄前端有斧刃，举起后劈开木头；这个词可对应斧头，也可对应小斧。

gloss_zh: 驯服；使温顺；安抚；驯兽者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an animal tame or docile, or to calm someone who is angry or upset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使动物变得驯服、温顺；也可指安抚生气或不安的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel annimal mans jew aktar ħelu fl-imġiba, jew tikkalma lil xi ħadd irrabjat jew imdejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驯服，使动物逐渐接受人的接近或管理。
使变得温顺、听从引导。
安抚；使愤怒、不满或不安的情绪平息。
驯兽者；从事动物驯服工作的人。
驯服者；使动物变得温顺的人。

formal.mt: It-trejner mannas iż-żiemel bil-paċenzja, sakemm l-annimal beda jafda fih.
formal.en: The trainer patiently tamed the horse until the animal began to trust him.
formal.zh: 训练员耐心地驯服这匹马，直到它开始信任他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min mannas lil dak iż-żiemel? Toni: Ħija; qatta' ħafna ħin miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who tamed that horse? Toni: My brother; he spent a lot of time with it.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：谁驯服了那匹马？托尼：我哥哥；他花了很多时间陪它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁驯服了那匹马？
messages.en: Who tamed that horse?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥；他花了很多时间陪它。
messages.en: My brother; he spent a lot of time with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记一匹紧张的马逐渐接受人的画面：动词mannas表示使它驯服；再换成生气的人，联想安抚；名词义则指执行驯服的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of being tamed or made docile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够被驯服或变得温顺的，描述驯服的可能性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi mmansat jew isir mans.

sense_translations.en_definition: able to be tamed or renderd docile
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够被驯服或被调教得温顺的。
可驯服的；具有被驯服的可能性。

formal.mt: It-trejner iqis li dan iż-żiemel huwa mannasi, iżda jgħid li jeħtieġ ħafna paċenzja.
formal.en: The trainer considers this horse tameable but says that a great deal of patience is needed.
formal.zh: 训练员认为这匹马可以驯服，但表示需要很大的耐心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taħseb li dan l-annimal huwa mannasi? Ġanni: Naħseb li iva, imma rridu nagħtuh iż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you think this animal is tameable? Ġanni: I think so, but we need to give it time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你觉得这只动物可以驯服吗？詹尼：我觉得可以，不过我们得给它时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (动物照护员)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan l-annimal huwa mannasi?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan l-annimal huwa mannasi?
messages.zh: 你觉得这只动物可以驯服吗？
messages.en: Do you think this animal is tameable?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (训练员)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li iva, imma rridu nagħtuh iż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva, imma rridu nagħtuh iż-żmien.
messages.zh: 我觉得可以，不过我们得给它时间。
messages.en: I think so, but we need to give it time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给动物照片贴上“以后可以驯服”的标签来记mannasi：重点是有可能变温顺；可与表示已经温顺的mans配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tame, docile, or domesticated, especially of an animal accustomed to people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 驯服、温顺或家养的，尤其形容已经适应与人相处的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa mdorri mal-bniedem, mhux selvaġġ, jew ħelu fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驯服的；适应人的接近而不表现得野性的。
温顺的；容易引导或管理的。
家养的；已经适应由人饲养和管理的。
家养、驯服的；与人相处已经较为习惯的。

formal.mt: Il-kelb huwa mans u jibqa' kalm meta jersqu lejh il-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The dog is docile and remains calm when visitors approach it.
formal.zh: 这只狗很温顺，访客走近时也保持平静。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Il-kelb tiegħek mans? Mark: Iva, hu kalm ħafna u jħobb ikun man-nies.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is your dog docile? Mark: Yes, he's very calm and likes being around people.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你的狗温顺吗？马克：是的，它很安静，也喜欢跟人在一起。

messages.speaker: Lina (访客)
messages.zh: 你的狗温顺吗？
messages.en: Is your dog docile?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu kalm ħafna u jħobb ikun man-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu kalm ħafna u jħobb ikun man-nies.
messages.zh: 是的，它很安静，也喜欢跟人在一起。
messages.en: Yes, he's very calm and likes being around people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把mans贴在一只安静待在人身边的动物旁：它描述当前驯服、温顺的状态；和mannasi“可以驯服”一起对照更好记。

gloss_zh: 使衰弱；使虚弱；斗篷；宽松长袍

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone physically weak or infirm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人的身体变得虚弱、衰弱或失去原有的体力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel lil xi ħadd dgħajjef jew tnaqqaslu s-saħħa fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使身体衰弱、虚弱无力。
斗篷；披在身上的宽大外衣。
使变弱；削弱体力或身体力量。
宽松、垂曳的长袍式外衣。

formal.mt: Il-mard twil mantar lill-pazjent, li issa jeħtieġ l-għajnuna biex jimxi.
formal.en: The prolonged illness weakened the patient, who now needs help to walk.
formal.zh: 长期患病使这位病人的身体衰弱，如今走路需要他人帮助。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-mard mantar lil missieri. Rita: Għadu bla saħħa? Anna: Iva, jgħejja malajr.
colloquial.en: Anna: This illness has weakened my father. Rita: Is he still weak? Anna: Yes, he gets tired quickly.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这场病让我的父亲变虚弱了。丽塔：他现在还是没力气吗？安娜：是的，他很容易累。

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.zh: 这场病让我的父亲变虚弱了。
messages.en: This illness has weakened my father.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他现在还是没力气吗？
messages.en: Is he still weak?

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.zh: 是的，他很容易累。
messages.en: Yes, he gets tired quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给mantar做两张独立词卡：动词卡画病后体力下降的人，名词卡画披着长斗篷的人；按句中词性分别提取意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line on which washed clothes are hung to dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来悬挂洗净衣物、使其晾干的绳子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel li fuqu jiddendlu l-ħwejjeġ maħsula biex jinxfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晾衣绳；供悬挂衣物以便晾干的绳子。

collocations.en: to hang clothes on the clothesline
to take clothes off the clothesline

formal.mt: Il-ħwejjeġ maħsula għandhom jiddendlu fuq il-manxar biex jinxfu sew.
formal.en: The washed clothes should be hung on the clothesline so that they dry thoroughly.
formal.zh: 洗好的衣服应挂在晾衣绳上，以便充分晾干。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tista' tiġbor il-ħwejjeġ minn fuq il-manxar? Ben: Iva, diġà nixfu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you take the clothes off the clothesline? Ben: Yes, they're already dry.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你能把晾衣绳上的衣服收下来吗？本：可以，衣服已经干了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiġbor il-ħwejjeġ minn fuq il-manxar?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiġbor il-ħwejjeġ minn fuq il-manxar?
messages.zh: 你能把晾衣绳上的衣服收下来吗？
messages.en: Can you take the clothes off the clothesline?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 可以，衣服已经干了。
messages.en: Yes, they're already dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根绳子横过阳台，衣服一件件挂在上面：把manxar与这根晾衣绳绑定，再用“挂上去、收下来”两个动作复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A visual representation of an area showing places and their positions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用图形表示某个区域及其中地点位置关系的地图。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rappreżentazzjoni viżiva ta' żona li turi l-postijiet u fejn jinsabu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地图；表示地区、地点及其位置关系的图。
地图，即以可视化方式呈现某一区域的图示。

collocations.en: to look for a place on the map

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi t-toroq ewlenin tal-belt u l-post fejn jinsab il-mużew.
formal.en: The map shows the city's main roads and the location of the museum.
formal.zh: 这张地图标出了城市的主要道路和博物馆的位置。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn hu l-mużew? David: Ejja nħarsu lejn il-mappa; għandu jkun ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where's the museum? David: Let's look at the map; it should be near the square.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：博物馆在哪儿？戴维：我们看看地图吧；应该就在广场附近。

messages.speaker: Elena (游客)
messages.zh: 博物馆在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's the museum?

messages.speaker: David (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nħarsu lejn il-mappa; għandu jkun ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nħarsu lejn il-mappa; għandu jkun ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 我们看看地图吧；应该就在广场附近。
messages.en: Let's look at the map; it should be near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用熟悉的英语map辅助记住mappa的外形，再想象在地图上圈出博物馆和广场；把词形、地图和找路动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of an object that you hold to open, lift or use it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体上供人握住，以便打开、提起或使用的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' oġġett li taqbad b'idek biex tiftaħ, terfa' jew tuża l-oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把手；供手握住的柄。

formal.mt: Qabel terfa' l-borma, kun żgur li l-maqbad ikun imwaħħal sew.
formal.en: Before lifting the pot, make sure that the handle is firmly attached.
formal.zh: 提起锅之前，请确保把手安装牢固。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-bieb ma jinfetaħx. Mark: Dawwar il-maqbad u mbagħad imbotta.
colloquial.en: Lara: The door won't open. Mark: Turn the handle and then push.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：门打不开。马克：转动把手，然后推门。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 门打不开。
messages.en: The door won't open.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 转动把手，然后推门。
messages.en: Turn the handle and then push.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开门时手握住的部件，把 maqbad 和门把手的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where dead people are buried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安葬逝者的场所，即墓地或坟场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jindifnu l-mejtin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 墓地；坟场。
墓地；安葬逝者的坟场。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom iżommu s-skiet fil-maqbar biex juru rispett lejn il-mejtin u l-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: Visitors should remain quiet in the cemetery to show respect for the dead and their families.
formal.zh: 访客在墓地内应保持安静，以表达对逝者及其家属的尊重。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi d-daħla tal-maqbar? Pawlu: Hemm, ħdejn dak il-ħajt għoli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the cemetery entrance? Pawlu: Over there, beside that high wall.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：墓地入口在哪里？保罗：在那边，就在那堵高墙旁。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 墓地入口在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the cemetery entrance?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.zh: 在那边，就在那堵高墙旁。
messages.en: Over there, beside that high wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqbar 放进一幅安静墓地的画面，联想入口、墓碑和探访者来记忆。

gloss_zh: 挑剔；贬低；批评；负面批评者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To criticize someone or something negatively, especially by finding faults or belittling them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以负面的方式批评某人或某事，尤其指挑毛病或贬低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikkritika lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa b'mod negattiv, billi sab id-difetti jew naqqas mill-valur tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑毛病；找出并批评不足之处。
贬低；以言语使人或事显得没有价值。
批评；指出或评论缺点。
进行负面批评的人；爱挑剔或贬低他人的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to criticise, put down, find fault with
sense_translations.zh_definition: 批评、贬低或对某人某事挑毛病。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, ir-reviżur maqdar il-proposta iżda ma offra ebda suġġeriment biex titjieb.
formal.en: In his report, the reviewer criticized the proposal but offered no suggestion for improving it.
formal.zh: 评审人在报告中批评了这项提议，却没有提出任何改进建议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex int imdejjaq? Toni: Mark maqdar ix-xogħol tiegħi mingħajr ma spjega x'kien ħażin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you upset? Toni: Mark criticized my work without explaining what was wrong.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不开心？托尼：马克批评了我的工作，却没有解释哪里有问题。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不开心？
messages.en: Why are you upset?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark maqdar ix-xogħol tiegħi mingħajr ma spjega x'kien ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Mark maqdar ix-xogħol tiegħi mingħajr ma spjega x'kien ħażin.
messages.zh: 马克批评了我的工作，却没有解释哪里有问题。
messages.en: Mark criticized my work without explaining what was wrong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人拿着作品只说缺点，用这个场景记 maqdar 的批评和贬低义；名词义则指这样批评的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place or object for sitting, including a chair, a vehicle seat or the sitting surface of a chair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人坐的地方或物件，可指椅子、车辆座位，也可指椅子的座面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew oġġett fejn wieħed joqgħod bilqiegħda, bħal siġġu, sedil ta' karozza jew il-parti tas-siġġu li wieħed joqgħod fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人坐的地方。
一把椅子。

sense_translations.en_definition: a place to sit; a spot or seat
sense_translations.zh_definition: 可坐的地方；一个位置或座位。

sense_translations.en_definition: a seat (that part of a chair on which one sits; a chair-like construction in a car etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 座面，即椅子上承托坐者的部分；也指汽车等交通工具内的座椅。

formal.mt: Qabel tibda ssuq, aġġusta l-maqgħad tal-karozza sabiex tkun tista' tilħaq il-pedali faċilment.
formal.en: Before you start driving, adjust the car seat so that you can reach the pedals easily.
formal.zh: 开始驾驶前，请调整汽车座椅，以便轻松踩到踏板。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-maqgħad ħieles? Ben: Iva, tista' toqgħod hawn ħdejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this seat free? Ben: Yes, you can sit here beside me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个座位有人吗？本：没有，你可以坐在我旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 这个座位有人吗？
messages.en: Is this seat free?

messages.speaker: Ben (乘客)
messages.zh: 没有，你可以坐在我旁边。
messages.en: Yes, you can sit here beside me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 maqgħad 就想象坐下的动作，再依场景区分整把椅子、车内座位和椅子座面。

gloss_zh: 牲畜围栏；畜圈；猪圈；畜栏

teaching_sense.en_definition: An enclosed area or compartment where farm animals are kept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于圈养牲畜的围起区域或隔间，可指畜圈、猪圈或畜栏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post magħluq jew imdawwar b'ċint fejn jinżammu l-annimali tar-razzett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于圈住或暂时安置动物的围栏区域。
猪圈。

sense_translations.en_definition: pen, sty, stall (fenced area or compartment for animals)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 畜圈、猪圈或畜栏，即供动物使用的围栏区域或隔间。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għandu jnaddaf il-maqjel regolarment u jipprovdi ilma frisk lill-annimali.
formal.en: The farmer should clean the animal pen regularly and provide the animals with fresh water.
formal.zh: 农民应定期清理畜圈，并为动物提供新鲜饮水。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn qegħdin in-nagħaġ? Ġużeppi: Fil-maqjel; għadni kemm tajthom l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are the sheep? Ġużeppi: In the pen; I've just given them water.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：羊在哪里？朱塞佩：在畜圈里；我刚给它们喂了水。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场访客)
messages.zh: 羊在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the sheep?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.zh: 在畜圈里；我刚给它们喂了水。
messages.en: In the pen; I've just given them water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象农场里围住羊或猪的小空间，用围栏、牲畜和饮水槽这幅画面记 maqjel。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place used for religious worship, such as a temple or shrine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于宗教礼拜的场所，如庙宇或圣所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn isir il-qima reliġjuża, bħal tempju jew santwarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教礼拜场所。
庙宇；神庙。
圣所；供奉神圣对象的场所。

collocations.zh: 一座古老的庙宇或圣所

collocations.en: the entrance to the place of worship

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom jidħlu fil-maqjem bil-kwiet u jirrispettaw lil dawk li jkunu qed jitolbu.
formal.en: Visitors should enter the place of worship quietly and respect those who are praying.
formal.zh: 访客应安静地进入礼拜场所，并尊重正在祈祷的人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nistgħu nidħlu fil-maqjem? Samwel: Iva, imma nitkellmu bil-mod għax hemm min qed jitlob.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can we go into the place of worship? Samwel: Yes, but let's speak quietly because some people are praying.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们可以进入这处礼拜场所吗？萨缪尔：可以，不过小声说话，因为有人正在祈祷。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 我们可以进入这处礼拜场所吗？
messages.en: Can we go into the place of worship?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nitkellmu bil-mod għax hemm min qed jitlob.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nitkellmu bil-mod għax hemm min qed jitlob.
messages.zh: 可以，不过小声说话，因为有人正在祈祷。
messages.en: Yes, but let's speak quietly because some people are praying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqjem 与人们安静祈祷的场景相连，先记礼拜场所，再按语境理解为庙宇或圣所。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small room or booth where a person confesses sins to a priest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人向神父告明罪过的小房间或亭式隔间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra żgħira jew kompartiment fejn persuna tqerr għand qassis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告解室；供信徒向神父告解的隔间。

sense_translations.en_definition: confessional (small room where confession is performed)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 告解室，即进行告解的小房间。

formal.mt: Fil-knisja, il-maqrar jinsab f'rokna kwieta sabiex il-qrar ikun jista' jsir fil-privatezza.
formal.en: In the church, the confessional is located in a quiet corner so that confession can take place in private.
formal.zh: 教堂内的告解室设在安静的角落，以便人们私下进行告解。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu l-maqrar? Pietru: Fuq ix-xellug, ħdejn il-bieb iż-żgħir.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the confessional? Pietru: On the left, beside the small door.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：告解室在哪里？彼得：在左边，靠近那扇小门。

messages.speaker: Marija (教堂访客)
messages.zh: 告解室在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the confessional?

messages.speaker: Pietru (教堂志愿者)
messages.zh: 在左边，靠近那扇小门。
messages.en: On the left, beside the small door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教堂角落里供人低声告解的小隔间，把 maqrar 与这个具体空间一起记住。

gloss_zh: 椰枣馅炸糕；椰枣馅烤糕

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pastry filled with dates and cooked by deep-frying or baking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用椰枣作馅，经油炸或烘烤制成的糕点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelwa mimlija bit-tamal, moqlija fiż-żejt jew moħmija fil-forn.

sense_translations.en_definition: deep fried or baked pastry stuffed with dates
sense_translations.zh_definition: 包有椰枣馅、经油炸或烘烤制成的糕点。

sense_translations.en_definition: a date-filled pastry fried in oil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在油中炸制的椰枣馅糕点。

formal.mt: Għall-attività tal-iskola, l-istudenti ħejjew maqrut bit-tamal u ħmewh fil-forn.
formal.en: For the school event, the students prepared date-filled pastry and baked it in the oven.
formal.zh: 学生们为学校活动制作了椰枣馅糕点，并放进烤箱烘烤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid biċċa maqrut mat-te? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobb il-mili tat-tamal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a piece of date-filled pastry with your tea? Pawlu: Yes, please. I like the date filling.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：喝茶时要来一块椰枣馅糕点吗？保罗：好的，谢谢。我喜欢椰枣馅。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 喝茶时要来一块椰枣馅糕点吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of date-filled pastry with your tea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobb il-mili tat-tamal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Inħobb il-mili tat-tamal.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。我喜欢椰枣馅。
messages.en: Yes, please. I like the date filling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqrut 配上一幅切开的椰枣馅糕点图：看到外皮和深色果馅，就回想这个糕点名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A division or separation, or the place where two parts are divided.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 划分或分隔，也指两个部分分开的地方、分界处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qsim jew firda, jew il-post fejn żewġ partijiet jinfirdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划分、分隔或分离。
划分发生的地方；两个部分的分界处。

collocations.en: the dividing point between two fields
collocations.zh: 两块田地之间的分界处

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi l-maqsam bejn iż-żewġ partijiet tal-art.
formal.en: The plan shows the division between the two sections of land.
formal.zh: 这张平面图标出了两部分土地之间的分界。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-ħajt huwa l-maqsam bejn il-ġonna? Ġanni: Iva, il-ġnien tagħna jibda minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this wall the dividing line between the gardens? Ġanni: Yes, our garden starts here.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这堵墙就是两个花园的分界吗？詹尼：是的，我们的花园从这里开始。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħajt huwa l-maqsam bejn il-ġonna?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħajt huwa l-maqsam bejn il-ġonna?
messages.zh: 这堵墙就是两个花园的分界吗？
messages.en: Is this wall the dividing line between the gardens?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġnien tagħna jibda minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġnien tagħna jibda minn hawn.
messages.zh: 是的，我们的花园从这里开始。
messages.en: Yes, our garden starts here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画两块田，中间划一道分界，把 maqsam 写在线上，同时记住“分隔”和“分界处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or other place used for prostitution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于卖淫活动的建筑或场所，即妓院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew post li jintuża għall-prostituzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一家妓院。
用于卖淫活动的场所。
妓院。

collocations.en: a building used as a brothel

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi bini li kien jintuża bħala maqħab.
formal.en: The report describes a building that was used as a brothel.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一栋曾被用作妓院的建筑。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser il-kelma maqħab f'dan it-test? David: Tfisser post li jintuża għall-prostituzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does the word maqħab mean in this text? David: It means a place used for prostitution.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这篇文章里的 maqħab 是什么意思？戴维：指用于卖淫活动的场所。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma maqħab f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma maqħab f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 maqħab 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word maqħab mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 指用于卖淫活动的场所。
messages.en: It means a place used for prostitution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用报道中一句建筑被用作妓院来记 maqħab，把词义与场所用途联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become ill; it can also mean to become fed up with something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生病、患病；也可表示对某事感到厌烦或受够了。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jbati minn marda; jista' jfisser ukoll li jiddejjaq ħafna b'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生病；开始出现患病的状态。
患病，或由健康转为生病。
感到厌烦；受够了。

formal.mt: L-istudent marad bil-influwenza u għalhekk ma attendiex il-lezzjonijiet dik il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The student fell ill with influenza and therefore did not attend classes that week.
formal.zh: 这名学生患了流感，因此那一周没有上课。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex illum? Lara: Marad ilbieraħ u baqa' d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark come today? Lara: He became ill yesterday and stayed at home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克今天为什么没来？拉拉：他昨天病了，留在家里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克今天为什么没来？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark come today?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 他昨天病了，留在家里了。
messages.en: He became ill yesterday and stayed at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 marad 放进“昨天病了”的事件画面，记住它表示生病这一变化；另用“受够了”的表情记第二种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Illness or disease, understood as a condition of being unwell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疾病、病痛，或身体处于不健康状态这一概念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' saħħa jew kundizzjonijiet li jagħmlu persuna ma tiflaħx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 患病状态；病痛。
疾病。
病痛；疾病；身体不适的状态。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi diversi tipi ta' mard u l-effett tagħhom fuq il-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The chapter describes various types of disease and their effects on everyday life.
formal.zh: 这一章介绍了多种疾病及其对日常生活的影响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fuq xiex inhu l-ktieb tiegħek? Toni: Fuq il-mard u kif jaħdem il-ġisem.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is your book about? Toni: About illness and how the body works.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你这本书讲什么？托尼：讲疾病，还有身体是怎样运作的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is your book about?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mard u kif jaħdem il-ġisem.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mard u kif jaħdem il-ġisem.
messages.zh: 讲疾病，还有身体是怎样运作的。
messages.en: About illness and how the body works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mard 写在“疾病”这个名词标签下，再与 marad“生病”和 marid“生病的”并排，借句子位置区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spindle used in spinning thread; the word can also name the woodchat shrike, a bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纺线时使用的纺锤；这个词也可指棕背伯劳这种鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex jinħadem il-ħajt waqt l-għażil; il-kelma tista' wkoll issemmi tip ta' għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺锤；也指棕背伯劳，一种鸟。
纺锤；纺线时用来捻纤维、卷绕纱线的工具。

formal.mt: Fil-wirja tal-mużew, kien hemm marden tal-injam ħdejn kampjuni ta' suf u ħajt.
formal.en: In the museum exhibition, there was a wooden spindle beside samples of wool and thread.
formal.zh: 博物馆的展览中，一枚木制纺锤摆在羊毛和纱线样品旁边。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Għal xiex jintuża dan il-marden? Marija: Bih naħdmu l-ħajt mis-suf.
colloquial.en: Luca: What is this spindle used for? Marija: We use it to make thread from wool.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：这个纺锤是做什么用的？玛丽亚：我们用它把羊毛纺成线。

messages.speaker: Luca (参观者)
messages.zh: 这个纺锤是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this spindle used for?

messages.speaker: Marija (纺织演示员)
messages.zh: 我们用它把羊毛纺成线。
messages.en: We use it to make thread from wool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 marden 做一张双图词卡：一边画缠线的纺锤，一边画棕背伯劳；靠上下文选择工具义或鸟名义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unwell or affected by illness; it can also describe someone physically infirm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体不适或患病的；也可形容身体虚弱、衰弱的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jiflaħx jew ibati minn marda; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd dgħajjef f'saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生病的；身体不适的。
患病的；不舒服的。
体弱的；身体衰弱的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem bagħat ix-xogħol lil tifel marid li ma setax jattendi l-iskola.
formal.en: The teacher sent the work to a sick boy who could not attend school.
formal.zh: 老师把作业发给了一个因病无法到校的男孩。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif qed tħossok illum? Ben: Għadni marid, imma aħjar mill-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: How are you feeling today? Ben: I'm still ill, but better than yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你今天感觉怎么样？本：我还病着，不过比昨天好些了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling today?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我还病着，不过比昨天好些了。
messages.en: I'm still ill, but better than yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 marid 当作贴在人旁边的“生病的”状态标签，用 tifel marid“生病的男孩”记住它的形容词用途。

gloss_zh: 使人生病；使人烦扰；传播疾病的人；烦扰他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to become ill, or to bother someone a great deal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人生病；也可表示严重烦扰某人、使人十分厌烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jimrad, jew idejjaq lil xi ħadd ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人生病。
很烦扰某人；使某人十分厌烦。
传播疾病的人。
经常烦扰他人的人；惹人厌烦的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause someone to fall ill
sense_translations.zh_definition: 导致某人患病；使某人生病。

collocations.en: he bothered everyone a great deal with his complaints
collocations.zh: 他的抱怨让所有人烦透了

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-ikel ikkontaminat marrad lil diversi mistednin waqt l-attività.
formal.en: According to the report, the contaminated food caused several guests to fall ill during the event.
formal.zh: 据报告，受污染的食物使几位来宾在活动期间生病。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex kulħadd iddejjaq b'Toni? Mark: Marrad lil kulħadd bl-istess ilmenti l-ġurnata kollha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did everyone get fed up with Toni? Mark: He bothered everyone with the same complaints all day.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：为什么大家都烦托尼了？马克：他一整天都在重复那些抱怨，把大家烦透了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 为什么大家都烦托尼了？
messages.en: Why did everyone get fed up with Toni?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Marrad lil kulħadd bl-istess ilmenti l-ġurnata kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Marrad lil kulħadd bl-istess ilmenti l-ġurnata kollha.
messages.zh: 他一整天都在重复那些抱怨，把大家烦透了。
messages.en: He bothered everyone with the same complaints all day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 marrad 配成两幅“影响别人”的画面：让人生病、让人烦透；另做人物词卡记住两个名词义，并留意双写 rr。

gloss_zh: 体弱多病的；健康状况不佳的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Often ill or in poor health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常生病或健康状况不佳的，常用来形容体弱多病的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimrad spiss jew li ma jkunx f'saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体弱多病的。
健康状况不佳的；不健康的。
体弱多病的；经常生病的。

collocations.zh: 一个健康状况不佳的男人

formal.mt: It-tifel marradi għandu bżonn aktar mistrieħ u attenzjoni.
formal.en: The sickly boy needs more rest and attention.
formal.zh: 这个体弱多病的男孩需要更多休息和照顾。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif inhu ħuk? Pawlu: Għadu marradi, imma llum iħossu aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marta: How is your brother? Pawlu: He's still in poor health, but he feels better today.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你哥哥怎么样了？保罗：他身体还是不太好，不过今天感觉好些了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥怎么样了？
messages.en: How is your brother?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu marradi, imma llum iħossu aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu marradi, imma llum iħossu aħjar.
messages.zh: 他身体还是不太好，不过今天感觉好些了。
messages.en: He's still in poor health, but he feels better today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 marradi 和“总是容易生病的人”这一画面相连，记住它描述的是多病、体弱的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bile or the gall bladder; figuratively, bitter resentment towards someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指胆汁或胆囊，也可比喻对某人或某事怀有的怨苦、怨恨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bili jew l-organu li jaħżnu; ukoll sens ta' mrar jew riżentiment lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胆汁。
胆囊，储存胆汁的器官。
对某事或某人怀有的怨苦、怨恨。

formal.mt: Il-marrara taħżen il-bili li jipproduċi l-fwied.
formal.en: The gall bladder stores the bile produced by the liver.
formal.zh: 胆囊储存肝脏产生的胆汁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jitkellem b'dik il-marrara kollha? Mark: Għadu rrabjat għax ħass li ma ttrattawhx sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is he speaking with so much bitterness? Mark: He's still angry because he felt he wasn't treated well.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他说话为什么带着那么重的怨气？马克：他觉得自己没受到善待，所以还在生气。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jitkellem b'dik il-marrara kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jitkellem b'dik il-marrara kollha?
messages.zh: 他说话为什么带着那么重的怨气？
messages.en: Why is he speaking with so much bitterness?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu rrabjat għax ħass li ma ttrattawhx sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu rrabjat għax ħass li ma ttrattawhx sew.
messages.zh: 他觉得自己没受到善待，所以还在生气。
messages.en: He's still angry because he felt he wasn't treated well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 marrara：胆汁、装胆汁的胆囊、心里的怨苦；这是区分词义的学习联想。

gloss_zh: 马尔萨什洛克，马耳他南部渔村及同名地方行政区

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a fishing village in southern Malta and its local council area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他南部一座渔村的名称，也指同名的地方行政区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raħal tas-sajjieda fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta u tal-lokalità amministrata mill-kunsill lokali tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: A fishing village in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马尔萨什洛克，位于马耳他南部的一座渔村。

sense_translations.en_definition: Marsaxlokk (a village and local council of the Southern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马尔萨什洛克，马耳他南部大区的一个村庄及其地方议会所辖行政区。

formal.mt: Marsaxlokk huwa raħal tas-sajjieda fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: Marsaxlokk is a fishing village in southern Malta.
formal.zh: 马尔萨什洛克是马耳他南部的一座渔村。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid immorru Marsaxlokk għada? David: Iva, nixtieq nimxi ħdejn il-port.
colloquial.en: Anna: Shall we go to Marsaxlokk tomorrow? David: Yes, I'd like to walk by the harbour.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们明天去马尔萨什洛克好吗？戴维：好啊，我想去港边走走。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去马尔萨什洛克好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to Marsaxlokk tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊，我想去港边走走。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to walk by the harbour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Marsaxlokk 写在“马耳他南部渔村与港口”的想象明信片上，用地点画面记住专名及其大写形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a heavy head and a handle, used to strike things, especially to drive in nails.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有较重锤头和手柄的敲击工具，常用来钉钉子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'ras tqila u manku, li tintuża biex wieħed jolqot affarijiet, speċjalment biex idaħħal l-imsiemer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锤子；榔头，用于敲击或钉钉子的工具。

collocations.en: to drive in a nail with a hammer

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża martell biex idaħħal il-musmar fl-injam.
formal.en: The worker used a hammer to drive the nail into the wood.
formal.zh: 工人用锤子把钉子钉进木头里。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tagħtini l-martell? Rita: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn l-imsiemer.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you pass me the hammer? Rita: Yes, it's on the table next to the nails.
colloquial.zh: 马克：能把锤子递给我吗？丽塔：可以，就在桌上，钉子旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 能把锤子递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the hammer?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn l-imsiemer.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn l-imsiemer.
messages.zh: 可以，就在桌上，钉子旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the table next to the nails.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 martell 就想象手握锤柄、锤头敲下的画面；把词与“锤子这件工具”牢牢对应。

gloss_zh: 锤击；锤打；用锤子敲的一下

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blow or strike delivered with a hammer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锤子敲打的一下，或一次锤击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa mogħtija b'martell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锤子敲击的一下。
一次锤打；锤击。
锤子的一击；锤击。

formal.mt: B'martellata waħda, il-ħaddiem daħħal il-musmar aktar fil-fond.
formal.en: With a single hammer blow, the worker drove the nail deeper.
formal.zh: 工人只敲了一锤，就把钉子钉得更深了。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Il-musmar għadu barra ftit. Sara: Agħtih martellata oħra, imma bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Toni: The nail is still sticking out a little. Sara: Give it another hammer blow, but gently.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：钉子还露着一点。萨拉：再敲一下，不过轻一点。

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 钉子还露着一点。
messages.en: The nail is still sticking out a little.

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 再敲一下，不过轻一点。
messages.en: Give it another hammer blow, but gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记 martell“锤子”和 martellata“敲的一下”：前者看工具，后者听见一声“当”，用场景区分。

gloss_zh: 锤打者；使用锤子敲打的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who strikes or works with a hammer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锤子进行敲打或作业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem bil-martell jew tagħti daqqiet bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锤子敲打的人。
锤打者；从事锤击作业的人。

formal.mt: Il-martellatur jagħti daqqiet regolari biex jagħti forma lill-metall.
formal.en: The hammerer delivers regular blows to shape the metal.
formal.zh: 锤打工有节奏地敲击，使金属成形。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu dak li qed jaħdem bil-martell? Ġanni: Dak hu l-martellatur; qed jagħti forma lill-metall.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is that working with the hammer? Ġanni: That's the hammerer; he's shaping the metal.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：那个拿锤子干活的人是谁？詹尼：那是锤打工，他正在把金属敲打成形。

messages.speaker: Marija (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jaħdem bil-martell?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jaħdem bil-martell?
messages.zh: 那个拿锤子干活的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that working with the hammer?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-martellatur; qed jagħti forma lill-metall.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-martellatur; qed jagħti forma lill-metall.
messages.zh: 那是锤打工，他正在把金属敲打成形。
messages.en: That's the hammerer; he's shaping the metal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一幅车间图分清三词：martell 是锤子，martellata 是一次锤击，martellatur 是握锤干活的人。

gloss_zh: 锤形调音工具；调音扳手；石材凿毛锤

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hammer-shaped tool used for tuning an instrument, or a bush hammer used to texture stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指乐器调音时使用的锤形工具，也可指用于使石材表面形成粗糙纹理的凿毛锤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda f'għamla ta' martell għall-irfinar ta' strument mużikali, jew martell li jintuża biex iħarrax wiċċ il-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: tuning instrument shaped like a hammer
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形状像锤子的乐器调音工具。
石材凿毛锤，用于敲出粗糙的石材表面。
调音扳手；用于调节乐器弦轴的锤形调音工具。

collocations.en: a tuning hammer for tuning a piano
collocations.zh: 用于钢琴调音的调音扳手

collocations.en: to roughen the stone with a bush hammer
collocations.zh: 用凿毛锤将石材表面敲粗

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża martellina biex iħarrax wiċċ il-ġebla.
formal.en: The worker used a bush hammer to roughen the surface of the stone.
formal.zh: 工人用凿毛锤将石材表面敲成粗糙纹理。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi dik l-għodda ħdejn il-pjanu? Karl: Din martellina; nużaha biex nirfina l-pjanu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that tool next to the piano? Karl: This is a tuning hammer; I use it to tune the piano.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：钢琴旁边那件工具是什么？卡尔：这是调音扳手，我用它给钢琴调音。

messages.speaker: Nina (钢琴学生)
messages.zh: 钢琴旁边那件工具是什么？
messages.en: What's that tool next to the piano?

messages.speaker: Karl (调音师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din martellina; nużaha biex nirfina l-pjanu.
messages.mt_standard: Din martellina; nużaha biex nirfina l-pjanu.
messages.zh: 这是调音扳手，我用它给钢琴调音。
messages.en: This is a tuning hammer; I use it to tune the piano.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 martellina 画两张用途卡：钢琴旁的调音工具、石材旁的凿毛锤；看到上下文再选择相应词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: March, the third month of the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 三月，一年中的第三个月。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tielet xahar tas-sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三月，作为月份名称的专有名词
三月，一年中的第三个月

formal.mt: Il-kors jibda fl-ewwel ta' Marzu u jintemm fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The course begins on the first of March and ends at the end of the month.
formal.zh: 课程于三月一日开始，并于当月底结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta ġejja żżurna? Rita: F'Marzu, lejn l-aħħar tax-xahar. Maja: Mela nħalli tmiem il-ġimgħa liberu.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you coming to visit us? Rita: In March, towards the end of the month. Maja: Then I'll keep the weekend free.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你什么时候来看我们？Rita：三月，接近月底的时候。Maja：那我就把周末空出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候来看我们？
messages.en: When are you coming to visit us?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 三月，接近月底的时候。
messages.en: In March, towards the end of the month.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我就把周末空出来。
messages.en: Then I'll keep the weekend free.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Marzu 与英语 March 成对记忆，再在日历第三格写上它；连同 f'Marzu“在三月”一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thick fluid that can collect in an infected wound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感染的伤口中可能积聚的黏稠液体，即脓液。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidu oħxon li jista' jinġabar f'ferita infettata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脓；脓液。
脓；感染部位可能产生的黏稠液体。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-infermier kiteb li kien hemm marċa fil-ferita.
formal.en: In the report, the nurse wrote that there was pus in the wound.
formal.zh: 护士在报告中写道，伤口里有脓液。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser marċa? Sara: Hija likwidu oħxon li jista' jkun hemm f'ferita infettata.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does marċa mean? Sara: It is a thick fluid that can be present in an infected wound.
colloquial.zh: 马克：marċa 是什么意思？萨拉：就是感染的伤口里可能出现的黏稠液体，也就是脓。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: marċa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does marċa mean?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija likwidu oħxon li jista' jkun hemm f'ferita infettata.
messages.mt_standard: Hija likwidu oħxon li jista' jkun hemm f'ferita infettata.
messages.zh: 就是感染的伤口里可能出现的黏稠液体，也就是脓。
messages.en: It is a thick fluid that can be present in an infected wound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用词卡把 marċa 与“伤口里的脓液”配对，特别圈出字母 ċ 上的小点，连同词义一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tadpole, the young aquatic form of a frog or toad, with a tail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蝌蚪，即蛙或蟾蜍在水中生活、带有尾巴的幼体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ferħ ta' żrinġ jew rospu meta jkun għadu jgħix fl-ilma u jkollu denb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蝌蚪；蛙或蟾蜍的水生幼体。
蝌蚪，指多只蛙或蟾蜍的水生幼体。

formal.mt: L-istudent osserva marżebb jgħum fl-għadira u nnota d-denb twil tiegħu.
formal.en: The student observed a tadpole swimming in the pond and noted its long tail.
formal.zh: 学生观察到一只蝌蚪在池塘里游动，并注意到它长长的尾巴。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara, hemm marżebb fl-ilma! Ben: Fejn? Lina: Ħdejn dik il-werqa, qed jgħum.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look, there's a tadpole in the water! Ben: Where? Lina: Next to that leaf, it's swimming.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：看，水里有只蝌蚪！本：在哪儿？莉娜：那片叶子旁边，它正在游呢。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 看，水里有只蝌蚪！
messages.en: Look, there's a tadpole in the water!

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 在哪儿？
messages.en: Where?

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 那片叶子旁边，它正在游呢。
messages.en: Next to that leaf, it's swimming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 marżebb 写在池塘里的小黑点旁，再给小黑点画一条摆动的长尾巴，用蝌蚪游水的形象记词。

gloss_zh: 木槌；用于敲打或捣击的木制工具

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wooden implement used for beating or pounding, such as a heavy wooden mallet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于敲打、捣击的木制工具，如较重的木槌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-injam li tintuża biex wieħed iħabbat jew jisħaq biha.

sense_translations.en_definition: an implement made out of wood used for beating or pounding
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于敲打或捣击的木制工具
大木槌；用于敲打或捣实的木槌

collocations.en: to beat with a wooden mallet

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża marżebba tal-injam biex iħabbat il-biċċa bil-mod.
formal.en: The worker used a wooden mallet to tap the piece gently.
formal.zh: 工人用一把木槌轻轻敲打那块工件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-marżebba? Pawlu: Fuq il-bank, ħdejn il-biċċa tal-injam. Lara: Sewwa, se nużaha biex inħabbat din il-biċċa bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the wooden mallet? Pawlu: On the workbench, beside the piece of wood. Lara: Good, I'll use it to tap this piece gently.
colloquial.zh: Lara：木槌在哪里？Pawlu：在工作台上，那块木头旁边。Lara：好，我要用它轻轻敲打这块工件。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: 木槌在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the wooden mallet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.zh: 在工作台上，那块木头旁边。
messages.en: On the workbench, beside the piece of wood.

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, se nużaha biex inħabbat din il-biċċa bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, se nużaha biex inħabbat din il-biċċa bil-mod.
messages.zh: 好，我要用它轻轻敲打这块工件。
messages.en: Good, I'll use it to tap this piece gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 marżebba 和“木制工具反复敲打”的动作画面一起记；看到这个词，就想起手握大木槌敲击工件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people catch fish, such as a fishing spot or fishing ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们进行捕鱼的地点，如钓鱼点或渔场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn isir is-sajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鱼地点；钓鱼点
渔场；与捕鱼活动有关的场所

collocations.en: a fishing spot near the shore

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi masjad qrib ix-xatt u l-kundizzjonijiet tas-sajd fih.
formal.en: The report describes a fishing spot near the shore and the fishing conditions there.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了一处近岸捕鱼地点及当地的捕鱼条件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taf xi masjad tajjeb hawnhekk? Ġużi: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn dawk il-blat. Mark: Mela mmorru hemm kmieni għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you know a good fishing spot around here? Ġużi: Yes, there's one beside those rocks. Mark: Then let's go there early tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你知道这附近有什么好的钓鱼点吗？Ġużi：知道，那些岩石旁边有一个。Mark：那我们明天早点去那里吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (钓鱼爱好者)
messages.zh: 你知道这附近有什么好的钓鱼点吗？
messages.en: Do you know a good fishing spot around here?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (当地渔民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn dawk il-blat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn dawk il-blat.
messages.zh: 知道，那些岩石旁边有一个。
messages.en: Yes, there's one beside those rocks.

messages.speaker: Mark (钓鱼爱好者)
messages.zh: 那我们明天早点去那里吧。
messages.en: Then let's go there early tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 masjad 记成地图上画着鱼竿的地点标记：这个词指可以捕鱼的地方，搭配 tajjeb 就是“好钓点”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mussel, a shellfish with two dark, elongated shells.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贻贝，具有两片深色长形贝壳的贝类，也常称青口贝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal tal-baħar b'żewġ qxur tawwalin u skuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贻贝；青口贝

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher masklu biż-żewġ qxur tiegħu magħluqa.
formal.en: The picture shows a mussel with its two shells closed.
formal.zh: 图片中是一只两片贝壳闭合的贻贝。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan masklu? Leo: Iva, ara l-qoxra twila u skura tiegħu. Nina: Issa nista' nagħrfu fl-istampi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a mussel? Leo: Yes, look at its long, dark shell. Nina: Now I can recognize it in pictures.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这是一只贻贝吗？Leo：是的，看看它又长又深色的贝壳。Nina：现在我能在图片里认出它了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这是一只贻贝吗？
messages.en: Is this a mussel?

messages.speaker: Leo (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-qoxra twila u skura tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-qoxra twila u skura tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，看看它又长又深色的贝壳。
messages.en: Yes, look at its long, dark shell.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 现在我能在图片里认出它了。
messages.en: Now I can recognize it in pictures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 masklu 写在一只深色长壳贻贝的图旁，配上“青口贝”三字；用外形画面帮助记住这个贝类名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A covering worn over the face, or goggles worn over the eyes when swimming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在脸上的面具或面罩，也可指游泳时戴在眼部的泳镜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata li tintlibes fuq il-wiċċ, jew għata għall-għajnejn li tintuża waqt l-għawm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面具；面罩
游泳眼镜；泳镜

formal.mt: L-istudent ħejja maskra tal-karnival għall-wirja tal-iskola.
formal.en: The student prepared a carnival mask for the school exhibition.
formal.zh: 这名学生为学校展览制作了一副狂欢节面具。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Ħadt il-maskra tal-għawm? Ben: Iva, qiegħda fil-borża ħdejn ix-xugaman. Emma: Tajjeb, mela nistgħu nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Emma: Did you pack the swimming goggles? Ben: Yes, they're in the bag beside the towel. Emma: Good, then we can leave.
colloquial.zh: Emma：你把泳镜带上了吗？Ben：带上了，在包里，毛巾旁边。Emma：好，那我们可以出发了。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把泳镜带上了吗？
messages.en: Did you pack the swimming goggles?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 带上了，在包里，毛巾旁边。
messages.en: Yes, they're in the bag beside the towel.

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那我们可以出发了。
messages.en: Good, then we can leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 maskra：狂欢节戴在脸上的是面具，游泳时戴在眼前的是泳镜；看后面的搭配判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craftsperson who makes, fits, or repairs wooden objects and structures, including furniture and doors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作、安装或修理木制物件与结构的工匠，例如制作家具和木门的木匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tas-sengħa li tagħmel, twaħħal jew issewwi oġġetti tal-injam, bħal għamara u bibien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木匠
木匠；从事木制品制作或修理的工匠
木匠；细木工，制作或装配木制构件的工匠

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa ħa l-qisien tal-bieb qabel beda jagħmel il-qafas tal-injam.
formal.en: The carpenter measured the door before starting to make the wooden frame.
formal.zh: 木匠先测量了门的尺寸，然后才开始制作木框。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Taf lil xi mastrudaxxa tajjeb? David: Iva, naf wieħed li sewwieli l-mejda. Marija: Tista' tagħtini n-numru tiegħu?
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you know a good carpenter? David: Yes, I know one who repaired my table. Marija: Can you give me his number?
colloquial.zh: Marija：你认识手艺好的木匠吗？David：认识，有一位帮我修过桌子。Marija：你能把他的电话号码给我吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (住户)
messages.zh: 你认识手艺好的木匠吗？
messages.en: Do you know a good carpenter?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naf wieħed li sewwieli l-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naf wieħed li sewwieli l-mejda.
messages.zh: 认识，有一位帮我修过桌子。
messages.en: Yes, I know one who repaired my table.

messages.speaker: Marija (住户)
messages.zh: 你能把他的电话号码给我吗？
messages.en: Can you give me his number?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把较长的 mastrudaxxa 整体贴在“木匠修桌子、做木门”的画面上，读词时依次想起量尺寸、加工木头和装配家具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land covered with trees, such as a wood, grove, or forest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长有成片树木的土地，可指树林、小树林或森林。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art miksija bis-siġar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一片树林
小树林；一小片树木聚生的地方
森林

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi minn masġar żgħir qabel tasal sal-wied.
formal.en: The path passes through a small grove before reaching the valley.
formal.zh: 这条小路穿过一片小树林，然后通往山谷。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Immorru nimxu fil-masġar? Toni: Iva, hemm id-dell u nistgħu nistrieħu ftit. Sara: Tajjeb, nieħu ftit ilma magħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we go for a walk in the woods? Toni: Yes, there's shade there and we can rest a little. Sara: Good, I'll take some water with us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们去树林里散步好吗？Toni：好，那里有树荫，我们可以休息一会儿。Sara：好，我带点水。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去树林里散步好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a walk in the woods?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm id-dell u nistgħu nistrieħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm id-dell u nistgħu nistrieħu ftit.
messages.zh: 好，那里有树荫，我们可以休息一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, there's shade there and we can rest a little.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我带点水。
messages.en: Good, I'll take some water with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 masġar 时想象自己走进一片有树荫的树林；对应英语 wood 时，要想到成片树木所在的地方。

gloss_zh: 为逾期付款辩解；拖延还债或付款；拖延阻挠

teaching_sense.en_definition: To delay settling a debt or making a payment, give reasons for not paying on time, or hinder progress by temporising.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拖延偿还债务或支付款项，为未按时付款辩解，也可指以拖延来阻碍事情进展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddewwem il-ħlas ta' dejn, tagħti raġunijiet għaliex ma ħallastx fil-ħin, jew ixxekkel xi ħaġa bit-tkaxkir.

sense_translations.en_definition: to justify failure to pay on time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为未能按时付款提出辩解或理由

sense_translations.en_definition: to postpone payment of debt incurred
sense_translations.zh_definition: 推迟偿还已经欠下的债务
阻挠；拖延应付；以拖延来争取时间
延迟付款；推迟支付一笔款项
