formal.mt: Id-debitur matal fil-ħlas tad-dejn u ta diversi raġunijiet għaliex ma ħallasx fil-ħin.
formal.en: The debtor delayed repaying the debt and gave several reasons for not paying on time.
formal.zh: 债务人拖延偿还债务，并为未按时付款提出了多项理由。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-klijent ħallas il-kont? Mark: Le, reġa' matal u qal li għandu bżonn aktar żmien. Rita: Mela nitolbuh jagħtina data ċara għall-ħlas.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the customer paid the bill? Mark: No, he delayed again and said he needs more time. Rita: Then let's ask him to give us a clear payment date.
colloquial.zh: Rita：客户付账了吗？Mark：没有，他又拖延了，说还需要更多时间。Rita：那我们请他给出一个明确的付款日期吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (店主)
messages.zh: 客户付账了吗？
messages.en: Has the customer paid the bill?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, reġa' matal u qal li għandu bżonn aktar żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, reġa' matal u qal li għandu bżonn aktar żmien.
messages.zh: 没有，他又拖延了，说还需要更多时间。
messages.en: No, he delayed again and said he needs more time.

messages.speaker: Rita (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nitolbuh jagħtina data ċara għall-ħlas.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nitolbuh jagħtina data ċara għall-ħlas.
messages.zh: 那我们请他给出一个明确的付款日期吧。
messages.en: Then let's ask him to give us a clear payment date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 matal 放进“账单到了，付款却一拖再拖，还不断解释理由”的小故事中；用拖延付款的画面串起各个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room where food is prepared and cooked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准备食材和烹饪饭菜的房间，即厨房。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra fejn jitħejja u jissajjar l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厨房；准备和烹饪食物的房间。

formal.mt: Il-matbaħ għandu jinżamm nadif waqt it-tħejjija tal-ikel.
formal.en: The kitchen should be kept clean while food is being prepared.
formal.zh: 准备食物时，应保持厨房清洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se nħejju l-ikla? Pawlu: Fil-matbaħ. Diġà naddaft il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we prepare the meal? Pawlu: In the kitchen. I've already cleaned the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里准备这顿饭？保罗：在厨房。我已经把桌子擦干净了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里准备这顿饭？
messages.en: Where shall we prepare the meal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在厨房。我已经把桌子擦干净了。
messages.en: In the kitchen. I've already cleaned the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 matbaħ 和灶台、锅具、切菜桌组成一幅厨房图景，再用“在厨房做饭”整句记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine used for printing, or a workplace where books and other materials are printed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于印刷的机器，也可指印制书籍等材料的印刷厂或印刷作坊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna li tintuża għall-istampar, jew post fejn jiġu stampati kotba u materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷机；把文字或图像印到纸张等材料上的机器。
印刷机；也可指从事印刷工作的印刷厂或印刷作坊。

collocations.en: a modern printing press or printworks

formal.mt: Il-kotba ntbagħtu lill-matbgħa biex jiġu stampati qabel il-bidu tas-sena skolastika.
formal.en: The books were sent to the printworks to be printed before the start of the school year.
formal.zh: 这些书已送交印刷厂，以便在学年开始前印好。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nistgħu nistampaw dawn il-kartolini? Mark: Hemm matbgħa ħdejn l-uffiċċju tiegħi. Nistgħu mmorru hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can we print these cards? Mark: There's a printworks near my office. We can go there.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们可以在哪里印这些卡片？马克：我办公室附近有家印刷厂。我们可以去那里。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们可以在哪里印这些卡片？
messages.en: Where can we print these cards?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm matbgħa ħdejn l-uffiċċju tiegħi. Nistgħu mmorru hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm matbgħa ħdejn l-uffiċċju tiegħi. Nistgħu mmorru hemm.
messages.zh: 我办公室附近有家印刷厂。我们可以去那里。
messages.en: There's a printworks near my office. We can go there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 matbgħa 放进“机器印出纸张、工人在厂里装订”的画面中，同时记住印刷机和印刷厂两种指向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to mathematics or using mathematical ideas and methods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与数学有关的，或使用数学概念和方法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-matematika jew juża l-ideat u l-metodi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数学的；与数学有关或运用数学方法的。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi użaw mudell matematiku biex jistmaw kif tinbidel it-temperatura matul il-jum.
formal.en: The researchers used a mathematical model to estimate how the temperature changes during the day.
formal.zh: 研究人员使用数学模型来估算一天之中温度的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kalkolu matematiku jidher diffiċli. David: Ejja nagħmluh pass pass. Nibdew b'dawn iż-żewġ numri.
colloquial.en: Lara: This mathematical calculation looks difficult. David: Let's do it step by step. We'll start with these two numbers.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这道数学计算看起来很难。戴维：我们一步一步来。先从这两个数开始。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这道数学计算看起来很难。
messages.en: This mathematical calculation looks difficult.

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nagħmluh pass pass. Nibdew b'dawn iż-żewġ numri.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nagħmluh pass pass. Nibdew b'dawn iż-żewġ numri.
messages.zh: 我们一步一步来。先从这两个数开始。
messages.en: Let's do it step by step. We'll start with these two numbers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用熟悉的英文 mathematical 联想 matematiku，再把它和 mudell 一起记成“数学模型”，巩固形容词用法。

gloss_zh: 上行楼梯；通往高处的阶梯

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stairway or set of steps leading up to a higher place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向上延伸、通往较高位置的楼梯或阶梯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taraġ li jwassal għal post ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向上通行的楼梯；上行阶梯。
通往较高位置的楼梯或阶梯。

formal.mt: Il-matla' tal-ġebel iwassal mill-bitħa għat-terrazzin ta' fuq.
formal.en: The stone stairway leads from the courtyard up to the upper terrace.
formal.zh: 这段石阶从庭院通往上层露台。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif naslu fuq it-terrazzin? Toni: Hemm matla' ħdejn il-bieb. Itla' bil-mod għax it-taraġ huwa dejjaq.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do we get up to the terrace? Toni: There's a stairway by the door. Go up slowly because the steps are narrow.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们怎么上露台？托尼：门旁边有一段上行楼梯。慢慢上，台阶很窄。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 我们怎么上露台？
messages.en: How do we get up to the terrace?

messages.speaker: Toni (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm matla' ħdejn il-bieb. Itla' bil-mod għax it-taraġ huwa dejjaq.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm matla' ħdejn il-bieb. Itla' bil-mod għax it-taraġ huwa dejjaq.
messages.zh: 门旁边有一段上行楼梯。慢慢上，台阶很窄。
messages.en: There's a stairway by the door. Go up slowly because the steps are narrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己沿 matla' 一阶一阶走上露台，把“向上到达高处”的方向感与这个名词一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place set aside for prayer, such as a prayer room or an oratory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门用于祈祷的场所，例如祈祷室或小祈祷堂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post imwarrab apposta għat-talb, bħal kamra jew kappella żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专门用于祈祷的地方；祈祷场所。
小祈祷堂；供祈祷使用的房间或小型宗教场所。

formal.mt: Il-matlab huwa miftuħ għal dawk li jixtiequ jqattgħu ftit ħin fit-talb.
formal.en: The oratory is open to those who wish to spend some time in prayer.
formal.zh: 这间祈祷室向希望花些时间祈祷的人开放。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hemm post kwiet fejn nista' nitlob? Marija: Iva, hemm matlab żgħir fit-tarf tal-kuritur.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is there a quiet place where I can pray? Marija: Yes, there's a small oratory at the end of the corridor.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：有可以安静祈祷的地方吗？玛丽亚：有，走廊尽头有间小祈祷室。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm post kwiet fejn nista' nitlob?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm post kwiet fejn nista' nitlob?
messages.zh: 有可以安静祈祷的地方吗？
messages.en: Is there a quiet place where I can pray?

messages.speaker: Marija (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm matlab żgħir fit-tarf tal-kuritur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm matlab żgħir fit-tarf tal-kuritur.
messages.zh: 有，走廊尽头有间小祈祷室。
messages.en: Yes, there's a small oratory at the end of the corridor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 matlab 配上一间安静小屋和低声祈祷的画面，记作“留给祈祷的地方”，不要联想成演讲活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A barn or granary used to store harvested crops or grain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于储存收获的农作物或谷物的谷仓、粮仓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħżen fejn jinżammu l-ħsad jew il-qamħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谷仓；存放收获的农作物等农用物资的仓房。
粮仓；专门储存谷物的仓库或储藏处。

collocations.en: to store wheat in the granary

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, il-bdiewa ħażnu l-qamħ fil-matmura biex iżommuh niexef.
formal.en: After the harvest, the farmers stored the wheat in the granary to keep it dry.
formal.zh: 收获后，农民把小麦储存在粮仓里，以保持干燥。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn se npoġġu dawn l-ixkejjer tal-qamħ? Ġużeppi: Fil-matmura. Hemm biżżejjed spazju għalihom.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where shall we put these sacks of wheat? Ġużeppi: In the granary. There's enough room for them.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些小麦袋放在哪里？朱塞佩：放在粮仓里。里面有足够的地方。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se npoġġu dawn l-ixkejjer tal-qamħ?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se npoġġu dawn l-ixkejjer tal-qamħ?
messages.zh: 这些小麦袋放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put these sacks of wheat?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.zh: 放在粮仓里。里面有足够的地方。
messages.en: In the granary. There's enough room for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收获后把一袋袋谷物搬进 matmura，用“谷物进入仓库”的连续画面同时记住谷仓和粮仓两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During or throughout a period of time, or along the length of a place or route.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在某段时间期间或贯穿该时段，也可表示沿某处或某条路线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waqt perjodu ta' żmien jew tul dak il-perjodu, jew tul post jew triq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……期间；用于说明事情发生的时间范围。
沿着；顺着某个地方或某条路线延伸。
贯穿……整个期间；在……期间。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena kollha, it-tim se jiġbor informazzjoni dwar is-siġar imħawla matul it-triq.
formal.en: Throughout the whole year, the team will collect information about the trees planted along the road.
formal.zh: 团队将在全年持续收集沿路种植的树木的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmel matul il-vaganzi? Mark: Se noqgħod għand in-nanniet u ngħinhom fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will you do during the holidays? Mark: I'll stay with my grandparents and help them in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：假期里你打算做什么？马克：我会住在祖父母家，帮他们打理花园。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 假期里你打算做什么？
messages.en: What will you do during the holidays?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se noqgħod għand in-nanniet u ngħinhom fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Se noqgħod għand in-nanniet u ngħinhom fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 我会住在祖父母家，帮他们打理花园。
messages.en: I'll stay with my grandparents and help them in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 matul 想成沿着一条线移动：时间线上是在某段期间，实际道路上则是沿路，用同一幅线条图记住两类用法。

gloss_zh: 出游；旅行；度假；外出走动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trip or outing, including a holiday, or an occasion of going out or walking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次旅行、出游或度假，也可指外出、走动的一次活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħarġa jew vjaġġ, inkluża vaganza, jew darba li wieħed joħroġ jew jimxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旅行；出游；前往某地的一次行程。
度假；为休息或游玩而安排的一次假期出行。
一次外出或步行；出去走动的活动。

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat mawra f'Għawdex biex l-istudenti jsiru jafu aħjar il-gżira.
formal.en: The school organized a trip to Gozo so that the students could get to know the island better.
formal.zh: 学校组织了一次戈佐岛之行，让学生更深入地了解这座岛屿。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Tiġi għal mawra ħdejn il-baħar il-Ħadd? Luqa: Iva, niġi. Nistgħu nimxu ftit u mbagħad nieħdu kafè.
colloquial.en: Elena: Will you come for an outing by the sea on Sunday? Luqa: Yes, I'll come. We can walk for a while and then have a coffee.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：星期日一起去海边逛逛吗？卢卡：好，我去。我们可以先走一会儿，然后喝杯咖啡。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiġi għal mawra ħdejn il-baħar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Tiġi għal mawra ħdejn il-baħar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期日一起去海边逛逛吗？
messages.en: Will you come for an outing by the sea on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi. Nistgħu nimxu ftit u mbagħad nieħdu kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi. Nistgħu nimxu ftit u mbagħad nieħdu kafè.
messages.zh: 好，我去。我们可以先走一会儿，然后喝杯咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come. We can walk for a while and then have a coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mawra 画一条从家门出发的路线：可以走到海边，也可以远行度假；围绕“一次外出”记住各个义项。

gloss_zh: 派某人出行；送走；使某人前往

teaching_sense.en_definition: To send someone on a trip, send someone off, or make someone go somewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 派某人出行、把某人送走，或使某人前往某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibgħat lil xi ħadd fuq vjaġġ, tibagħtu lejn xi post jew iġġiegħlu jmur.

sense_translations.en_definition: to send sb. on a trip
sense_translations.zh_definition: 派某人去旅行或出行。
送走某人；把某人打发走。
使某人离开或前往某处。

collocations.en: sent Pawlu on a trip to Gozo
sent the worker off to a meeting

formal.mt: Id-direttur mawwar lil Pawlu lejn Għawdex biex jattendi laqgħa mal-klijenti.
formal.en: The director sent Pawlu to Gozo to attend a meeting with the clients.
formal.zh: 主管派保罗前往戈佐岛，参加与客户的会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu Pawlu llum? Mark: Il-kap mawwar lil Pawlu lejn Għawdex għal laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Pawlu today? Mark: The boss sent Pawlu to Gozo for a meeting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗今天在哪儿？马克：老板派保罗去戈佐岛开会了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗今天在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kap mawwar lil Pawlu lejn Għawdex għal laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kap mawwar lil Pawlu lejn Għawdex għal laqgħa.
messages.zh: 老板派保罗去戈佐岛开会了。
messages.en: The boss sent Pawlu to Gozo for a meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主管指着地图派人出发，把 mawwar 与“派出去、送走”的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To comb someone's hair; in another sense, to rob someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 梳理某人的头发；另一个义项表示抢劫某人，须根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi moxt minn xagħar xi ħadd biex tirranġah; f'tifsira oħra, tisraq lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用梳子梳理头发。
抢劫；劫取某人的财物。

formal.mt: Qabel ir-ritratt tal-familja, il-missier maxat xagħar bintu b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: Before the family photograph, the father carefully combed his daughter's hair.
formal.zh: 拍全家福之前，父亲仔细地给女儿梳了头发。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min maxat xagħar it-tifla? Pawlu: Jien, għax dalwaqt nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who combed the girl's hair? Pawlu: I did, because we're leaving soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁给小女孩梳了头发？保罗：我梳的，因为我们很快就要出门了。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁给小女孩梳了头发？
messages.en: Who combed the girl's hair?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 我梳的，因为我们很快就要出门了。
messages.en: I did, because we're leaving soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情景卡分别记 maxat：梳子整理头发、劫匪抢走财物；两个义项依靠语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of combing hair, or a single occasion of giving hair a comb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 梳理头发这一行为，也可指给头发梳理一次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħaddi moxt minn ġox-xagħar, jew darba waħda li tagħmel dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳头；梳理头发这一行为。
一次梳理；一次梳头。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, ix-xagħar kellu bżonn maxta ħafifa biex jitneħħew l-għoqiedi.
formal.en: After washing, the hair needed a light combing to remove the tangles.
formal.zh: 洗过之后，头发需要轻轻梳理一下，以解开打结的地方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xagħri għandu bżonn maxta tajba. Nina: Hawn il-moxt; għandna ħin qabel noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: My hair needs a thorough combing. Nina: Here's the comb; we have time before we go out.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我的头发需要好好梳一下。妮娜：梳子在这里；出门前我们还有时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的头发需要好好梳一下。
messages.en: My hair needs a thorough combing.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn il-moxt; għandna ħin qabel noħorġu.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn il-moxt; għandna ħin qabel noħorġu.
messages.zh: 梳子在这里；出门前我们还有时间。
messages.en: Here's the comb; we have time before we go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maxta 记成日程表上的“一次梳头”：它指梳理这件事，也可以数作一次梳理。

gloss_zh: 大吃；狼吞虎咽；大口咀嚼

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat a lot, gobble food down, or chomp one's food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃很多东西，狼吞虎咽地吃，或大口咀嚼食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiekol ħafna, tibla' l-ikel bil-għaġla jew tomgħod b'ħalq mimli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃很多；大量进食。
狼吞虎咽地吃下；很快地吞食。
大口咀嚼食物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to eat much, to gobble up, gorge, chomp
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大吃、狼吞虎咽、塞饱肚子或大口嚼食。

collocations.en: gobbled down food in a hurry

formal.mt: Wara l-vjaġġ twil, il-mistieden maxtar ħafna waqt l-ikla.
formal.en: After the long journey, the guest ate a great deal at the meal.
formal.zh: 长途旅行之后，那位客人在用餐时吃了很多。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu maxtar ħafna waqt l-ikla! Mark: Kien bil-ġuħ wara dik il-mixja twila.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu really ate a lot at the meal! Mark: He was hungry after that long walk.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗这顿饭可真吃了不少！马克：走了那么远的路，他饿了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗这顿饭可真吃了不少！
messages.en: Pawlu really ate a lot at the meal!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien bil-ġuħ wara dik il-mixja twila.
messages.mt_standard: Kien bil-ġuħ wara dik il-mixja twila.
messages.zh: 走了那么远的路，他饿了。
messages.en: He was hungry after that long walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象长途步行后面对一大盘饭，大口嚼、吃得快又多，用这个画面记住 maxtar。

gloss_zh: 饲槽；马槽；圣诞马槽布景

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeding trough for animals, especially for hay; also a Christmas nativity scene.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供牲畜吃干草等饲料的槽；也可指表现耶稣诞生场景的圣诞马槽布景。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent fejn jitqiegħed il-ħuxlief jew ikel ieħor għall-annimali; ukoll xena tal-Milied li turi t-twelid ta' Ġesù.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饲槽；这里指供牲畜进食的槽。
马槽；牲畜的饲料槽。

sense_translations.en_definition: crib, manger (vessel for hay and the like)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛放干草等饲料、供牲畜进食的槽。
圣诞马槽布景；表现耶稣诞生场景的陈设。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi mela l-maxtura bil-ħuxlief qabel daħħal l-annimali fl-istalla.
formal.en: The farmer filled the manger with hay before bringing the animals into the stable.
formal.zh: 农民把牲畜赶进畜舍之前，先在饲槽里装满了干草。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn se npoġġu l-maxtura tal-Milied? Ġanni: Fuq il-mejda ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where shall we put the Christmas nativity scene? Ġanni: On the table beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们把圣诞马槽布景放在哪里？詹尼：放在窗边的桌子上。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 我们把圣诞马槽布景放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the Christmas nativity scene?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (父亲)
messages.zh: 放在窗边的桌子上。
messages.en: On the table beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 maxtura 配两幅学习图：畜舍里盛干草的饲槽，以及圣诞节摆出的耶稣诞生布景。

gloss_zh: 经常或用力梳理；梳头者；理发师；制梳者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To comb hair regularly or vigorously, or more generally to comb it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常或用力地梳理头发，也可一般地表示梳头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi moxt minn ġox-xagħar ta' spiss jew b'ħafna saħħa; ukoll, b'mod ġenerali, tgħaddi moxt minn ġox-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常梳理，或用力梳理头发。
梳头的人；从事梳理的人。
梳理；用梳子梳头。
理发师；为人整理发型的人。
制作梳子的人；制梳匠。

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, l-attur maxxat xagħru bis-saħħa biex jirranġah.
formal.en: Before the performance, the actor combed his hair vigorously to tidy it.
formal.zh: 演出之前，演员用力梳理自己的头发，把它整理好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex xagħar Leo jidher daqshekk pulit? Mark: Missieru maxxat xagħru qabel ħareġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does Leo's hair look so neat? Mark: His father combed his hair before he went out.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：利奥的头发怎么这么整齐？马克：他爸爸在他出门前给他梳了头发。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex xagħar Leo jidher daqshekk pulit?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex xagħar Leo jidher daqshekk pulit?
messages.zh: 利奥的头发怎么这么整齐？
messages.en: Why does Leo's hair look so neat?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 他爸爸在他出门前给他梳了头发。
messages.en: His father combed his hair before he went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maxxat 的双写 xx 当作记忆提示，联想反复或用力梳头；名词义另记三张人物卡：梳头者、理发师、制梳匠。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of things gathered together as a pack, pile, sheaf, or bunch; also a deck of cards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚在一起的一包、一堆、一捆或一束东西；也可指一副纸牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet miġbura flimkien, marbuta jew f'munzell; ukoll sett ta' karti tal-logħob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一包；聚集成组的一批东西。
一堆；堆放在一起的东西。
一捆；一束，如捆在一起的纸张或谷秆。
一束；一串，如花束或一串钥匙。
一副纸牌。

formal.mt: Is-segretarja poġġiet mazz karti fuq l-iskrivanija biex jiġu eżaminati.
formal.en: The secretary placed a stack of papers on the desk for examination.
formal.zh: 秘书把一沓文件放在书桌上，供人审阅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ta' min hu dan il-mazz ċwievet? Mark: Tiegħi; fih iċ-ċavetta tad-dar u dik tal-uffiċċju.
colloquial.en: Sara: Whose bunch of keys is this? Mark: Mine; it has the house key and the office key.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这串钥匙是谁的？马克：我的，里面有家里的钥匙和办公室的钥匙。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' min hu dan il-mazz ċwievet?
messages.mt_standard: Ta' min hu dan il-mazz ċwievet?
messages.zh: 这串钥匙是谁的？
messages.en: Whose bunch of keys is this?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiegħi; fih iċ-ċavetta tad-dar u dik tal-uffiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Tiegħi; fih iċ-ċavetta tad-dar u dik tal-uffiċċju.
messages.zh: 我的，里面有家里的钥匙和办公室的钥匙。
messages.en: Mine; it has the house key and the office key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一组聚在一起的东西”串联 mazz：花是一束，钥匙是一串，纸是一沓，纸牌是一副。

gloss_zh: 棍棒；狼牙棒；有吸引力的人（非正式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heavy club or mace; informally, a person considered attractive or desirable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 较重的棍棒或狼牙棒；在非正式表达中，也可指很有吸引力的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastun tqil jew arma b'ras tqila; b'mod informali, persuna meqjusa attraenti jew mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棍棒；可用作武器的粗重棒子。
狼牙棒；带有沉重棒头的钝击武器。
很有吸引力、令人倾慕的人，属于非正式说法。

formal.mt: Fil-wirja hemm mazza tal-injam b'manku qasir u ras tqila.
formal.en: The exhibition contains a wooden club with a short handle and a heavy head.
formal.zh: 展览中有一根木制棍棒，柄较短，棒头沉重。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-mazza tidher tqila. Pawlu: Iva, iżda dik l-oħra hija replika ħafifa għat-teatru.
colloquial.en: Lara: This club looks heavy. Pawlu: Yes, but that other one is a lightweight replica for the theatre.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这根棍棒看起来很重。保罗：是的，不过另一根是供戏剧表演使用的轻质仿制品。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这根棍棒看起来很重。
messages.en: This club looks heavy.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda dik l-oħra hija replika ħafifa għat-teatru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda dik l-oħra hija replika ħafifa għat-teatru.
messages.zh: 是的，不过另一根是供戏剧表演使用的轻质仿制品。
messages.en: Yes, but that other one is a lightweight replica for the theatre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mazza 画一根粗重棍棒，再加一张“有吸引力的人”的口语卡；同时辨清 mazz 表示一束或一组东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dragonfly: an insect with a long body and two pairs of wings, often seen near water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜻蜓，一种身体细长、有两对翅膀、常见于水边的昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett b'ġisem twil u żewġ pari ġwienaħ, li spiss jidher ħdejn l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜻蜓。
蜻蜓。

collocations.en: a dragonfly flying over the water

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għadira, l-istudenti raw mazzarell itir fuq l-ilma.
formal.en: While observing the pond, the students saw a dragonfly flying over the water.
formal.zh: 观察池塘时，学生们看到一只蜻蜓飞过水面。

colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that dragonfly by the water! Luqa: I saw it! Let's see whether it lands on that branch.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看水边那只蜻蜓！Luqa：我看到了！看看它会不会停在那根树枝上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看水边那只蜻蜓！
messages.en: Look at that dragonfly by the water!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Ejja naraw jekk jieqafx fuq dik il-fergħa.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Ejja naraw jekk jieqafx fuq dik il-fergħa.
messages.zh: 我看到了！看看它会不会停在那根树枝上。
messages.en: I saw it! Let's see whether it lands on that branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mazzarell 配上池塘边蜻蜓的图像，边指图边读词，用“水边飞行的小昆虫”这个场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Beside or next to a person, place, or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示位于某人、某处或某物的旁边，或紧挨着它。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika pożizzjoni qrib ħafna ta' persuna, post jew ħaġa, fuq naħa minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……旁边；在……一侧
紧挨着；在……旁边

collocations.en: to sit or stay beside a friend

formal.mt: Il-librerija tinsab maġenb l-iskola, u d-daħla tagħha tagħti għall-pjazza.
formal.en: The library is next to the school, and its entrance faces the square.
formal.zh: 图书馆位于学校旁边，入口朝向广场。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' noqgħod maġenb it-tieqa? Ben: Iva, dak is-siġġu għadu vojt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I sit next to the window? Ben: Yes, that chair is still free.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我可以坐在窗边吗？Ben：可以，那把椅子还空着。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 我可以坐在窗边吗？
messages.en: Can I sit next to the window?

messages.speaker: Ben (服务员)
messages.zh: 可以，那把椅子还空着。
messages.en: Yes, that chair is still free.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一扇窗，再把椅子放在窗旁，用 maġenb it-tieqa 记住旁边这种位置关系。

gloss_zh: 火盆；燃烧煤炭等燃料的炉处

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brazier or other place where coal or another fuel is burned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来燃烧煤炭或其他燃料的火盆，也可指这样的燃烧处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent jew post fejn jinħaraq il-faħam jew fjuwil ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: a place where coal or other fuel is burnt
sense_translations.zh_definition: 燃烧煤炭或其他燃料的地方；炉处
一个火盆；用于盛放并燃烧炭等燃料的容器
火盆；炭盆

collocations.en: to light the charcoal in the brazier

formal.mt: Fil-bitħa kien hemm maġmar tal-ħadid li fih kien qed jinħaraq il-faħam.
formal.en: In the courtyard there was an iron brazier in which charcoal was burning.
formal.zh: 院子里放着一个铁制火盆，里面正燃烧着木炭。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn inpoġġi l-faħam? Ġorġ: Fil-maġmar hemm barra; imbagħad nixegħluh.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where should I put the charcoal? Ġorġ: In the brazier outside; then we'll light it.
colloquial.zh: Rita：木炭放在哪里？Ġorġ：放在外面的火盆里，然后我们把它点着。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 木炭放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the charcoal?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.zh: 放在外面的火盆里，然后我们把它点着。
messages.en: In the brazier outside; then we'll light it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象铁盆里装着发红的炭，把 maġmar 贴在盆上，记住它是燃烧燃料的火盆或炉处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The greater part of a group or total, especially more than half of the people or votes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个群体或总数中占较大部分的多数，尤其指人数或票数超过一半。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-akbar parti ta' grupp jew total, speċjalment aktar minn nofs in-nies jew il-voti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多数；大多数；通常指超过总数一半的人数或票数

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva l-proposta b'maġġoranza kbira wara d-diskussjoni.
formal.en: The committee approved the proposal by a large majority after the discussion.
formal.zh: 讨论结束后，委员会以很大的多数优势通过了这项提议。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Il-maġġoranza trid tmur il-baħar jew il-park? Leo: Il-baħar; sitta minn tmienja għażluh.
colloquial.en: Emma: Does the majority want to go to the seaside or the park? Leo: The seaside; six out of eight chose it.
colloquial.zh: Emma：大多数人想去海边还是公园？Leo：海边，八个人里有六个人选了海边。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maġġoranza trid tmur il-baħar jew il-park?
messages.mt_standard: Il-maġġoranza trid tmur il-baħar jew il-park?
messages.zh: 大多数人想去海边还是公园？
messages.en: Does the majority want to go to the seaside or the park?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 海边，八个人里有六个人选了海边。
messages.en: The seaside; six out of eight chose it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画八个人，其中六个人举手，把人数较多的一边标成 maġġoranza，直观记住多数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blow one's nose in order to remove mucus from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过擤鼻子的动作，把鼻腔中的鼻涕清出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tneħħi l-mukus minn imnieħrek billi tonfoħ minn ġo fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擤鼻子；擤鼻涕。

sense_translations.en_definition: to extract mucus from the nose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把鼻腔中的黏液清出来。

collocations.en: blew his nose using a clean handkerchief
collocations.zh: 用干净的手帕擤了鼻涕

formal.mt: It-tifel maħat imnieħru b'maktur nadif u mbagħad ħasel idejh.
formal.en: The boy blew his nose using a clean handkerchief and then washed his hands.
formal.zh: 男孩用干净的手帕擤了鼻涕，然后洗了手。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tifel maħat imnieħru? David: Iva, u mbagħad ħasel idejh.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did the boy blow his nose? David: Yes, and then he washed his hands.
colloquial.zh: Anna：孩子擤鼻涕了吗？David：擤了，之后也洗了手。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子擤鼻涕了吗？
messages.en: Did the boy blow his nose?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.zh: 擤了，之后也洗了手。
messages.en: Yes, and then he washed his hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħat 配成三个连续动作：拿手帕、擤鼻涕、洗双手；用动作顺序记住它表示清理鼻腔。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person one loves dearly, especially a romantic partner; a beloved or sweetheart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己深爱的人，尤其指恋爱伴侣，即爱人、心上人或亲爱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li wieħed iħobb ħafna, speċjalment is-sieħeb f'relazzjoni ta' mħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深爱的人；挚爱。
亲爱的；宝贝，作为对所爱之人的称呼。
亲爱的人；亲爱的，作为亲昵称呼。
心上人；恋人。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, esprimiet ix-xewqa li terġa' tiltaqa' mal-maħbub tagħha.
formal.en: In her letter, she expressed her wish to meet her beloved again.
formal.zh: 她在信中表达了与爱人再次相见的愿望。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lil min qed tikteb? Maja: Lill-maħbub tiegħi; illum għeluq sninu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who are you writing to? Maja: My sweetheart; it's his birthday today.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在给谁写信？Maja：给我的爱人，今天是他的生日。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在给谁写信？
messages.en: Who are you writing to?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 给我的爱人，今天是他的生日。
messages.en: My sweetheart; it's his birthday today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在一封生日情书上写“给我的心上人”，把 maħbub 和收信的那个人联系起来，记住这里是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 旧时婚礼中新娘所在的位置；绿地

teaching_sense.en_definition: A green place; also, the place where a bride used to be present during her wedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一处绿色的地方或绿地；也指旧时婚礼中新娘所在的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post aħdar; ukoll, il-post fejn kienet tkun l-għarusa waqt it-tieġ tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: place where the bride used to be in attendance during her wedding
sense_translations.zh_definition: 旧时婚礼期间新娘所在的位置或场所。
一处绿色的地方；绿地。

collocations.en: the bride's place at the wedding
collocations.zh: 婚礼中新娘所在的位置

collocations.en: a green place near the village

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-maħdar bħala l-post fejn kienet tkun l-għarusa waqt it-tieġ tagħha.
formal.en: The text describes the maħdar as the place where the bride used to be present during her wedding.
formal.zh: 文中将 maħdar 描述为旧时婚礼中新娘所在的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nistgħu nistrieħu ftit? Pawlu: Hemm maħdar ħdejn ir-raħal; nistgħu noqogħdu hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can we rest for a while? Pawlu: There's a green place near the village; we can sit there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们能在哪里歇一会儿？Pawlu：村庄附近有一处绿地，我们可以在那里坐坐。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 我们能在哪里歇一会儿？
messages.en: Where can we rest for a while?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm maħdar ħdejn ir-raħal; nistgħu noqogħdu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm maħdar ħdejn ir-raħal; nistgħu noqogħdu hemm.
messages.zh: 村庄附近有一处绿地，我们可以在那里坐坐。
messages.en: There's a green place near the village; we can sit there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张记忆卡：一张画村边绿地，一张标出婚礼中新娘的位置；两张都写 maħdar，分别记住两个场所义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forgiveness or pardon for a wrong someone has committed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人所犯过错给予的原谅、宽恕或赦免。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li taħfer lil xi ħadd għal żball jew ħtija tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原谅；宽恕他人的过错。
宽恕；赦免。
原谅、宽恕或赦免。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, talab maħfra għall-kliem li kien weġġa' lil ħabibu.
formal.en: In his letter, he asked for forgiveness for the words that had hurt his friend.
formal.zh: 他在信中为那些伤害朋友的话请求原谅。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nitolbok maħfra talli ksirt it-tazza. Sara: Naħfirlek; naf li kien aċċident.
colloquial.en: Mark: Please forgive me for breaking the cup. Sara: I forgive you; I know it was an accident.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我打破了杯子，请你原谅。Sara：我原谅你，我知道那是个意外。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我打破了杯子，请你原谅。
messages.en: Please forgive me for breaking the cup.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我原谅你，我知道那是个意外。
messages.en: I forgive you; I know it was an accident.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友打破杯子后请求原谅，你放下责备并伸手和好；把这份“宽恕”记成名词 maħfra。

gloss_zh: 脏的；污秽的；粗劣的；猥亵的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dirty or unclean; also used for squalid surroundings, shoddy work, or obscene thoughts and material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肮脏或不洁的，也可形容环境污秽、做工粗劣，或思想及内容猥亵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex nadif; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi ambjent mitluq, xogħol ta' kwalità ħażina, jew ħsibijiet u materjal oxxeni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脏的；沾有污物的。
粗制滥造的；质量低劣的。
昏暗且脏旧的；灰暗不洁的。
污秽不堪的；环境脏乱恶劣的。
思想龌龊的；满脑子猥亵念头的。
不整洁的；凌乱的。
淫秽的；色情的。

formal.mt: L-ispettur sab li l-art tal-maħżen kienet maħmuġa u talab li titnaddaf minnufih.
formal.en: The inspector found that the warehouse floor was dirty and requested that it be cleaned immediately.
formal.zh: 检查员发现仓库地面很脏，要求立即清洁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-flokk maħmuġ? Toni: Iva, waqgħet ftit zalza fuqu. Se naħslu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this shirt dirty? Toni: Yes, some sauce spilled on it. I'll wash it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这件上衣脏了吗？托尼：是啊，上面洒了点酱汁。我会把它洗干净。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这件上衣脏了吗？
messages.en: Is this shirt dirty?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waqgħet ftit zalza fuqu. Se naħslu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waqgħet ftit zalza fuqu. Se naħslu.
messages.zh: 是啊，上面洒了点酱汁。我会把它洗干净。
messages.en: Yes, some sauce spilled on it. I'll wash it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 maħmuġ 和沾满酱汁的上衣联系起来，再扩展到脏乱环境、粗劣做工和不干净的言语思想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place or source of refuge, protection, or help in danger or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在危险或困境中提供安全、保护或援助的地方或依靠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew sors ta' kenn, ħarsien jew għajnuna f'ħin ta' periklu jew diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一处避难所；可供躲避危险的地方。
危难中的援助；救助。
庇护；供人避难的安全处所。
避难；庇护；可依靠的安全之地。

formal.mt: Matul il-maltemp, il-bini l-antik serva ta' maħrab sigur għall-vjaġġaturi.
formal.en: During the storm, the old building served as a safe refuge for the travellers.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，那座旧建筑为旅人提供了安全的避难处。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ix-xita qed tiżdied. Fejn nistgħu nistkennu? Ġanni: Dik id-dar tista' tkun maħrab tajjeb sakemm tgħaddi l-maltempata.
colloquial.en: Nina: The rain is getting heavier. Where can we shelter? Ġanni: That house could be a good refuge until the storm passes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：雨越下越大了。我们能去哪里躲躲？詹尼：暴风雨过去之前，那间房子可以让我们好好避一避。

messages.speaker: Nina (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xita qed tiżdied. Fejn nistgħu nistkennu?
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xita qed tiżdied. Fejn nistgħu nistkennu?
messages.zh: 雨越下越大了。我们能去哪里躲躲？
messages.en: The rain is getting heavier. Where can we shelter?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik id-dar tista' tkun maħrab tajjeb sakemm tgħaddi l-maltempata.
messages.mt_standard: Dik id-dar tista' tkun maħrab tajjeb sakemm tgħaddi l-maltempata.
messages.zh: 暴风雨过去之前，那间房子可以让我们好好避一避。
messages.en: That house could be a good refuge until the storm passes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħrab 想成暴风雨中亮着灯的小屋：它既是避难的地方，也能代表危难时获得的庇护和援助。

gloss_zh: 逃亡者；逃走的；匆忙的；被避开的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has run away or escaped, especially someone trying to avoid capture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经逃走或逃脱的人，尤其指为躲避追捕而逃亡的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ħarbet jew skappat, speċjalment biex tevita li tinqabad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃亡者；逃犯。
已经逃走；处于逃离后的状态。
十分匆忙；急急忙忙。
ħarab 的过去分词，表示已经逃走的。
逃亡的；出逃的。
匆忙的；赶时间的。
被避开的；被疏远、被保持距离的。

formal.mt: Il-pulizija sabu lill-maħrub f'dar abbandunata wara tfittxija ta' diversi sigħat.
formal.en: The police found the fugitive in an abandoned house after a search lasting several hours.
formal.zh: 经过数小时的搜寻，警方在一所废弃房屋中找到了那名逃亡者。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Sabu lill-maħrub li semmew fl-aħbarijiet? David: Iva, qalu li sabuh dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did they find the fugitive mentioned in the news? David: Yes, they said they found him this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：新闻里提到的那个逃亡者找到了吗？戴维：找到了，说是今天早上找到的。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.zh: 新闻里提到的那个逃亡者找到了吗？
messages.en: Did they find the fugitive mentioned in the news?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.zh: 找到了，说是今天早上找到的。
messages.en: Yes, they said they found him this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面对比记忆：maħrab 是供人避难的地方，maħrub 可指逃走的人；遇到形容词用法，再按语境判断匆忙或被疏远等义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mucus from the nose, especially the substance that appears when someone has a runny nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻腔产生的黏液，尤指流鼻涕时流出或沾在鼻孔周围的分泌物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mukus li joħroġ mill-imnieħer, speċjalment meta wieħed ikun irjiħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻涕，常用于日常口语。
鼻涕；鼻腔黏液。

formal.mt: L-omm mesħet il-maħta minn taħt imnieħer it-tifel b'maktur nadif.
formal.en: The mother wiped the snot from beneath the boy's nose with a clean handkerchief.
formal.zh: 母亲用干净的手帕擦掉了男孩鼻子下面的鼻涕。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek ftit maħta taħt imnieħrek. Trid maktur? Ben: Iva, grazzi. Għandi riħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: You've got a little snot under your nose. Would you like a handkerchief? Ben: Yes, thanks. I've got a cold.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你鼻子下面有点鼻涕。要手帕吗？本：要，谢谢。我感冒了。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ftit maħta taħt imnieħrek. Trid maktur?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ftit maħta taħt imnieħrek. Trid maktur?
messages.zh: 你鼻子下面有点鼻涕。要手帕吗？
messages.en: You've got a little snot under your nose. Would you like a handkerchief?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。我感冒了。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. I've got a cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħta 和感冒时拿手帕擦鼻子的动作一起记，直接联想到“鼻涕”，比只记抽象的“黏液”更容易。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To erase writing or marks, cancel something arranged, or delete information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 擦掉文字或痕迹，取消已安排的事情，或删除信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħassar kitba jew marki, jikkanċella xi ħaġa ppjanata, jew ineħħi informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦除；抹去文字或痕迹。
取消；撤销原有的安排。
删除；从文本或记录中移除内容。

collocations.en: deleted the name from the list

formal.mt: L-għalliem maħħa l-kitba minn fuq il-bord qabel ma beda l-lezzjoni l-ġdida.
formal.en: The teacher erased the writing from the board before starting the new lesson.
formal.zh: 老师开始新一课之前，擦掉了黑板上的字。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min maħħa n-numru minn fuq il-bord? Pawlu: Jien, imma ktibtu fuq karta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who erased the number from the board? Pawlu: I did, but I wrote it on a piece of paper.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把黑板上的号码擦掉了？保罗：是我，不过我把它写在一张纸上了。

messages.speaker: Lara (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Min maħħa n-numru minn fuq il-bord?
messages.mt_standard: Min maħħa n-numru minn fuq il-bord?
messages.zh: 谁把黑板上的号码擦掉了？
messages.en: Who erased the number from the board?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.zh: 是我，不过我把它写在一张纸上了。
messages.en: I did, but I wrote it on a piece of paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħħa 配上橡皮擦的画面：字迹被擦掉、安排被取消、记录被删除，都可围绕“移除”来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To think deeply or repeatedly about something, sometimes with worry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深入或反复思考某事，有时带着忧虑，久久不能释怀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħseb fit-tul jew ħafna drabi fuq xi ħaġa, kultant bi tħassib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复思量；在心里一再琢磨。
仔细考虑某事；反复权衡。
担忧；为某事忧心。
深入思考；深思。

sense_translations.en_definition: to brood, to think and worry about something
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事反复思虑并感到忧心；耿耿于怀。

collocations.zh: 忧心忡忡地想了一整夜

formal.mt: Qabel ta t-tweġiba tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur maħħaħ fit-tul fuq il-problema.
formal.en: Before giving his answer, the researcher thought deeply about the problem for a long time.
formal.zh: 研究人员给出答复之前，对这个问题进行了长时间的深入思考。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek taħseb fuq dik id-deċiżjoni? Mark: Iva, ilbieraħ maħħaħt fuqha l-lejla kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still thinking about that decision? Mark: Yes, yesterday I mulled it over all evening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在考虑那个决定吗？马克：是啊，昨天我反复想了一整晚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在考虑那个决定吗？
messages.en: Are you still thinking about that decision?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilbieraħ maħħaħt fuqha l-lejla kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilbieraħ maħħaħt fuqha l-lejla kollha.
messages.zh: 是啊，昨天我反复想了一整晚。
messages.en: Yes, yesterday I mulled it over all evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 maħħaħ 时想象一个人托着下巴，把同一个问题想了一遍又一遍；既可能是深思，也可能越想越担心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room, building, or other place used to store goods, supplies, or equipment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放货物、物资或设备的房间、建筑或其他场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra, bini jew post ieħor fejn jinżammu oġġetti, provvisti jew tagħmir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一处储存场所；存放物品的地方。
一座仓库；用于存放货物的建筑。
仓库；储藏处；储存。

formal.mt: Il-kaxxi għandhom jinżammu fil-maħżen sakemm jasal it-trasport.
formal.en: The boxes should be kept in the warehouse until transport arrives.
formal.zh: 这些箱子应存放在仓库里，直到运输车辆到达。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn poġġejt il-kaxxa tal-għodda? Luqa: Fil-maħżen, fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you put the toolbox? Luqa: In the storeroom, on the shelf next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你把工具箱放在哪里了？卢卡：在储藏室里，门旁边的架子上。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你把工具箱放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the toolbox?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.zh: 在储藏室里，门旁边的架子上。
messages.en: In the storeroom, on the shelf next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到 maħżen，就想象一排货架和贴好标签的箱子：小到储藏室，大到货物仓库，重点都是“存放物品的地方”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Far away or remote in location; also emotionally distant or estranged from other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示地点相距很远或位置偏僻；也可表示人与人之间感情疏远。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab 'il bogħod jew f'post remot; jista' jiddeskrivi wkoll lil min hu mifrud minn oħrajn fil-ħajja jew fis-sentimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遥远的；偏远的。
远的；相距很远的。
远的；遥远的；距离很远的；偏远的。
感到疏离的；与他人关系疏远的。

collocations.en: a place far from the city

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi raħal mbiegħed fejn it-trasport pubbliku huwa limitat.
formal.en: The report describes a remote village where public transport is limited.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一个公共交通有限的偏远村庄。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn joqgħod ħuk issa? Mark: F'raħal mbiegħed, imma nitkellmu kuljum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where does your brother live now? Mark: In a remote village, but we talk every day.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你哥哥现在住在哪里？Mark：住在一个偏远的村庄，不过我们每天都聊天。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥现在住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your brother live now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 住在一个偏远的村庄，不过我们每天都聊天。
messages.en: In a remote village, but we talk every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图记 mbiegħed：一张是地图上远处的村庄，一张是关系疏远的两个人，把空间距离与感情距离联系起来。

gloss_zh: 说不出话的；惊得哑口无言的

teaching_sense.en_definition: The past participle of bikkem, used to describe someone unable to speak or left speechless by an event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: bikkem 的过去分词形式，用来描述无法说话，或因某件事而一时说不出话的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partiċipju passat ta' bikkem, li jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li ma jistax jitkellem jew li jibqa' bla kliem minħabba xi ġrajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊得目瞪口呆、说不出话的。
动词 bikkem 的过去分词。

sense_translations.en_definition: mute, dumb (unable to speak by disability)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因残障而无法说话的。

sense_translations.en_definition: speechless, dumbfounded (unable to find words due to some occurrence)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某件事而一时说不出话的；惊得哑口无言的。

formal.mt: Meta tħabbar ir-riżultat, ir-rebbieħ baqa' mbikkem għal ftit sekondi qabel irringrazzja lill-ġurija.
formal.en: When the result was announced, the winner was speechless for a few seconds before thanking the jury.
formal.zh: 结果公布后，获奖者一时说不出话，过了几秒才向评审致谢。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma għedt xejn meta rajt ir-rigal? Pawlu: Bqajt mbikkem bis-sorpriża! Ma kontx qed nistenna rigal bħal dak.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why didn't you say anything when you saw the present? Pawlu: I was speechless with surprise! I wasn't expecting a present like that.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看到礼物时怎么一句话也没说？Pawlu：我惊讶得说不出话！我没想到会收到那样的礼物。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma għedt xejn meta rajt ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma għedt xejn meta rajt ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 你看到礼物时怎么一句话也没说？
messages.en: Why didn't you say anything when you saw the present?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bqajt mbikkem bis-sorpriża! Ma kontx qed nistenna rigal bħal dak.
messages.mt_standard: Bqajt mbikkem bis-sorpriża! Ma kontx qed nistenna rigal bħal dak.
messages.zh: 我惊讶得说不出话！我没想到会收到那样的礼物。
messages.en: I was speechless with surprise! I wasn't expecting a present like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开意外礼物后张口却说不出话的表情，用整个短语 baqa' mbikkem 记住“愣得无言”的状态。

gloss_zh: 疯狂的；不稳定的；疯癫的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mad, unstable, or crazy, describing a person or behaviour that seems erratic or irrational.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或行为显得疯狂、不稳定、反复无常或不合常理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher miġnun, instabbli jew mhux raġonevoli fil-ħsieb jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疯狂的；疯癫的。
不稳定的；情绪或行为反复无常的。
疯狂的；不合常理的。

collocations.zh: 疯疯癫癫或反复无常的人
疯狂或反复无常的行为

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-kittieb jiddeskrivi l-aġir mderwex tal-karattru prinċipali, li jbiddel il-pjanijiet tiegħu bla raġuni ċara.
formal.en: In the novel, the writer describes the main character's erratic behaviour as he changes his plans for no clear reason.
formal.zh: 小说中，作者描写了主人公反复无常的行为：他总是没有明确理由就改变计划。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-karattru fil-film jidher mderwex! Ben: Iva, kull darba jagħmel xi ħaġa li ma tistennihiex.
colloquial.en: Lara: That character in the film seems crazy! Ben: Yes, he keeps doing things you don't expect.
colloquial.zh: Lara：电影里那个角色看起来疯疯癫癫的！Ben：是啊，他总会做出让人意想不到的事。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里那个角色看起来疯疯癫癫的！
messages.en: That character in the film seems crazy!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull darba jagħmel xi ħaġa li ma tistennihiex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull darba jagħmel xi ħaġa li ma tistennihiex.
messages.zh: 是啊，他总会做出让人意想不到的事。
messages.en: Yes, he keeps doing things you don't expect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mderwex 放进电影角色的场景：人物忽然改变计划、举止难以预测，用这种反复无常的画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 放下；铺开；把手等放到表面上

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lay something down, spread it over a surface, or place something such as one's hand on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物放下或铺在一个表面上，也可指把手等放到某个表面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed xi ħaġa fuq wiċċ, jifrex xi ħaġa fuqu, jew ipoġġi idu fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放下；使某物平放。
铺在表面上；在一个表面上铺开。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lay (something on a surface, especially one's hand)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物放在表面上，尤指把手放上去。

collocations.en: he laid his hand on the table
he spread a cloth on the ground

formal.mt: Qabel poġġa l-oġġetti għall-wiri, l-organizzatur medd drapp abjad fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: Before placing the objects on display, the organiser spread a white cloth over the table.
formal.zh: 摆放展品之前，组织者在桌上铺了一块白布。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min medd dan id-drapp fuq l-art? Pietru: Jien, biex ikollna fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who spread this cloth on the ground? Pietru: I did, so we'd have somewhere to sit.
colloquial.zh: Anna：谁把这块布铺在地上的？Pietru：我铺的，这样我们就有地方坐了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min medd dan id-drapp fuq l-art?
messages.mt_standard: Min medd dan id-drapp fuq l-art?
messages.zh: 谁把这块布铺在地上的？
messages.en: Who spread this cloth on the ground?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, biex ikollna fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, biex ikollna fejn noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 我铺的，这样我们就有地方坐了。
messages.en: I did, so we'd have somewhere to sit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作记 medd：先把手平放桌面，再把布铺开；共同画面都是让东西落在一个表面上。

gloss_zh: 一段；一片；时间或空间的跨度

teaching_sense.en_definition: A length or stretch of time or space, considered as one continuous extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一段连续的时间或空间，可指一段时期、一段距离或一片延伸的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tul jew firxa kontinwa ta' żmien jew ta' spazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长度；延伸的一段。
连续的一段；延伸的一片区域。

sense_translations.en_definition: a length, stretch (of time or space)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 时间或空间的一段；一段时期或一段延伸范围。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-bidliet fil-popolazzjoni fuq medda ta' għaxar snin.
formal.en: The study analyses changes in the population over a span of ten years.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了十年间的人口变化。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dik il-medda ta' art hija kollha tagħkom? Ġużeppi: Le, tagħna hija biss il-parti ħdejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is that whole stretch of land yours? Ġużeppi: No, only the part beside the house is ours.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那一整片地都是你们的吗？Ġużeppi：不是，只有房子旁边那部分是我们的。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik il-medda ta' art hija kollha tagħkom?
messages.mt_standard: Dik il-medda ta' art hija kollha tagħkom?
messages.zh: 那一整片地都是你们的吗？
messages.en: Is that whole stretch of land yours?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (土地所有者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tagħna hija biss il-parti ħdejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tagħna hija biss il-parti ħdejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 不是，只有房子旁边那部分是我们的。
messages.en: No, only the part beside the house is ours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 medda 想成用笔框出的一整段：时间轴上框出一段时间，地图上框出一片土地，分别练习两个常用搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Medicine: a substance used to treat or prevent illness, or the field concerned with health and the treatment of illness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 药或药物，指用于治疗或预防疾病的物质；也可指研究健康与疾病治疗的医学。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex tikkura jew tipprevjeni l-mard; ukoll il-qasam tal-istudju tas-saħħa u tal-kura tal-mard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 药；药物；医学。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent talab lill-ispiżjar jispjegalu l-istruzzjonijiet miktuba fuq il-kaxxa tal-mediċina.
formal.en: The patient asked the pharmacist to explain the instructions written on the medicine box.
formal.zh: 患者请药剂师解释药盒上写的用药说明。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn poġġejt il-mediċina? David: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda, għadha fil-kaxxa tagħha.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where did you put the medicine? David: In the drawer beside the bed; it's still in its box.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你把药放在哪里了？David：床边的抽屉里，还在原来的药盒中。

messages.speaker: Elena (妻子)
messages.zh: 你把药放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the medicine?

messages.speaker: David (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda, għadha fil-kaxxa tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda, għadha fil-kaxxa tagħha.
messages.zh: 床边的抽屉里，还在原来的药盒中。
messages.en: In the drawer beside the bed; it's still in its box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mediċina 与英语 medicine 对照记忆，再配上药盒和医学生两幅图，分别记住“药物”和“医学”两种用法。

gloss_zh: 在地上打滚；在地板上滚动

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of rolling one's body on the ground or floor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体在地面或地板上翻滚的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitgerbeb b'ġismu mal-art.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of rolling on the ground
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在地上打滚这一动作。
在地板上翻滚；一次在地板上的打滚。

collocations.en: to have a roll on the ground

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja, il-kelb għamel megħka fuq il-ħaxix qabel reġa' daħal id-dar.
formal.en: After the walk, the dog had a roll on the grass before going back into the house.
formal.zh: 散步后，狗在草地上打了个滚，然后回到屋里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kelb kollu trab? Toni: Għamel megħka mal-art fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the dog covered in dust? Toni: He had a roll on the ground in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：狗怎么浑身都是灰？托尼：它刚在花园的地上打了个滚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗怎么浑身都是灰？
messages.en: Why is the dog covered in dust?

messages.speaker: Toni (狗主人)
messages.zh: 它刚在花园的地上打了个滚。
messages.en: He had a roll on the ground in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把小狗在草地上翻身打滚的画面与 megħka 绑定，记住它表示打滚的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mortar used in construction to bind bricks or stones together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑中用于黏合砖块或石块的砂浆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita li tintuża fil-bini biex tgħaqqad il-briks jew il-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑用砂浆，用于黏合砖石。
研钵，用于配合杵捣碎或研磨材料的容器。

formal.mt: Il-bennej ħejja l-mehrież biex jgħaqqad il-ġebel tal-ħajt.
formal.en: The builder prepared the mortar to bind the stones of the wall together.
formal.zh: 建筑工人准备好砂浆，用来黏合墙体的石块。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se tfarrak dawn iż-żrieragħ? Pawlu: Bil-mehrież u l-lida; hekk nista' nfarrakhom ftit ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are you going to crush these seeds? Pawlu: With the mortar and pestle; that way I can crush them a little at a time.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你打算怎么把这些种子捣碎？保罗：用研钵和杵，这样可以一点点捣碎。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算怎么把这些种子捣碎？
messages.en: How are you going to crush these seeds?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (做饭的人)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-mehrież u l-lida; hekk nista' nfarrakhom ftit ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-mehrież u l-lida; hekk nista' nfarrakhom ftit ftit.
messages.zh: 用研钵和杵，这样可以一点点捣碎。
messages.en: With the mortar and pestle; that way I can crush them a little at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅场景记 mehrież：工地上的砂浆，以及厨房里配杵使用的研钵；靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move or hold something at an angle instead of keeping it upright or level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物偏离直立或水平的位置，呈一定角度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċċaqlaq jew żomm xi ħaġa f'pożizzjoni inklinata minflok dritta jew ċatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使倾斜；使朝某个方向偏转。
使倾侧；使容器倾斜以倒出内容物。
使成斜角；使斜向一边。
使倾斜；使倾侧。

formal.mt: Mejjel il-kontenitur bil-mod biex tferra' l-ilma mingħajr ma xxerrdu.
formal.en: Tilt the container slowly to pour the water without spilling it.
formal.zh: 慢慢倾斜容器，把水倒出来，避免洒出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ir-ritratt se joħroġ aħjar hekk? Mark: Iva, mejjel rasek ftit lejn ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will the photo look better like this? Mark: Yes, tilt your head a little to the left.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这样拍出来会更好吗？马克：会，把头稍微向左歪一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (被拍照的朋友)

messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mejjel rasek ftit lejn ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mejjel rasek ftit lejn ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 会，把头稍微向左歪一点。
messages.en: Yes, tilt your head a little to the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 mejjel 时想象把直立的瓶子慢慢斜过来倒水，用倾斜这个动作记住动词。

gloss_zh: 死的；已故的；麻木的；冷淡的；乏味的；渴望的

teaching_sense.en_definition: No longer alive; also used figuratively for a lack of feeling, interest, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经死亡的；也可比喻缺乏感觉、兴趣或活力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li m'għadux ħaj; jintuża wkoll b'mod figurattiv għal nuqqas ta' sensazzjoni, interess jew ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 死的；没有生命的。
已故的；去世的，常用于较正式地提及亡者。
冷淡的；对事情缺乏兴趣或反应的。
麻木的；失去知觉或无法活动的。
沉闷的；乏味的；缺乏生气的。
十分渴望的；急切想要做某事的。

formal.mt: L-għasfur instab mejjet ħdejn it-tieqa tal-bini.
formal.en: The bird was found dead beside the building's window.
formal.zh: 人们在建筑物的窗边发现了那只死鸟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek trid tara dak il-film? Toni: Iva, jien mejjet biex narah! Immorru llejla?
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you still want to see that film? Toni: Yes, I'm dying to see it! Shall we go tonight?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你还想看那部电影吗？托尼：想啊，我太想看了！我们今晚去好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还想看那部电影吗？
messages.en: Do you still want to see that film?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien mejjet biex narah! Immorru llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien mejjet biex narah! Immorru llejla?
messages.zh: 想啊，我太想看了！我们今晚去好吗？
messages.en: Yes, I'm dying to see it! Shall we go tonight?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用死鸟记住 mejjet 的基本义，再用中文“想得要命”联想它表示强烈渴望的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A basin or trough used to hold water or to wash things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛水或清洗物品的水槽或槽形容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħawt li jintuża biex iżomm l-ilma jew biex jinħaslu fih l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水槽；用于清洗物品的洗涤槽。
水槽；用于盛水或洗涤的槽形容器。

collocations.en: to wash clothes in the trough

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema naddfu l-mejjilla u mlewha b'ilma nadif għall-ħasil.
formal.en: The workers cleaned the trough and filled it with clean water for washing.
formal.zh: 工人们清理了洗涤槽，并注入干净的水供清洗使用。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn nista' naħsel dawn iċ-ċraret? Marija: Fil-mejjilla tal-bitħa. Hemm ilma nadif fiha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where can I wash these cloths? Marija: In the trough in the yard. There's clean water in it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这些抹布可以在哪里洗？玛丽娅：在院子里的洗涤槽洗，里面有干净的水。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 这些抹布可以在哪里洗？
messages.en: Where can I wash these cloths?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-mejjilla tal-bitħa. Hemm ilma nadif fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-mejjilla tal-bitħa. Hemm ilma nadif fiha.
messages.zh: 在院子里的洗涤槽洗，里面有干净的水。
messages.en: In the trough in the yard. There's clean water in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象院子里一个装水洗抹布的长槽，把 mejjilla 与盛水、洗涤的具体场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: May, the fifth month of the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 五月，一年中的第五个月。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħames xahar tas-sena, bejn April u Ġunju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五月，作为月份名称使用。
五月；一年中的第五个月。

formal.mt: Il-kors jibda fil-ħamsa ta' Mejju u jintemm fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The course begins on the fifth of May and ends at the end of the month.
formal.zh: 课程于五月五日开始，并在当月底结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se tiġi żżurna? David: F'Mejju, aktarx fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you coming to visit us? David: In May, probably at the end of the month.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你什么时候来看我们？戴维：五月，大概在月底。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候来看我们？
messages.en: When are you coming to visit us?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 五月，大概在月底。
messages.en: In May, probably at the end of the month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历第五格写下 Mejju，再连读 f'Mejju“在五月”，把月份名称和常用表达一起记。

gloss_zh: 磨利；磨砺；磨刀皮带或油石；姓氏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a blade or cutting edge sharper by rubbing it against a sharpening surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将刀刃在磨具表面摩擦，使其变得更锋利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Agħmel xafra aktar taqta' billi togħrokha ma' wiċċ adattat għas-sann.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨利；使刀刃变锋利。
磨刀；通过摩擦磨具使刃口锋利。
细磨刀刃；磨砺刃口。
磨剃刀用的皮带；磨刀用的油石。
磨砺；磨刀；使刃口变锋利。
一个姓氏，写作 Mejlaq。

formal.mt: Qabel tibda tqatta' l-injam, mejlaq ix-xafra tal-għodda biex tkun taqta' sew.
formal.en: Before you start cutting the wood, sharpen the tool's blade so that it cuts well.
formal.zh: 开始切削木材前，先磨利工具的刀刃，使其能够顺利切削。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew. Pawlu: Mejlaq is-sikkina l-ewwel, imbagħad erġa' pprova.
colloquial.en: Lina: This knife doesn't cut well. Pawlu: Sharpen the knife first, then try again.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这把刀不太好切。保罗：先把刀磨利，再试一次。

messages.speaker: Lina (做饭的人)
messages.zh: 这把刀不太好切。
messages.en: This knife doesn't cut well.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Mejlaq is-sikkina l-ewwel, imbagħad erġa' pprova.
messages.mt_standard: Mejlaq is-sikkina l-ewwel, imbagħad erġa' pprova.
messages.zh: 先把刀磨利，再试一次。
messages.en: Sharpen the knife first, then try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用刀刃在磨具上来回摩擦的画面记动词 mejlaq；名词指磨具，姓氏 Mejlaq 则单独记认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of dizziness or spinning that can make it difficult to keep one's balance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头昏或感觉周围旋转、可能难以保持平衡的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' sturdament jew li kollox qed idur, li tista' tagħmilha diffiċli biex wieħed iżomm il-bilanċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头晕；头昏、站立不稳的感觉。
眩晕；感觉自己或周围环境在旋转。
伙伴；朋友。

formal.mt: Waqt il-mixja, ir-raġel waqaf u qagħad bilqiegħda għax qabdu l-mejt.
formal.en: During the walk, the man stopped and sat down because he became dizzy.
formal.zh: 散步时，那名男子感到头晕，于是停下来坐下。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qgħadt bilqiegħda? Mark: Qabadni l-mejt meta qomt. Se nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you sit down? Mark: I felt dizzy when I stood up. I'm going to rest for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你怎么坐下了？马克：我站起来时有点头晕，想休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么坐下了？
messages.en: Why did you sit down?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabadni l-mejt meta qomt. Se nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Qabadni l-mejt meta qomt. Se nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 我站起来时有点头晕，想休息一会儿。
messages.en: I felt dizzy when I stood up. I'm going to rest for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mejt 的头晕义放进“站起后坐下休息”的画面；伙伴义另联想英语 mate，作为记忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to machines, their parts, or the way they work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与机器、机器零件或其运作方式有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-magni, mal-partijiet tagħhom jew mal-mod kif jaħdmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机械的；与机器或机械运作有关的。

formal.mt: L-apparat waqaf jaħdem minħabba ħsara mekkanika.
formal.en: The equipment stopped working because of a mechanical fault.
formal.zh: 设备因机械故障而停止运作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqfet il-magna? Mark: Għandha difett mekkaniku; it-tekniku se jiċċekkjaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the machine stop? Mark: It has a mechanical defect; the technician will check it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：机器为什么停了？马克：有机械故障，技术人员会来检查。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 机器为什么停了？
messages.en: Why did the machine stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha difett mekkaniku; it-tekniku se jiċċekkjaha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha difett mekkaniku; it-tekniku se jiċċekkjaha.
messages.zh: 有机械故障，技术人员会来检查。
messages.en: It has a mechanical defect; the technician will check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词放在机器旁边记：apparat mekkaniku 是机械设备；搭配 ħsara 时记成 ħsara mekkanika，连同词尾变化一起练习。

gloss_zh: 来回走动；拖着步子闲走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk back and forth or wander about, sometimes with slow, dragging steps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来回走动或四处闲走，有时步履缓慢、拖着脚步。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi 'l hemm u 'l hawn jew idur bla direzzjoni ċara, xi drabi b'passi mkaxkra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来回走动。
拖着脚步四处走动；步履蹒跚地闲走。

sense_translations.en_definition: to wander about, to go back and forth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 四处闲逛；来回走动。

collocations.zh: 拖着步子在房间里走来走去

formal.mt: Ir-raġel mekkek fil-kuritur waqt li kien qed jistenna l-aħbar.
formal.en: The man walked back and forth in the corridor while waiting for the news.
formal.zh: 那名男子等消息时，在走廊里来回走动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu waqt li stenna? Mark: Mekkek 'l hemm u 'l hawn ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do while he waited? Mark: He walked back and forth near the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗等候时做了什么？马克：他在门边走来走去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗等候时做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do while he waited?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mekkek 'l hemm u 'l hawn ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Mekkek 'l hemm u 'l hawn ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 他在门边走来走去。
messages.en: He walked back and forth near the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人在门边等消息，脚步来来回回：用 mekkek 配合 'l hemm u 'l hawn 记住动作，也可联想拖着步子闲走的样子。

gloss_zh: 装满；塞满；另有“当然、所以、好吧”等义

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something into a container or space until it is full, or to stuff something with a filling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西放进容器或空间直到装满，或用填充物把某物塞满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal xi ħaġa f'reċipjent jew fi spazju sakemm sar mimli, jew daħħal mili ġo xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装满；使充满。
塞满；填入馅料或其他填充物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become cloudy (used of the weather)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 天气转阴；天空布满云。
当然；肯定地。
因此；所以；于是。
那么；好吧；好的，用于承接话题或表示同意。
装满；填满；塞满。
水位上涨；水涌满或泛滥。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem mela l-kontenitur bl-ilma qabel beda t-tindif.
formal.en: The worker filled the container with water before starting the cleaning.
formal.zh: 工人在开始清洁前，把容器装满了水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min mela l-buqar bl-ilma? Mark: Pawlu mela l-buqar; tista' tferra' ftit fit-tazzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who filled the jug with water? Mark: Pawlu filled the jug; you can pour some into the glasses.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把水壶装满了水？马克：保罗装的，你可以往杯子里倒一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把水壶装满了水？
messages.en: Who filled the jug with water?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu mela l-buqar; tista' tferra' ftit fit-tazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu mela l-buqar; tista' tferra' ftit fit-tazzi.

messages.en: Pawlu filled the jug; you can pour some into the glasses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“把杯子装满”的画面记动词 mela；再把对话中的“当然、所以、好吧”分开做卡片，遇到这个词时先看句中作用再选义。

gloss_zh: 厌恶；不喜欢；作名词时指枯病

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dislike something or find it repugnant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不喜欢某事物，或觉得它令人反感、厌恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass stmerrija jew nuqqas ta' simpatija lejn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 觉得令人厌恶；对某事物感到强烈反感。
不喜欢；厌恶。
憎恶；厌恶；不喜欢。
枯病；使植物枯萎、受损的病害。

formal.mt: Il-protagonist mell il-qerq u għażel li jgħid il-verità.
formal.en: The protagonist abhorred deceit and chose to tell the truth.
formal.zh: 主人公厌恶欺骗，选择说出真相。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq Pawlu? Mark: Mell il-gideb u ma riedx jibqa' hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave? Mark: He found the lying repugnant and did not want to stay there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么走了？马克：他厌恶那些谎话，不愿再待在那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mell il-gideb u ma riedx jibqa' hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Mell il-gideb u ma riedx jibqa' hemm.
messages.zh: 他厌恶那些谎话，不愿再待在那里。
messages.en: He found the lying repugnant and did not want to stay there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听到谎话便皱眉”的画面记 mell 的动词义；另画一株枯萎的植物记名词义，并在两张卡片上分别标明动词和名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of disgust or disdain towards someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事物产生的厌恶、嫌弃或鄙视之情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' stmerrija jew disprezz lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厌恶；嫌恶；反感。
鄙视；轻蔑；不屑。

formal.mt: L-awtur esprima mella lejn l-imġiba krudili tal-karattru.
formal.en: The author expressed disgust at the character's cruel behaviour.
formal.zh: 作者对该人物的残忍行为表达了厌恶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħassejtek meta smajt dak il-kliem? Mark: Ħassejt mella; kien kliem krudili ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you feel when you heard those words? Mark: I felt disgust; those words were very cruel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：听到那些话时，你有什么感受？马克：我感到厌恶，那些话太残忍了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassejtek meta smajt dak il-kliem?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassejtek meta smajt dak il-kliem?
messages.zh: 听到那些话时，你有什么感受？
messages.en: How did you feel when you heard those words?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt mella; kien kliem krudili ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt mella; kien kliem krudili ħafna.
messages.zh: 我感到厌恶，那些话太残忍了。
messages.en: I felt disgust; those words were very cruel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mella 写在一张“情绪名词”卡上，旁边画皱眉和不屑的表情；练习 ħass mella“感到厌恶”，同时看清它比 mela 多一个 l。

gloss_zh: 加盐；用盐腌制；另有伤害、毁坏义

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add salt to food for seasoning or to preserve food in salt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给食物加盐调味，或用盐腌制食物以便保存。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żied il-melħ mal-ikel biex jagħtih it-togħma jew biex jippreservah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加盐。
用盐调味。
用盐腌制保存。
给某物加盐；用盐处理。
伤害；使受伤。
毁坏；毁掉。

formal.mt: Il-kok mellaħ il-ħut qabel poġġieh fil-forn.
formal.en: The cook salted the fish before putting it in the oven.
formal.zh: 厨师给鱼加盐后，把它放进了烤箱。

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁给汤加了盐？马克：保罗加的，不过他只放了一点盐。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)

messages.mt_standard: Pawlu mellaħha, imma żied biss ftit melħ.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手拿盐罐给汤调味，配着动作说 mellaħ is-soppa；再用盐腌鱼的画面记保存义，伤害和毁坏义则另列例义卡，不强行串成词源。

gloss_zh: 爱抚；宠爱；为求好处而奉承

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温柔而亲昵地抚摸某人或某物，或以纵容、宠爱的方式对待某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadda idu bil-ħlewwa fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew tratta lil xi ħadd b'ħafna għożża u indulġenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抚；温柔地抚摸。
宠爱；娇惯；悉心优待。

sense_translations.en_definition: to flater in order to gain favours
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了获得好处或关照而奉承、讨好。

sense_translations.en_definition: to flatter in order to gain favours
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为求好处而恭维；为了获得优待而讨好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
