cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个小画面记 melles：轻抚猫背、过分宠爱孩子、为求关照而恭维上司；分别贴上“爱抚、娇惯、奉承”，靠语境选择意思。

gloss_zh: 盐田；Mellieħa 也作马耳他地名

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shallow basin or area where salt water is left to evaporate so that salt can be collected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让盐水蒸发以收集盐的浅池或场地，即盐田。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadira baxxa jew post fejn jitħalla jevapora l-ilma mielaħ biex jinġabar il-melħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盐田；供盐水蒸发、结晶并收集盐的浅池。

sense_translations.en_definition: Mellieħa (a village and local council of the Northern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: Mellieħa：马耳他北部大区的一座村镇及其地方议会名称。

formal.mt: Il-melħ jinġabar mill-mellieħa wara li jevapora l-ilma.
formal.en: Salt is collected from the salt pan after the water evaporates.
formal.zh: 水蒸发后，人们从盐田中收集盐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik l-għadira baxxa? Mark: Dik mellieħa; l-ilma jevapora u jibqa' l-melħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that shallow pool? Mark: That is a salt pan; the water evaporates and the salt remains.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个浅池是什么？马克：那是盐田，水蒸发后就留下盐。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 那个浅池是什么？
messages.en: What is that shallow pool?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik mellieħa; l-ilma jevapora u jibqa' l-melħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dik mellieħa; l-ilma jevapora u jibqa' l-melħ.
messages.zh: 那是盐田，水蒸发后就留下盐。
messages.en: That is a salt pan; the water evaporates and the salt remains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个浅池，水逐渐蒸发后留下白盐，把 mellieħa 写在池边；另把大写 Mellieħa 放在地名卡上，帮助区分普通名词和专名。

gloss_zh: 产盐的；咸的、盐渍的；梅利哈的；梅利哈男性居民

teaching_sense.en_definition: Yielding salt or having a salty quality; also describing something of, from, or relating to Mellieħa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容产盐、带咸味或具有盐渍性质的事物；也可表示来自梅利哈或与梅利哈有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti l-melħ jew għandu kwalità mielħa; ukoll li hu minn Mellieħa jew għandu x'jaqsam magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产盐的；能够产生盐的。
咸的；具有加盐、盐渍作用的。

sense_translations.en_definition: of, from or relating to Mellieħa
sense_translations.zh_definition: 梅利哈的；来自梅利哈或与梅利哈有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: native or inhabitant of Mellieħa (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 梅利哈本地人或居民，通常指男性。

collocations.en: a male native or inhabitant of Mellieħa who lives here
collocations.zh: 住在这里的梅利哈男性本地人或居民

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ilma tal-bir bħala mellieħi.
formal.en: The report describes the well water as salty.
formal.zh: 报告将这口井的水描述为咸水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-raġel minn fejn hu? Mark: Hu Mellieħi, minn Mellieħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is this man from? Mark: He is from Mellieħa, a Mellieħa local.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这位男子是哪里人？马克：他是梅利哈人，来自梅利哈。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这位男子是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is this man from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是梅利哈人，来自梅利哈。
messages.en: He is from Mellieħa, a Mellieħa local.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张场景卡分开记：一张写咸水，一张写梅利哈居民；看到上下文先判断是在说盐还是在说籍贯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sequence of musical notes heard as a recognizable tune.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由一连串音符组成、能够辨认或哼唱的旋律、曲调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' noti mużikali li flimkien jiffurmaw għanja li tista' tagħraf jew tkanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋律；由连续音符构成的曲调。

formal.mt: Il-melodija tal-kanzunetta hija sempliċi u faċli biex tiftakarha.
formal.en: The melody of the song is simple and easy to remember.
formal.zh: 这首歌的旋律简单，容易记住。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tiftakar il-kliem tal-kanzunetta? Pawlu: Le, imma niftakar il-melodija. Nista' nkantahielek bla kliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you remember the words of the song? Pawlu: No, but I remember the melody. I can sing it to you without words.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你记得这首歌的歌词吗？保罗：不记得，但我记得旋律。我可以不带歌词唱给你听。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你记得这首歌的歌词吗？
messages.en: Do you remember the words of the song?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma niftakar il-melodija. Nista' nkantahielek bla kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma niftakar il-melodija. Nista' nkantahielek bla kliem.
messages.zh: 不记得，但我记得旋律。我可以不带歌词唱给你听。
messages.en: No, but I remember the melody. I can sing it to you without words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象忘了歌词却还能哼出曲调的情景，把耳边那条音符线与 melodija 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to melody or having a clear, tuneful musical quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与旋律有关的，或具有清晰、悦耳的旋律特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-melodija jew għandu melodija ċara u sabiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋律的；具有旋律性的；曲调悦耳的。

formal.mt: Il-kompożitur juża stil melodiku li jagħmel it-tema faċli biex tiftakarha.
formal.en: The composer uses a melodic style that makes the theme easy to remember.
formal.zh: 作曲家采用富有旋律性的风格，使主题容易记住。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbok dan il-bran? Ben: Iva, għandu stil melodiku sabiħ. Diġà qed inkanta parti minnu!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you like this piece? Ben: Yes, it has a lovely melodic style. I am already singing part of it!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你喜欢这首曲子吗？本：喜欢，它的旋律风格很优美。我已经在唱其中一段了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这首曲子吗？
messages.en: Did you like this piece?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu stil melodiku sabiħ. Diġà qed inkanta parti minnu!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu stil melodiku sabiħ. Diġà qed inkanta parti minnu!
messages.zh: 喜欢，它的旋律风格很优美。我已经在唱其中一段了！
messages.en: Yes, it has a lovely melodic style. I am already singing part of it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 melodija 当作一段旋律，把 melodiku 当作贴在音乐上的形容标签，练习用它描述曲子的旋律特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability to retain and recall information or experiences; also the storage used by a computer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保存并回想信息或经历的能力，即记忆、记忆力；也指计算机用于保存信息的存储器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li żżomm u tiftakar tagħrif jew esperjenzi; ukoll il-parti tal-kompjuter li taħżen it-tagħrif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记忆；记忆力；也可指计算机的存储器或内存。

formal.mt: Ir-ripetizzjoni regolari tgħin lill-istudent isaħħaħ il-memorja tiegħu.
formal.en: Regular repetition helps the student strengthen their memory.
formal.zh: 定期重复有助于学生增强记忆力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ftakart l-ismijiet kollha? Adam: Għandi memorja tajba għall-ismijiet, imma d-dati ninsiehom malajr.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you remember all the names? Adam: I have a good memory for names, but I forget dates quickly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么记住了所有人的名字？亚当：我记名字很在行，但日期很快就忘了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你怎么记住了所有人的名字？
messages.en: How did you remember all the names?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi memorja tajba għall-ismijiet, imma d-dati ninsiehom malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi memorja tajba għall-ismijiet, imma d-dati ninsiehom malajr.
messages.zh: 我记名字很在行，但日期很快就忘了。
messages.en: I have a good memory for names, but I forget dates quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脑中有个保存名字的小抽屉，再联想到电脑保存信息的内存，用同一个 memorja 串起两种场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of banning something, or a rule that forbids an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 禁止某事的行为，或不允许某种行为的规定、禁令。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tipprojbixxi xi ħaġa, jew regola li ma tħallix li ssir azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止、取缔的行为。
禁令；明确不允许某事的规定。

formal.mt: L-avviż jistabbilixxi mengħa fuq id-dħul mingħajr permess.
formal.en: The notice establishes a prohibition on entry without permission.
formal.zh: 公告规定，未经许可禁止进入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'mengħa' fuq dan l-avviż? Toni: Tfisser projbizzjoni. Hawn hemm mengħa fuq it-tipjip.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'mengħa' mean on this notice? Toni: It means a prohibition. Smoking is prohibited here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张告示上的 mengħa 是什么意思？托尼：意思是禁止。这里禁止吸烟。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这张告示上的 mengħa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mengħa' mean on this notice?

messages.speaker: Toni (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser projbizzjoni. Hawn hemm mengħa fuq it-tipjip.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser projbizzjoni. Hawn hemm mengħa fuq it-tipjip.
messages.zh: 意思是禁止。这里禁止吸烟。
messages.en: It means a prohibition. Smoking is prohibited here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mengħa 写在红色禁止标志旁边：既可想到发布禁止的行为，也可想到已经生效的禁令。

gloss_zh: 清洗处；围起的小块土地

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place used for cleansing, or a small enclosed stretch of land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于清洗、洗涤的地方；也指一小块围起来的土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post użat għat-tindif jew għall-ħasil; ukoll biċċa art żgħira u magħluqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于清洗的一处地方；清洗点。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small, enclosed stretch of land
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小块围起来的土地。
用于清洗或洗涤的场所。

collocations.en: a small plot enclosed by a wall

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi menqgħa mdawra b'ħajt ħdejn il-ġnien.
formal.en: The plan shows a small plot enclosed by a wall beside the garden.
formal.zh: 平面图显示，花园旁有一小块由墙围起的土地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' naħsel dawn l-għodod? Pawlu: Hemm menqgħa għall-ħasil wara d-dar. Tista' tużaha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I wash these tools? Pawlu: There is a washing place behind the house. You can use it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以在哪里清洗这些工具？保罗：屋后有个洗涤处，你可以用。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里清洗这些工具？
messages.en: Where can I wash these tools?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm menqgħa għall-ħasil wara d-dar. Tista' tużaha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm menqgħa għall-ħasil wara d-dar. Tista' tużaha.
messages.zh: 屋后有个洗涤处，你可以用。
messages.en: There is a washing place behind the house. You can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两幅小图帮助记义：一幅是清洗工具的地方，一幅是围墙内的小地块；两幅都标上 menqgħa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object with a reflective surface that shows an image; figuratively, a model or example to follow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过反射表面映出影像的镜子；比喻可供学习、效仿的榜样或典范。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett b'wiċċ li jirrifletti xbieha; f'sens figurattiv, mudell jew eżempju li wieħed jista' jimxi fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镜子；能反射并映出影像的物品。
榜样；典范；可供效仿的例子。

formal.mt: L-għalliem iddeskriva lill-istudenta bħala mera ta' mġiba tajba għall-klassi kollha.
formal.en: The teacher described the student as a model of good behaviour for the whole class.
formal.zh: 老师称这名学生是全班良好行为的典范。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi xi ħaġa fuq wiċċi? Sara: Iva, ftit żebgħa. Ħares fil-mera ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is there something on my face? Sara: Yes, a little paint. Look in the mirror by the door.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我脸上有东西吗？萨拉：有，一点颜料。照一下门边的镜子。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我脸上有东西吗？
messages.en: Is there something on my face?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit żebgħa. Ħares fil-mera ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit żebgħa. Ħares fil-mera ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 有，一点颜料。照一下门边的镜子。
messages.en: Yes, a little paint. Look in the mirror by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想照镜子整理自己，再想对照榜样改进行为；用这两个学习画面连接 mera 的镜子义和典范义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Liquid from fruit or other organic material; in cooking, also the juices or gravy served with food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水果或其他有机物中的汁液；在烹饪中也指食物的汁水或佐餐肉汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidu li joħroġ mill-frott jew minn materjal organiku ieħor; fit-tisjir jista' jfisser ukoll il-likwidu jew iz-zalza tal-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汁；尤指从水果或蔬菜中取得的汁液。
肉汁；用烹调肉类时产生的汁水制成的酱汁。
液体；液态的物质。
含有有机物的汁液；不限于饮用果汁。

formal.mt: Wara li tagħsar il-larinġ, ferra' l-meraq f'kontenitur nadif u żommu fil-friġġ.
formal.en: After squeezing the oranges, pour the juice into a clean container and keep it in the refrigerator.
formal.zh: 榨好橙子后，将橙汁倒入干净的容器，放进冰箱保存。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tazza meraq tal-larinġ? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi, imma mingħajr silġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a glass of orange juice? Pawlu: Yes, thanks, but without ice.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要一杯橙汁吗？保罗：要，谢谢，不过不要冰。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要一杯橙汁吗？
messages.en: Would you like a glass of orange juice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢，不过不要冰。
messages.en: Yes, thanks, but without ice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把橙子挤出的汁和烤肉流出的汁放在同一幅图里，用“食物中的汁液”串联 meraq 的多个义项。

gloss_zh: 奇观；令人惊叹的事物；惊叹

teaching_sense.en_definition: A remarkable thing that causes wonder or admiration, or the wonder it inspires.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到惊奇或赞叹的事物，也可指由此产生的惊叹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa li tqanqal għaġeb jew ammirazzjoni, jew l-għaġeb li wieħed iħoss quddiemha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奇观；令人惊叹的事物。
奇迹般的事物；奇观；惊奇或赞叹。

formal.mt: Il-gwida tiddeskrivi l-għar bħala meravilja tan-natura minħabba l-forom mhux tas-soltu tal-blat tiegħu.
formal.en: The guide describes the cave as a wonder of nature because of its unusually shaped rock formations.
formal.zh: 指南将这座洞穴描述为自然奇观，因为其中的岩石形态独特。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt ir-ritratt tal-pont il-ġdid? Mark: Iva! Dak il-pont huwa meravilja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the photo of the new bridge? Mark: Yes! That bridge is a marvel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看过那座新桥的照片吗？马克：看过！那座桥真是个奇迹。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过那座新桥的照片吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the photo of the new bridge?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看过！那座桥真是个奇迹。
messages.en: Yes! That bridge is a marvel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在壮观洞穴前说“这真是一个奇观”，把 meravilja 记成可以指认的一件惊叹之物。

gloss_zh: 美妙的；极好的；令人赞叹的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely good, beautiful, or impressive, causing pleasure or admiration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常好、美丽或出色，能使人感到愉快或赞叹的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tajjeb, sabiħ jew impressjonanti ħafna, b'mod li jqanqal pjaċir jew ammirazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美妙的；极好的；令人愉快或赞叹的。
绝妙的；非凡的；令人惊叹的。
极好的；美妙的；令人赞叹的。

collocations.zh: 一场精彩绝伦的音乐会

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi l-ġnien bħala post meraviljuż fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu jgawdu l-kwiet u s-sbuħija tan-natura.
formal.en: The author describes the garden as a wonderful place where visitors can enjoy peace and the beauty of nature.
formal.zh: 作者将这座花园描述为一个美妙的地方，游客可以在此享受宁静与自然之美。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien il-kunċert ilbieraħ? Daniel: Kien meraviljuż! Nixtieq nerġa' nisma' lil dak il-kantant.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was the concert yesterday? Daniel: It was wonderful! I'd love to hear that singer again.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天的音乐会怎么样？丹尼尔：太精彩了！我真想再听那位歌手演唱。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的音乐会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the concert yesterday?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien meraviljuż! Nixtieq nerġa' nisma' lil dak il-kantant.
messages.mt_standard: Kien meraviljuż! Nixtieq nerġa' nisma' lil dak il-kantant.
messages.zh: 太精彩了！我真想再听那位歌手演唱。
messages.en: It was wonderful! I'd love to hear that singer again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meraviljuż 放到“地方、音乐会”等名词后练习，记住它是在夸某样东西“美妙、精彩”。

gloss_zh: 四处走动；漫游；游历各地

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk or roam about, or to travel through many different places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 四处走动、漫游，或到许多不同地方旅行、游历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li timxi minn post għal ieħor, iddur bla destinazzjoni waħda, jew tivvjaġġa f'ħafna postijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四处走动；到处走走。
漫游；没有固定目的地地走动。
远游；游历各地。
漫游；四处游荡或游走。

collocations.en: he travelled from country to country
collocations.zh: 他游历了一个又一个国家

formal.mt: Matul is-snin ta' żgħożitu, il-kittieb meraħ minn pajjiż għal ieħor u kiteb dwar in-nies li ltaqa' magħhom.
formal.en: During his youth, the writer travelled from country to country and wrote about the people he met.
formal.zh: 这位作家年轻时游历了一个又一个国家，并写下了他所遇见的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Pawlu dalgħodu? Toni: Meraħ ftit mal-kampanja. Qalli li ried jimxi bla għaġla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Pawlu go this morning? Toni: He roamed the countryside for a while. He told me he wanted to walk without rushing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天早上去哪里了？托尼：他去乡间走了一阵。他告诉我，他想不慌不忙地走走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天早上去哪里了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meraħ ftit mal-kampanja. Qalli li ried jimxi bla għaġla.
messages.mt_standard: Meraħ ftit mal-kampanja. Qalli li ried jimxi bla għaġla.
messages.zh: 他去乡间走了一阵。他告诉我，他想不慌不忙地走走。
messages.en: He roamed the countryside for a while. He told me he wanted to walk without rushing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上一串随脚步延伸的足迹：近处是四处走走，远处是游历各国，用移动范围记住 meraħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Marjoram, an aromatic herb whose leaves are used to season food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马郁兰，一种芳香草本植物，叶子可用作烹饪调味料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta aromatika li l-weraq tagħha jintuża biex jagħti togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜马郁兰，即马郁兰，一种用作调味料的芳香草本植物。
马郁兰；叶子可用于烹饪调味的香草。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob kuċċarina merdqux imnixxef, li għandu jiżdied maz-zalza waqt it-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a teaspoon of dried marjoram, which should be added to the sauce during cooking.
formal.zh: 这份食谱需要一茶匙干马郁兰，应在烹煮时加入酱汁。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandna nżidu mas-soppa? Toni: Ftit merdqux. Għandna xi weraq frisk fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should we add to the soup? Toni: A little marjoram. We have some fresh leaves in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：汤里该加点什么？托尼：一点马郁兰。厨房里有些新鲜叶子。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 汤里该加点什么？
messages.en: What should we add to the soup?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit merdqux. Għandna xi weraq frisk fil-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit merdqux. Għandna xi weraq frisk fil-kċina.
messages.zh: 一点马郁兰。厨房里有些新鲜叶子。
messages.en: A little marjoram. We have some fresh leaves in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房里一罐标着 merdqux 的香草，闻香后往汤里撒一点，把词形与马郁兰调味的动作相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grass-covered land, especially land where animals graze; a pasture or meadow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长有草的土地，尤指供牲畜吃草的牧草地，也可指草甸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Art miksija bil-ħaxix, speċjalment fejn jirgħu l-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供牲畜吃草的牧草地；放牧地。
草甸；主要覆盖着草本植物的开阔土地。
牧场；长有牧草、可供动物放牧的土地。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħalla parti mill-art bħala mergħa sabiex in-nagħaġ ikollhom fejn jirgħu.
formal.en: The farmer kept part of the land as pasture so that the sheep would have somewhere to graze.
formal.zh: 农民保留了部分土地作为牧草地，让羊群有地方吃草。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn qegħdin in-nagħaġ? Ġorġ: Fil-mergħa wara r-razzett. Hemm ħafna ħaxix hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are the sheep? Ġorġ: In the pasture behind the farm. There's plenty of grass there.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：羊群在哪里？乔治：在农场后面的牧草地里。那里有很多草。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场访客)
messages.zh: 羊群在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the sheep?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-mergħa wara r-razzett. Hemm ħafna ħaxix hemmhekk.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-mergħa wara r-razzett. Hemm ħafna ħaxix hemmhekk.
messages.zh: 在农场后面的牧草地里。那里有很多草。
messages.en: In the pasture behind the farm. There's plenty of grass there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一片绿草地，再放上几只正在吃草的羊，把 mergħa 牢牢记成放牧用的草地。

gloss_zh: 加过多液体；榨汁；使液化；使多汁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add too much liquid to something, extract its juice, turn it into liquid, or make it juicy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某物加入过多液体；也可指榨取汁液、使其液化或使其变得多汁，具体含义由语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżżid wisq likwidu ma' xi ħaġa, tagħsarha biex toħroġ il-meraq, tibdilha f'likwidu jew tagħmilha aktar mimlija bil-meraq, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加入过多液体；把食物等调得过稀。
榨汁；从水果等材料中提取汁液。
使液化；使变成液体。
使多汁；使含有更多汁水。

collocations.en: to add too much liquid to the sauce

formal.mt: Il-kok merraq iz-zalza billi żied wisq ilma, u għalhekk kellu jħalliha ttektek aktar biex teħxien.
formal.en: The cook made the sauce too watery by adding too much water, so he had to let it simmer longer to thicken.
formal.zh: 厨师加水过多，把酱汁调得太稀，因此只好再炖煮一会儿，让它变浓。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex iz-zalza hi daqshekk likwida? Karl: Għax Pawlu merraq iz-zalza b'wisq ilma. Inħalluha ttektek ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why is the sauce so runny? Karl: Because Pawlu added too much water to it. Let's let it simmer a little longer.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：酱汁怎么这么稀？卡尔：因为保罗往里面加了太多水。我们让它再炖一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (家人)
messages.zh: 酱汁怎么这么稀？
messages.en: Why is the sauce so runny?

messages.speaker: Karl (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu merraq iz-zalza b'wisq ilma. Inħalluha ttektek ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu merraq iz-zalza b'wisq ilma. Inħalluha ttektek ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为保罗往酱汁里加了太多水。我们让它再炖一会儿吧。
messages.en: Because Pawlu added too much water to the sauce. Let's let it simmer a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房里的四个动作记 merraq：加水过多、榨出果汁、变成液体、增加汁水；读句子时靠宾语和上下文选义。

gloss_zh: 爱反驳的；好唱反调的；相矛盾的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to contradict others or oppose what they say.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于反驳别人或对他人的说法唱反调的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jmeri lil ħaddieħor jew imur kontra dak li jgħid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于反驳别人或提出相反意见的。
好唱反调的；表示反驳的；彼此矛盾的。

collocations.en: a person who tends to contradict others

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, il-parteċipant kien meruż u spiss mar kontra dak li qalu l-oħrajn.
formal.en: During the discussion, the participant was inclined to contradict others and often opposed what they said.
formal.zh: 讨论中，这位参与者表现得爱唱反调，经常反对其他人的说法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tkun daqshekk meruż illum? Mark: Għandi dubju dwar il-pjan, imma se nispjegah bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you being so contrary today? Mark: I have a doubt about the plan, but I'll explain it calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天怎么这么爱唱反调？马克：我对这个计划有个疑问，不过我会平静地解释。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tkun daqshekk meruż illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tkun daqshekk meruż illum?
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么爱唱反调？
messages.en: Why are you being so contrary today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi dubju dwar il-pjan, imma se nispjegah bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi dubju dwar il-pjan, imma se nispjegah bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 我对这个计划有个疑问，不过我会平静地解释。
messages.en: I have a doubt about the plan, but I'll explain it calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讨论中总有人接一句“我不同意”，把这个爱唱反调的形象与 meruż 联系起来。

gloss_zh: 非时结果；非正常季节结出的果实

teaching_sense.en_definition: The production of fruit outside its usual season, or the fruit produced in that way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 果树在通常果期之外结果的现象，或在这种非正常季节结出的果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-produzzjoni ta' frott barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu, jew il-frott li jiġi prodott b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.en_definition: yielding of fruit out of season
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非时结果；在通常结果季节之外产出果实的现象。
非正常季节结出的果实；通常果期之外产出的果实。

collocations.zh: 树木在通常果期之外结果

collocations.en: the collection of fruit produced out of season
collocations.zh: 采收非正常季节结出的果实

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddokumenta l-merħ ta' dawn is-siġar, jiġifieri l-produzzjoni tal-frott barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu.
formal.en: The report documents these trees' out-of-season fruiting, meaning their production of fruit outside the usual season.
formal.zh: 报告记录了这些树木的非时结果现象，即它们在通常果期之外产出果实。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-frott kiber barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu? Pietru: Iva, dan hu merħ. Ġbart ftit minnu dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did this fruit grow outside the usual season? Pietru: Yes, this is out-of-season fruit. I picked some of it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这些果实是在通常果期之外长出来的吗？彼得：是的，这是非正常季节结出的果实。我今天早上摘了一些。

messages.speaker: Anna (果园访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-frott kiber barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-frott kiber barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu?
messages.zh: 这些果实是在通常果期之外长出来的吗？
messages.en: Did this fruit grow outside the usual season?

messages.speaker: Pietru (果农)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan hu merħ. Ġbart ftit minnu dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan hu merħ. Ġbart ftit minnu dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 是的，这是非正常季节结出的果实。我今天早上摘了一些。
messages.en: Yes, this is out-of-season fruit. I picked some of it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象果园的日历已翻过正常果期，枝头却又结了果；merħ 同时记这件事和结出的果实。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting or reception that shows someone is gladly received.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示乐于接待某人的问候或迎接；作感叹语时表示“欢迎！”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima jew laqgħa li turi li persuna qed tintlaqa' bil-ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢迎；表示高兴接待来人的问候或迎接。
欢迎！用于向到来的人表示欢迎。

formal.mt: L-iskola tat merħba mill-qalb lill-istudenti l-ġodda waqt iċ-ċerimonja tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: The school gave the new students a heartfelt welcome during the opening ceremony.
formal.zh: 学校在开学典礼上向新生表示了衷心的欢迎。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Merħba, David! Idħol u oqgħod bilqiegħda. David: Grazzi, Marija. Kemm hu sabiħ li nerġa' narak!
colloquial.en: Marija: Welcome, David! Come in and sit down. David: Thank you, Marija. It's so lovely to see you again!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：欢迎，大卫！进来坐吧。大卫：谢谢你，玛丽亚。再次见到你真好！

messages.speaker: Marija (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Merħba, David! Idħol u oqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Merħba, David! Idħol u oqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 欢迎，大卫！进来坐吧。
messages.en: Welcome, David! Come in and sit down.

messages.speaker: David (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, Marija. Kemm hu sabiħ li nerġa' narak!
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, Marija. Kemm hu sabiħ li nerġa' narak!
messages.zh: 谢谢你，玛丽亚。再次见到你真好！
messages.en: Thank you, Marija. It's so lovely to see you again!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把开门迎客时张开双臂的动作配上“Merħba！”，再用“一次热情的欢迎”记住它也能作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move a cloth, a hand, or another object across a surface to clean or dry it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用布、手或其他物体擦过表面，使其干净或干燥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi biċċa drapp, idek jew xi ħaġa oħra fuq wiċċ biex tnaddfu jew tnixxfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦；擦拭；擦净或擦干。
轻轻擦过；掠擦表面。

formal.mt: Wara li naddaf it-tagħmir, il-ħaddiem mesaħ il-wiċċ b'ċarruta niexfa.
formal.en: After cleaning the equipment, the worker wiped the surface with a dry cloth.
formal.zh: 清洁设备后，工作人员用干布擦拭了表面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min mesaħ il-mejda? Mark: Jien, għax kien hemm ftit ilma fuqha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who wiped the table? Mark: I did, because there was a little water on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁擦了桌子？马克：我擦的，因为上面有一点水。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁擦了桌子？
messages.en: Who wiped the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, għax kien hemm ftit ilma fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, għax kien hemm ftit ilma fuqha.
messages.zh: 我擦的，因为上面有一点水。
messages.en: I did, because there was a little water on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mesaħ 放进“拿布擦桌面”的动作画面中；想到布从表面擦过，就回忆这个词。

gloss_zh: 怜悯；表示同情；表达体恤

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel or express pity, compassion, or empathy for someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人产生或表达怜悯、同情或感同身受的关怀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoss jew tesprimi ħasra, mogħdrija jew empatija lejn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心生怜悯；感到同情。
表达同情、体恤或感同身受的理解。
对某人表示怜悯或同情。

formal.mt: Wara li sema' bl-inċident, id-direttur mesken lill-familja u offra l-għajnuna tiegħu.
formal.en: After hearing about the accident, the director expressed compassion for the family and offered his help.
formal.zh: 得知事故后，主任向那个家庭表达了同情，并提出提供帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta sema' bl-aħbar? Lara: Mesken lill-familja u qal li ried jgħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark react when he heard the news? Lara: He expressed sympathy for the family and said he wanted to help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克听到这个消息时有什么反应？拉拉：他对那个家庭表示同情，还说想帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta sema' bl-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta sema' bl-aħbar?
messages.zh: 马克听到这个消息时有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Mark react when he heard the news?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mesken lill-familja u qal li ried jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Mesken lill-familja u qal li ried jgħin.
messages.zh: 他对那个家庭表示同情，还说想帮忙。
messages.en: He expressed sympathy for the family and said he wanted to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到别人遭遇困难后，先表达心疼和理解，再伸出援手；用这幅场景记住 mesken。

gloss_zh: 触碰；影响；触觉；应当；用于表达反事实的庆幸

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make physical contact with someone or something, or to have an effect on them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人或某物发生身体接触，或对其产生影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel kuntatt fiżiku ma' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew tħalli effett fuqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 触碰；接触。
影响；对……产生作用。
触觉，即通过身体接触感知物体的感觉。
触碰这一动作；接触。
触碰；影响。

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to indicate duty or obligation: ought; should
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表示责任、义务或应做之事：应当；应该。

sense_translations.en_definition: Used in conditional or counterfactual statements to show relief that one didn't do something that would have led to a bad or regrettable result.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于条件句或反事实表达，表示庆幸没有做某件本会造成不良或令人后悔的结果的事。
动词 mess 的动作名词，表示触碰或接触这一行为。
触碰；接触；一次触摸。

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, l-istudent mess il-wiċċ tal-materjal biex jevalwa n-nisġa tiegħu permezz tas-sens tal-mess.
formal.en: During the experiment, the student touched the surface of the material to assess its texture through the sense of touch.
formal.zh: 实验中，学生触摸了材料表面，通过触觉判断其纹理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min mess it-telefon tiegħi? Mark: Jien, biex inressqu 'l bogħod mill-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who touched my phone? Mark: I did, to move it away from the water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁碰了我的手机？马克：我碰的，为了把它挪到离水远一点的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁碰了我的手机？
messages.en: Who touched my phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我碰的，为了把它挪到离水远一点的地方。
messages.en: I did, to move it away from the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“手碰到物体”记住 mess 的触碰义，再联想事情“触及自己”的影响义；应当与反事实用法另按整句记忆。

gloss_zh: 消息；口信；短信或电子讯息

teaching_sense.en_definition: Information communicated to someone, including a short written or electronic text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 传达给某人的信息，包括口信、简短文字或电子讯息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħrif li jitwassal lil xi ħadd, inkluż test qasir miktub jew elettroniku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消息；信息；口信。
传递给某人的消息或口信。

sense_translations.en_definition: message (short text that is sent, especially electronically)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发给某人的简短文字信息，尤指短信或电子讯息。

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju bagħat messaġġ lill-parteċipanti biex jinfurmahom bil-bidla fil-ħin tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The office sent a message to the participants to inform them of the change in the meeting time.
formal.zh: 办公室向参与者发送了一条消息，通知他们会议时间已更改。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Wasallek il-messaġġ tiegħi? Mark: Iva, rajtu issa. Niltaqgħu fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you get my message? Mark: Yes, I've just seen it. Let's meet at six.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你收到我的消息了吗？马克：收到了，我刚看到。我们六点见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你收到我的消息了吗？
messages.en: Did you get my message?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 收到了，我刚看到。我们六点见。
messages.en: Yes, I've just seen it. Let's meet at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手机聊天框里刚收到的一条消息标成 messaġġ，同时记住它也可以指别人带来的口信。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wipe something vigorously or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力地或反复地擦拭某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timsaħ xi ħaġa bis-saħħa jew għal diversi drabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力擦拭某物。
反复擦拭；一遍又一遍地擦。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem messaħ il-ħġieġ b'ċarruta ratba sakemm neħħa t-traċċi kollha.
formal.en: The worker repeatedly wiped the glass with a soft cloth until he removed all the marks.
formal.zh: 工作人员用软布反复擦拭玻璃，直到清除了所有痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik it-tebgħa għadha hemm? Mark: Iva. Pawlu messaħ il-mejda diversi drabi, imma t-tebgħa baqgħet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that stain still there? Mark: Yes. Pawlu wiped the table repeatedly, but the stain remained.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那块污渍还在吗？马克：是啊。保罗反复擦了桌子，可污渍还是没掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那块污渍还在吗？
messages.en: Is that stain still there?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Pawlu messaħ il-mejda diversi drabi, imma t-tebgħa baqgħet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Pawlu messaħ il-mejda diversi drabi, imma t-tebgħa baqgħet.
messages.zh: 是啊。保罗反复擦了桌子，可污渍还是没掉。
messages.en: Yes. Pawlu wiped the table repeatedly, but the stain remained.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 messaħ 中双写的 s 当作“多擦几下”的视觉提示：这是帮助区分它与 mesaħ 的学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to poetic metre or to the metric system of measurement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与诗歌的格律有关的，或与公制计量体系有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-metrika tal-poeżija jew mas-sistema metrika tal-kejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诗歌格律的；与诗行的节奏结构有关的。
公制的；米制的；采用公制计量体系的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-ritmu metriku tal-poeżija u jqabbel l-istruttura tal-versi.
formal.en: The study examines the poem's metrical rhythm and compares the structure of its lines.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察诗歌的格律节奏，并比较各诗行的结构。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kejl huwa metriku? Mark: Iva, it-tul huwa mogħti f'metri u ċentimetri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this measurement metric? Mark: Yes, the length is given in metres and centimetres.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个尺寸用的是公制吗？马克：是的，长度用米和厘米表示。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个尺寸用的是公制吗？
messages.en: Is this measurement metric?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tul huwa mogħti f'metri u ċentimetri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tul huwa mogħti f'metri u ċentimetri.
messages.zh: 是的，长度用米和厘米表示。
messages.en: Yes, the length is given in metres and centimetres.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 metriku 准备两张情境卡：一张写诗行节奏，一张画米尺；看到诗歌想格律，看到计量想公制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of length equal to one hundred centimetres.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长度单位米，等于一百厘米。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' tul li hija daqs mitt ċentimetru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 米；公尺，等于一百厘米的长度单位。
米；公尺，英语可拼作 metre 或 meter 的长度单位。

formal.mt: Skont il-pjanta, il-wisa' tal-passaġġ huwa metru u nofs.
formal.en: According to the plan, the passage is one and a half metres wide.
formal.zh: 根据平面图，通道宽一米半。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' taqtagħli metru ta' dan id-drapp? Mark: Żgur. Trid metru eżatt jew ftit iżjed?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you cut me a metre of this fabric? Mark: Of course. Would you like exactly a metre or a little more?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：能给我剪一米这种布吗？马克：当然。你要正好一米，还是稍微多一点？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' taqtagħli metru ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' taqtagħli metru ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 能给我剪一米这种布吗？
messages.en: Can you cut me a metre of this fabric?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Trid metru eżatt jew ftit iżjed?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Trid metru eżatt jew ftit iżjed?
messages.zh: 当然。你要正好一米，还是稍微多一点？
messages.en: Of course. Would you like exactly a metre or a little more?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在布店把尺子拉到一百厘米，剪下一米布；把 metru 与这段具体长度一起记住。

gloss_zh: 咂嘴；吃东西时发出咀嚼声

teaching_sense.en_definition: To smack one's lips or chew with audible mouth noises while eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃东西时咂嘴，或在咀嚼时发出明显的嘴部声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss b'xufftejh jew b'ħalqu waqt li jkun qed jiekol u jomgħod.

sense_translations.en_definition: to smack one's lips or make noise while chewing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 咂嘴；咀嚼时发出声音。

sense_translations.en_definition: to munch, to make noise while chewing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 出声地咀嚼；吃东西时发出咀嚼声。

collocations.en: he made mouth noises while eating
collocations.zh: 他吃东西时发出咂嘴声

collocations.en: he chewed noisily with his mouth open

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla, it-tifel meċlaq b'ħalqu miftuħ, u missieru fakkru biex jomgħod b'ħalqu magħluq.
formal.en: During the meal, the boy chewed noisily with his mouth open, and his father reminded him to chew with his mouth closed.
formal.zh: 用餐时，男孩张着嘴发出咀嚼声，父亲提醒他闭着嘴咀嚼。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ħuk meċlaq waqt l-ikla? Toni: Iva, imma waqaf meta fakkartu biex jagħlaq ħalqu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did your brother chew noisily during the meal? Toni: Yes, but he stopped when I reminded him to close his mouth.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你弟弟吃饭时咂嘴了吗？Toni：是啊，不过我提醒他闭上嘴后，他就不再咂嘴了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟吃饭时咂嘴了吗？
messages.en: Did your brother chew noisily during the meal?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma waqaf meta fakkartu biex jagħlaq ħalqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma waqaf meta fakkartu biex jagħlaq ħalqu.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我提醒他闭上嘴后，他就不再咂嘴了。
messages.en: Yes, but he stopped when I reminded him to close his mouth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 meċlaq 时给吃饭画面加上“吧唧吧唧”的声音，重点记住咀嚼时有声这一特征，而不只是一般的吃。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A target to aim at, or a goal or purpose that someone wants to achieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瞄准的靶子或对象，也指希望达成的目标或目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li wieħed jimmira lejh, jew għan li wieħed jixtieq jilħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想要达到的目标。
行动针对的目标或瞄准的对象。
目的；比喻行动所要实现的结果。
靶子；瞄准的目标，例如射击时的目标。
目标；希望实现的成果或做事的目的。

formal.mt: Il-mira tal-proġett hija li jitnaqqas il-ħela tal-ilma fl-iskola.
formal.en: The aim of the project is to reduce water waste at the school.
formal.zh: 该项目的目标是减少学校的用水浪费。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-mira tiegħek għal din il-ġimgħa? Mark: Irrid naqra ktieb sħiħ bil-Malti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's your goal for this week? Mark: I want to read a whole book in Maltese.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你这周的目标是什么？马克：我想读完一本马耳他语的书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-mira tiegħek għal din il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-mira tiegħek għal din il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 你这周的目标是什么？
messages.en: What's your goal for this week?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想读完一本马耳他语的书。
messages.en: I want to read a whole book in Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mira 想成眼前的靶心：射箭时是靶子，学习时就是要达到的目标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ship, boat, or other vessel used to travel on water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在水上航行、运送人员或货物的船只。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment jew dgħajsa li tintuża biex tivvjaġġa fuq l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船；在水上航行的船舶。
船只；可指船舶或小船。

formal.mt: Il-mirkeb daħal fil-port kmieni filgħodu biex iħott il-merkanzija.
formal.en: The vessel entered the harbour early in the morning to unload its cargo.
formal.zh: 这艘船清晨驶入港口卸货。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tara dak il-mirkeb ħdejn il-moll? Pawlu: Iva, wasal dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you see that vessel by the quay? Pawlu: Yes, it arrived this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见码头旁边那艘船了吗？保罗：看见了，它今天早上到的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见码头旁边那艘船了吗？
messages.en: Do you see that vessel by the quay?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了，它今天早上到的。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mirkeb 时在脑中画一艘靠港的船，再用“在船上、船进港”两个场景巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deserving or inspiring pity or sympathy because of suffering, difficulty, or helplessness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因遭受痛苦、遇到困难或处境无助而使人怜悯、同情的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqanqal ħasra jew mogħdrija minħabba tbatija, diffikultà jew nuqqas ta' għajnuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可怜的；处境或样子令人怜悯的。
受到同情的；令人产生怜悯之情的。
可怜的；使人同情的，此处不专指缺钱。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel miskin tilef daru fil-maltempata u kellu bżonn l-għajnuna.
formal.en: The poor man lost his home in the storm and needed help.
formal.zh: 这位可怜的男子在暴风雨中失去了家园，需要帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-kelb miskin, kollu mxarrab. Mark: Ejja nġibulu xugaman.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that poor dog, all wet. Mark: Let's get it a towel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那只可怜的狗，浑身都湿了。马克：我们给它拿条毛巾吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-kelb miskin, kollu mxarrab.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-kelb miskin, kollu mxarrab.
messages.zh: 看那只可怜的狗，浑身都湿了。
messages.en: Look at that poor dog, all wet.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们给它拿条毛巾吧。
messages.en: Let's get it a towel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到雨中湿透的小狗，就想到 miskin 的“可怜、令人同情”；重点是同情的感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who follows Islam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信奉伊斯兰教的人，即穆斯林。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħaddan ir-reliġjon tal-Iżlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穆斯林；信奉伊斯兰教的人。
穆斯林，即伊斯兰教信徒。

collocations.zh: 践行宗教生活的穆斯林

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, mislem spjega xi tfisser għalih il-fidi tiegħu.
formal.en: During the meeting, a Muslim explained what his faith means to him.
formal.zh: 在会上，一位穆斯林解释了自己的信仰对他意味着什么。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int mislem, Sami? Sami: Iva, jien mislem. U int?
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you a Muslim, Sami? Sami: Yes, I'm a Muslim. And you?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：萨米，你是穆斯林吗？萨米：是的，我是穆斯林。你呢？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 萨米，你是穆斯林吗？
messages.en: Are you a Muslim, Sami?

messages.speaker: Sami (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，我是穆斯林。你呢？
messages.en: Yes, I'm a Muslim. And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mislem 与英语 Muslim 并排记忆，再连到中文“穆斯林”；本词条指信教的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of jewellery worn on an ear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 佩戴在耳朵上的一件首饰，即耳环或耳饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġojjellerija li tintlibes fil-widna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳环；戴在耳朵上的饰物。

formal.mt: Il-misluta tal-fidda nstabet ħdejn id-daħla u tqiegħdet f'kaxxa żgħira.
formal.en: The silver earring was found near the entrance and placed in a small box.
formal.zh: 那只银耳环在入口附近被找到，并被放进一个小盒子里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-misluta tiegħi? Naħseb li waqgħet hawn. Sara: Iva, qiegħda taħt is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you seen my earring? I think it fell here. Sara: Yes, it's under the chair.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看见我的耳环了吗？我想它掉在这里了。萨拉：看见了，在椅子下面。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-misluta tiegħi? Naħseb li waqgħet hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-misluta tiegħi? Naħseb li waqgħet hawn.
messages.zh: 你看见我的耳环了吗？我想它掉在这里了。
messages.en: Have you seen my earring? I think it fell here.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了，在椅子下面。
messages.en: Yes, it's under the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 misluta 时想象一只银耳环掉在椅子下，把“耳朵上的首饰”和寻找场景一起记住。

gloss_zh: 动物饮水槽；鸟用饮水器

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trough or container that holds drinking water for an animal or bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盛放饮用水、供动物或鸟饮水的槽或容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħawt jew reċipjent li jżomm l-ilma biex jixorbu minnu l-annimali jew l-għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: water trough for an animal or bird
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供动物或鸟饮水的水槽或饮水容器。
饮水槽；供动物喝水的槽。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi naddaf il-misqa u mela l-misqa b'ilma frisk għall-annimali.
formal.en: The farmer cleaned the watering trough and filled it with fresh water for the animals.
formal.zh: 农民清洗了饮水槽，并为动物加满干净的水。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Il-misqa tal-għasafar vojta. Timlieha int? Lara: Iva, se nġib ftit ilma issa.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: The birds' drinking container is empty. Will you fill it? Lara: Yes, I'll get some water now.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：鸟的饮水器空了。你来加水好吗？拉拉：好，我现在去拿些水。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 鸟的饮水器空了。你来加水好吗？
messages.en: The birds' drinking container is empty. Will you fill it?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nġib ftit ilma issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nġib ftit ilma issa.
messages.zh: 好，我现在去拿些水。
messages.en: Yes, I'll get some water now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 misqa 记成动物的“喝水站”：牛低头喝水、鸟停下饮水，眼前那个容器就是它。

gloss_zh: 广场；城镇中的开阔空地

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open public space in a town or village where people can meet or gather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城镇或村庄中供人会面、聚集的公共开阔场地，即广场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju pubbliku miftuħ f'belt jew raħal fejn in-nies jistgħu jiltaqgħu jew jinġabru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 广场；供人活动的开阔公共场地。
广场，即城镇中的公共开阔空地。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill organizza attività kulturali fil-misraħ tar-raħal nhar il-Ħadd.
formal.en: The council organised a cultural event in the village square on Sunday.
formal.zh: 地方议会星期日在村庄广场举办了一场文化活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu llejla? Mark: Fil-misraħ, ħdejn il-funtana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet this evening? Mark: In the square, by the fountain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今晚在哪里见面？马克：在广场的喷泉旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今晚在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet this evening?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在广场的喷泉旁边。
messages.en: In the square, by the fountain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 misraħ 时想象村中心有喷泉、人们相约见面的开阔广场，把地点和会面场景绑在一起。

gloss_zh: 受诅咒的；倒霉的；顽皮惹事的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Described as cursed or unlucky, or, in some contexts, mischievous and troublesome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容被认为受到诅咒或运气不佳的人或事物；在某些语境中也形容顽皮、惹麻烦的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitqies milqut minn saħta jew sfortuna, jew, f'ċerti kuntesti, imqareb u ta' nkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受诅咒的；被认为遭到诅咒的。
倒霉的；运气不佳的。
顽皮的；爱恶作剧的。
淘气的；爱惹事、让人费心的。

gloss_zh: 预测；预报；另有“公告”及“适逢某日”义
