messages.zh: 我解开的，因为它太紧了。
messages.en: I did, because it was too tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħall 放进两幅学习画面：绳结旁记“解开”，沙拉瓶旁记“醋”；用搭配区分动词和名词。

gloss_zh: 留下；离开；允许；另有使变甜、使变软及海浪、堆等义

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave someone or something in a place, leave them behind, or allow someone to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人或某物留在某处，离开或留下他们，也可指允许某人做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħalli lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa f'post, titlaq minn ħdejhom, jew tagħti permess lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 离开某人或某物；把某人或某物留下。
抛弃；遗弃；放弃。
使变甜；给某物增加甜味。
使变软；使柔和。
海面的涌浪或起伏。

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave (someone or something in a place)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人或某物留在某个地方。
让某人做某事。
省略；遗漏；不包括在内。
允许；许可。
拍岸浪；翻涌的大浪。
由成捆谷物堆成的垛。
堆；堆积起来的一堆东西。

collocations.en: left the keys on the table

formal.mt: Id-direttur ħalla kopja tar-rapport fl-uffiċċju biex il-kollegi jkunu jistgħu jaqrawha.
formal.en: The director left a copy of the report in the office so that colleagues could read it.
formal.zh: 主管在办公室留了一份报告，供同事阅读。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn ħalla ċ-ċwievet Mark? Pawlu: Ħalliehom fuq il-mejda tal-kċina.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did Mark leave the keys? Pawlu: He left them on the kitchen table.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark把钥匙放在哪里了？Pawlu：他把钥匙留在厨房桌上了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: Mark把钥匙放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did Mark leave the keys?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 他把钥匙留在厨房桌上了。
messages.en: He left them on the kitchen table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个小场景：钥匙“留下”，孩子“获准玩耍”。海浪和谷物堆的名词义另外配图记忆，避免混成同一个意思。

gloss_zh: 勾起食欲；使人想尝一尝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arouse someone's appetite or make them want to eat or taste something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 勾起某人的食欲，使人产生想吃或想品尝某物的欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqajjem l-aptit ta' xi ħadd jew ix-xewqa tiegħu li jiekol jew iduq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勾起食欲；使人胃口大开。

sense_translations.en_definition: make one wish to taste s.th.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人想品尝某种东西。
刺激食欲；使人更想吃东西。
引起强烈的渴望或馋意。
模拟食欲。

sense_translations.en_definition: to arouse a desire to eat or taste something
sense_translations.zh_definition: 唤起想吃或想品尝某物的欲望。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt tal-ikel fil-menu ħallaq lill-mistednin qabel ma waslu l-platti.
formal.en: The photograph of the food on the menu whetted the guests' appetite before the dishes arrived.
formal.zh: 菜品端上来之前，菜单上的食物照片就勾起了客人们的食欲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-ritratt ħallaqni għat-torta! Rita: Trid biċċa? Għad fadal fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Maja: This photo has made me crave the cake! Rita: Would you like a slice? There's still some in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张照片让我好想吃那块蛋糕！Rita：要来一块吗？厨房里还有。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张照片让我好想吃那块蛋糕！
messages.en: This photo has made me crave the cake!

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 要来一块吗？厨房里还有。
messages.en: Would you like a slice? There's still some in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看见蛋糕照片便馋得想尝一口，把 ħallaq 与“食物出现，食欲被勾起”的连续画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 付款；补偿；酬报；另有梳理义及付款人名词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give money for goods or services, settle a bill, or compensate someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为商品或服务付钱，结清账单，或向某人作出补偿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti flus għal oġġetti jew servizzi, tħallas kont, jew tagħti kumpens lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 付款；支付费用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make amends or atone for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某事作出弥补；赎过。
付款的人；支付者。
补偿；酬谢；奖励。
梳理；用梳子梳。

formal.mt: Il-klijent ħallas il-kont kollu qabel id-data tal-għeluq.
formal.en: The client paid the entire bill before the due date.
formal.zh: 客户在到期日前付清了整张账单。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min ħallas il-kont? Lara: Jien ħallastu bil-karta. Id-darba li jmiss tħallas int.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who paid the bill? Lara: I paid it by card. Next time it's your turn to pay.
colloquial.zh: Mark：谁付的账？Lara：我刷卡付了。下次轮到你付。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁付的账？
messages.en: Who paid the bill?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ħallastu bil-karta. Id-darba li jmiss tħallas int.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ħallastu bil-karta. Id-darba li jmiss tħallas int.
messages.zh: 我刷卡付了。下次轮到你付。
messages.en: I paid it by card. Next time it's your turn to pay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħallas 写在结账小票旁，先牢牢记住“付款”；再用“给钱补偿、给钱酬谢”串联相关义，梳理义单独记卡片。

gloss_zh: 混合；调和；混淆；另有比较、配种、稀释等义

teaching_sense.en_definition: To combine two or more things into a mixture; also, to confuse one thing with another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把两种或更多东西混在一起，也可指把不同事物混淆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad żewġ affarijiet jew aktar f'taħlita; ukoll, tfixkel ħaġa ma' oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合；把不同东西放在一起。
调和；使不同成分融合。
混杂；使交融在一起。
混淆；使不同事物难以区分。
认错；把一个事物误认为另一个。
比较；把事物放在一起对照。
给山羊配种。
稀释；加入其他液体以降低浓度。
进行混合的人或物。
混合器；搅拌机；调配者。
混合；搅拌在一起。

collocations.en: mixed the flour with the water

formal.mt: Il-kok ħallat id-dqiq mal-ilma sakemm kiseb għaġina lixxa.
formal.en: The cook mixed the flour with the water until he obtained a smooth dough.
formal.zh: 厨师把面粉与水混合，直到形成光滑的面团。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu ħallat iz-zokkor mal-melħ? Maja: Iva, il-vażetti kienu jixxiebhu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu mix up the sugar and the salt? Maja: Yes, the jars looked very similar.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu把糖和盐弄混了吗？Maja：是啊，那两个罐子看起来太像了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: Pawlu把糖和盐弄混了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu mix up the sugar and the salt?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，那两个罐子看起来太像了。
messages.en: Yes, the jars looked very similar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房双画面记 ħallat：面粉加水是主动“混合”，糖盐认错是意外“混淆”；同一个词配两种清楚的情境。

gloss_zh: 使牲畜产奶；给瓷砖填缝；给屋顶做防水

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make livestock yield milk; in building work, to grout tiles or apply waterproofing to a roof.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使牲畜产奶；用于建筑施工时，指给瓷砖填缝或给屋顶做防水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel lill-bhejjem jagħtu l-ħalib; fil-bini, timla l-fili bejn il-madum jew tapplika saff kontra l-ilma fuq il-bejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使动物产奶。
给瓷砖填缝；在瓷砖之间施加填缝材料。

sense_translations.en_definition: to apply waterproofing to the roof of a building
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给建筑物的屋顶施加防水材料。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make livestock (cows, sheep, etc) yield milk
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使牛、绵羊等牲畜产奶。
灌浆；用填缝材料填实缝隙。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħalleb il-madum tal-kamra tal-banju wara li l-kolla nixfet.
formal.en: The worker grouted the bathroom tiles after the adhesive had dried.
formal.zh: 工人在胶黏剂干燥后给浴室瓷砖填了缝。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-bennej ħalleb il-bejt illum? Toni: Iva, u qal li s-saff irid jinxef sew.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the builder waterproof the roof today? Toni: Yes, and he said the coating needs to dry thoroughly.
colloquial.zh: Rita：建筑工今天给屋顶做防水了吗？Toni：做了，他说涂层要充分干燥。

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.zh: 建筑工今天给屋顶做防水了吗？
messages.en: Did the builder waterproof the roof today?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u qal li s-saff irid jinxef sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u qal li s-saff irid jinxef sew.
messages.zh: 做了，他说涂层要充分干燥。
messages.en: Yes, and he said the coating needs to dry thoroughly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħalleb 做三格图卡：牲畜产奶、瓷砖填缝、屋顶防水。按使用场景分别记忆，不把三个义项硬套成同一种动作。

gloss_zh: 使宣誓；主持宣誓；以誓言约束

teaching_sense.en_definition: To administer an oath to someone or require them to make a solemn sworn promise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主持某人的宣誓，或要求某人作出庄严的宣誓承诺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed lil xi ħadd taħt ġurament jew titolbu jagħmel wegħda solenni b'ġurament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人宣誓；让某人处于宣誓约束之下。
主持某人的宣誓；向某人施行宣誓程序。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bind someone by an oath
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以誓言约束某人；使某人立誓承担承诺。

collocations.en: administered an oath to the new members

formal.mt: L-imħallef ħallef lix-xhud qabel ma dan beda jagħti x-xhieda tiegħu.
formal.en: The judge put the witness under oath before he began giving his testimony.
formal.zh: 法官在证人开始作证前让他宣了誓。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-imħallef ħallef lix-xhud? Mark: Iva, qabel ma beda jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the judge put the witness under oath? Mark: Yes, before he started speaking.
colloquial.zh: Maja：法官让证人宣誓了吗？Mark：是的，在证人开始讲话之前。

messages.speaker: Maja (旁听者)
messages.zh: 法官让证人宣誓了吗？
messages.en: Did the judge put the witness under oath?

messages.speaker: Mark (旁听者)
messages.zh: 是的，在证人开始讲话之前。
messages.en: Yes, before he started speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象法官要求证人先宣誓再作证：ħallef 的主语是主持或要求宣誓的人，宾语是受到誓言约束的人。

gloss_zh: 变成醋；使变成醋；指控偷窃

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become vinegar, or to cause a liquid such as wine to become vinegar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成醋，或使葡萄酒等液体变成醋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinbidel f'ħall, jew jagħmel likwidu bħall-inbid jinbidel f'ħall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变成醋。
指控某人偷窃；把盗窃行为归咎于某人。
使变成醋；将液体制成醋。

formal.mt: Il-produttur ħallel parti mill-inbid biex jagħmel ħall għall-kċina.
formal.en: The producer turned some of the wine into vinegar for use in the kitchen.
formal.zh: 生产者把一部分葡萄酒制成了厨房用醋。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'għamel Pawlu bl-inbid li kien fadal? Rita: Ħallel l-inbid u issa juża l-ħall fl-insalata.
colloquial.en: Marta: What did Pawlu do with the leftover wine? Rita: He turned the wine into vinegar, and now he uses the vinegar in salad.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗把剩下的葡萄酒怎么处理了？丽塔：他把葡萄酒制成了醋，现在用来拌沙拉。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Pawlu bl-inbid li kien fadal?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Pawlu bl-inbid li kien fadal?
messages.zh: 保罗把剩下的葡萄酒怎么处理了？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do with the leftover wine?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallel l-inbid u issa juża l-ħall fl-insalata.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallel l-inbid u issa juża l-ħall fl-insalata.
messages.zh: 他把葡萄酒制成了醋，现在用来拌沙拉。
messages.en: He turned the wine into vinegar, and now he uses the vinegar in salad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把酒瓶换上醋瓶标签的画面与 ħallel 连起来，记住“变醋、制醋”；另把“指控偷窃”作为独立义项记忆。

gloss_zh: 反复梳理棉花；去除棉籽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To card cotton repeatedly or remove the seeds from cotton.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复梳理棉花纤维，或从棉花中去除棉籽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdem il-qoton biex tifred u tirranġa l-fibri tiegħu ripetutament jew biex tneħħilu ż-żerriegħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁或反复地梳理棉花纤维。
从棉花中去除棉籽。

collocations.zh: 梳理了棉花或去除了棉籽

formal.mt: L-artiġjan ħalleġ il-qoton biex ineħħi ż-żerriegħa qabel l-istadju li jmiss tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The craftsperson deseeded the cotton before the next stage of the work.
formal.zh: 手工艺人在进入下一道工序前去除了棉花中的棉籽。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Toni ħalleġ il-qoton illum? Pawlu: Iva, neħħa ż-żerriegħa kollha minnu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Toni deseed the cotton today? Pawlu: Yes, he removed all the seeds from it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Toni今天给棉花去籽了吗？Pawlu：是的，他把里面的棉籽全都去掉了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: Toni今天给棉花去籽了吗？
messages.en: Did Toni deseed the cotton today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工坊同事)
messages.zh: 是的，他把里面的棉籽全都去掉了。
messages.en: Yes, he removed all the seeds from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħalleġ 配上一团棉花的两张动作图：一张反复梳开纤维，一张挑出棉籽；看到 qoton 就联想这两个加工动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who steals things belonging to other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偷取他人财物的人，即小偷或窃贼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisraq affarijiet li huma ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 入室窃贼；闯入建筑物偷窃的人。
骗子；以欺诈或其他不诚实手段牟利的人。
小偷；窃贼。
制醋者；生产醋的人。

formal.mt: Il-pulizija qabdet lill-ħalliel wara li sabet l-oġġetti misruqa fil-karozza tiegħu.
formal.en: The police caught the thief after finding the stolen items in his car.
formal.zh: 警方在窃贼的汽车里发现赃物后，将他抓获。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt lil xi ħadd jieħu r-rota tiegħi! Lara: Forsi kien ħalliel. Ejja nċemplu lill-pulizija.
colloquial.en: Mark: I saw someone take my bike! Lara: Maybe it was a thief. Let's call the police.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我看见有人把我的自行车拿走了！拉拉：可能是小偷。我们报警吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (自行车主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil xi ħadd jieħu r-rota tiegħi!
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil xi ħadd jieħu r-rota tiegħi!
messages.zh: 我看见有人把我的自行车拿走了！
messages.en: I saw someone take my bike!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi kien ħalliel. Ejja nċemplu lill-pulizija.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi kien ħalliel. Ejja nċemplu lill-pulizija.
messages.zh: 可能是小偷。我们报警吧。
messages.en: Maybe it was a thief. Let's call the police.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自行车被偷时大喊 ħalliel，把词和“小偷”直接配对；“制醋者”另用工作围裙的画面记忆，避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or being that creates, invents, or makes something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创造、发明或制作某事物的人或存在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew esseri li joħloq, jivvinta jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创造者；创作者。
发明者；发明家。
制作者；制造者。
动词 ħalaq 的施事名词，指实施创造行为的人或存在。
创造者、发明者或制作者。

collocations.en: the inventor of a new tool

formal.mt: Il-ħallieq ta' din l-għodda spjega kif l-invenzjoni tiegħu tnaqqas il-ħin meħtieġ għax-xogħol.
formal.en: The inventor of this tool explained how his invention reduces the time needed for the work.
formal.zh: 这件工具的发明者解释了他的发明如何缩短工作所需的时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-ħallieq ta' din il-logħba? David: Ħija! Ilu jaħdem fuqha għal xhur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the creator of this game? David: My brother! He's been working on it for months.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这款游戏是谁创作的？戴维：我哥哥！他已经做了好几个月。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-ħallieq ta' din il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-ħallieq ta' din il-logħba?
messages.zh: 这款游戏是谁创作的？
messages.en: Who is the creator of this game?

messages.speaker: David (创作者的弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija! Ilu jaħdem fuqha għal xhur.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija! Ilu jaħdem fuqha għal xhur.
messages.zh: 我哥哥！他已经做了好几个月。
messages.en: My brother! He's been working on it for months.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħallieq 写在作品旁的作者名牌上，记住它回答“是谁创造的”；再与表示“有创意的”的 ħallieqi 对照。

gloss_zh: 有创造力的；富有创意的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to produce new ideas, or showing imagination and originality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够提出新想法的，或表现出想象力与独创性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila joħloq ideat ġodda, jew li juri immaġinazzjoni u oriġinalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有创造力的；富有创意的。

collocations.zh: 富有创意的作品或工作

formal.mt: Il-proġett iħeġġeġ il-ħsieb ħallieqi billi jitlob lill-istudenti jsibu użi ġodda għal materjali komuni.
formal.en: The project encourages creative thinking by asking students to find new uses for everyday materials.
formal.zh: 这个项目要求学生为常见材料寻找新用途，从而鼓励创造性思维。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għamilt lampa minn flixkun qadim. Karl: Kemm hu ħallieqi dan ix-xogħol! Kif ġietek l-idea?
colloquial.en: Nina: I made a lamp from an old bottle. Karl: This is such creative work! How did you get the idea?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我用一个旧瓶子做了盏灯。卡尔：这个作品真有创意！你怎么想到的？

messages.speaker: Nina (手工爱好者)
messages.zh: 我用一个旧瓶子做了盏灯。
messages.en: I made a lamp from an old bottle.

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu ħallieqi dan ix-xogħol! Kif ġietek l-idea?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu ħallieqi dan ix-xogħol! Kif ġietek l-idea?
messages.zh: 这个作品真有创意！你怎么想到的？
messages.en: This is such creative work! How did you get the idea?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这个作品很有创意”练习 ħallieqi，把它放在描述性质的位置；与名词 ħallieq“创造者”成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The opening in the face used for eating and speaking; also an opening in an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面部用于进食和说话的嘴，也可指物体的开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fetħa fil-wiċċ li tintuża biex wieħed jiekol u jitkellem; ukoll fetħa f'oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘴；口。

sense_translations.en_definition: an eater, a person to be fed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃饭的人；需要供养的一口人。
开口；物体的口部。

formal.mt: Ħalq il-flixkun għandu jibqa' nadif qabel ma jitpoġġa t-tapp.
formal.en: The mouth of the bottle should remain clean before the cap is put on.
formal.zh: 盖上瓶盖之前，瓶口应保持清洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi ħalqi xott. Għandek ftit ilma? Toni: Iva, ħu dan il-flixkun.
colloquial.en: Maja: My mouth is dry. Do you have some water? Toni: Yes, take this bottle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我口干了。你有点水吗？托尼：有，拿这瓶吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħalqi xott. Għandek ftit ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħalqi xott. Għandek ftit ilma?
messages.zh: 我口干了。你有点水吗？
messages.en: My mouth is dry. Do you have some water?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，拿这瓶吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一张嘴，再画瓶口，最后写“一家几口人”，用中文“口”的三个画面串联 ħalq 的各个义项。

gloss_zh: 非常热；保护者；捍卫者；公公或岳父

teaching_sense.en_definition: The father of one's husband or wife; a father-in-law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丈夫或妻子的父亲，即公公或岳父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Missier ir-raġel jew tal-mara ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常热；十分炎热。
保护者；庇护者。
捍卫者；保卫者。
配偶的父亲；公公或岳父。

formal.mt: Il-ħam ta' Mark attenda ċ-ċerimonja flimkien mal-bqija tal-familja.
formal.en: Mark's father-in-law attended the ceremony together with the rest of the family.
formal.zh: 马克的岳父与其他家人一起出席了仪式。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min hu dak ħdejn Mark? Pawlu: Dak il-ħam ta' Mark, missier martu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is that next to Mark? Pawlu: That's Mark's father-in-law, his wife's father.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克旁边那位是谁？保罗：那是马克的岳父，也就是他妻子的父亲。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克旁边那位是谁？
messages.en: Who is that next to Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ħam ta' Mark, missier martu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ħam ta' Mark, missier martu.
messages.zh: 那是马克的岳父，也就是他妻子的父亲。
messages.en: That's Mark's father-in-law, his wife's father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在家庭关系图里，把 ħam 放在“配偶的父亲”位置，中文依关系译成“公公”或“岳父”；其他义项分别制卡记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To protect someone or something from danger, harm, or attack.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保护或保卫某人、某物，使其免受危险、伤害或攻击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa mill-periklu, mill-ħsara jew minn attakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保卫；捍卫。
污泥；淤泥。
泥；泥浆。
软泥；稀软的泥浆。

sense_translations.en_definition: silt, sludge, ooze (fine mud as found especially near the seashore)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 淤泥、污泥或软泥，尤指海岸附近的细泥。
保护；保卫；使免受伤害或攻击。

collocations.en: a layer of silt or mud

formal.mt: Is-suldat ħama lit-tifel mill-periklu sakemm waslet l-għajnuna.
formal.en: The soldier protected the boy from danger until help arrived.
formal.zh: 士兵保护那个男孩免受危险，直到救援人员到达。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ħama lit-tifel waqt il-maltemp? Toni: Ġużeppi ħama lit-tifel u ħadu ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who protected the boy during the storm? Toni: Ġużeppi protected the boy and took him inside.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：暴风雨期间是谁保护了那个男孩？托尼：朱塞佩保护了他，还把他带进了屋里。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 暴风雨期间是谁保护了那个男孩？
messages.en: Who protected the boy during the storm?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġużeppi ħama lit-tifel u ħadu ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Ġużeppi ħama lit-tifel u ħadu ġewwa.
messages.zh: 朱塞佩保护了那个男孩，还把他带进了屋里。
messages.en: Ġużeppi protected the boy and took him inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ħama 画两张独立卡片：盾牌表示动词“保护”，岸边细泥表示名词“淤泥”；读句子时先判断词性再选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crude or vulgar in speech or behaviour; an insulting description that can also express social prejudice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言语或行为粗俗、缺乏礼貌；带有贬义，用于评价人时也可能表达社会阶层偏见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem jew iġib ruħu b'mod vulgari u bla manjieri; kelma dispreġġjattiva li tista' tesprimi wkoll preġudizzju soċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗鄙的；言行缺乏礼貌和修养的。
粗俗的；言语或举止不雅的。
粗俗的；带贬义地形容被视为社会下层的人或其言行，可能含有阶层偏见。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva l-kliem bħala ħamallu u talab li d-diskussjoni tkompli b'aktar rispett.
formal.en: The report described the language as vulgar and requested that the discussion continue more respectfully.
formal.zh: 报告将这些言语描述为粗俗，并要求讨论以更加尊重他人的方式继续。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-kliem kien ħamallu. Pawlu: Iva, seta' tkellem b'aktar rispett.
colloquial.en: Lara: That language was vulgar. Pawlu: Yes, he could have spoken more respectfully.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那些话太粗俗了。Pawlu：是啊，他本来可以说得更尊重人一些。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 那些话太粗俗了。
messages.en: That language was vulgar.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 是啊，他本来可以说得更尊重人一些。
messages.en: Yes, he could have spoken more respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħamallu 与“说话粗俗、举止失礼”的场景相连；记住它带贬义，描述具体言行比随意给人贴标签更合适。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loud, confused noise, especially from a crowd, or the turmoil accompanying it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尤指人群发出的嘈杂喧闹声，也可指伴随这种喧闹的纷乱状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Storbju qawwi u mħallat, speċjalment minn folla nies, jew it-taħwid li jkun hemm miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纷乱；混乱而不平静的状态。
喧闹声；如人群聚集时产生的嘈杂声。
嘈杂声；喧闹；纷乱。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-ħamba tal-folla, ħafna nies ma semgħux l-avviż.
formal.en: Because of the noise of the crowd, many people did not hear the announcement.
formal.zh: 由于人群十分嘈杂，许多人没有听见通知。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhi din il-ħamba? Toni: Kulħadd qed jitkellem fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Marija: What's all this noise? Toni: Everyone is talking at the same time.
colloquial.zh: Marija：怎么这么吵？Toni：大家都在同时说话。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么这么吵？
messages.en: What's all this noise?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家都在同时说话。
messages.en: Everyone is talking at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群人同时说话，声音混成一片：ħamba 就是这片喧闹，也可让你联想到现场的纷乱。

gloss_zh: 激烈争辩；大声说话；高声争吵

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak loudly or argue in a loud, vehement manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大声说话，或以高声、激烈的方式争辩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'leħen għoli jew jargumenta b'mod qawwi u mqanqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激烈地争辩；情绪激动地争论。
大声说话；高声讲话。
高声争辩；大声争吵。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti ħambaq dwar id-deċiżjoni u l-president talbu jitkellem bil-kalma.
formal.en: During the meeting, one participant argued vehemently about the decision, and the chair asked him to speak calmly.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名与会者就该决定激烈争辩，会议主席请他平静地发言。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ħambaq Pawlu hekk? Mark: Ma qabilx mad-deċiżjoni, iżda seta' spjega ruħu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu argue so loudly? Mark: He disagreed with the decision, but he could have explained himself calmly.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 为什么争得那么大声？Mark：他不同意那个决定，不过他本来可以平静地说明自己的想法。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么争得那么大声？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu argue so loudly?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qabilx mad-deċiżjoni, iżda seta' spjega ruħu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qabilx mad-deċiżjoni, iżda seta' spjega ruħu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 他不同意那个决定，不过他本来可以平静地说明自己的想法。
messages.en: He disagreed with the decision, but he could have explained himself calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħambaq 时想象争论者越说越响：先抓住“大声说”，再把情绪加进去，就记住“激烈争辩”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be able to bear or tolerate something difficult or unpleasant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够承受或忍受困难、痛苦或令人不快的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun kapaċi jissaporti jew jittollera xi ħaġa diffiċli jew li ddejqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够承受；经受得住。
忍受；承受痛苦或困难。
忍受；承受；容忍。
喜欢；对某人或某事有好感。

formal.mt: Għalkemm il-kamra kienet storbjuża, Mark ħamel l-istorbju sakemm spiċċa l-eżami.
formal.en: Although the room was noisy, Mark put up with the noise until the exam ended.
formal.zh: 尽管房间里很吵，Mark 还是一直忍受着噪声，直到考试结束。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ħamilt dak l-istorbju kollu? Toni: Għalaqt it-tieqa u ppruvajt ma nagħtix kas.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you put up with all that noise? Toni: I closed the window and tried to ignore it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那么吵，你是怎么忍下来的？Toni：我关上窗户，尽量不去理会。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那么吵，你是怎么忍下来的？
messages.en: How did you put up with all that noise?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalaqt it-tieqa u ppruvajt ma nagħtix kas.
messages.mt_standard: Għalaqt it-tieqa u ppruvajt ma nagħtix kas.
messages.zh: 我关上窗户，尽量不去理会。
messages.en: I closed the window and tried to ignore it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“噪声再大也承受住”的画面记 ħamel 的忍受义；另把“喜欢”单列一张义项卡，结合语境辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The short form of five used before a noun; with the definite article, it also expresses fifth in an order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 置于名词前表示数量“五”的简短形式；与定冠词连用时，也可表示顺序中的“第五”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma qasira ta' ħamsa li tintuża qabel nom; bl-artiklu definit tindika wkoll il-ħames post f'ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第五；表示排列顺序中的第五位。
ħamsa（五）用作名词前定语时的简短形式，表示五个、五件等数量。

formal.mt: Il-ħames kapitlu fih ħames eżempji dwar l-użu tal-kliem.
formal.en: The fifth chapter contains five examples of word usage.
formal.zh: 第五章包含五个词语用法的例子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm għandna ħin? Mark: Għad għandna ħames minuti qabel il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much time do we have? Mark: We still have five minutes before the lesson.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们还有多少时间？Mark：离上课还有五分钟。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 我们还有多少时间？
messages.en: How much time do we have?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandna ħames minuti qabel il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandna ħames minuti qabel il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 离上课还有五分钟。
messages.en: We still have five minutes before the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记两幅图：ħames minuti 是钟面上的“五分钟”，il-ħames paġna 是翻到“第五页”；用搭配区分数量与顺序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pigeons or doves, referred to collectively as a group or kind of bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对鸽子、鸽类鸟的集合称呼，可用于泛指这一类鸟或一群鸽子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasafar bħal dawk li jidhru fil-pjazez jew jitrabbew fid-djar, imsemmija bħala grupp jew tip ta' għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸽；常称作斑鸠或鸽子的这一类鸟。
鸽子；如广场上常见的鸽类鸟。
鸽子、鸽类鸟的集合称呼。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-ħamiem fil-pjazza u kitbu dwar l-imġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: The students observed the pigeons in the square and wrote about their behaviour.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了广场上的鸽子，并写下了对其行为的描述。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hawn ħamiem fil-pjazza! Toni: Iva, hemm ukoll xi ħamiem abjad ħdejn il-funtana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how many pigeons there are in the square! Toni: Yes, there are also some white ones near the fountain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看，广场上有这么多鸽子！Toni：是啊，喷泉旁边还有一些白鸽。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看，广场上有这么多鸽子！
messages.en: Look how many pigeons there are in the square!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ukoll xi ħamiem abjad ħdejn il-funtana.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ukoll xi ħamiem abjad ħdejn il-funtana.
messages.zh: 是啊，喷泉旁边还有一些白鸽。
messages.en: Yes, there are also some white ones near the fountain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广场上一群灰鸽与白鸽一起飞起，用整个鸽群的画面记 ħamiem，帮助记住它的集合用法。

gloss_zh: 使变红；使脸红；涂红者；来月经

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something red, including making someone's face turn red through embarrassment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变红，也可指使某人因害羞或尴尬而脸红。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ħamra, jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiħmar f'wiċċu bil-mistħija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变红；使呈现红色。
使某人脸红，通常因害羞或尴尬。
用红色涂绘的人；把物体涂红的人。
使某人因害羞或尴尬而脸红。
来月经；行经。

formal.mt: Il-kumpliment quddiem il-klassi kollha ħammar wiċċ Marija.
formal.en: The compliment in front of the whole class made Marija blush.
formal.zh: 当着全班同学的面受到称赞，使 Marija 羞红了脸。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak il-kumpliment ħammar wiċċ Mark! Lara: Iva, ma kienx qed jistenna tant tifħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: That compliment made Mark blush! Lara: Yes, he wasn't expecting so much praise.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那句赞美让 Mark 脸都红了！Lara：是啊，他没想到会得到这么多夸奖。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 那句赞美让 Mark 脸都红了！
messages.en: That compliment made Mark blush!

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma kienx qed jistenna tant tifħir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma kienx qed jistenna tant tifħir.
messages.zh: 是啊，他没想到会得到这么多夸奖。
messages.en: Yes, he wasn't expecting so much praise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“墙被涂红、脸被夸红”两幅图记主要动词义；把名词“涂红者”和动词“来月经”另列卡片，避免混淆词性与义项。

gloss_zh: 清理干净；清除泥土；清理畜栏；苗床播种；除草；逃走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clean out a place by removing dirt or unwanted material, especially from an animal enclosure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过清除污物或杂物把某处清理干净，尤其指清理畜栏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaddaf post billi tneħħi l-ħmieġ jew materjal mhux mixtieq, speċjalment minn maqjel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清除内部的污物或杂物，把里面清理干净。
挖出并清除泥土。

sense_translations.en_definition: to clean the enclosure where animals are kept
sense_translations.zh_definition: 清理饲养动物的围栏或畜栏。

sense_translations.en_definition: to sow seeds in a bed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在苗床或种植畦中播种。
清洁、清除污物，使某处干净。
除去杂草。
逃走；跑掉。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħammel il-maqjel qabel ma daħħal l-annimali fih.
formal.en: The worker cleaned out the enclosure before putting the animals inside.
formal.zh: 工人在把动物赶进去之前，先清理了畜栏。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ħammel il-maqjel qabel l-ikel, jekk jogħġbok. Pawlu: Tajjeb, nibda issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Please clean out the animal enclosure before lunch. Pawlu: All right, I'll start now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：请在午饭前把畜栏清理干净。Pawlu：好的，我现在就开始。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħammel il-maqjel qabel l-ikel, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Ħammel il-maqjel qabel l-ikel, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请在午饭前把畜栏清理干净。
messages.en: Please clean out the animal enclosure before lunch.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工人)
messages.zh: 好的，我现在就开始。
messages.en: All right, I'll start now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 ħammel 配上“清空畜栏”的画面；再把播种、除草、逃走各做一张语境卡，避免把不同义项硬套成一个意思。

gloss_zh: 反复思量；想得过多；念念不忘

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep thinking excessively about something and find it difficult to put it out of one's mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事反复想个不停，想得过多，难以放下或忘记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħseb iżżejjed dwar xi ħaġa u ssibha diffiċli biex twarrabha minn moħħok.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过度反复思量；对某事想个不停。

sense_translations.en_definition: to ruminate, to think excessively about, to be unable to forget
sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复思索，过度想着某事，或一直无法忘记。

collocations.zh: 对这个问题反复想个不停

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, Pawlu ħammem fuq il-kritika għal sigħat sħaħ.
formal.en: After the meeting, Pawlu dwelt on the criticism for hours.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，Pawlu 对那些批评反复想了好几个小时。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek taħseb f'dak li qal Mark? Luqa: Iva, ilbieraħ ħammemt fuqu l-lejla kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you still thinking about what Mark said? Luqa: Yes, yesterday I dwelt on it all evening.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你还在想 Mark 说的话吗？Luqa：是啊，昨天我整晚都在反复想那件事。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek taħseb f'dak li qal Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek taħseb f'dak li qal Mark?
messages.zh: 你还在想 Mark 说的话吗？
messages.en: Are you still thinking about what Mark said?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilbieraħ ħammemt fuqu l-lejla kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilbieraħ ħammemt fuqu l-lejla kollha.
messages.zh: 是啊，昨天我整晚都在反复想那件事。
messages.en: Yes, yesterday I dwelt on it all evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħammem 想成脑中一段话不断循环播放：重点是“反复而且过多”，并非普通地想一下。这是学习画面，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 弄脏；污损；玷污名誉；排泄

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty or soiled; figuratively, to damage someone's honour or reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变脏或受到污损；比喻玷污某人的荣誉或名声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa maħmuġa; f'sens figurattiv, jagħmel ħsara lill-unur jew lir-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏；使变得不干净。
污秽；弄污；使肮脏不洁。
玷污；污损名声或荣誉。
排泄；排出体内废物。
弄脏；使沾上污物。
使蒙羞；玷污荣誉或名声。
排便；解大便。

formal.mt: It-tajn li daħal mit-tieqa ħammeġ id-dokumenti fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: The mud that came in through the window soiled the documents on the table.
formal.zh: 从窗户进来的泥弄脏了桌上的文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-kelb ħammeġ l-art bit-tajn. Pawlu: Se nġib il-mopp u nnaddafha.
colloquial.en: Marija: The dog got mud all over the floor. Pawlu: I'll get the mop and clean it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：狗把泥弄到地上，地板都脏了。Pawlu：我去拿拖把，把地板清理干净。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 狗把泥弄到地上，地板都脏了。
messages.en: The dog got mud all over the floor.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我去拿拖把，把地板清理干净。
messages.en: I'll get the mop and clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“泥弄脏衣服”记 ħammeġ，再用“污点损害名声”记比喻义；排泄义另配如厕场景，按语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a red tinge or a colour that is somewhat red.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色有些发红或略带红色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn kemxejn aħmar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微红的；略带红色的。

formal.mt: L-artist uża lewn ħamrani biex ipinġi s-sema filgħaxija.
formal.en: The artist used a reddish hue to paint the evening sky.
formal.zh: 画家用微红的色调描绘傍晚的天空。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kulur huwa aħmar? Mark: Għandu lewn ħamrani, iżda mhuwiex aħmar qawwi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this colour red? Mark: It has a reddish hue, but it isn't bright red.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个颜色是红色吗？Mark：它略带红色，但不是鲜红色。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个颜色是红色吗？
messages.en: Is this colour red?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu lewn ħamrani, iżda mhuwiex aħmar qawwi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu lewn ħamrani, iżda mhuwiex aħmar qawwi.
messages.zh: 它略带红色，但不是鲜红色。
messages.en: It has a reddish hue, but it isn't bright red.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 ħamrani 时，想象白纸上薄薄扫过一层红色：看得出红意，却不一定是鲜红；用“略带红色”整块记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat red in colour or showing a red tinge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色略红或呈现红色色调的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur kemxejn aħmar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微红的；带红色的。
红色的土壤；红土。
红色的泥土；红土。

collocations.en: the red soil of the field

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu lewn ħamri li jidher sew fid-dawl naturali.
formal.en: The sample has a reddish hue that is clearly visible in natural light.
formal.zh: 这个样本呈微红色，在自然光下看得很清楚。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex dan il-ħajt jidher ħamri? Toni: Għażilna żebgħa b'lewn ħamri.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why does this wall look reddish? Toni: We chose paint with a reddish hue.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这面墙为什么看起来有些红？Toni：我们选了带微红色调的油漆。

messages.speaker: Elena (访客)
messages.zh: 这面墙为什么看起来有些红？
messages.en: Why does this wall look reddish?

messages.speaker: Toni (屋主)
messages.zh: 我们选了带微红色调的油漆。
messages.en: We chose paint with a reddish hue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħamri 做两张卡：形容词卡画“微红色调”，名词卡画“一把红土”。用搭配判断词性，不把颜色义和土壤义混在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The material covering the ground in which plants grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖地表、供植物生长的土壤或泥土。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-materjal li jgħatti l-art u li fih jikbru l-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 土壤；泥土。

sense_translations.en_definition: earth; soil (organic material which covers the land)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 泥土；土壤，即覆盖地表的有机物质。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tħawwil, il-ġardinar eżamina l-ħamrija biex jara jekk kinitx niedja biżżejjed.
formal.en: Before planting, the gardener examined the soil to see whether it was moist enough.
formal.zh: 种植前，园丁检查了土壤，看看它是否足够湿润。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi nsaqqi din il-pjanta? Luqa: Mess il-ħamrija l-ewwel; għadha niedja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should I water this plant? Luqa: Touch the soil first; it's still moist.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我要给这株植物浇水吗？Luqa：先摸摸土，它还湿着呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要给这株植物浇水吗？
messages.en: Should I water this plant?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 先摸摸土，它还湿着呢。
messages.en: Touch the soil first; it's still moist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħamrija 和手指触摸花盆泥土的动作一起记：干湿、肥沃都能形容它。这个词指土壤本身，不限定为红土。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number five, used when naming the number or counting on its own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字五；用于说出数字名称或独立数数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tan-numru 5, li jiġi wara erbgħa u qabel sitta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五；数字五。
五，独立使用的数词形式。

formal.mt: L-attività tibda fil-ħamsa ta' filgħaxija u tispiċċa fis-sitta.
formal.en: The activity begins at five in the afternoon and ends at six.
formal.zh: 活动下午五点开始，六点结束。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ħin niltaqgħu? Mark: Fil-ħamsa, ħdejn il-kafetterija.
colloquial.en: Sara: What time shall we meet? Mark: At five, near the café.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们几点见面？Mark：五点，在咖啡馆旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们几点见面？
messages.en: What time shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 五点，在咖啡馆旁边。
messages.en: At five, near the café.

cognitive_memory_aid: 张开一只手的五根手指，说 ħamsa；再把钟面五点配上 fil-ħamsa。把独立数字和报时用法分别练熟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number fifty, equal to five groups of ten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词五十，表示五个十的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 50, jiġifieri ħames gruppi ta' għaxra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五十，表示数量的基数词。
五十。

formal.mt: Il-grupp jinkludi ħamsin student minn skejjel differenti.
formal.en: The group includes fifty students from different schools.
formal.zh: 这个小组包括来自不同学校的五十名学生。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm jiswa dan il-basket? Toni: Ħamsin ewro. Nina: Tajjeb, nieħdu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much does this basket cost? Toni: Fifty euros. Nina: All right, I'll take it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个篮子多少钱？Toni：五十欧元。Nina：好的，我买了。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个篮子多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this basket cost?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.zh: 五十欧元。
messages.en: Fifty euros.

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 好的，我买了。
messages.en: All right, I'll take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画五捆、每捆十根小棒，旁边写 ħamsin＝50；再与 ħamsa＝5 对照朗读，特别留意两个词结尾的不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deceive or cheat someone by acting dishonestly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不诚实的行为欺骗或欺诈他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqarraq b'xi ħadd billi taġixxi b'mod diżonest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；使他人受骗。
背弃协议；不履行已经达成的约定。
欺骗；以不诚实的手段欺诈他人。

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ ħan lix-xerrej billi tah informazzjoni falza dwar il-prodott.
formal.en: The seller deceived the buyer by giving him false information about the product.
formal.zh: 卖家向买家提供有关产品的虚假信息，欺骗了买家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu m'għadux jafda lil Mark? Sara: Għax Mark ħan lil Pawlu dwar il-flus.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Pawlu trust Mark anymore? Sara: Because Mark deceived Pawlu about the money.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 为什么不再信任 Mark 了？Sara：因为 Mark 在钱的事情上骗了 Pawlu。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu m'għadux jafda lil Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu m'għadux jafda lil Mark?
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么不再信任 Mark 了？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu trust Mark anymore?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Mark ħan lil Pawlu dwar il-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Mark ħan lil Pawlu dwar il-flus.
messages.zh: 因为 Mark 在钱的事情上骗了 Pawlu。
messages.en: Because Mark deceived Pawlu about the money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħan 配上“受骗后失去信任”的场景；另用一张写着协议却未履行的卡片记背约义。这些画面用于记义，不代表词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ditch or trench in the ground, often long and narrow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地面上通常狭长的沟或壕沟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Foss fl-art, ħafna drabi twil u dejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沟；沟渠。
壕沟；挖出的长沟。
地面的凹陷处；洼地。
低洼处；斜坡。
沟；壕沟。
深壑；深而宽的裂隙。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema ħaffru ħandaq tul it-triq biex jgħaddu l-pajpijiet tal-ilma.
formal.en: The workers dug a trench along the road to lay the water pipes.
formal.zh: 工人们沿道路挖了一条沟，用来铺设水管。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Oqgħod attent, hemm ħandaq quddiemek! Lara: Grazzi, se ngħaddi min-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Be careful, there's a ditch in front of you! Lara: Thanks, I'll go around the other side.
colloquial.zh: 马克：小心，你前面有条沟！拉拉：谢谢，我从另一边绕过去。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心，你前面有条沟！
messages.en: Be careful, there's a ditch in front of you!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我从另一边绕过去。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll go around the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħandaq 配上路边深沟的画面，再用“深沟”和“挖沟”两个搭配巩固；遇到地形语境时，再联想到洼地或深壑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The soft tissue surrounding the teeth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包围牙齿根部的柔软组织，即牙龈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-laħam artab ta' madwar is-snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牙龈。
牙龈，即牙齿周围的软组织。
沙洲；由沙子堆积形成的浅滩。

formal.mt: Id-dentist eżamina l-ħanek tal-pazjent qabel beda jnaddaf is-snien.
formal.en: The dentist examined the patient's gums before starting to clean the teeth.
formal.zh: 牙医在开始清洁牙齿之前，检查了患者的牙龈。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi uġigħ fil-ħanek. Pawlu: Trid inċempel lid-dentist għalik?
colloquial.en: Nina: My gums hurt. Pawlu: Would you like me to call the dentist for you?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我的牙龈疼。保罗：要我帮你给牙医打电话吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (妻子)
messages.zh: 我的牙龈疼。
messages.en: My gums hurt.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.zh: 要我帮你给牙医打电话吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to call the dentist for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħanek 时先想象牙齿周围的一圈牙龈，并搭配“牙龈疼痛”复述；沙洲义另配一张水中沙滩图，分场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A beetle, an insect with hard outer wing covers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 甲虫，一类具有坚硬外层鞘翅的昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett bil-ġwienaħ ta' barra iebsin li jgħattu l-ġwienaħ tat-titjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甲虫。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudent ra ħanfus iswed miexi fuq werqa.
formal.en: During the observation in the garden, the student saw a black beetle walking on a leaf.
formal.zh: 在花园观察时，学生看见一只黑色甲虫在叶子上爬行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm ħanfus fuq il-mejda! Ben: Se npoġġih barra fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a beetle on the table! Ben: I'll put it outside in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，桌子上有只甲虫！本：我把它放到外面的花园里去。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 看，桌子上有只甲虫！
messages.en: Look, there's a beetle on the table!

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 我把它放到外面的花园里去。
messages.en: I'll put it outside in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħanfus 写在一张甲虫图旁边，突出硬壳和叶片，再朗读“黑色甲虫”“叶子上的甲虫”，用形象与搭配一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kind and compassionate towards others, especially when they are in difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人仁慈、体恤的，尤其会同情和关怀处于困难中的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ħniena u mogħdrija lejn ħaddieħor, speċjalment lejn min jinsab f'diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仁慈的；宽厚的。
对某人表示同情或体恤的。

sense_translations.en_definition: darling (typically in the use of the term of endearment 'ħanini' - 'my darling')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲爱的；宝贝，通常用于亲昵称呼 ħanini，意为“我的宝贝”或“亲爱的”。
亲爱的；心爱的，可用于表达亲昵。

formal.mt: Il-voluntier kien ħanin mal-familja u sema' l-problemi tagħha bil-paċenzja.
formal.en: The volunteer was compassionate towards the family and listened patiently to their problems.
formal.zh: 志愿者体恤这家人的处境，耐心倾听他们的困难。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ħanini, trid ftit te? David: Iva, grazzi. Kemm int ħanina miegħi!
colloquial.en: Anna: Darling, would you like some tea? David: Yes, thank you. You're so kind to me!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：亲爱的，要喝点茶吗？戴维：要，谢谢。你对我真好！

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.zh: 亲爱的，要喝点茶吗？
messages.en: Darling, would you like some tea?

messages.speaker: David (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Kemm int ħanina miegħi!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Kemm int ħanina miegħi!
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。你对我真好！
messages.en: Yes, thank you. You're so kind to me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“温柔递茶”的画面连接 ħanin 的体恤义与 ħanini 的亲昵称呼；再把 bniedem ħanin 和 qalb ħanina 成对朗读，记住形容词形式随所修饰的名词变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of jewellery worn around the neck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在脖子上的首饰，即项链。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġojjellerija li tintlibes madwar l-għonq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 项链。
花环；串成环状或链状的花饰。
领带。

formal.mt: Fil-vetrina tal-mużew hemm ħannieqa tad-deheb b'dekorazzjoni delikata.
formal.en: In the museum display case there is a gold necklace with delicate decoration.
formal.zh: 博物馆的展柜里陈列着一条装饰精巧的金项链。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-ħannieqa kemm tiswa? Rita: Tiswa għoxrin ewro. Trid tipprovaha?
colloquial.en: Sara: How much does this necklace cost? Rita: It costs twenty euros. Would you like to try it on?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条项链多少钱？丽塔：二十欧元。你想试戴吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这条项链多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this necklace cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 二十欧元。你想试戴吗？
messages.en: It costs twenty euros. Would you like to try it on?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħannieqa 画三张词义卡：金项链、鲜花花环、衬衫领带。先熟记项链，再靠材质和服饰语境区分其他义项，不把记忆画面当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small or young pig.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体型小或年幼的猪，即小猪、猪崽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanżir żgħir fl-età jew fid-daqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只小猪。
猪崽；幼猪。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi poġġa l-ħannus f'post nadif u sħun ħdejn ommu.
formal.en: The farmer placed the piglet in a clean, warm place beside its mother.
formal.zh: 农民把小猪安置在它妈妈身旁一个干净、温暖的地方。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Fejn hu l-ħannus? Marija: Qiegħed ħdejn ommu. Ejja narawh bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Luca: Where's the piglet? Marija: It's beside its mother. Let's go and look at it quietly.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：小猪在哪里？玛丽娅：在它妈妈身边。我们轻轻地过去看看它。

messages.speaker: Luca (孩子)
messages.zh: 小猪在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the piglet?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn ommu. Ejja narawh bil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn ommu. Ejja narawh bil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 在它妈妈身边。我们轻轻地过去看看它。
messages.en: It's beside its mother. Let's go and look at it quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħannus 时想象一只依偎在妈妈身边的小猪，再用“喂小猪”的动作帮助回忆；把“小”和“幼”都放进词义卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people buy goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人购买商品的场所，即商店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn in-nies jixtru prodotti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商店；店铺。
商店；零售店。
作坊；工场。
办公室；办事处。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut jiftaħ fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu u jagħlaq fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The shop opens at nine in the morning and closes at six in the evening.
formal.zh: 这家商店上午九点开门，傍晚六点关门。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Il-ħanut għadu miftuħ? Toni: Iva, għandna ħin nidħlu nixtru xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is the shop still open? Toni: Yes, we have time to go in and buy something.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：商店还开着吗？托尼：开着，我们还有时间进去买点东西。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店还开着吗？
messages.en: Is the shop still open?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna ħin nidħlu nixtru xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna ħin nidħlu nixtru xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 开着，我们还有时间进去买点东西。
messages.en: Yes, we have time to go in and buy something.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħanut 想成街边的一间店，再在招牌上添 tal-ħwejjeġ，形成“服装店”。另用工作台和办公桌画面，分别记作坊义与办公室义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop that sells food and everyday household supplies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售食品及日常家用物品的杂货店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut li jbigħ ikel u affarijiet għall-użu ta' kuljum fid-dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食品杂货店。
杂货商店；出售食品等日用品的店铺。

collocations.en: to buy from a grocery shop
to go to the grocery shop

formal.mt: Il-ħanut tal-merċa tal-viċinat jbigħ ħobż, ħalib u prodotti oħra għall-użu ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The neighbourhood grocery shop sells bread, milk and other everyday products.
formal.zh: 社区里的食品杂货店出售面包、牛奶及其他日常用品。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se tgħaddi mill-ħanut tal-merċa? Pawlu: Iva. Trid inġiblek ħobż u ħalib?
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you going to stop by the grocery shop? Pawlu: Yes. Would you like me to get you bread and milk?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你要顺路去食品杂货店吗？保罗：要。需要我给你带面包和牛奶吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.zh: 你要顺路去食品杂货店吗？
messages.en: Are you going to stop by the grocery shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Trid inġiblek ħobż u ħalib?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Trid inġiblek ħobż u ħalib?
messages.zh: 要。需要我给你带面包和牛奶吗？
messages.en: Yes. Would you like me to get you bread and milk?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħanut tal-merċa 整组贴在装有面包和牛奶的购物袋图上：看到购物袋就说完整词组，并用“顺路去杂货店”的对话反复提取。

gloss_zh: 酒吧；经营酒类饮品的店铺

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bar or other establishment where alcoholic drinks are sold for customers to drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售酒类饮品、供顾客饮用的营业场所，即酒吧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jinbiegħ xorb alkoħoliku biex jixorbuh il-klijenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酒吧。

sense_translations.en_definition: bar (business licensed to sell intoxicating beverages)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 获准经营并出售酒精饮料的营业场所；酒吧。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut tax-xorb fil-pjazza jiftaħ kuljum fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The bar in the square opens every day at six in the evening.
formal.zh: 广场上的酒吧每天傍晚六点开门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niltaqgħu fil-ħanut tax-xorb wara x-xogħol? Mark: Iva, niltaqgħu hemm fis-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we meet at the bar after work? Mark: Yes, let's meet there at seven.
colloquial.zh: Maja：下班后我们在酒吧见面好吗？Mark：好，我们七点在那里见。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 下班后我们在酒吧见面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet at the bar after work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我们七点在那里见。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet there at seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组与“下班后到酒吧见面”的画面绑定，练习时连同 fil-ħanut tax-xorb 一起记，表示“在酒吧里”。

gloss_zh: 猛砍；割断；粗暴拨奏；大声叫喊

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slash or cut something violently; also to strum an instrument roughly or make a very loud vocal sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用猛烈、粗暴的动作砍割物体；也可指粗暴地拨奏乐器，或大声说话、尖叫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' xi ħaġa bil-vjolenza; ukoll idoqq strument b'mod goff jew jgħajjat b'leħen għoli ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猛砍；用利器猛划。
割断；切断，使某物分离。
粗暴地拨奏弦乐器。
用极大的声音说话；高声嚷嚷。
尖叫；大声喊叫。
用于猛砍或划割的东西。
猛砍；猛烈地切割。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħanxar il-ħabel b'sikkina sakemm qata' l-parti li kienet imwaħħla.
formal.en: The worker slashed at the rope with a knife until he cut off the part that was attached.
formal.zh: 工人用刀猛割绳子，直到割断了固定着的那一段。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ħanxar il-kitarra hekk? Toni: Kien irrabjat, imma issa qed idoqq bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark strum the guitar so roughly? Toni: He was angry, but now he's playing gently.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 刚才为什么那样粗暴地弹吉他？Toni：他当时在生气，不过现在弹得轻柔了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 刚才为什么那样粗暴地弹吉他？
messages.en: Why did Mark strum the guitar so roughly?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien irrabjat, imma issa qed idoqq bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Kien irrabjat, imma issa qed idoqq bil-mod.
messages.zh: 他当时在生气，不过现在弹得轻柔了。
messages.en: He was angry, but now he's playing gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅夸张画面记义项：猛割绳子、粗暴扫弦、大声叫喊；名词义另记为“执行猛砍的东西”，不要混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pig, sometimes specifically a male pig; also an insulting term for a person who eats excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猪，可泛指不区分性别的猪，也可特指公猪；用于人时可贬指贪吃的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal tar-razzett, kultant speċifikament ir-raġel tal-ispeċi; ukoll kelma ta' disprezz għal persuna li tiekol iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猪。
猪，未说明其性别。
公猪；雄性的猪。
贪吃的人；吃得过多的人，带侮辱或贬损意味。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żamm il-ħanżir f'post nadif u tah ilma frisk kuljum.
formal.en: The farmer kept the pig in a clean place and gave it fresh water every day.
formal.zh: 农民把猪养在干净的地方，每天给它提供新鲜饮水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara l-ħanżir ħdejn iċ-ċint! Pawlu: Rajtu! Qed jiekol, ejja nħalluh bi kwietu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at the pig by the fence! Pawlu: I see it! It's eating; let's leave it in peace.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看围栏旁边那头猪！Pawlu：我看到了！它正在吃东西，我们别打扰它。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 看围栏旁边那头猪！
messages.en: Look at the pig by the fence!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Qed jiekol, ejja nħalluh bi kwietu.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Qed jiekol, ejja nħalluh bi kwietu.
messages.zh: 我看到了！它正在吃东西，我们别打扰它。
messages.en: I see it! It's eating; let's leave it in peace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用农场围栏旁的一头猪记住本义，再单独标注“可指公猪”；指人贪吃时带贬义，不能当作中性的人物称呼。

gloss_zh: 压迫；欺凌；虐待；陷入困境；索取高价

teaching_sense.en_definition: To oppress, dominate, or treat someone cruelly, especially a child, an animal, or someone with less power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 压迫、欺凌或残酷对待他人，尤其指虐待儿童、动物或处于弱势的一方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħkem fuq xi ħadd jew jittrattah ħażin u bi ħruxija, speċjalment tifel, annimal jew persuna bla saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫；使人受到不公正的控制和欺凌。
施行暴虐统治；专横地欺压。
制服；压服，使对方屈从。
陷入困境；生活变得艰难或贫困。

sense_translations.en_definition: to charge sb. a lot of momey
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人索取高额费用；向某人收取很高的价钱。
压服、压迫或以暴虐手段统治。

sense_translations.en_definition: to mistreat, neglect, be cruel to (especially a child or animal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 虐待、疏于照顾或残酷对待，尤指儿童或动物。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif is-sid ħaqar lill-ħaddiema u ċaħħadhom minn jiem ta' mistrieħ.
formal.en: The report describes how the owner oppressed the workers and denied them days of rest.
formal.zh: 报告描述了老板如何压迫工人，并剥夺他们的休息日。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kelb jibża' min-nies? Ben: Is-sid ta' qabel ħaqar lilu. Issa għandu bżonn paċenzja u kura.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the dog afraid of people? Ben: Its previous owner treated it cruelly. Now it needs patience and care.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这只狗为什么怕人？Ben：它以前的主人虐待过它。现在它需要耐心和照顾。

messages.speaker: Sara (领养者)
messages.zh: 这只狗为什么怕人？
messages.en: Why is the dog afraid of people?

messages.speaker: Ben (动物收容所工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sid ta' qabel ħaqar lilu. Issa għandu bżonn paċenzja u kura.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sid ta' qabel ħaqar lilu. Issa għandu bżonn paċenzja u kura.
messages.zh: 它以前的主人虐待过它。现在它需要耐心和照顾。
messages.en: Its previous owner treated it cruelly. Now it needs patience and care.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“强者欺压弱者”作为主要记忆画面，联想到受压迫的工人与受虐待的动物；“陷入困境”和“索取高价”另列义项卡。

gloss_zh: 应得；公正；功绩；价值；该死（感叹）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deserve something because of one's actions, qualities, or the value of one's work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因行为、品质或工作价值而应当得到某种待遇、评价或回报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun jistħoqqlu xi ħaġa minħabba l-għemil tiegħu, il-kwalitajiet tiegħu jew il-valur ta' xogħlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应得；值得获得。
正义；公正。
功绩；值得肯定或奖赏之处。
某物的价值。
公正；公平的判断或裁决。
该死；真倒霉；可恶，用于咒骂或表达强烈不满。

formal.mt: Dan ix-xogħol ħaqqu tifħir għall-preċiżjoni tiegħu u għall-kura li turi kull paġna.
formal.en: This work deserves praise for its precision and for the care evident on every page.
formal.zh: 这份作品准确严谨，每一页都体现出用心，因此值得赞扬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fl-aħħar spiċċajt il-proġett! Mark: Prosit! Ħaqqek ftit mistrieħ wara dak ix-xogħol kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I've finally finished the project! Mark: Well done! You deserve some rest after all that work.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我终于完成这个项目了！Mark：干得好！做了那么多工作，你该好好休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我终于完成这个项目了！
messages.en: I've finally finished the project!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Prosit! Ħaqqek ftit mistrieħ wara dak ix-xogħol kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Prosit! Ħaqqek ftit mistrieħ wara dak ix-xogħol kollu.
messages.zh: 干得好！做了那么多工作，你该好好休息一下。
messages.en: Well done! You deserve some rest after all that work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“努力后应得奖赏”记动词用法，例如 ħaqqek premju；名词“公正、功绩、价值”和感叹用法分别标记，按句中作用辨认。

gloss_zh: 咒骂；据理力争；与人争辩；坚持主张

teaching_sense.en_definition: To argue forcefully or insist on a claim; it can also mean to curse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强硬地争辩、据理力争或坚持某项主张；也可表示咒骂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jargumenta bil-qawwa jew jinsisti fuq dak li jgħid; jista' wkoll ifisser li jisħet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咒骂；诅咒。
坚定地争辩；据理力争。
与某人争辩或争论。
争辩；坚称或明确坚持某项主张。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant ħaqqaq dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tal-ftehim u insista fuq ħlas ġust għall-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The representative argued firmly about the terms of the agreement and insisted on fair pay for the workers.
formal.zh: 代表就协议条款据理力争，坚持要求给予工人公平的报酬。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ħaqqaq miegħek? Toni: Ma qbilniex fuq il-prezz, imma issa kollox sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark argue with you? Toni: We disagreed about the price, but everything is fine now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 为什么和你争辩？Toni：我们对价格有分歧，不过现在已经没事了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么和你争辩？
messages.en: Why did Mark argue with you?

messages.speaker: Toni (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qbilniex fuq il-prezz, imma issa kollox sew.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qbilniex fuq il-prezz, imma issa kollox sew.
messages.zh: 我们对价格有分歧，不过现在已经没事了。
messages.en: We disagreed about the price, but everything is fine now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象顾客拿着价签坚持自己的理由，记住“争辩、坚称”；用 ma' 连接争辩对象，用 dwar 引出争论话题，咒骂义另记。

gloss_zh: 排便（粗俗）；粪便；街坊；自负；麻烦；坏人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To defecate; a vulgar verb meaning to pass solid bodily waste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排出粪便，即“拉屎”，属于粗俗表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-ħmieġ solidu mill-ġisem; verb meqjus vulgari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排便；排出粪便。
拉屎，粗俗用语。
屎，粗俗用语。
粪便；排泄物。
一个街坊；一片邻里居住区。
某人居住的那条街；自家所在的街坊。
街区；邻里地区。
拉屎；排便，粗俗用语。

sense_translations.en_definition: (with fi) to overwear a piece of clothing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 fi 连用，指一件衣服穿得过久或过于频繁，以致穿旧、穿坏。
屎；粪便，粗俗用语。
自负；自大。
麻烦；困境。
坏人；恶人，带贬损意味。
混账东西；烂人，用于辱骂人的强烈粗俗称呼。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-verb 'ħara' jiddeskrivi l-att tad-defekazzjoni u għandu reġistru vulgari.
formal.en: In this example, the verb 'ħara' describes the act of defecation and has a vulgar register.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，动词 ħara 描述排便行为，属于粗俗语体。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-kelb ħara fil-bitħa. Sara: Rajt. Se niġbor il-ħmieġ u naħsel il-post.
colloquial.en: Mark: The dog shat in the yard. Sara: I saw. I'll pick up the mess and wash the area.
colloquial.zh: Mark：狗在院子里拉屎了。Sara：我看到了。我会把粪便清理掉，再冲洗那里。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 狗在院子里拉屎了。
messages.en: The dog shat in the yard.

messages.speaker: Sara (养狗的室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt. Se niġbor il-ħmieġ u naħsel il-post.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt. Se niġbor il-ħmieġ u naħsel il-post.
messages.zh: 我看到了。我会把粪便清理掉，再冲洗那里。
messages.en: I saw. I'll pick up the mess and wash the area.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分栏记忆同形词：动作栏写“拉屎”，物质栏写“粪便”，地点栏写“街坊”；衣服穿坏及贬义用法另列，避免见词就套同一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To run away or escape from a place, danger, or confinement; also to avoid someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某处、危险或拘禁中逃跑、逃脱；也可表示躲开或回避某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlaq biex jeħles minn post, periklu jew priġunerija; ukoll jevita lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃跑；跑开。
逃脱；逃离受困或受限制的处境。
躲避或回避某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to escape, to run away; to avoid
sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃脱；逃跑；躲开或回避。

formal.mt: Il-priġunier ħarab mill-ħabs matul il-lejl, u l-pulizija bdew ifittxuh filgħodu.
formal.en: The prisoner escaped from prison during the night, and the police began searching for him in the morning.
formal.zh: 囚犯在夜间越狱，警方早晨开始搜寻他。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-qattus? Pawlu: Ħarab mill-bieb meta ftaħtu, imma għadu fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where's the cat? Pawlu: It ran out through the door when I opened it, but it's still in the garden.
colloquial.zh: Nina：猫在哪里？Pawlu：我开门时它从门口跑出去了，不过还在花园里。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 猫在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the cat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养猫的室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħarab mill-bieb meta ftaħtu, imma għadu fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Ħarab mill-bieb meta ftaħtu, imma għadu fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 我开门时它从门口跑出去了，不过还在花园里。
messages.en: It ran out through the door when I opened it, but it's still in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开门时猫突然逃向花园，记住“逃跑、逃脱”；再把场景换成故意躲开某个人，帮助区分“回避某人”的义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To burn something with fire or damage it through excessive heat; also used for recording data onto a disc.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用火烧某物，或因过热而把某物烧坏；也可指把数据刻录到光盘上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħraq xi ħaġa bin-nar jew jagħmlilha ħsara bis-sħana żejda; jintuża wkoll meta jirrekordja dejta fuq diska.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烧；燃烧；烧坏。
把某物放到火上烧；付之一炬。

sense_translations.en_definition: to burn a disc (CD, DVD etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刻录光盘，如 CD、DVD 等。
惹恼某人；使某人愤怒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to look for in every place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 到处寻找；找遍各处。
吸烟；抽烟。
挥霍金钱；大手大脚地花钱。

formal.mt: Il-kok ħaraq il-ħobż għax ħallieh fil-forn għal żmien twil wisq.
formal.en: The cook burned the bread because he left it in the oven for too long.
formal.zh: 厨师把面包烤焦了，因为他把面包放在烤箱里的时间太长。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara lill-karta? Lara: Ħija ħaraqha bi żball, imma ħadd ma weġġa'.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened to the paper? Lara: My brother burned it by mistake, but nobody was hurt.
colloquial.zh: Mark：那张纸怎么了？Lara：我哥哥不小心把它烧了，不过没有人受伤。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那张纸怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the paper?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ħaraqha bi żball, imma ħadd ma weġġa'.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ħaraqha bi żball, imma ħadd ma weġġa'.
messages.zh: 我哥哥不小心把它烧了，不过没有人受伤。
messages.en: My brother burned it by mistake, but nobody was hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaraq 配上纸张着火的画面，再用中文“烧钱”联想挥霍义；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 犁地；耕作；胜过；裁剪；疾走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To plough or work the soil in preparation for growing crops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翻耕或整治土地，为种植农作物做准备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqalleb jew jaħdem il-ħamrija biex iħejji l-art għaż-żrigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犁地；用犁翻土。
耕作土地；翻耕田地。

sense_translations.en_definition: to beat at sport (especially a race)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在体育比赛中击败对手，尤指在竞速比赛中获胜。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cut out parts of an item of clothing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 裁出一件衣物所需的各个部分。
超过；胜过；把对方甩在后面。
匆忙行走；快步赶路。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cut out parts of a garment
sense_translations.zh_definition: 裁剪衣服的各个组成部分。

collocations.en: outstripped his opponents in the race
collocations.zh: 在赛跑中远远超过了对手

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħarat l-għalqa qabel ma żera' l-qamħ.
formal.en: The farmer ploughed the field before sowing the wheat.
formal.zh: 农民在播种小麦之前犁了田地。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Il-bidwi diġà ħarat l-għalqa? Pawlu: Iva, ħaratha dalgħodu. Issa jista' jiżra'.
colloquial.en: Eva: Has the farmer already ploughed the field? Pawlu: Yes, he ploughed it this morning. Now he can sow.
colloquial.zh: Eva：农民已经犁好田了吗？Pawlu：是的，他今天早上犁好了。现在可以播种了。

messages.speaker: Eva (学生)
messages.zh: 农民已经犁好田了吗？
messages.en: Has the farmer already ploughed the field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħaratha dalgħodu. Issa jista' jiżra'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħaratha dalgħodu. Issa jista' jiżra'.
messages.zh: 是的，他今天早上犁好了。现在可以播种了。
messages.en: Yes, he ploughed it this morning. Now he can sow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħarat 时先想象犁翻开整片田地；遇到比赛语境，再切换成选手一路超过对手的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fleeing or remaining in hiding to avoid being caught.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正在逃跑，或为了避免被抓住而处于逃亡、躲藏状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li qed jaħrab jew jistaħba biex ma jinqabadx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃亡的；潜逃中的；为避免被捕而躲藏的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi raġel ħarban li qed jistaħba f'dar abbandunata.
formal.en: The report describes a fugitive man who is hiding in an abandoned house.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一名躲藏在废弃房屋中的逃亡男子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħarban fl-istorja? Marija: Hu priġunier li ħarab mill-ħabs u issa qed jistaħba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that fugitive man in the story? Marija: He is a prisoner who escaped from prison and is now hiding.
colloquial.zh: Nina：故事里那个逃亡的男人是谁？Marija：他是一名越狱的囚犯，现在正躲藏着。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħarban fl-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħarban fl-istorja?
messages.zh: 故事里那个逃亡的男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that fugitive man in the story?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu priġunier li ħarab mill-ħabs u issa qed jistaħba.
messages.mt_standard: Hu priġunier li ħarab mill-ħabs u issa qed jistaħba.
messages.zh: 他是一名越狱的囚犯，现在正躲藏着。
messages.en: He is a prisoner who escaped from prison and is now hiding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarban 当作人物旁边的“逃亡中”标签来记，想象故事里的人躲进废屋，突出它描述状态的形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage something badly, put things in disorder, or disrupt an activity or plan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 严重破坏某物，把东西弄乱，或打乱活动与计划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsara kbira, iqiegħed l-affarijiet f'diżordni jew ifixkel attività jew pjan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严重破坏；摧毁；使遭受重创。
把东西弄乱；使失去秩序。
破坏者；搞破坏的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to disrupt, devastate, to cause chaos and disarray
sense_translations.zh_definition: 扰乱；严重破坏；造成混乱和无序。

collocations.en: made a mess of the room

formal.mt: Il-maltemp ħarbat il-pjanijiet tal-vjaġġ, u l-grupp kellu jibqa' d-dar.
formal.en: The bad weather disrupted the travel plans, and the group had to stay at home.
formal.zh: 恶劣天气打乱了旅行计划，大家只好待在家里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ħarbat il-kamra? Mark: It-tfal ħarbtuha waqt il-logħob; issa se nirranġawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who made a mess of the room? Mark: The children messed it up while playing; now we will tidy it together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁把房间弄乱了？Mark：孩子们玩的时候弄乱的；现在我们会一起收拾。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁把房间弄乱了？
messages.en: Who made a mess of the room?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfal ħarbtuha waqt il-logħob; issa se nirranġawha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfal ħarbtuha waqt il-logħob; issa se nirranġawha flimkien.
messages.zh: 孩子们玩的时候弄乱的；现在我们会一起收拾。
messages.en: The children messed it up while playing; now we will tidy it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“整齐房间被弄乱、旅行计划被打乱”两幅画面记 ħarbat；另把名词义单独标成“破坏者”。

gloss_zh: 潦草书写；乱涂；涂鸦；把事情做糟

teaching_sense.en_definition: To write or draw carelessly, producing untidy marks, notes, or doodles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不工整地写字或画画，留下潦草的字迹、笔记或涂鸦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikteb jew ipinġi bla reqqa, b'marki, noti jew tpinġijiet mhux puliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潦草地写；乱写乱画。
随手涂画；漫不经心地涂鸦。
乱写；涂鸦；不认真、潦草地书写。
把某件事做得很差；做得马虎或糟糕。

formal.mt: L-istudent ħarbex xi noti fil-marġni tal-paġna waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The student scribbled some notes in the margin of the page during the lesson.
formal.zh: 学生上课时在页边空白处潦草地记了些笔记。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistax naqra din in-nota? Ben: Ħija ħarbex kollox bl-għaġla. Se niktibha mill-ġdid b'mod ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't I read this note? Ben: My brother scribbled everything in a hurry. I will rewrite it clearly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张便条怎么读不清楚？Ben：我哥哥匆忙间把所有内容都写得很潦草。我会重新写清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax naqra din in-nota?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax naqra din in-nota?
messages.zh: 这张便条怎么读不清楚？
messages.en: Why can't I read this note?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ħarbex kollox bl-għaġla. Se niktibha mill-ġdid b'mod ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ħarbex kollox bl-għaġla. Se niktibha mill-ġdid b'mod ċar.
messages.zh: 我哥哥匆忙间把所有内容都写得很潦草。我会重新写清楚。
messages.en: My brother scribbled everything in a hurry. I will rewrite it clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarbex 写在一张模拟的潦草便条旁，联想“字迹乱、随手画”；做事义则记作“做得马虎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To direct one's eyes towards something, or to guard and protect someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把目光投向某人或某物；也指看守、守护或保护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idawwar ħarstu lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew jgħasses u jipproteġi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 看；把目光投向某处。
观看；留意观察。
保护；守护。
监视；持续观察某人或某物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pass the time doing nothing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 无所事事地消磨时间；闲待着。
盯着看；凝视。
幽灵；鬼影。
鬼；幽灵。
看；瞥一眼。
看着；观察。

sense_translations.en_definition: to guard; to watch over; to protect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 看守；照看；守护；保护。

sense_translations.en_definition: to observe; to keep (e.g. a commandment)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遵守；恪守，如遵守诫命。
鬼；幽灵；鬼影。

formal.mt: Il-gwardjan ħares il-bini matul il-lejl biex ħadd ma jidħol mingħajr permess.
formal.en: The guard protected the building during the night so that nobody would enter without permission.
formal.zh: 警卫夜间守护着大楼，防止任何人未经许可进入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħares lejn dik id-dgħajsa! Toni: Iva, qed naraha. Kemm hi sabiħa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that boat! Toni: Yes, I can see it. How beautiful it is!
colloquial.zh: Maja：看那条船！Toni：嗯，我看到了。真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那条船！
messages.en: Look at that boat!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed naraha. Kemm hi sabiħa!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed naraha. Kemm hi sabiħa!
messages.zh: 嗯，我看到了。真漂亮！
messages.en: Yes, I can see it. How beautiful it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“看”和“看守”帮助区分 ħares 的常用动词义；名词“幽灵”另做一张词卡，避免混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 出去；离开；取出；出版；公开；结果是

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go or come out of a place; also to appear, become public, or be published.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个地方出去或出来；也指事物出现、公开或出版。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ minn post għal barra; jingħad ukoll dwar xi ħaġa li tidher, issir magħrufa jew tiġi ppubblikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退出；从某处出去。
离开某处。
出去；外出。
把某物拿出来；取出某物。
被出版；问世。
被公开；被公布。
参加竞选；作为候选人参选。

sense_translations.en_definition: to go out, to come out, to exit
sense_translations.zh_definition: 出去；出来；离开内部空间。
与某人一起消磨时间；与某人来往。
离开；辞职；退出职务。
放弃；离弃。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pull out; to send out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拔出；抽出；派出；发出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become known; to come out (as of the truth)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得为人所知；显露出来，如真相大白。
结果是；最终呈现出某种情况。
结果良好；做出来的效果好。
出现可见症状；发出或长出疹子等症状。
侵蚀；腐蚀。
提供所需的手段、资源或费用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to come out of the closet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 出柜；公开自己的性取向或性别身份。
出版；刊行；发布作品或材料。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ħareġ illum u fih informazzjoni ġdida dwar il-proġett.
formal.en: The report came out today and contains new information about the project.
formal.zh: 报告于今天发布，其中包含有关该项目的新信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu Mark? Toni: Ħareġ mid-dar ftit ilu; se jerġa' lura dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Mark? Toni: He went out of the house a little while ago; he will be back soon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 在哪里？Toni：他刚出门不久，很快就会回来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħareġ mid-dar ftit ilu; se jerġa' lura dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Ħareġ mid-dar ftit ilu; se jerġa' lura dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 他刚出门不久，很快就会回来。
messages.en: He went out of the house a little while ago; he will be back soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“人走出来、书出版出来、真相显露出来”三幅画面记 ħareġ 的常用义；其余义项另配语境记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The season between summer and winter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夏季与冬季之间的季节，即秋季。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istaġun ta' bejn is-sajf u x-xitwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秋天；秋季。
秋季，指一年中夏季之后、冬季之前的季节。

formal.mt: Fil-ħarifa, il-ġranet jibdew jitqassru u t-temperatura tonqos.
formal.en: In autumn, the days begin to grow shorter and the temperature falls.
formal.zh: 秋天，白昼开始变短，气温下降。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema staġun jogħġbok l-aktar? Mark: Il-ħarifa, għax ma jkunx hemm is-sħana tas-sajf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which season do you like best? Mark: Autumn, because it isn't as hot as summer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最喜欢哪个季节？马克：秋天，因为没有夏天那么热。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最喜欢哪个季节？
messages.en: Which season do you like best?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħarifa, għax ma jkunx hemm is-sħana tas-sajf.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħarifa, għax ma jkunx hemm is-sħana tas-sajf.
messages.zh: 秋天，因为没有夏天那么热。
messages.en: Autumn, because it isn't as hot as summer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarifa 放在“夏天结束、冬天未到”的季节画面里，再用 fil-ħarifa 整体记住“在秋天”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fine, soft fibre produced by silkworms, or fabric made from this fibre.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蚕产生的细软纤维，或用这种纤维织成的丝绸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fibra fina u ratba prodotta mid-dud tal-ħarir, jew drapp magħmul minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丝；丝绸。
顺利地；成功地；毫无阻碍地。

formal.mt: Il-libsa hija magħmula mill-ħarir u għandha tinħasel skont l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: The dress is made of silk and should be washed according to the instructions on the label.
formal.zh: 这件连衣裙由丝绸制成，应按照标签上的说明清洗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Mark: Kollox mar ħarir; spiċċajna fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the meeting go? Mark: Everything went smoothly; we finished on time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：会议进行得怎么样？马克：一切都很顺利，我们按时结束了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 会议进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 一切都很顺利，我们按时结束了。
messages.en: Everything went smoothly; we finished on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“丝绸摸起来顺滑，事情进行得顺利”串联两个词义；这是记忆联想，名词“丝绸”和副词“顺利地”要分开使用。

gloss_zh: 鱼叉；捕猎大型海洋动物的叉枪

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long, pointed weapon used to catch large fish or other sea animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于捕捉大鱼或其他海洋动物的长柄尖头武器，即鱼叉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda twila bil-ponta li tintuża biex jinqabad ħut kbir jew annimali oħra tal-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鱼叉；用于捕捉大鱼或海洋动物的尖头叉具。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi ħarpun antik flimkien ma' għodod oħra tas-sajd.
formal.en: The museum displays an old harpoon alongside other fishing tools.
formal.zh: 博物馆将一把旧鱼叉与其他捕鱼工具一同展出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak wara l-ħġieġ? Pawlu: Dak ħarpun; kien jintuża għas-sajd.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that behind the glass? Pawlu: That's a harpoon; it was used for fishing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：玻璃后面那个是什么？保罗：那是鱼叉，以前用来捕鱼。

messages.en: That's a harpoon; it was used for fishing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħarpun 与博物馆里一把长长的尖头鱼叉配成画面，再用“鱼叉的尖端”这个搭配巩固具体形象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An absorbent cloth or garment worn by a baby to collect urine and faeces; a nappy or diaper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 婴儿穿用、用于吸收尿液和承接粪便的布或用品，即尿布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp jew oġġett assorbenti li jintlibes minn tarbija biex jiġbor l-awrina u l-ħmieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛巾布；尿布。
尿布；婴儿用的尿片。
一次燃烧或焚烧。

formal.mt: Qabel ma tbiddel il-ħarqa tat-tarbija, aħsel idejk u ħejji ħarqa nadifa.
formal.en: Before changing the baby's nappy, wash your hands and prepare a clean nappy.
formal.zh: 给婴儿换尿布前，先洗手并准备好一片干净的尿布。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tista' ġġibli ħarqa nadifa? Mark: Iva, hemm waħda fil-borża tat-tarbija.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you bring me a clean nappy? Mark: Yes, there's one in the baby's bag.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你能给我拿一片干净的尿布吗？马克：可以，宝宝的包里有一片。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 你能给我拿一片干净的尿布吗？
messages.en: Can you bring me a clean nappy?

messages.en: Yes, there's one in the baby's bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 ħarqa 放进“宝宝换尿布”的生活场景；另做一张“燃烧一次”的词义卡，用上下文区分这两个意思。

gloss_zh: 热；暖意；炙烤；酸涩味；真诚；炎热的；干燥的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Heat or warmth, especially strong heat felt in hot weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 热或暖意，尤指炎热天气中感受到的强烈热气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sħana, speċjalment sħana qawwija li tinħass f'temp sħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酸涩的味道；尖锐的酸味。
热；热气。
灼烧；炙烤。
被烤焦的；被灼烧的。
干了的；被弄干的。
热；温暖；暖意。
真诚；诚挚。
干旱的；干燥少水的。
热的；温暖的。

formal.mt: Il-ħarr tas-sajf jagħmel ix-xogħol fl-għelieqi aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The summer heat makes work in the fields more difficult.
formal.zh: 夏季的炎热使田间劳作更加艰难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'dan il-ħarr, immorru nimxu issa? Mark: Aħjar nistennew sa filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go for a walk now in this heat? Mark: We'd better wait until the evening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这么热，我们现在去散步吗？马克：最好等到傍晚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这么热，我们现在去散步吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a walk now in this heat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 最好等到傍晚。
messages.en: We'd better wait until the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 以“夏日热浪”为主画面记住名词“热”，再把酸涩味、真诚以及几个形容词义分格记录，避免把不同词性混成一个意思。

gloss_zh: 打耳光；使人耕地；耕地者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slap someone in the face; also, to cause someone to plough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打某人的耳光；也可表示使某人耕地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta daqqa ta' ħarta lil xi ħadd f'wiċċu; ukoll, ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jaħrat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to slap sb. in the face
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打某人的耳光。
使人耕地；使土地得到犁耕。
犁田者；从事耕地的人。
耕地者；操作犁进行耕作的人。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel ħarrat lill-ġar tiegħu waqt argument.
formal.en: The witness said that the man slapped his neighbour in the face during an argument.
formal.zh: 证人说，那名男子在争吵时打了邻居一耳光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex telaq Mark? Pawlu: Għax Toni ħarrat lilu waqt l-argument.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark leave? Pawlu: Because Toni slapped him in the face during the argument.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么走了？保罗：因为托尼争吵时打了他一耳光。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Toni ħarrat lilu waqt l-argument.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Toni ħarrat lilu waqt l-argument.
messages.zh: 因为托尼争吵时打了他一耳光。
messages.en: Because Toni slapped him in the face during the argument.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħarrat 画两张独立场景卡：争吵中的耳光、田里的犁耕；再用“做动作”与“做事的人”区分动词和名词。

gloss_zh: 使粗糙；惹恼；使恶化；使事情更糟的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a surface rougher, irritate someone, or make a problem or situation worse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使表面变得粗糙；惹恼某人；使问题或局势恶化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel wiċċ aktar aħrax, irrita lil xi ħadd, jew għamel problema jew sitwazzjoni agħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变粗糙；使表面不再光滑。
使某人烦躁；惹恼某人。
使物体表面变粗糙的人。
使事情变得更糟的人；使局面恶化的人。
使加重；使问题或局势恶化。

collocations.en: roughened the surface of the wood

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' komunikazzjoni ħarrax is-sitwazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ gruppi.
formal.en: The lack of communication made the situation between the two groups worse.
formal.zh: 缺乏沟通使两个群体之间的局势进一步恶化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kumment tiegħu għen? Mark: Le, ħarrax is-sitwazzjoni u kulħadd beda jargumenta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did his comment help? Mark: No, it made the situation worse and everyone started arguing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他那句话有帮助吗？马克：没有，反而使情况更糟，大家都争吵起来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 他那句话有帮助吗？
messages.en: Did his comment help?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħarrax is-sitwazzjoni u kulħadd beda jargumenta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħarrax is-sitwazzjoni u kulħadd beda jargumenta.
messages.zh: 没有，反而使情况更糟，大家都争吵起来了。
messages.en: No, it made the situation worse and everyone started arguing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想“木面变粗糙，气氛也变得难受”：前者帮助记住使粗糙，后者帮助记住惹恼和恶化；名词义另记为造成这些变化的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To invent stories or tell things that are not true, either as fiction or as fibs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 编造故事，或说出不真实的事情；可指虚构叙述，也可指说假话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ivvinta stejjer jew qal affarijiet li mhumiex veri, bħala stejjer immaġinarji jew bħala gideb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编故事；虚构故事内容。
说假话；讲述不真实的事情。

sense_translations.en_definition: to tell fibs, make up stories
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说小谎；编造故事。

collocations.en: made up stories about a journey
collocations.zh: 编造有关一次旅行的故事

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru prinċipali ħarref dwar vjaġġ li qatt ma għamel.
formal.en: In the story, the main character made up an account of a journey he had never taken.
formal.zh: 在这篇故事中，主人公编造了一段自己从未有过的旅行经历。

colloquial.en: Lara: Is it true that Pawlu saw a dog flying? Mark: No, he made it up to make us laugh.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗真的看见一只狗在飞吗？马克：没有，他编出来逗我们笑的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Veru li Pawlu ra kelb itir?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人绘声绘色地讲“会飞的狗”，把 ħarref 记成“编出来讲”；再看语境判断是在讲虚构故事，还是在说假话。

gloss_zh: 搅动；移动；摇动；唤起；起诉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something move, stir or shake it; also to arouse a response or bring legal proceedings against someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物移动、搅动或摇动；也可指唤起反应，或对某人提起法律诉讼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel xi ħaġa tiċċaqlaq, iħawwadha jew iheżżiżha; ukoll iqajjem reazzjoni jew jiftaħ kawża kontra xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搅动某物。
移动某物，使某物改变位置。
摇动或晃动某物。
对某人提起诉讼。
对某人提起刑事诉讼。
使移动；使搅动。
唤起、激起某种感受或反应。

sense_translations.en_definition: to sue ('someone in court'); to cite
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向法院起诉某人；传唤某人到庭。

formal.mt: Il-klijent ħarrek lill-kumpanija fil-qorti wara li din naqset milli twettaq l-obbligi tagħha.
formal.en: The client sued the company in court after it failed to fulfil its obligations.
formal.zh: 该公司未能履行义务后，客户向法院对其提起诉讼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tħarrek il-mejda ftit lejn it-tieqa? Mark: Iva, imma għinni nneħħi l-kotba minn fuqha l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you move the table a little towards the window? Mark: Yes, but help me take the books off it first.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能把桌子往窗边挪一点吗？Mark：可以，不过先帮我把上面的书拿下来。
