cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅场景记忆：搅汤、挪桌、到法院起诉；见到这个词，先靠宾语判断具体意思。

gloss_zh: 使产生性欲；引起性兴奋

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel sexual desire or become sexually aroused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生性欲或进入性兴奋状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem xewqa sesswali f'xi ħadd jew iġiegħlu jħoss eċċitament sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使产生性兴奋。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause lust, to arouse sexually
sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起性欲；使某人产生性兴奋。

collocations.en: sexually arouse the reader with an erotic description
collocations.zh: 以情色描写引起读者的性兴奋

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi letterarja, il-kritiku jiddiskuti kif it-test ħarrem lill-qarrej adult permezz tad-deskrizzjonijiet erotiċi.
formal.en: In the literary analysis, the critic discusses how the text sexually aroused the adult reader through its erotic descriptions.
formal.zh: 在文学分析中，评论者讨论文本如何通过情色描写引起成年读者的性兴奋。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta tgħid li test ħarrem lil xi ħadd, tfisser li qajjem fih xewqa sesswali? Pawlu: Iva, hawnhekk qed nitkellmu dwar eċċitament sesswali.
colloquial.en: Lara: When you say that a text sexually aroused someone, do you mean that it stirred sexual desire in them? Pawlu: Yes, here we are talking about sexual arousal.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你说一篇文字让某人产生性兴奋，是指它引起了那个人的性欲吗？Pawlu：对，这里说的是性兴奋。

messages.speaker: Lara (成年学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid li test ħarrem lil xi ħadd, tfisser li qajjem fih xewqa sesswali?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid li test ħarrem lil xi ħadd, tfisser li qajjem fih xewqa sesswali?
messages.zh: 你说一篇文字让某人产生性兴奋，是指它引起了那个人的性欲吗？

messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawnhekk qed nitkellmu dwar eċċitament sesswali.

gloss_zh: 讲故事的人；告密者；说谎者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tells stories; depending on context, also a person who tells on others or tells falsehoods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 讲故事的人；视语境也可指向别人告状、泄露他人事情的人，或说谎者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirrakkonta stejjer; skont il-kuntest, ukoll persuna li tikxef għemil ħaddieħor jew tgħid il-gideb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱告状或泄露他人事情的人；告密者。
讲故事的人；故事讲述者。
说谎的人；编造不实之言的人。
讲故事的人；故事讲述者。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa kulturali, ħarrief tas-sengħa rrakkonta storja quddiem udjenza attenta.
formal.en: During the cultural gathering, a skilled storyteller told a story to an attentive audience.
formal.zh: 在文化聚会上，一位技艺娴熟的讲故事者向专注的听众讲述了一个故事。

colloquial.mt: Nina: In-nannu tiegħek ħarrief tajjeb ħafna! Samwel: Iva, kull darba jirrakkonta storja differenti u kulħadd joqgħod jisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Your grandfather is a very good storyteller! Samwel: Yes, he tells a different story every time, and everyone stops to listen to him.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你爷爷真会讲故事！Samwel：是啊，他每次讲的故事都不同，大家都会停下来听。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷真会讲故事！
messages.en: Your grandfather is a very good storyteller!

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull darba jirrakkonta storja differenti u kulħadd joqgħod jisimgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull darba jirrakkonta storja differenti u kulħadd joqgħod jisimgħu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象围坐听故事的场景；再看语境，分清是在称赞讲述本领，还是批评告密或说谎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Carob: the fruit of Ceratonia siliqua, or the tree that bears it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 角豆树的果实，亦指结这种果实的角豆树，学名为 Ceratonia siliqua。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frott tas-siġra Ceratonia siliqua, jew is-siġra li tagħmel dan il-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 角豆；角豆树。

sense_translations.en_definition: carob (fruit and tree of Ceratonia siliqua L.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 角豆，指角豆树（Ceratonia siliqua L.）的果实，也指这种树本身。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li dan il-prodott fih ġulepp tal-ħarrub.
formal.en: The label indicates that this product contains carob syrup.
formal.zh: 标签注明，这种产品含有角豆糖浆。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek ġulepp tal-ħarrub? Toni: Iva, il-flixkun qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn l-għasel.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have any carob syrup? Toni: Yes, the bottle is on the shelf beside the honey.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你有角豆糖浆吗？Toni：有，瓶子就在蜂蜜旁边的架子上。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 你有角豆糖浆吗？
messages.en: Do you have any carob syrup?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-flixkun qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn l-għasel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-flixkun qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn l-għasel.

messages.en: Yes, the bottle is on the shelf beside the honey.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“树上角豆、瓶中糖浆、袋中粉末”串成购物画面，把同一个词的果实和树木两义连起来。

gloss_zh: 书籍、电影等的简短内容介绍

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short description introducing a book, film or similar work, often intended to attract interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 介绍书籍、电影等作品的简短文字，通常用于吸引读者或观众的兴趣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni qasira ta' ktieb, film jew xogħol simili, spiss maħsuba biex tqajjem l-interess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简短的作品介绍；宣传简介。

sense_translations.en_definition: blurb (short description of a book, film, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 书籍、电影等的简短介绍文字。

formal.mt: Il-pubblikatur talab ħarsetta tal-ktieb biex titqiegħed fuq il-qoxra ta' wara.
formal.en: The publisher requested a book blurb to be placed on the back cover.
formal.zh: 出版商要求撰写一段书籍简介，放在封底上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taf dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Luqa: Aqra l-ħarsetta fuq wara; tagħtik idea tal-istorja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you know what this book is about? Luqa: Read the blurb on the back; it will give you an idea of the story.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你知道这本书讲什么吗？Luqa：读一下背面的简介，就能大致了解故事了。

messages.speaker: Sara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Taf dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 你知道这本书讲什么吗？
messages.en: Do you know what this book is about?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqra l-ħarsetta fuq wara; tagħtik idea tal-istorja.
messages.mt_standard: Aqra l-ħarsetta fuq wara; tagħtik idea tal-istorja.
messages.zh: 读一下背面的简介，就能大致了解故事了。
messages.en: Read the blurb on the back; it will give you an idea of the story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买书时先翻到封底，读一小段就知道大意；把这个阅读动作与“作品简介”绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tip of the nose; in other senses, the cheek or the inside of the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子的尖端；其他义项也可指面颊或鼻子内部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ponta tal-imnieħer; f'tifsiriet oħra, il-ħaddejn jew il-parti ta' ġewwa tal-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻尖；鼻子的最前端。
面颊；脸颊。
鼻子内部；鼻内侧。
面颊；脸颊。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, il-ħartum tal-imnieħer jidher aħmar, filwaqt li l-bqija tal-wiċċ jidher ċar.
formal.en: In the photograph, the tip of the nose appears red, while the rest of the face appears pale.
formal.zh: 照片中，鼻尖显得发红，而脸部其余部分显得苍白。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi xi ħaġa fuq il-ħartum tal-imnieħer? David: Iva, ftit żebgħa. Ħa nġiblek maktur.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have I got something on the tip of my nose? David: Yes, a little paint. Let me get you a tissue.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我鼻尖上是不是沾了什么？David：是，沾了点颜料。我给你拿张纸巾。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi xi ħaġa fuq il-ħartum tal-imnieħer?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi xi ħaġa fuq il-ħartum tal-imnieħer?
messages.zh: 我鼻尖上是不是沾了什么？
messages.en: Have I got something on the tip of my nose?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit żebgħa. Ħa nġiblek maktur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit żebgħa. Ħa nġiblek maktur.
messages.zh: 是，沾了点颜料。我给你拿张纸巾。
messages.en: Yes, a little paint. Let me get you a tissue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脸部示意图上分别标出鼻尖、面颊和鼻内侧，逐项配对记忆，再用上下文选择对应部位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young sheep, especially one that is still small.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年幼的绵羊，尤指尚小的羔羊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir tal-ispeċi tan-nagħaġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羔羊；小绵羊。
羔羊，即年幼的绵羊。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi osserva l-ħaruf li kien għadu kif twieled u żgura li kien qrib ommu.
formal.en: The farmer observed the newborn lamb and made sure it was close to its mother.
formal.zh: 农民查看了刚出生的羔羊，并确保它待在母羊身边。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Ara dak il-ħaruf żgħir! Ben: Iva, qed jimxi wara ommu. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Emma: Look at that little lamb! Ben: Yes, it is walking behind its mother. Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: Emma：看那只小羔羊！Ben：是啊，它正跟在妈妈后面。我们就在这里看吧。

messages.speaker: Emma (游客)
messages.zh: 看那只小羔羊！
messages.en: Look at that little lamb!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jimxi wara ommu. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jimxi wara ommu. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.zh: 是啊，它正跟在妈妈后面。我们就在这里看吧。
messages.en: Yes, it is walking behind its mother. Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只刚出生的小绵羊跟着母羊走，把单词与“年幼的羊”这个完整画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: 外出活动；出游；期刊的一期

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outing or trip away from home; also an individual issue of a periodical.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次外出、出游或集体活动；也指报刊等定期出版物的某一期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ jew vjaġġ għal żjara jew divertiment; ukoll numru wieħed ta' pubblikazzjoni perjodika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次外出活动；出游；郊游。
期刊的一期；定期出版物的某期版本。
报刊或杂志的一期。

collocations.en: the latest issue of the magazine

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat ħarġa lejn il-mużew biex l-istudenti jitgħallmu aktar dwar l-istorja lokali.
formal.en: The school organized an outing to the museum so that the students could learn more about local history.
formal.zh: 学校组织了一次博物馆参观活动，让学生进一步了解当地历史。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tiġi għal ħarġa magħna nhar il-Ħadd? Ben: Iva, niġi bil-qalb! Fejn se mmorru?
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like to come on an outing with us on Sunday? Ben: Yes, I'd love to! Where are we going?
colloquial.zh: Sara：星期天想和我们一起出去玩吗？Ben：好啊，我很乐意！我们去哪里？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi għal ħarġa magħna nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi għal ħarġa magħna nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期天想和我们一起出去玩吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come on an outing with us on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niġi bil-qalb! Fejn se mmorru?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niġi bil-qalb! Fejn se mmorru?
messages.zh: 好啊，我很乐意！我们去哪里？
messages.en: Yes, I'd love to! Where are we going?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħarġa 配两张图：一张朋友出游合照，一张杂志封面；分别标上“一次外出”和“某一期”，按语境选义。

gloss_zh: 收割；收获；使吃惊；使惊吓；夺去年轻生命

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reap or harvest crops; also to surprise or startle someone, or to take a life prematurely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收割或收获庄稼；也指使某人吃惊、受惊，或过早夺去生命。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' u jiġbor il-ħsad; ukoll jissorprendi jew ibeżża' lil xi ħadd għal għarrieda, jew itemm ħajja qabel iż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收割庄稼。
收获农作物。
使吃惊；使感到意外。
使某人突然受惊；吓某人一跳。

sense_translations.en_definition: to kill or execute at a young age
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某人年纪尚轻时将其杀死或处决。
收获；收割农作物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to take (the life of); to kill prematurely (usually through illness or accident)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 夺去生命；使人过早死亡，通常指因疾病或事故而丧生。

collocations.mt: ħasad lil xi ħadd b'ħoss qawwi
collocations.en: startled someone with a loud noise

collocations.zh: 夺去了一条年轻的生命

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħasad il-qamħ meta kien misjur, qabel bdiet ix-xita.
formal.en: The farmer harvested the wheat when it was ripe, before the rain began.
formal.zh: 农民在小麦成熟后、下雨之前完成了收割。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dak il-ħoss ħasadni! X'kien? Ġanni: Il-bieb għalaq bis-saħħa minħabba r-riħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: That noise startled me! What was it? Ġanni: The door slammed shut because of the wind.
colloquial.zh: Rita：那声音吓了我一跳！是什么声音？Ġanni：风把门猛地吹关上了。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 那声音吓了我一跳！是什么声音？
messages.en: That noise startled me! What was it?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.zh: 风把门猛地吹关上了。
messages.en: The door slammed shut because of the wind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三张场景卡记忆：田里收割、巨响惊吓、生命早逝；每次读句子时先找庄稼、声响或生命等线索。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Harm or destruction that affects the condition or usefulness of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物受损、遭到破坏或降低其使用价值的损害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara jew qerda li tolqot il-qagħda jew l-użu ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 损害；损坏；破坏。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħasar li l-maltemp għamel lill-uċuħ tar-raba'.
formal.en: The report describes the damage that the storm caused to the crops.
formal.zh: 报告描述了暴风雨对农作物造成的损害。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-maltemp għamel ħafna ħasar fl-għalqa? Pawlu: Iva, ħafna mill-ħaxix tħassar u rridu nerġgħu niżirgħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did the storm cause much damage in the field? Pawlu: Yes, much of the vegetable crop was ruined, and we need to sow again.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：暴风雨对田地造成了很大损害吗？保罗：是的，很多蔬菜都毁了，我们得重新播种。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.zh: 暴风雨对田地造成了很大损害吗？
messages.en: Did the storm cause much damage in the field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħafna mill-ħaxix tħassar u rridu nerġgħu niżirgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħafna mill-ħaxix tħassar u rridu nerġgħu niżirgħu.
messages.zh: 是的，很多蔬菜都毁了，我们得重新播种。
messages.en: Yes, much of the vegetable crop was ruined, and we need to sow again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħasar 和暴风雨后的受损田地画面相连：看到倒伏的庄稼，就想到名词“损害”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use the mind to consider something or form an idea or opinion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运用头脑考虑某事，形成想法、判断或看法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża moħħu biex iqis xi ħaġa jew jifforma idea jew opinjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 思考；想；认为。

sense_translations.en_definition: to mistake sth. for sth. else
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物误认为另一物；认错。

sense_translations.en_definition: to plan for sth. in advance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某事预先考虑、作打算或作安排。

formal.mt: Qabel ħa d-deċiżjoni, id-direttur ħaseb sew dwar l-ispejjeż u l-ħtiġijiet tal-proġett.
formal.en: Before making the decision, the director thought carefully about the costs and needs of the project.
formal.zh: 作出决定前，主管仔细考虑了项目的费用和需求。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ġie Mark illum? Luqa: Ħaseb li l-laqgħa kienet illum, imma fil-fatt hija għada.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Mark come today? Luqa: He thought the meeting was today, but it is actually tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：马克为什么今天来了？卢卡：他以为会议在今天，其实是明天。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么今天来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark come today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħaseb li l-laqgħa kienet illum, imma fil-fatt hija għada.
messages.mt_standard: Ħaseb li l-laqgħa kienet illum, imma fil-fatt hija għada.
messages.zh: 他以为会议在今天，其实是明天。
messages.en: He thought the meeting was today, but it is actually tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħaseb 配三幅脑内画面：思考问题、认错东西、提前安排；共同抓住“心里怎么想”。

gloss_zh: 洗；浸泡；训斥；洗钱；发生；忽然明白

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clean a person, an object, or a part of the body using water, often with soap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水，通常配合肥皂，清洗人、物品或身体部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaddaf persuna, oġġett jew parti tal-ġisem bl-ilma, spiss bis-sapun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗；清洗。
浸泡；使浸湿或湿透。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give sb. a dressing down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 严厉训斥某人；把某人狠狠责备一顿。
洗钱；通过交易等手段掩饰资金的非法来源。
发生；出现。
使某人忽然明白；某人开始意识到。
洗涤衣物等；也指洗钱，即掩饰非法资金的来源。

formal.mt: Qabel beda jħejji l-ikel, il-kok ħasel idejh sew bl-ilma u s-sapun.
formal.en: Before he began preparing the food, the cook washed his hands thoroughly with water and soap.
formal.zh: 开始准备食物前，厨师用水和肥皂仔细洗了手。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min ħasel dawn il-flokkijiet? Mark: Jien ħsilthom dalgħodu; issa tista' tonxorhom.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who washed these T-shirts? Mark: I washed them this morning; you can hang them out now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这些T恤是谁洗的？马克：我今天早上洗的，现在可以把它们晾出去了。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 这些T恤是谁洗的？
messages.en: Who washed these T-shirts?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ħsilthom dalgħodu; issa tista' tonxorhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ħsilthom dalgħodu; issa tista' tonxorhom.
messages.zh: 我今天早上洗的，现在可以把它们晾出去了。
messages.en: I washed them this morning; you can hang them out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“洗手、洗衣”两个动作记住 ħasel 的常用义；训斥、洗钱、发生和忽然明白分别配情境卡记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A capon: a castrated male chicken raised for its meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阉鸡，即为食用而饲养的去势公鸡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serduk ikkastrat li jitrabba għal-laħam.

sense_translations.en_definition: a capon (large chicken which is stuffed)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 阉鸡；此义指用于填馅烹制的大只鸡。
育肥猪；养肥供食用的猪。
阉鸡；去势后饲养供食用的公鸡。
为育肥而去势的猪。
阉人；宦官。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispjega kif timla ħasi u ssajru fil-forn bil-patata.
formal.en: The recipe explains how to stuff a capon and cook it in the oven with potatoes.
formal.zh: 这份食谱说明如何给阉鸡填馅，再配土豆放入烤箱烹制。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'se nsajru għall-ikla tal-Ħadd? Toni: Nistgħu nsajru ħasi bil-patata; nixtrih għada.
colloquial.en: Rita: What shall we cook for Sunday lunch? Toni: We could cook a capon with potatoes; I'll buy it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：星期天午饭我们做什么？托尼：可以做阉鸡配土豆；我明天去买。

messages.speaker: Rita (妻子)
messages.zh: 星期天午饭我们做什么？
messages.en: What shall we cook for Sunday lunch?

messages.speaker: Toni (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nsajru ħasi bil-patata; nixtrih għada.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nsajru ħasi bil-patata; nixtrih għada.
messages.zh: 可以做阉鸡配土豆；我明天去买。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħasi 放进“填馅烤鸡”的餐桌画面记主义；遇到养猪或人物语境，再分别判断育肥猪和阉人义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blind hung over a door or window to provide shade, which can usually be raised or lowered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挂在门或窗上用于遮挡阳光、通常可以升降的帘子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata li jiddendel quddiem bieb jew tieqa biex jilqa' x-xemx u li normalment jista' jittella' jew jitniżżel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a sunblind to protect doors or windows from the sun. Typically, this can be drawn up or down over the door. Traditionally, it was made of bamboo canework, though nowadays it is often made of synthetic materials, such as canvas.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于给门窗遮阳的帘子，通常可以在门前升起或放下；传统上由竹篾编成，如今也常用帆布等材料制作。
席子；席垫。

sense_translations.en_definition: a blind, sunblind (used in Malta on windows as well as doors)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 帘子；遮阳帘，在马耳他用于窗户，也用于门口。

formal.mt: Il-ħasira quddiem il-bieb tnaqqas id-dawl tax-xemx li jidħol fil-kamra.
formal.en: The sunblind in front of the door reduces the sunlight entering the room.
formal.zh: 门前的遮阳帘减少了照进房间的阳光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ix-xemx qed tidħol dritt fuq il-mejda. Ninu: Niżżel il-ħasira ftit, u nkunu nistgħu nieklu fid-dell.
colloquial.en: Lara: The sun is shining straight onto the table. Ninu: Lower the sunblind a little, and we'll be able to eat in the shade.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：阳光正直照到桌子上。尼努：把遮阳帘放下来一点，我们就能在阴凉处吃饭了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xemx qed tidħol dritt fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xemx qed tidħol dritt fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 阳光正直照到桌子上。
messages.en: The sun is shining straight onto the table.

messages.speaker: Ninu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Niżżel il-ħasira ftit, u nkunu nistgħu nieklu fid-dell.
messages.mt_standard: Niżżel il-ħasira ftit, u nkunu nistgħu nieklu fid-dell.
messages.zh: 把遮阳帘放下来一点，我们就能在阴凉处吃饭了。
messages.en: Lower the sunblind a little, and we'll be able to eat in the shade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把 ħasira 从门上放下来挡太阳，记住“遮阳帘”；另把“席垫”画在地上，靠位置区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of pity or regret about someone's suffering or an unfortunate situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人的遭遇感到怜悯，或对不如意的情况感到遗憾、可惜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' mogħdrija għal min ibati jew ta' dispjaċir għal sitwazzjoni sfortunata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怜悯；同情；对不幸情况的惋惜。
遗憾；可惜的事。

sense_translations.en_definition: shame, pity; as in “it’s a shame/pity that...”
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗憾；可惜，用于表达“……真可惜”或“遗憾的是……”。

formal.mt: Hija ħasra li l-attività kellha titħassar minħabba t-temp ħażin.
formal.en: It is a pity that the event had to be cancelled because of the bad weather.
formal.zh: 很遗憾，活动因天气恶劣而不得不取消。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma nistax niġi għall-kunċert illejla. Ben: X'ħasra! Kont qed nittama li niġu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: I can't come to the concert tonight. Ben: What a pity! I was hoping we could go together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我今晚没法来听音乐会。 本：真可惜！我还盼着我们一起去呢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今晚没法来听音乐会。
messages.en: I can't come to the concert tonight.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ħasra! Kont qed nittama li niġu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: X'ħasra! Kont qed nittama li niġu flimkien.
messages.zh: 真可惜！我还盼着我们一起去呢。
messages.en: What a pity! I was hoping we could go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 x'ħasra 整块记成“真可惜”：朋友不能赴约时轻叹一声，就能联想到 ħasra 的遗憾感。

gloss_zh: 感觉；触摸；感官；触觉；生菜

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become aware of a physical sensation, an emotion, or something happening around you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感受到身体感觉、情绪或周围发生的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinduna b'sensazzjoni fiżika, b'emozzjoni jew b'xi ħaġa li tkun qed tiġri madwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 察觉；感知；意识到。
感觉；感受到。
触摸；用手摸。
感觉；感知能力；感官。
触觉，即通过接触感知物体的感觉。
生菜；莴苣类叶菜。
感觉到某物或某种感觉；感受到某事。
感到处于某种身体或情绪状态，如觉得疲倦或开心。

formal.mt: Wara s-siegħa ta' eżerċizzju, l-istudent ħassu għajjien u waqaf biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After an hour of exercise, the student felt tired and stopped to rest.
formal.zh: 运动一小时后，这名学生感到疲倦，便停下来休息。

colloquial.mt: Nora: Pawlu ħass il-kesħa meta ħareġ? Ġorġ: Iva, reġa' daħal biex jieħu l-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Nora: Did Pawlu feel the cold when he went out? Ġorġ: Yes, he came back inside to get his jacket.
colloquial.zh: 诺拉：保罗出去时觉得冷了吗？乔治：是的，他又进来拿外套了。

messages.speaker: Nora (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗出去时觉得冷了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu feel the cold when he went out?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, reġa' daħal biex jieħu l-ġakketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, reġa' daħal biex jieħu l-ġakketta.
messages.zh: 是的，他又进来拿外套了。
messages.en: Yes, he came back inside to get his jacket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħass 分两张图卡：一张是身体“感觉到冷”，另一张是餐盘里的“生菜”；再用词性和上下文辨认具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut and gather a crop when it is ready for harvesting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在庄稼成熟、可以收获时将其割下并收集起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' u jiġbor l-uċuħ tar-raba' meta jkunu lesti għall-ħsad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收割；收获庄稼。
收割者；从事收割的人。
收割庄稼的人；收割工。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħassad il-qamħ meta kien misjur u ħejja l-għalqa għall-istaġun li jmiss.
formal.en: The farmer harvested the wheat when it was ripe and prepared the field for the next season.
formal.zh: 农民在小麦成熟时进行了收割，并为下一个种植季整理了田地。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-bidwi ħassad il-qamħ diġà? Pietru: Iva, ħassad kollox ilbieraħ; l-għalqa issa vojta.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the farmer harvested the wheat already? Pietru: Yes, he harvested it all yesterday; the field is empty now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：农民已经把小麦收割了吗？彼得：是的，他昨天全收完了，田里现在已经空了。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 农民已经把小麦收割了吗？
messages.en: Has the farmer harvested the wheat already?

messages.speaker: Pietru (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħassad kollox ilbieraħ; l-għalqa issa vojta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħassad kollox ilbieraħ; l-għalqa issa vojta.
messages.zh: 是的，他昨天全收完了，田里现在已经空了。
messages.en: Yes, he harvested it all yesterday; the field is empty now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象成熟麦田里的收割动作来记 ħassad；动词卡写“收割”，名词卡画“收割的人”，分别练习两种词性。

gloss_zh: 损坏；糟蹋；取消；擦除；删除

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spoil or damage something, cancel an arrangement, or erase information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变坏或受损，也可指取消安排、擦除文字或删除信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ħażina jew jagħmlilha l-ħsara, iħassar arranġament, jew ineħħi kitba jew informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物腐烂。
使变坏；糟蹋；破坏原有的良好状态。
损坏；使受到损害。
故意毁坏或破坏财物。
取消活动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to discourage sb. from doing sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人打消做某事的念头；使某人泄气而不去做某事。
取消活动的人。
把事情搞砸或造成破坏的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause to rot, make rotten
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使腐烂；使变得腐坏。
伤害；损害；损坏。
撤销；废止；取消。
擦除文字或痕迹；删除内容或数据。

formal.mt: L-organizzatur ħassar il-laqgħa minħabba t-temp ħażin u informa lill-parteċipanti bil-miktub.
formal.en: The organiser cancelled the meeting because of the bad weather and informed the participants in writing.
formal.zh: 组织者因天气恶劣取消了会议，并书面通知了参与者。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-fajl m'għadux hawn? Pawlu: Ħija ħassar il-fajl bi żball, imma għandna kopja oħra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is the file no longer here? Pawlu: My brother deleted the file by mistake, but we have another copy.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：文件怎么不在这里了？保罗：我兄弟误删了文件，不过我们还有另一份副本。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 文件怎么不在这里了？
messages.en: Why is the file no longer here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija ħassar il-fajl bi żball, imma għandna kopja oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija ħassar il-fajl bi żball, imma għandna kopja oħra.
messages.zh: 我兄弟误删了文件，不过我们还有另一份副本。
messages.en: My brother deleted the file by mistake, but we have another copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“活动被取消、文件被删除、计划被搞砸”连成三幅图，记住这个词可表示让原有事物失效、消失或变坏；具体意思由宾语决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel worried or concerned about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人为某事感到担心或忧虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jinkwieta jew iħoss tħassib dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使担心；使忧虑。
引起担忧或关切。
使某人产生忧虑；让某人担心。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat tal-eżami ħasseb lit-tabib, li talab aktar testijiet.
formal.en: The examination result concerned the doctor, who requested further tests.
formal.zh: 检查结果使医生感到担忧，因此医生要求进一步检查。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ommok ċemplet darbtejn? Mark: Id-dewmien tiegħi ħasseb lil ommi; insejt ngħidilha li l-karozza tal-linja kienet tard.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did your mother call twice? Mark: My delay worried my mother; I forgot to tell her that the bus was late.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你妈妈为什么打了两次电话？马克：我迟迟没到，让妈妈担心了；我忘了告诉她公交车晚点了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你妈妈为什么打了两次电话？
messages.en: Why did your mother call twice?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dewmien tiegħi ħasseb lil ommi; insejt ngħidilha li l-karozza tal-linja kienet tard.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dewmien tiegħi ħasseb lil ommi; insejt ngħidilha li l-karozza tal-linja kienet tard.
messages.zh: 我迟迟没到，让妈妈担心了；我忘了告诉她公交车晚点了。
messages.en: My delay worried my mother; I forgot to tell her that the bus was late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成“消息一来，让人担心”：句子主语常是引发忧虑的事情，后面接感到担心的人，重点是“使别人担忧”。

gloss_zh: 思想家；哲学家；知识分子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who thinks deeply about ideas, especially philosophical or intellectual questions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深入思考观念和问题的人，尤指思想家、哲学家或知识分子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħseb fil-fond dwar ideat u kwistjonijiet, speċjalment dawk filosofiċi jew intellettwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 思想家；善于深入思考的人。
哲学家；研究或思考哲学问题的人。
知识分子；从事思想或学术活动的人。
思考者；进行思考的人。
思想家；知识分子。

formal.mt: Fl-esej tagħha, l-istudenta analizzat l-ideat ta' ħassieb li kiteb dwar il-libertà u r-responsabbiltà.
formal.en: In her essay, the student analysed the ideas of a thinker who wrote about freedom and responsibility.
formal.zh: 这名学生在文章中分析了一位论述自由与责任的思想家的观点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kittieb għaliex jistaqsi tant mistoqsijiet? Toni: Għax hu ħassieb; irid jifhem għaliex naħsbu kif naħsbu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does this writer ask so many questions? Toni: Because he is a thinker; he wants to understand why we think the way we do.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这位作家为什么提出这么多问题？托尼：因为他是一位思想家；他想弄明白我们为什么会这样思考。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kittieb għaliex jistaqsi tant mistoqsijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kittieb għaliex jistaqsi tant mistoqsijiet?
messages.zh: 这位作家为什么提出这么多问题？
messages.en: Why does this writer ask so many questions?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ħassieb; irid jifhem għaliex naħsbu kif naħsbu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ħassieb; irid jifhem għaliex naħsbu kif naħsbu.
messages.zh: 因为他是一位思想家；他想弄明白我们为什么会这样思考。
messages.en: Because he is a thinker; he wants to understand why we think the way we do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个读完书还不断追问“为什么”的人，把 ħassieb 与“深入思考的人”绑定；再用“深刻、批判、独立”三个形容词练习搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the male sex glands that produce sperm and sex hormones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性生殖腺之一，产生精子和性激素，即一枚睾丸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mill-glandoli sesswali maskili li jipproduċu l-isperma u l-ormoni sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睾丸。
睾丸，即男性生殖腺。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-bijoloġija, l-għalliema spjegat li ħaswa hija glandola tas-sistema riproduttiva maskili.
formal.en: In the biology lesson, the teacher explained that a testicle is a gland of the male reproductive system.
formal.zh: 生物课上，老师解释说，睾丸是男性生殖系统中的一种腺体。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tabiba, għandi uġigħ f'ħaswa waħda. Elena: Meta beda l-uġigħ? Mark: Dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Doctor, I have pain in one testicle. Elena: When did the pain start? Mark: This morning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：医生，我有一侧睾丸疼。埃莱娜：什么时候开始疼的？马克：今天早上。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 医生，我有一侧睾丸疼。
messages.en: Doctor, I have pain in one testicle.

messages.speaker: Elena (医生)
messages.zh: 什么时候开始疼的？
messages.en: When did the pain start?

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 今天早上。
messages.en: This morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进人体解剖图中记忆：ħaswa 对应一枚睾丸，再连着练习“一个、疼痛、肿胀”三种表达，帮助准确描述身体部位。

gloss_zh: 有过错；应受责备；对损害负有责任

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be at fault or responsible for something wrong or harmful that has happened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对已经发生的错误、坏事或损害负有责任；有过错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun responsabbli għal xi ħaġa ħażina jew għal ħsara li tkun saret.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有罪；有过错。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be the cause of evil or harm done
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为已发生的坏事或损害的肇因；对此负有责任。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be to blame, at fault, guilty
sense_translations.zh_definition: 应受责备；有过失；有罪责。

collocations.en: was at fault in this case
was at fault and should take responsibility

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega min ħata u min għandu jerfa' r-responsabbiltà għall-ħsara.
formal.en: The report explains who was at fault and who should take responsibility for the damage.
formal.zh: 报告说明了谁有过错，以及谁应对损害承担责任。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min ħata f'dan il-każ? Toni: Pawlu ħata; hu ħalla l-bieb miftuħ u l-kelb ħareġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who was at fault in this case? Toni: Pawlu was at fault; he left the door open and the dog got out.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这件事是谁的过错？托尼：保罗有过错；他没关门，狗就跑出去了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 这件事是谁的过错？
messages.en: Who was at fault in this case?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ħata; hu ħalla l-bieb miftuħ u l-kelb ħareġ.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ħata; hu ħalla l-bieb miftuħ u l-kelb ħareġ.
messages.zh: 保罗有过错；他没关门，狗就跑出去了。
messages.en: Pawlu was at fault; he left the door open and the dog got out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“门没关，狗跑了，谁有过错？”这个小情景记忆 ħata；重点是行为者应负的责任，而不是事情带来的单纯遗憾。

gloss_zh: 柴火；供燃烧的树枝或木块

teaching_sense.en_definition: Twigs or pieces of wood collected or prepared for burning as fuel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收集或准备好用作燃料的树枝、木块等柴火。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Friegħi jew biċċiet tal-injam miġbura jew ippreparati biex jintużaw bħala fjuwil għan-nar.

sense_translations.en_definition: twigs or pieces of wood for burning
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供燃烧用的细树枝或木块；柴火。
柴火；薪柴。

formal.mt: Il-ħatab inħażen f'post niexef biex ikun lest għall-użu fix-xitwa.
formal.en: The firewood was stored in a dry place so that it would be ready for use in winter.
formal.zh: 柴火存放在干燥的地方，以备冬季使用。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għad għandna ħatab għall-fuklar? Ġanni: Iva, hemm mazz ħatab niexef ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do we still have firewood for the fireplace? Ġanni: Yes, there is a bundle of dry firewood beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们还有烧壁炉的柴火吗？詹尼：有，门旁边有一捆干柴。

messages.speaker: Rita (妻子)
messages.zh: 我们还有烧壁炉的柴火吗？
messages.en: Do we still have firewood for the fireplace?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm mazz ħatab niexef ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm mazz ħatab niexef ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 有，门旁边有一捆干柴。
messages.en: Yes, there is a bundle of dry firewood beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门边一捆准备放进壁炉的干木枝，把 ħatab 与“拿来烧的柴火”绑定，再顺着练习“收集柴火、干柴、一捆柴”。

gloss_zh: 抓住；抢走；绑架；厉声斥责

teaching_sense.en_definition: To seize or snatch something suddenly, abduct a person, or speak sharply to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然抓住或抢走某物；也可指绑架某人，或对某人厉声说话、加以斥责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbad jew jieħu xi ħaġa għal għarrieda, jaħtaf persuna, jew ikellem lil xi ħadd b'mod aħrax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猛地抓住；夺取。
突然抢走；一把夺走。
绑架；劫持某人。
对某人厉声说话；突然冲某人发火。
责骂或训斥某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to seize, to grasp, to snatch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓住；紧抓；猛地夺取。
绑架；劫持；强行掳走某人。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-ħalliel ħataf il-basket minn id il-mara u ħarab.
formal.en: According to the report, the thief snatched the bag from the woman's hand and ran away.
formal.zh: 据报告，窃贼从女子手中抢走了包，随后逃跑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Sara tinsab imdejqa? Mark: Toni ħataf magħha meta staqsietu mistoqsija. Lara: Miskina, kienet biss qed titlob l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is Sara upset? Mark: Toni snapped at her when she asked him a question. Lara: Poor thing, she was only asking for help.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：萨拉为什么难过？马克：她问了托尼一个问题，托尼就冲她发火了。劳拉：真可怜，她只是想寻求帮助。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 萨拉为什么难过？
messages.en: Why is Sara upset?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni ħataf magħha meta staqsietu mistoqsija.
messages.mt_standard: Toni ħataf magħha meta staqsietu mistoqsija.
messages.zh: 她问了托尼一个问题，托尼就冲她发火了。
messages.en: Toni snapped at her when she asked him a question.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Miskina, kienet biss qed titlob l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Miskina, kienet biss qed titlob l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 真可怜，她只是想寻求帮助。
messages.en: Poor thing, she was only asking for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“动作猛、话也冲”串联记忆：手上猛地抓取可以是抢走，强行带走人可以是绑架，说话突然变冲则是厉声斥责；结合宾语和搭配辨义。

gloss_zh: 盖印；加盖印章；用印封缄

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mark or seal something with a stamp, signet ring, or coat of arms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用印章、印戒或纹章给某物盖印或封缄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimmarka jew jagħlaq xi ħaġa b'siġill, b'ċurkett tas-siġill jew b'arma.

sense_translations.en_definition: to seal with a ring or coat of arms
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用印戒或纹章加印封缄。
封缄；盖印；加盖印章。

formal.mt: Is-segretarju ħatam id-dokument bis-siġill uffiċjali qabel bagħtu lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The secretary stamped the document with the official seal before sending it to the office.
formal.zh: 秘书在文件上加盖公章后，将其寄送到办公室。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif għalaq l-ittra? Luqa: Ħatam l-ittra b'ċurkett tas-siġill. Nina: Ara, għad hemm il-marka fix-xama'.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did he seal the letter? Luqa: He sealed the letter with a signet ring. Nina: Look, the impression is still there in the wax.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他是怎么封这封信的？卢卡：他用印戒给信件加印封缄。妮娜：看，蜡上还留着印痕。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.zh: 他是怎么封这封信的？
messages.en: How did he seal the letter?

messages.speaker: Luqa (讲解员)
messages.zh: 他用印戒给信件加印封缄。
messages.en: He sealed the letter with a signet ring.

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.zh: 看，蜡上还留着印痕。
messages.en: Look, the impression is still there in the wax.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把印章或印戒压进封蜡，留下清楚的印痕；用这个动作记住 ħatam 的“盖印、封缄”，再搭配文件和信件练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To choose someone for a task or position, including by election, or to appoint someone to a position of responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 选择某人承担任务或担任职务，包括通过投票选举或正式任命。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħżel lil xi ħadd għal xogħol jew kariga, permezz ta' elezzjoni jew ta' deċiżjoni ta' ħatra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选举；选出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to select sb. for a position of responsibility
sense_translations.zh_definition: 选任某人担任负有责任的职务。
棍；棒。
用于击打的粗短棍棒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to elect; to choose by vote
sense_translations.zh_definition: 选举；通过投票选出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to select; to appoint; to choose for a task or position
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挑选；任命；选择某人承担任务或担任职务。
棍、手杖、杆、棒或粗短棍棒。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ħatar lil Maria president permezz ta' votazzjoni.
formal.en: The council elected Maria president by a vote.
formal.zh: 理事会通过投票选举玛丽亚为主席。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lil min ħatar il-kap biex imexxi l-proġett? Pawlu: Ħatar lil Sara; għandha ħafna esperjenza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who did the boss appoint to lead the project? Pawlu: He appointed Sara; she has a lot of experience.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：主管任命谁来负责这个项目？保罗：他任命了萨拉；她经验很丰富。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min ħatar il-kap biex imexxi l-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min ħatar il-kap biex imexxi l-proġett?
messages.zh: 主管任命谁来负责这个项目？
messages.en: Who did the boss appoint to lead the project?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħatar lil Sara; għandha ħafna esperjenza.
messages.mt_standard: Ħatar lil Sara; għandha ħafna esperjenza.
messages.zh: 他任命了萨拉；她经验很丰富。
messages.en: He appointed Sara; she has a lot of experience.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个词性分开记：动词配人物与职位，表示选任；名词配木头，想象手里拿着一根棍棒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ring worn as jewellery, especially one bearing a design used to make a seal; also a seal or identifying symbol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 佩戴于手指的戒指，尤指刻有可用于盖印的图案的印章戒指；也可指印记或标识符号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċurkett li jintlibes bħala ġojjell, speċjalment wieħed b'disinn biex isir siġill; ukoll siġill jew simbolu ta' identifikazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印章戒指；戒面刻有可用于盖印的图案的戒指。
戒指。
印记；具有特定标识意义的符号。
戒指，泛指作为首饰佩戴的指环。

formal.mt: Il-ħatem espost fil-mużew għandu disinn imnaqqax li kien jintuża biex isir siġill fix-xama'.
formal.en: The ring displayed in the museum has an engraved design that was used to make a seal in wax.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出的这枚戒指刻有图案，过去用来在蜡上压印。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ħatem sabiħ! Minn fejn ġibtu? Mark: Kien ta' nannti; tatuli ommi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What a beautiful ring! Where did you get it? Mark: It belonged to my grandmother; my mother gave it to me.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这枚戒指真漂亮！你从哪里得来的？马克：以前是我祖母的；我妈妈把它送给了我。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这枚戒指真漂亮！你从哪里得来的？
messages.en: What a beautiful ring! Where did you get it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 以前是我祖母的；我妈妈把它送给了我。
messages.en: It belonged to my grandmother; my mother gave it to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一枚刻着图案的戒指按进蜡里：手上是戒指，蜡上是印记，用一个画面串起各义。

gloss_zh: 施行包皮环切；姻亲兄弟；女婿

teaching_sense.en_definition: To perform circumcision by removing the foreskin of the penis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 施行包皮环切，即切除阴茎包皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' l-prepuzju tal-pene waqt iċ-ċirkonċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施行包皮环切。
姻亲兄弟，例如配偶的兄弟或姐妹的丈夫。
施行包皮环切。
女婿；女儿的丈夫。

collocations.zh: 为患者施行了包皮环切

collocations.en: my brother-in-law or my son-in-law, depending on context
collocations.zh: 我的姻亲兄弟或女婿，具体关系由语境确定

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddikjara li l-kirurgu ħaten lill-pazjent waqt l-operazzjoni.
formal.en: The report states that the surgeon circumcised the patient during the operation.
formal.zh: 报告记载，外科医生在手术中为患者施行了包皮环切。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan min hu fir-ritratt ħdejn bintek? Ġużeppi: Dak il-ħaten tiegħi, ir-raġel ta' binti.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is this next to your daughter in the photo? Ġużeppi: That's my son-in-law, my daughter's husband.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：照片里你女儿旁边的这位是谁？朱塞佩：那是我女婿，我女儿的丈夫。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan min hu fir-ritratt ħdejn bintek?
messages.mt_standard: Dan min hu fir-ritratt ħdejn bintek?
messages.zh: 照片里你女儿旁边的这位是谁？
messages.en: Who is this next to your daughter in the photo?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ħaten tiegħi, ir-raġel ta' binti.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ħaten tiegħi, ir-raġel ta' binti.
messages.zh: 那是我女婿，我女儿的丈夫。
messages.en: That's my son-in-law, my daughter's husband.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给同形词画两张卡：医疗动作记动词，家庭合照记名词；亲属义再用人物关系确认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person responsible for an offence or wrongful act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对违法行为或过错负有责任的人；有罪者或肇事者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna responsabbli għal reat jew għal xi għemil ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肇事者；造成过错的人。
有罪的人；负有过错责任的人。
有罪的；负有过错的。
违法的；犯错的；用于描述违法者或肇事者。

collocations.en: the person guilty of the offence

formal.mt: Wara li eżaminat il-provi, il-qorti sabet lill-akkużat ħati ta' serq.
formal.en: After examining the evidence, the court found the accused guilty of theft.
formal.zh: 审查证据后，法院判定被告犯有盗窃罪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħalla l-bieb miftuħ? Toni: Jien il-ħati! Insejt nagħlqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who left the door open? Toni: I'm the culprit! I forgot to close it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把门敞着没关？托尼：是我干的！我忘了关门。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把门敞着没关？
messages.en: Who left the door open?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 是我干的！我忘了关门。
messages.en: I'm the culprit! I forgot to close it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 il-ħati 记成指人的“肇事者”，把 instab ħati 记成“被判有罪”，用搭配区分名词和形容词。

gloss_zh: 卸下；拆毁；卸货；拆除；线条；笔画

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove a load from a vehicle or container, or to tear down a structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从车辆或容器中卸下货物；也指拆毁建筑物或其他构筑物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi tagħbija minn vettura jew reċipjent, jew iwaqqa' bini jew struttura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆毁；拆掉。
卸下货物；卸载。
卸货；卸载的过程。
拆除；拆毁。
一条线；一道线条。
笔画；用笔划出的一道痕迹。

sense_translations.en_definition: to unload, offload, remove from a vehicle or container (and store somewhere)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卸货；从车辆或容器中取下货物，并可将其存放于某处。
拆毁；拆除。
线；线条。

formal.mt: Ix-xufier ħatt il-kaxxi mit-trakk u poġġiehom fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The driver unloaded the boxes from the truck and placed them in the warehouse.
formal.zh: 司机把箱子从卡车上卸下，放进了仓库。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu diġà ħatt il-karozza? Mark: Iva, ħatt kollox u daħħal il-basktijiet fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Pawlu already unloaded the car? Mark: Yes, he unloaded everything and brought the bags into the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗已经把车上的东西卸下来了吗？马克：是的，他把所有东西都卸下了，还把袋子拿进了厨房。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 保罗已经把车上的东西卸下来了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu already unloaded the car?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħatt kollox u daħħal il-basktijiet fil-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħatt kollox u daħħal il-basktijiet fil-kċina.
messages.zh: 是的，他把所有东西都卸下了，还把袋子拿进了厨房。
messages.en: Yes, he unloaded everything and brought the bags into the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三幅图记忆：卡车卸箱子、工人拆墙、纸上画一笔；这些是不同词义，靠宾语和场景辨认。

gloss_zh: 在固定地点生长的；不育的；贫瘠的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Growing in a fixed place; in another sense, sterile or barren and unable to produce offspring or crops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在固定地点生长的；另一义为不育的或贫瘠的，不能繁育后代或产出作物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikber f'post fiss; f'tifsira oħra, li ma jistax ikollu frieħ jew li ma jagħtix għelejjel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在固定地点生长的。
不育的；不能繁殖的；土地贫瘠不产的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-raba' bħala ħawli, għax ma jagħtix għelejjel.
formal.en: The report describes the farmland as barren because it produces no crops.
formal.zh: 报告将这片农地描述为贫瘠不产，因为它没有作物产出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma jiżirgħux f'dak ir-raba'? Toni: Għax hu ħawli; ma jagħti xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't they sow crops in that field? Toni: Because it's barren; it produces nothing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么不在那块地里播种？托尼：因为那块地贫瘠不产，什么都长不出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么不在那块地里播种？
messages.en: Why don't they sow crops in that field?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu ħawli; ma jagħti xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu ħawli; ma jagħti xejn.
messages.zh: 因为那块地贫瘠不产，什么都长不出来。
messages.en: Because it's barren; it produces nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立图片记义：一张标出生长的固定位置，另一张画不产作物的土地；不要把两个义项混为因果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The belly or stomach; in a bird, the crop, a pouch that temporarily stores food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肚子或胃；用于鸟类时指嗉囊，即暂时储存食物的囊状部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żaqq jew l-istonku; f'għasfur, borża fejn jinżamm l-ikel għal xi żmien qabel jgħaddi għall-istonku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肚子；腹部。

sense_translations.en_definition: a bird's craw (pouch for food storage(
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟的嗉囊，即用於暂时储存食物的囊状部位。
嗉囊，鸟类储存食物的囊状部位。
胃。

collocations.zh: 装满食物的嗉囊或吃饱的肚子

formal.mt: Il-ħawsla tal-għasfur iżżomm l-ikel għal xi żmien qabel ma jgħaddi għall-istonku.
formal.en: The bird's crop holds food for a while before it passes into the stomach.
formal.zh: 鸟的嗉囊会暂时储存食物，随后食物再进入胃中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara l-ħamiema! Għandha l-ħawsla mimlija? Pawlu: Iva, għadha kemm kielet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at the pigeon! Is its crop full? Pawlu: Yes, it has just eaten.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看那只鸽子！它的嗉囊是满的吗？保罗：是的，它刚吃过东西。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那只鸽子！它的嗉囊是满的吗？
messages.en: Look at the pigeon! Is its crop full?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，它刚吃过东西。
messages.en: Yes, it has just eaten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸟吃完谷粒后鼓起的食物小袋，记住嗉囊义；遇到人的语境，再联想到肚子或胃。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container or basin for holding water or other material, such as an animal trough, a tank, or a holy-water stoup.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盛放水或其他物料的槽或盆，可指牲畜饮水槽、储水槽，也可指教堂里的圣水盆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent jew vaska għall-ilma jew għal materjal ieħor, bħal dak li jixorbu minnu l-annimali jew dak tal-ilma mbierek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供牲畜饮水或进食的槽。
储存水或其他液体的槽、池或容器。
教堂内盛放圣水的盆。

formal.mt: Il-ħawt għandu jitnaddaf qabel jimtela b'ilma frisk għall-annimali.
formal.en: The trough must be cleaned before it is filled with fresh water for the animals.
formal.zh: 给牲畜的饮水槽应先清洗，再装入新鲜的水。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-ħawt għadu vojt? Pawlu: Iva, se nimlieh bl-ilma issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the trough still empty? Pawlu: Yes, I'll fill it with water now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：饮水槽还是空的吗？Pawlu：是的，我现在就给它加水。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场主)
messages.zh: 饮水槽还是空的吗？
messages.en: Is the trough still empty?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场助手)
messages.zh: 是的，我现在就给它加水。
messages.en: Yes, I'll fill it with water now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把牲畜饮水槽、储水槽和圣水盆并排想象，抓住共同的“盛水容器”形象，再靠场景区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stir or mix something, or figuratively to muddle things and make someone confused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 搅动或混合某物；也可比喻把事情弄乱，或使人感到困惑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddawwar jew tħallat xi ħaġa; b'mod figurattiv, tagħmel l-affarijiet imħabbla jew tikkonfondi lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搅动；搅拌。
把不同东西混合在一起。
把事物、次序或想法弄乱、混淆。
造成混乱或引起困惑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be up to no good
sense_translations.zh_definition: 干坏事；暗中搞不正当的勾当。
在性关系上随意，与多个对象发生性关系，通常带贬义。
搅拌者；进行搅动的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tends to indulge in underhand dealings
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于暗中耍手段或从事不正当勾当的人。
使某人迷惑；使人分不清或弄不明白。

collocations.en: shuffle or mix up the cards

formal.mt: Ħawwad l-ingredjenti sakemm it-taħlita tkun lixxa u mingħajr boċċi.
formal.en: Mix the ingredients until the mixture is smooth and free of lumps.
formal.zh: 搅拌配料，直到混合物顺滑且没有结块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħawwad is-soppa ftit, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tajjeb. Inżid ftit melħ ukoll?
colloquial.en: Lara: Stir the soup a little, please. Mark: All right. Shall I add a little salt too?
colloquial.zh: Lara：请把汤稍微搅一搅。Mark：好。要不要再加一点盐？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 请把汤稍微搅一搅。
messages.en: Stir the soup a little, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好。要不要再加一点盐？
messages.en: All right. Shall I add a little salt too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象勺子把汤搅在一起，再联想信息被“搅乱”而使人困惑；遇到人物或行为语境时，另辨名词及贬义用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scare or frighten someone; in another sense, to lose weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吓唬某人，使人害怕；另有体重减轻、变瘦的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbeżża' lil xi ħadd; f'tifsira oħra, tonqos fil-piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吓唬；使人害怕。
体重减轻；变瘦。
惊吓某人，使其感到恐惧。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi ħawwef lit-tfal li kienu qed jilagħbu fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The loud noise frightened the children who were playing in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 那声巨响吓到了正在院子里玩耍的孩子们。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dak il-ħoss ħawwef lit-tifel. David: Ejja mmorru ħdejh u ngħidulu li kollox sew.
colloquial.en: Anna: That noise frightened the boy. David: Let's go over to him and tell him everything is all right.
colloquial.zh: Anna：那个声音吓到孩子了。David：我们过去陪着他，告诉他一切都好。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 那个声音吓到孩子了。
messages.en: That noise frightened the boy.

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja mmorru ħdejh u ngħidulu li kollox sew.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja mmorru ħdejh u ngħidulu li kollox sew.
messages.zh: 我们过去陪着他，告诉他一切都好。
messages.en: Let's go over to him and tell him everything is all right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立画面记忆：巨响使人害怕，体重秤显示变轻；两义分别记，读句子时用上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a plant, tree, or seed into the ground so that it can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把植物、树木或种子放入土中，使其生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed pjanta, siġra jew żerriegħa fil-ħamrija biex tikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种植；把植物、树苗或种子栽入土中。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar ħawwel siġra ġdida fil-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: The gardener planted a new tree in the school garden.
formal.zh: 园丁在学校花园里种了一棵新树。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn ħawwel il-fjuri missierek? Toni: Ħdejn il-bieb, fejn hemm ħafna xemx.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where did your father plant the flowers? Toni: Near the door, where there is plenty of sunshine.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你爸爸把花种在哪里了？Toni：门边，那里阳光很充足。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸把花种在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did your father plant the flowers?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb, fejn hemm ħafna xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb, fejn hemm ħafna xemx.
messages.zh: 门边，那里阳光很充足。
messages.en: Near the door, where there is plenty of sunshine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ħawwel 就想象双手把树苗放进土里，再用“种树、种花、种进花盆”三个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grass growing on the ground, or vegetables grown or used as food, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指地面生长的草，也可指作为食物的蔬菜，具体意思取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanti li jiksu l-art, jew pjanti u partijiet minnhom li jittieklu bħala ikel, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 草；覆盖地面的草本植物。
蔬菜，作为食物的一类植物或植物部分。
蔬菜；一种可供食用的蔬菜植物或其部分。

formal.mt: Aħsel il-ħaxix sew qabel tużah biex tipprepara s-soppa.
formal.en: Wash the vegetables thoroughly before using them to prepare the soup.
formal.zh: 用蔬菜煮汤之前，应先将其彻底洗净。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ħaxix għandna għas-soppa? Pawlu: Għandna karrotti, patata u qarabagħli.
colloquial.en: Marija: What vegetables do we have for the soup? Pawlu: We have carrots, potatoes, and courgettes.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们有哪些蔬菜可以煮汤？Pawlu：有胡萝卜、土豆和西葫芦。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有哪些蔬菜可以煮汤？
messages.en: What vegetables do we have for the soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 有胡萝卜、土豆和西葫芦。
messages.en: We have carrots, potatoes, and courgettes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记同一个词：花园里割的是草，厨房里洗的是蔬菜；让动作和地点帮助判断 ħaxix。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A colloquial term for marijuana or hashish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 口语中指大麻或大麻脂的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma kollokjali għall-marijuana jew il-ħaxixa bħala sustanza tad-droga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大麻的口语称呼。
大麻脂；大麻。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, wieħed mill-karattri juża l-kelma "ħaxixa" meta jitkellem dwar il-marijuana.
formal.en: In the novel, one of the characters uses the word "ħaxixa" when talking about marijuana.
formal.zh: 小说中，一个角色在谈论大麻时使用了“ħaxixa”这个词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser "ħaxixa" f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Hawn qed jitkellmu dwar il-marijuana.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does "ħaxixa" mean in this sentence? Mark: Here they are talking about marijuana.
colloquial.zh: Lara：“ħaxixa”在这句话里是什么意思？Mark：这里说的是大麻。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: “ħaxixa”在这句话里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "ħaxixa" mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这里说的是大麻。
messages.en: Here they are talking about marijuana.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本词条单独放进“大麻相关词汇”记忆卡，与表示草或蔬菜的 ħaxix 分卡学习，避免只看相似拼写就套用意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bungle a task or spoil a piece of work, especially by doing it too hastily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把任务或工作做坏、搞砸，尤其指因过分匆忙而草率出错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel biċċa xogħol ħażin jew tħassarha, speċjalment għax tagħmilha b'għaġla żejda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to mess up a piece of work due to excessive haste
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因过于匆忙而把一项工作做坏。
笨拙或草率地处理某事，把事情搞砸。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħaxlef it-tiswija għax ipprova jlesti kollox f'ħin qasir wisq.
formal.en: The worker bungled the repair because he tried to finish everything in too little time.
formal.zh: 工人想在过短的时间内完成所有工作，结果把修理搞砸了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-bieb għadu ma jagħlaqx? Toni: Min sewwieh ħaxlef ix-xogħol. Kellu għaġla wisq.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does the door still not close? Toni: Whoever repaired it bungled the job. He was in too much of a hurry.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这扇门怎么还是关不上？Toni：修门的人把活儿做砸了。他太赶时间了。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.zh: 这扇门怎么还是关不上？
messages.en: Why does the door still not close?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min sewwieh ħaxlef ix-xogħol. Kellu għaġla wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Min sewwieh ħaxlef ix-xogħol. Kellu għaġla wisq.
messages.zh: 修门的人把活儿做砸了。他太赶时间了。
messages.en: Whoever repaired it bungled the job. He was in too much of a hurry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赶工修门，匆忙装完却关不上；把“太赶、草率、做坏”连成画面，记住这个动词的结果意味。

gloss_zh: 沙沙作响；飕飕作响；低声说话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a soft rustling or swishing sound, or to speak in a whisper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出轻柔的沙沙声或飕飕声；也指低声耳语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel ħoss ħafif bħal dak tal-weraq jew tad-drapp meta jiċċaqlaq, jew titkellem b'leħen baxx ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出沙沙声，如树叶或纸张轻轻摩擦的声音。
移动时发出轻柔的飕飕声或唰唰声。
低声说话；耳语。

formal.mt: Il-weraq ħaxwex hekk kif żiffa ħafifa għaddiet minn bejn is-siġar.
formal.en: The leaves rustled as a light breeze passed between the trees.
formal.zh: 微风从树间吹过，树叶沙沙作响。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'kien dak il-ħoss? David: Il-weraq ħaxwex fir-riħ. M'hemm ħadd barra.
colloquial.en: Anna: What was that sound? David: The leaves rustled in the wind. There is nobody outside.
colloquial.zh: Anna：刚才是什么声音？David：是树叶在风里沙沙响。外面没有人。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-weraq ħaxwex fir-riħ. M'hemm ħadd barra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-weraq ħaxwex fir-riħ. M'hemm ħadd barra.
messages.zh: 是树叶在风里沙沙响。外面没有人。
messages.en: The leaves rustled in the wind. There is nobody outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把树叶沙沙、衣料唰唰和耳边低语录成一组想象中的轻声，再用发声者是物还是人区分三个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To catch or trap a finger in something such as a closing door or drawer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使手指等被关上的门、抽屉等夹住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbad jew jagħfas subgħa bejn żewġ uċuħ, bħal meta jingħalaq bieb jew kexxun.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have one's fingers caught (e.g. in a door)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指被夹住，例如被门夹住。
使物体表面凹陷；碰出凹痕。

sense_translations.en_definition: to catch, trap one’s finger (etc.), as in a door or drawer
sense_translations.zh_definition: 夹住手指等，例如被门或抽屉夹住。

collocations.en: He caught his finger in the door.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħaxxem subgħajh fil-kexxun waqt li kien qed jagħlqu.
formal.en: The worker caught his finger in the drawer while closing it.
formal.zh: 那名工人在关抽屉时夹住了手指。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil Pawlu? Mark: Ħaxxem subgħajh fil-bieb, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to Pawlu? Mark: He caught his finger in the door, but he is all right now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么了？马克：他的手指被门夹了，不过现在没事了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħaxxem subgħajh fil-bieb, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Ħaxxem subgħajh fil-bieb, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 他的手指被门夹了，不过现在没事了。
messages.en: He caught his finger in the door, but he is all right now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaxxem 配上关门夹手的画面，再联想车门被碰出凹痕，用两个受挤压的场景分别记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a person or animal fatter, or to make a liquid or mixture thicker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物变胖，或使液体、混合物变稠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel persuna jew annimal aktar oħxon, jew jagħmel likwidu jew taħlita aktar magħquda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使长胖；把动物养肥。
使变稠或变厚。
贿赂某人。
使某人逐渐长胖。
贿赂某人；给某人好处以求通融。

collocations.en: He thickened the sauce with flour.
collocations.zh: 他用面粉把酱汁调稠了。

formal.mt: Il-kok ħaxxen iz-zalza bi ftit dqiq qabel ma serva l-ikla.
formal.en: The cook thickened the sauce with a little flour before serving the meal.
formal.zh: 厨师在上菜前用少量面粉把酱汁调稠了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif għamel iz-zalza daqshekk magħquda? Mark: Ħaxxen iz-zalza bi ftit dqiq.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did he make the sauce so thick? Mark: He thickened the sauce with a little flour.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他怎么把酱汁做得这么稠？马克：他加了一点面粉，把酱汁调稠了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同住者)
messages.zh: 他怎么把酱汁做得这么稠？
messages.en: How did he make the sauce so thick?

messages.speaker: Mark (同住者)
messages.zh: 他加了一点面粉，把酱汁调稠了。
messages.en: He thickened the sauce with a little flour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动物长胖、酱汁变稠两幅画记住 ħaxxen；另把贿赂义单独配上偷偷递钱的场景，不把场景联想当作词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object, a matter being discussed, or something that happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一件东西、正在谈论的一件事，或发生的一件事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett, kwistjoni li wieħed jitkellem dwarha, jew xi ħaġa li tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 东西；事物；一件事。
财物；个人物品或随身物品。
货物；商品；制成的物品。
东西；事情或问题；发生的事件。

formal.mt: L-ewwel ħaġa li għandek tagħmel hija li taqra l-istruzzjonijiet bir-reqqa.
formal.en: The first thing you should do is read the instructions carefully.
formal.zh: 你首先应该做的事是仔细阅读说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nistaqsik ħaġa? Luke: Żgur, xi trid tkun taf?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I ask you something? Luke: Of course, what would you like to know?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以问你一件事吗？卢克：当然，你想知道什么？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以问你一件事吗？
messages.en: Can I ask you something?

messages.speaker: Luke (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，你想知道什么？
messages.en: Of course, what would you like to know?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħaġa 配两个图标：手里的一件东西、脑中的一件事情；用“可拿的东西、可谈的事情”帮助切换意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stones or pieces of rock considered together as a collection or material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集合意义上的石头、石块或岩石，也可指作为材料的石料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebel jew biċċiet ta' blat meqjusa flimkien, bħala ġabra jew materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石头；石块，表示集合。
岩石；较大的石块。

formal.mt: Il-ħajt inbena bil-ħaġar miġbur mill-għalqa.
formal.en: The wall was built with stones collected from the field.
formal.zh: 这堵墙用从田里收集来的石头砌成。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'se tagħmel b'dan il-ħaġar? Toni: Se nużah biex nibni ħajt żgħir fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Rita: What are you going to do with these stones? Toni: I will use them to build a small wall in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你打算用这些石头做什么？托尼：我打算用它们在花园里砌一堵小墙。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 你打算用这些石头做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do with these stones?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nużah biex nibni ħajt żgħir fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Se nużah biex nibni ħajt żgħir fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 我打算用它们在花园里砌一堵小墙。
messages.en: I will use them to build a small wall in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħaġar 想成一整堆石料：先看见石头堆，再想起砌墙用途；加上 prezzjuż 时则联想珍贵宝石。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hide something or cover it so that it cannot be seen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物隐藏或遮挡起来，使人看不见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħbi jew jgħatti xi ħaġa biex ma tidhirx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐藏；遮住，使看不见。
眉毛。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel ħaġeb wiċċu wara l-ktieb biex ħadd ma jagħrfu.
formal.en: In the story, the man hid his face behind the book so that nobody would recognize him.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男人把脸藏在书后面，以免有人认出他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandek fuq il-ħaġeb? Mark: Ftit żebgħa; se nneħħiha issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's on your eyebrow? Mark: A little paint; I'll remove it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你眉毛上是什么？Mark：一点颜料；我现在就擦掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你眉毛上是什么？
messages.en: What's on your eyebrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 一点颜料；我现在就擦掉。
messages.en: A little paint; I'll remove it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个小画面分开记：动词是拿书遮脸，名词是镜中眉毛；同形词要结合词性和句子判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many stones, or made of stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某处石头很多，或某物由石材制成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ħafna ġebel, jew li hu magħmul mill-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多石的；布满石头的。
石制的；由石头制成的。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi ħajt ħaġri madwar il-ġnien.
formal.en: The plan shows a stone wall around the garden.
formal.zh: 平面图显示，花园四周有一堵石墙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nimxu minn hawn? Mark: Iva, imma l-art ħaġrija; imxi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we walk this way? Mark: Yes, but the ground is stony; walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们能从这里走吗？Mark：能，不过地上石头很多，慢点走。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们能从这里走吗？
messages.en: Can we walk this way?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-art ħaġrija; imxi bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-art ħaġrija; imxi bil-mod.
messages.zh: 能，不过地上石头很多，慢点走。
messages.en: Yes, but the ground is stony; walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象多石的地面和石头砌的墙：前者记环境特征，后者记制作材料，一词掌握两种用法。

gloss_zh: 投石击打；用石头打死或赶走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To throw stones at a person, animal, or object, including to kill or drive someone or something away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向人、动物或物体投掷石头攻击，也可指以投石的方式打死或驱赶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitfa' l-ġebel lejn persuna, annimal jew oġġett, anki biex joqtol jew ikeċċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向……投掷石头；用石头攻击。

sense_translations.en_definition: to stone (kill or drive away by throwing stones at)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过投掷石头打死或赶走。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li raġel ħaġġar il-karozza u kisser tieqa.
formal.en: The witness said that a man threw stones at the car and broke a window.
formal.zh: 证人说，一名男子向汽车投掷石头，打破了一扇车窗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex it-tieqa miksura? Luqa: Xi ħadd ħaġġar id-dar ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the window broken? Luqa: Someone threw stones at the house yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：窗户怎么破了？Luqa：昨天有人朝房子扔石头。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 窗户怎么破了？
messages.en: Why is the window broken?

messages.speaker: Luqa (住户)
messages.zh: 昨天有人朝房子扔石头。
messages.en: Someone threw stones at the house yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词记成一段动作：拿起石头、朝目标投去；句中目标就是遭到投石的人或物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a place in southern Malta, also called Żabbar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他南部的地名，也称 Żabbar，中文可译作扎巴尔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' lokalità fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta, magħrufa wkoll bħala Żabbar.

sense_translations.en_definition: name of a village in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他南部一个村庄的名称：扎巴尔。

sense_translations.en_definition: Żabbar (a city and local council of the Port Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 扎巴尔，马耳他港口地区的一座城市及地方议会辖区。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir Ħaż-Żabbar nhar il-Ġimgħa filgħaxija.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Żabbar on Friday evening.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期五晚上在扎巴尔举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tmur Ħaż-Żabbar illum? Mark: Iva, se niltaqa' ma' ħabib hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you going to Żabbar today? Mark: Yes, I am meeting a friend there.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天去扎巴尔吗？马克：去，我要在那里见一个朋友。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天去扎巴尔吗？
messages.en: Are you going to Żabbar today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niltaqa' ma' ħabib hemmhekk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niltaqa' ma' ħabib hemmhekk.
messages.zh: 去，我要在那里见一个朋友。
messages.en: Yes, I am meeting a friend there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ħaż-Żabbar 写在马耳他地图南部的一张地名卡上，整块记住大写、连字符和带点的 Ż，再练习去那里与来自那里。

gloss_zh: 储存；腌藏；哀悼；表示敬意；邪恶；狡诈

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep food, goods, or other supplies for later use, or to build up a stock of them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食品、物品或其他物资存放起来供日后使用，或积存这些物资。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm ikel, oġġetti jew provvisti għal użu aktar tard, jew jiġbor provvista minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储存某物；把某物存放起来。
储备某物；购入或积存某物以备后用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to preserve (e.g. in brine or oil)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 保存食品，例如浸在盐水或油中保存。
哀悼；因某人的去世而悲伤。
邪恶；恶。
坏；恶劣的性质或品行。
腐败；道德上的败坏。
狡猾；善于用计谋达到目的。
邪恶；恶毒；作恶的品性。
狡诈；耍心机的特性。
储存；备货；积存物资。
腌制食品；用腌渍方式保存。

sense_translations.en_definition: to mourn, to put on mourning
sense_translations.zh_definition: 哀悼；穿戴丧服或以服饰表示服丧。
向某人表示敬意。

collocations.en: He preserved the olives in brine.
collocations.zh: 他把橄榄浸在盐水中保存。

formal.mt: Is-sid ħażen il-provvisti f'post frisk u niexef biex jużahom aktar tard.
formal.en: The owner stored the supplies in a cool, dry place for later use.
formal.zh: 物主把物资存放在阴凉干燥的地方，以备日后使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu r-ross li xtara Pawlu? Sara: Ħażen ir-ross fil-kexxun ta' taħt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the rice Pawlu bought? Sara: He stored the rice in the bottom drawer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗买的米在哪里？萨拉：他把米放在最下面的抽屉里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同住者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu r-ross li xtara Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu r-ross li xtara Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗买的米在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the rice Pawlu bought?

messages.speaker: Sara (同住者)
messages.zh: 他把米放在最下面的抽屉里了。
messages.en: He stored the rice in the bottom drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ħażen 分设词义卡：动词用储物罐、腌橄榄、服丧和致敬场景，名词用邪恶与狡诈场景；同形不等于同义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A supply kept for future use, or the act of keeping things until they are needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为日后使用而保留的储备，或把物品存放起来的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Provvista miżmuma għal meta jkun hemm bżonnha, jew l-att li żżomm affarijiet għal użu aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲痛；深切的哀伤。
哀悼；服丧。
储备；储存；为以后准备的物资。

formal.mt: L-iskola żiedet l-ispazju għall-ħażna tal-kotba u tal-materjal tat-tagħlim.
formal.en: The school increased the storage space for books and teaching materials.
formal.zh: 学校增加了存放书籍和教学材料的空间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandna biżżejjed ikel għal tmiem il-ġimgħa? Maja: Iva, għandna ħażna ta' għaġin u ross.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do we have enough food for the weekend? Maja: Yes, we have a stock of pasta and rice.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们有足够周末吃的食物吗？玛雅：有，我们储备了意大利面和米。

messages.speaker: Mark (同住者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna biżżejjed ikel għal tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna biżżejjed ikel għal tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 我们有足够周末吃的食物吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough food for the weekend?

messages.speaker: Maja (同住者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna ħażna ta' għaġin u ross.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna ħażna ta' għaġin u ross.
messages.zh: 有，我们储备了意大利面和米。
messages.en: Yes, we have a stock of pasta and rice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用装满米面的储物柜记住 ħażna 的储备义，再另画哀悼场景记住悲痛义；阅读时靠周围词语选择含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A friendly relationship between people, involving affection, trust, or familiarity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人之间带有好感、信任或熟悉感的友好关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Relazzjoni tajba bejn persuni, b'affezzjoni, fiduċja jew familjarità bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 友谊；朋友之间的情谊。
良好关系；友好关系。
友谊；彼此熟悉、熟络的关系。

formal.mt: Il-proġett saħħaħ ir-rabta ta' ħbiberija bejn l-istudenti taż-żewġ skejjel.
formal.en: The project strengthened the bond of friendship between the students of the two schools.
formal.zh: 这个项目加强了两所学校学生之间的友谊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna ħbieb wara dawn is-snin kollha. Sara: Dażgur, il-ħbiberija tagħna għadha b'saħħitha.
colloquial.en: Maja: We are still friends after all these years. Sara: Of course, our friendship is still strong.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：过了这么多年，我们还是朋友。萨拉：当然，我们的友谊依然深厚。

messages.speaker: Maja (老朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna ħbieb wara dawn is-snin kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna ħbieb wara dawn is-snin kollha.
messages.zh: 过了这么多年，我们还是朋友。
messages.en: We are still friends after all these years.

messages.speaker: Sara (老朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，我们的友谊依然深厚。
messages.en: Of course, our friendship is still strong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两位多年老友仍一起喝茶，把 ħbiberija 写在两人之间的连线上；这条线同时提示友谊、友好关系和熟络感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of cooking bread or other food in an oven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把面包或其他食物放进烤箱烤熟的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess tat-tisjir tal-ħobż jew ta' ikel ieħor fil-forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烘焙；烤制食物的过程。
撤回；退出；撤出的行为。

formal.mt: Il-ħin tal-ħbiż jiddependi mid-daqs tal-ħobża u mit-temperatura tal-forn.
formal.en: The baking time depends on the size of the loaf and the temperature of the oven.
formal.zh: 烘烤时间取决于面包的大小和烤箱的温度。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm se jdum il-ħbiż? Sara: Madwar nofs siegħa; imbagħad inħallu l-ħobż jiksaħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: How long will the baking take? Sara: About half an hour; then we will let the bread cool.
colloquial.zh: 马克：要烤多久？萨拉：大约半小时，然后我们让面包放凉。

messages.speaker: Mark (烘焙同伴)
messages.zh: 要烤多久？
messages.en: How long will the baking take?

messages.speaker: Sara (烘焙同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar nofs siegħa; imbagħad inħallu l-ħobż jiksaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar nofs siegħa; imbagħad inħallu l-ħobż jiksaħ.
messages.zh: 大约半小时，然后我们让面包放凉。
messages.en: About half an hour; then we will let the bread cool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用烤箱旁的计时器记住 ħbiż 的烘焙过程义；撤回或退出义另配一个向后箭头，分开记忆并依语境判断。

gloss_zh: 变绿；变得嫉妒或怨毒；脸色变苍白

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become green, as grass or a landscape does when fresh vegetation grows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成绿色，例如草地或景观因植物生长而转绿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħdar, bħall-ħaxix jew il-pajsaġġ meta tikber il-veġetazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转绿；变成绿色。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become very jealous or spiteful
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得非常嫉妒，或充满怨恨、恶意。
变绿；呈现绿色。
脸色变苍白；面色失去血色。

collocations.en: the valley turned green after the rain

formal.mt: Wara diversi jiem ta' xita, il-wied ħdar u deher mimli ħajja.
formal.en: After several days of rain, the valley turned green and looked full of life.
formal.zh: 连续下了几天雨后，山谷变绿了，显得生机勃勃。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt il-ġnien wara x-xita? Mark: Iva, ħdar kollu u jidher sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you seen the garden after the rain? Mark: Yes, it has turned green all over and looks lovely.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看过雨后的花园了吗？马克：看过，整个花园都变绿了，看起来特别漂亮。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看过雨后的花园了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the garden after the rain?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħdar kollu u jidher sabiħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħdar kollu u jidher sabiħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 看过，整个花园都变绿了，看起来特别漂亮。
messages.en: Yes, it has turned green all over and looks lovely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħdar 记成一个变化镜头：雨后山谷由枯黄转绿；遇到人物语境时，再分别检查嫉妒、怨毒或脸色苍白的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number eleven, used for counting or as a number on its own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数词“十一”，用于计数，也可独立表示数字十一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara għaxra u qabel tnax, użat fl-għadd jew waħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十一，表示数量的基数词。
十一，独立使用、不直接修饰名词的形式。

formal.mt: Ħdax-il student ħadu sehem fil-laqgħa li bdiet fil-ħdax ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: Eleven students took part in the meeting that began at eleven in the morning.
formal.zh: 十一名学生参加了上午十一点开始的会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandna biljetti? Mark: Għandna ħdax. Maja: Tajjeb, biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many tickets do we have? Mark: We have eleven. Maja: Good, that's enough for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有多少张票？马克：我们有十一张。玛雅：好，够大家用了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们有多少张票？
messages.en: How many tickets do we have?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们有十一张。
messages.en: We have eleven.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，够大家用了。
messages.en: Good, that's enough for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象十张票旁再添一张，合起来就是 ħdax；单独回答数量时直接说这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A preposition expressing a position near or beside something, or an approximate amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 介词，表示在某物附近或旁边；也可表示数量大约为某个数值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prepożizzjoni li tindika post qrib jew maġenb xi ħaġa, jew kwantità approssimattiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……旁边；靠着……。
在……附近；靠近……。
紧挨着……；在……旁边。
靠近……；在……近旁。
在……旁边；与……相邻。
大约；左右，用于表示近似数量。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir fis-sala ħdejn il-librerija.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in the hall beside the library.
formal.zh: 会议将在图书馆旁边的礼堂举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-bieb tal-iskola. Sara: Tajjeb, narak hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we meet? Pawlu: By the school gate. Sara: Okay, see you there.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们在哪里见面？保罗：在学校大门旁边。萨拉：好，到时候那里见。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 在学校大门旁边。
messages.en: By the school gate.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 好，到时候那里见。
messages.en: Okay, see you there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħdejn 想成地图上两个靠近的点：接地点表示“旁边”，接数量可表示“大约”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become drowsy, with a growing feeling of wanting to sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得困倦，逐渐产生想睡觉的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jħoss in-ngħas u x-xewqa li jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困倦；昏昏欲睡的状态。
卑劣；道德上的败坏或堕落。
开始犯困；变得昏昏欲睡。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikel, l-istudent ħdiel waqt il-qari u ħa pawża qasira.
formal.en: After eating, the student became drowsy while reading and took a short break.
formal.zh: 吃完饭后，那名学生读书时犯困了，于是短暂休息了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf jaqra Mark? Sara: Ħdiel wara l-ikel. Maja: Mela nħalluh jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark stop reading? Sara: He got drowsy after eating. Maja: Then let's let him rest a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么不读了？萨拉：他吃完饭后犯困了。玛雅：那让他休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克为什么不读了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop reading?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 他吃完饭后犯困了。
messages.en: He got drowsy after eating.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那让他休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Then let's let him rest a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“饭后读书，眼皮渐沉”的画面记 ħdiel 的犯困义；“卑劣”另做义项卡片，分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something out of sight or keep information from becoming known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物藏起来，使人看不见；或隐瞒信息，使别人不知道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed xi ħaġa fejn ma tidhirx, jew iżomm informazzjoni mistura minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐藏；藏起来。
保密；隐瞒而不让他人知道。
把某物藏起来，使其不被看见或找到。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-impjegat ħeba d-dokument f'kexxun imsakkar.
formal.en: According to the report, the employee hid the document in a locked drawer.
formal.zh: 根据报告，那名员工把文件藏在了一个上锁的抽屉里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu r-rigal? Mark: Pawlu ħeba r-rigal fil-gwardarobba. Maja: Tajjeb, hekk jibqa' sorpriża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the present? Mark: Pawlu hid the present in the wardrobe. Maja: Good, that way it stays a surprise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：礼物在哪里？马克：保罗把礼物藏在衣柜里了。玛雅：好，这样就能保留惊喜了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 礼物在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the present?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗把礼物藏在衣柜里了。
messages.en: Pawlu hid the present in the wardrobe.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，这样就能保留惊喜了。
messages.en: Good, that way it stays a surprise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把礼物放进柜子，再把惊喜藏在心里：ħeba 既能藏物，也能隐瞒信息。

gloss_zh: 袭击；攻击；扑向；袭击行为；附着

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attack or assault someone, or rush at a person or thing aggressively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 攻击或袭击某人，或带着攻击性猛冲向某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jattakka lil xi ħadd jew jinxteħet b'aggressività lejn persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击某人。
袭击某人；对某人施加暴力。
袭击；暴力攻击行为。
附着；连接。

sense_translations.en_definition: to attack, to assault; to rush at
sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击，袭击；猛冲向，扑向。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud stqarr li raġel ħebb għal persuna oħra barra l-istazzjon.
formal.en: The witness stated that a man attacked another person outside the station.
formal.zh: 证人陈述，一名男子在车站外袭击了另一个人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tibki? Maja: Kelb ħebb għall-kelb tiegħi fil-park. Sara: Il-kelb tiegħek weġġa'?
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you crying? Maja: A dog rushed at my dog in the park. Sara: Did your dog get hurt?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么哭？玛雅：公园里有只狗扑向了我的狗。萨拉：你的狗受伤了吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么哭？
messages.en: Why are you crying?

messages.speaker: Maja (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 公园里有只狗扑向了我的狗。
messages.en: A dog rushed at my dog in the park.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗受伤了吗？
messages.en: Did your dog get hurt?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħebb 的两个 b 画成向前冲的两只拳头，帮助记住攻击义；搭配 għal 记住攻击对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To predict or foreshadow a future event, or have a premonition that it will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预测或预示未来的事件，或对某件即将发生的事产生预感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibassar jew jagħti ħjiel ta' ġrajja futura, jew ikollu premonizzjoni dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预示；成为某事即将发生的征兆。
预测；预言将会发生的事。
有预感；事先感到某事将要发生。

collocations.en: predicted that a storm was coming

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar kapitlu, il-kittieb ħeber bidla kbira fil-ħajja tal-protagonist.
formal.en: In the final chapter, the writer foreshadowed a major change in the protagonist's life.
formal.zh: 在最后一章中，作者预示了主人公生活中将出现的重大变化。

colloquial.mt: Mark: In-nannu ħeber li kienet ġejja maltempata. Maja: U kellu raġun? Mark: Iva, bdiet ix-xita ftit wara.
colloquial.en: Mark: Grandpa predicted that a storm was coming. Maja: Was he right? Mark: Yes, it started raining shortly afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 马克：爷爷预言暴风雨要来了。玛雅：他说准了吗？马克：准了，没过多久就下雨了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu ħeber li kienet ġejja maltempata.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu ħeber li kienet ġejja maltempata.
messages.zh: 爷爷预言暴风雨要来了。
messages.en: Grandpa predicted that a storm was coming.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他说准了吗？
messages.en: Was he right?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 准了，没过多久就下雨了。
messages.en: Yes, it started raining shortly afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一朵乌云，再画随后落下的雨，用“事情发生前已有预示”的时间顺序记 ħeber。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone drowsy or sleepy, or cause numbness or paralysis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人困倦或想睡觉；也可指使其麻木或瘫痪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss in-ngħas, jew jikkawża tnemnim jew paraliżi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人困倦；使某人昏昏欲睡。
使困倦，使想睡觉。
使麻木；使瘫痪，使失去活动能力。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinnota li l-effett tal-mediċina ħeddel lill-pazjent għal xi żmien.
formal.en: The report notes that the effect of the medicine made the patient drowsy for a while.
formal.zh: 报告指出，药物的作用使病人在一段时间内昏昏欲睡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark qed jagħlaq għajnejh? Sara: Il-film twil ħeddel lil Mark. Maja: Mela nagħmlu pawża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Mark closing his eyes? Sara: The long film made Mark sleepy. Maja: Then let's take a break.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么闭上眼睛了？萨拉：那部很长的电影让马克犯困了。玛雅：那我们休息一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么闭上眼睛了？
messages.en: Why is Mark closing his eyes?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那部很长的电影让马克犯困了。
messages.en: The long film made Mark sleepy.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们休息一下吧。
messages.en: Then let's take a break.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħeddel 的双 d 画一支指向别人的箭头，记作“使别人困倦”；与 ħedel 的自身状态对照。

gloss_zh: 变得困倦；昏昏欲睡；麻木；瘫痪

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become or be drowsy and sleepy, or be numb or paralysed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得困倦或处于昏昏欲睡的状态；也可指处于麻木或瘫痪状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jħoss in-ngħas jew ikun bi ngħas, jew ikun imtarr baxx bis-sensazzjoni jew paralizzat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始犯困；变得昏昏欲睡。
感到困倦；处于想睡觉的状态。
处于麻木或瘫痪状态。

formal.mt: Wara lejl bla rqad, l-istudent ħedel waqt il-lezzjoni ta' filgħodu.
