messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien biss il-bieb li ngħalaq bir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Kien biss il-bieb li ngħalaq bir-riħ.
messages.zh: 只是风把门吹关了。
messages.en: It was just the door blowing shut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立场景记忆：田里收麦是“收割、收成”，突然听到巨响是“惊吓”；这里的 start 要记成“猛然一惊”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Damage or harm to a person or thing, harmful mischief, or a fault that prevents something from working properly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人或物受到的损害、造成破坏的捣乱行为，或使设备无法正常工作的故障。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dannu lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa, għemil li jagħmel dannu, jew difett li ma jħallix apparat jaħdem sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 损坏；物品、建筑等受到的破坏。
伤害；对人、事物或其利益造成的不良影响。
捣乱；可能造成损失或破坏的淘气行为。
故障；使机器或设备不能正常运作的毛病。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni kkonfermat li l-maltemp għamel ħsara serja lis-saqaf tal-iskola.
formal.en: The inspection confirmed that the storm had caused serious damage to the school's roof.
formal.zh: 检查确认，暴风雨对学校屋顶造成了严重损坏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-karozza għandha ħsara fil-magna. Pawlu: Mela llum immorru bil-karozza tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: The car has an engine fault. Pawlu: Then we'll go in my car today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这辆车的发动机出故障了。保罗：那今天我们坐我的车去。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 这辆车的发动机出故障了。
messages.en: The car has an engine fault.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 那今天我们坐我的车去。
messages.en: Then we'll go in my car today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到坏掉的汽车，先想“故障”；再想到撞坏的车身是“损坏”、伤到人是“伤害”，把几种负面后果一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thought in the mind, the idea underlying something, or a person's mental world.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指脑中的一个想法、某事背后的构思或理念，也可指人的精神世界。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idea fil-moħħ, il-kunċett li fuqu tinbena xi ħaġa, jew id-dinja mentali ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 思想；思考的内容或心中所想。

sense_translations.en_definition: the concept or idea behind sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某事物背后的构思、理念或核心想法。
心灵；人的内在精神世界及心理活动。
一个念头；脑中出现的某个具体想法。

formal.mt: Il-ħsieb wara dan il-proġett huwa li l-qari jsir aktar aċċessibbli għat-tfal.
formal.en: The idea behind this project is to make reading more accessible to children.
formal.zh: 这个项目背后的理念是让儿童更容易接触阅读。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ġieni ħsieb: għaliex ma nistudjawx flimkien? Adam: Ħsieb tajjeb! Niltaqgħu fil-librerija.
colloquial.en: Nina: I had a thought: why don't we study together? Adam: Good idea! Let's meet at the library.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我有个想法：我们为什么不一起学习呢？亚当：好主意！我们在图书馆见吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġieni ħsieb: għaliex ma nistudjawx flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Ġieni ħsieb: għaliex ma nistudjawx flimkien?
messages.zh: 我有个想法：我们为什么不一起学习呢？
messages.en: I had a thought: why don't we study together?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 好主意！我们在图书馆见吧。
messages.en: Good idea! Let's meet at the library.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脑中亮起一盏灯：一闪是“一个念头”，用来设计项目是“构思”，放大到整个内在世界就是“心灵”。

gloss_zh: 努力争取；焦躁；烦恼生气

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strive hard to achieve something, or to become fretful and upset about a difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指为实现目标而努力争取，也指因困难而焦躁、烦恼或生气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel sforz kbir biex jikseb xi ħaġa, jew tħasseb u rrabja minħabba xi diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 努力；奋力争取实现某个目标。
焦躁不安；因担忧或不满而烦躁。
生闷气；因事情不顺而恼怒、烦恼或焦虑。

collocations.en: he strove to find a solution
he fretted because everything went wrong
collocations.zh: 他因事事不顺而焦躁烦恼

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur ħtabat għal diversi xhur biex isib soluzzjoni għall-problema.
formal.en: The researcher strove for several months to find a solution to the problem.
formal.zh: 这位研究人员努力了好几个月，试图找到解决该问题的办法。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif mar l-eżami ta' Ben? David: Għadda! Ħtabat ħafna biex jipprepara.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did Ben's exam go? David: He passed! He worked very hard to prepare.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：本的考试怎么样？戴维：他通过了！他为了备考下了很大功夫。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 本的考试怎么样？
messages.en: How did Ben's exam go?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 他通过了！他为了备考下了很大功夫。
messages.en: He passed! He worked very hard to prepare.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人遇到难题：埋头解决时是“奋力争取”，急得皱眉时是“焦躁烦恼”；用两幅动作画面分别记义。

gloss_zh: 抓挠自己；未经邀请而参加

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scratch one's own body, or to join an event without having been invited.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指抓挠自己的身体，也可指未获邀请便自行参加聚会或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħakk lil ġismu stess, jew daħal f'festa jew attività mingħajr stedina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓挠自己；用手抓挠自己发痒的身体部位。

sense_translations.en_definition: to gatecrash (to invite oneself without receiving an invitation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 未经邀请便自行参加；不请自来地加入聚会或活动。

collocations.zh: 他未经邀请参加了一场私人聚会

formal.mt: Wara li gidmitu nemusa, it-tifel ħtekk driegħu u ħalla marka ħamra.
formal.en: After a mosquito bit him, the boy scratched his arm and left a red mark.
formal.zh: 被蚊子叮咬后，男孩抓挠自己的手臂，留下了一道红印。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għandu driegħu aħmar Leo? Sam: Gidmitu nemusa u ħtekk driegħu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is Leo's arm red? Sam: A mosquito bit him, and he scratched his arm.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：利奥的手臂怎么红了？萨姆：蚊子叮了他，他抓了抓手臂。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 利奥的手臂怎么红了？
messages.en: Why is Leo's arm red?

messages.speaker: Sam (父亲)
messages.zh: 蚊子叮了他，他抓了抓手臂。
messages.en: A mosquito bit him, and he scratched his arm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别记住“自己挠痒”和“自己跑去参加聚会”两幅画面；这是帮助区分词义的联想，不代表两个意思的历史来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To need or require something, or to be necessary in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指需要某物、要求具备某种条件，或在特定情况下有必要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kellu bżonn xi ħaġa, talab xi ħaġa bħala kundizzjoni, jew kien meħtieġ f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要；因有所欠缺或为达成目的而须得到某物。
要求；使某物、某种条件或某项行动成为必需。
需要；必须具备某物或满足某种条件。
有必要；在某种情况下为必需。

formal.mt: Il-proġett ħtieġ aktar żmien minħabba l-kumplessità tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The project required more time because of the complexity of the work.
formal.zh: 由于工作复杂，这个项目需要更多时间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dam daqshekk it-tiswija? Mark: Ix-xogħol ħtieġ aktar żmien milli ħsibna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did the repair take so long? Mark: The work needed more time than we thought.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：修理怎么花了这么久？马克：这项工作需要的时间比我们想的多。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 修理怎么花了这么久？
messages.en: Why did the repair take so long?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xogħol ħtieġ aktar żmien milli ħsibna.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xogħol ħtieġ aktar żmien milli ħsibna.
messages.zh: 这项工作需要的时间比我们想的多。
messages.en: The work needed more time than we thought.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“项目需要更多时间”这个完整句子里记忆，重点抓住“需要”这一动词作用，并与名词 ħtieġa 配对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A need for something, or the necessity of having something or taking an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指对某物的需要，或拥有某物、采取某项行动的必要性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bżonn ta' xi ħaġa, jew in-neċessità li wieħed ikollu xi ħaġa jew jagħmel azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要；对某种事物、帮助或条件的需求。
需要；必要性；某事不可缺少或必须进行的性质。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-ħtieġa li jitjiebu s-servizzi tat-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: The report stresses the need to improve public transport services.
formal.zh: 报告强调了改善公共交通服务的必要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm ħtieġa li nixtru aktar ħobż? Toni: Le, għad għandna biżżejjed għal għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there any need to buy more bread? Toni: No, we still have enough for tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有必要再买些面包吗？托尼：不用，我们还有足够明天吃的。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħtieġa li nixtru aktar ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħtieġa li nixtru aktar ħobż?
messages.zh: 有必要再买些面包吗？
messages.en: Is there any need to buy more bread?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għad għandna biżżejjed għal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għad għandna biżżejjed għal għada.
messages.zh: 不用，我们还有足够明天吃的。
messages.en: No, we still have enough for tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“需要”想成清单上的一项需求：水、帮助、交通都可以成为 ħtieġa；再用“有必要做某事”巩固它的名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of suddenly seizing something, or taking a person away by force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然夺走物品的行为，也指强行带走某人的绑架行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jieħu xi ħaġa għal għarrieda, jew jieħu persuna bil-forza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然抢走、夺走物品的行为；抢夺。
绑架；强行带走或扣留某人的行为。
动词 ħataf 的动作名词，表示抢夺、抓走或绑架的行为。
绑架行为；强行掳走某人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' ħtif ta' persuna u l-investigazzjoni li saret wara.
formal.en: The report describes a kidnapping case and the investigation that followed.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起绑架案及随后开展的调查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm il-pulizija ħdejn il-ħanut? Mark: Kien hemm ħtif ta' borża; qed ikellmu lix-xhieda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are the police outside the shop? Mark: There was a bag-snatching; they are talking to the witnesses.
colloquial.zh: Maja：商店旁边为什么有警察？Mark：发生了抢包事件，他们正在询问目击者。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店旁边为什么有警察？
messages.en: Why are the police outside the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħtif ta' borża; qed ikellmu lix-xhieda.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħtif ta' borża; qed ikellmu lix-xhieda.
messages.zh: 发生了抢包事件，他们正在询问目击者。
messages.en: There was a bag-snatching; they are talking to the witnesses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħtif 联想成“突然夺走”的画面：夺走包袋是抢夺，强行带走人是绑架；结合后面的对象记住具体词义。

gloss_zh: 内疚；过错；责备；责任；罪过

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fault or responsibility for something wrong, or the feeling of having done wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对错误或坏事所负的过错与责任，也指因做错事而产生的内疚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-responsabbiltà għal żball jew għal xi ħaġa ħażina, jew is-sentiment li wieħed ikun għamel il-ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内疚、负罪感；也可指有罪的状态。
过错；造成错误或不良结果的责任。
责备；对过错的归责。
责任，尤其指对错误或不良后果所负的责任。
罪过；宗教或道德意义上的过犯。
罪责、过错；因过错而受到的责备。

collocations.en: I put the blame on someone else

formal.mt: Fid-dikjarazzjoni tiegħu, id-direttur ammetta l-ħtija għall-iżball fir-rapport.
formal.en: In his statement, the director admitted fault for the error in the report.
formal.zh: 主任在声明中承认，报告中的错误是他的过错。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Skużani, il-ħtija tiegħi li wasalna tard. Pawlu: Tinkwetax, għad għandna ħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Sorry, it is my fault that we arrived late. Pawlu: Don't worry, we still have time.
colloquial.zh: Lara：对不起，我们迟到是我的错。Pawlu：别担心，我们还有时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, il-ħtija tiegħi li wasalna tard.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, il-ħtija tiegħi li wasalna tard.
messages.zh: 对不起，我们迟到是我的错。
messages.en: Sorry, it is my fault that we arrived late.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 别担心，我们还有时间。
messages.en: Don't worry, we still have time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这是谁的错？”串起 ħtija 的词义：事情上的过错、承担的罪责，以及心里产生的内疚，都围绕做错事展开。

gloss_zh: 待人热忱；热情；北非灼热风；寒风引起的嘴唇皲裂

teaching_sense.en_definition: Warmth in a person's manner, or strong enthusiasm and fervor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 待人接物时表现出的热忱，或对某事怀有的强烈热情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sħana fl-imġiba lejn ħaddieħor, jew entużjażmu u ħeġġa qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 待人接物时的热忱、亲切与温暖。
热情；热忱；强烈而投入的情感。

sense_translations.en_definition: a scorching wind from North Africa, often carrying sand
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自北非的灼热风，常夹带沙尘。

sense_translations.en_definition: chapping of lips because of cold winds
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因寒风吹袭而出现的嘴唇干裂、皲裂。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, irringrazzjat lill-familja għall-ħtrieq li bih laqgħuha f'darhom.
formal.en: In her letter, she thanked the family for the warmth with which they welcomed her into their home.
formal.zh: 她在信中感谢这家人热情地接待她到家中做客。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi ħtrieq fix-xufftejn wara dik il-mixja fir-riħ kiesaħ. Anna: Jien ukoll; xofftejja nixfu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: My lips are chapped after that walk in the cold wind. Anna: Mine too; my lips have become very dry.
colloquial.zh: Marija：在寒风里走了那一趟，我的嘴唇都皲裂了。Anna：我也是，嘴唇变得特别干。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħtrieq fix-xufftejn wara dik il-mixja fir-riħ kiesaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħtrieq fix-xufftejn wara dik il-mixja fir-riħ kiesaħ.
messages.zh: 在寒风里走了那一趟，我的嘴唇都皲裂了。
messages.en: My lips are chapped after that walk in the cold wind.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也是，嘴唇变得特别干。
messages.en: Mine too; my lips have become very dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ħtrieq 做四格记忆卡：亲切迎客、满怀热情、北非热风、寒风裂唇。四幅图分别记义，不把它们当成词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male sibling: someone's brother, whether older or younger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性手足，即某人的哥哥或弟弟；本身不区分年长或年幼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna maskili li għandha mill-inqas ġenitur wieħed komuni ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兄弟；哥哥或弟弟。
男性手足；与某人有共同父亲或母亲的哥哥或弟弟。

formal.mt: Ħu Marija se jirrappreżenta lill-familja waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: Marija's brother will represent the family at the ceremony.
formal.zh: Marija 的兄弟将在典礼上代表家人出席。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Dak ħu Lara; ġie jiġborha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that by the door? Mark: That is Lara's brother; he has come to pick her up.
colloquial.zh: Maja：门边那个人是谁？Mark：那是 Lara 的兄弟，他来接她。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 门边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 那是 Lara 的兄弟，他来接她。
messages.en: That is Lara's brother; he has come to pick her up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħu 放进家庭合照记忆：ħu Marija 就是 Marija 的男性手足。中文要选哥哥还是弟弟，须看实际年龄。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stinging nettle, Urtica dioica, a plant with hairs that sting when touched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺荨麻，即异株荨麻（Urtica dioica），其表面的刺毛接触皮肤时会引起刺痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta, Urtica dioica, b'xagħar fin li jniggeż il-ġilda meta jintmess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺荨麻；带有能使皮肤产生刺痛感的刺毛的荨麻植物。
异株荨麻，学名 Urtica dioica。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-ġnien, l-istudenti identifikaw il-ħurrieq li kien qed jikber ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: While observing the garden, the students identified the nettles growing beside the wall.
formal.zh: 学生们观察花园时，辨认出了长在墙边的荨麻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-pjanta ħdejn il-ħajt? Nannu: Dak ħurrieq; oqgħod attenta, għax iniggeż.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that plant beside the wall? Grandfather: That is stinging nettle; be careful, because it stings.
colloquial.zh: Lara：墙边那是什么植物？爷爷：那是刺荨麻，小心，它会蜇人。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 墙边那是什么植物？
messages.en: What is that plant beside the wall?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħurrieq; oqgħod attenta, għax iniggeż.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħurrieq; oqgħod attenta, għax iniggeż.
messages.zh: 那是刺荨麻，小心，它会蜇人。
messages.en: That is stinging nettle; be careful, because it stings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ħurrieq 配一张荨麻叶和手指缩回的记忆图：看起来是绿叶，碰到却会刺痛，用这个触觉场景记住刺荨麻。

gloss_zh: 临终喉鸣；呼吸时喉中痰鸣

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rattling sound in the throat during breathing when mucus is not fully cleared, including such a sound near death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼吸时因黏液未完全清除而在喉部产生的痰鸣声，也可指临终时出现的喉鸣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss fil-griżmejn waqt in-nifs meta l-mukus ma jkunx tneħħa kollu, li jista' jinstema' wkoll qrib il-mewt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 临终喉鸣；人在临终时呼吸产生的喉部痰鸣声。

sense_translations.en_definition: rattle (sound made in the throat whilst breathing when mucus is not fully cleared)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 痰鸣声；呼吸时因黏液未完全清除而在喉部发出的响声。

collocations.en: a rattling sound can be heard

formal.mt: Fin-nota tal-osservazzjoni, l-infermiera semmiet ħurħara li kienet tinstema' waqt in-nifs tal-pazjent.
formal.en: In the observation note, the nurse mentioned a rattling sound audible as the patient breathed.
formal.zh: 护士在观察记录中提到，病人呼吸时可以听见痰鸣声。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed tisma' dik il-ħurħara fil-griżmejn tiegħu? Pawlu: Iva, se nsejjaħ lill-infermiera.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you hear that rattling in his throat? Pawlu: Yes, I will call the nurse.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你听见他喉咙里的痰鸣声了吗？Pawlu：听见了，我去叫护士。

messages.speaker: Marija (病人家属)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dik il-ħurħara fil-griżmejn tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dik il-ħurħara fil-griżmejn tiegħu?
messages.zh: 你听见他喉咙里的痰鸣声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that rattling in his throat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (病人家属)
messages.zh: 听见了，我去叫护士。
messages.en: Yes, I will call the nurse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħurħara 与“呼吸时喉中呼噜响”的听觉画面配对。先记一般痰鸣，再用 tal-mewt 记住临终喉鸣这一义项。

gloss_zh: 媒人；婚姻介绍人；经纪人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who arranges introductions between potential marriage partners; also a broker who brings parties together for a deal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为可能结婚的双方牵线介绍的媒人，也可指促成交易的经纪人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tlaqqa' nies bil-ħsieb taż-żwieġ, jew li tlaqqa' partijiet biex isir ftehim kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 媒人；为婚姻双方牵线介绍的人。
经纪人；在交易双方之间牵线并促成交易的中间人。
职业媒人；以婚姻介绍为业的人。

collocations.en: he works as a matchmaker or broker
collocations.zh: 他从事媒人或经纪人的工作

formal.mt: Il-ħuttab laqqa' lix-xerrej mal-bejjiegħ biex jiddiskutu l-kundizzjonijiet tal-bejgħ.
formal.en: The broker brought the buyer and seller together to discuss the terms of the sale.
formal.zh: 经纪人安排买卖双方会面，商讨交易条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min laqqa' lil Anna ma' Pawlu? Mark: Iz-ziju tiegħi; dejjem jagħmilha ta' ħuttab fil-familja!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who introduced Anna to Pawlu? Mark: My uncle; he is always playing matchmaker in the family!
colloquial.zh: Maja：是谁介绍 Anna 和 Pawlu 认识的？Mark：我叔叔，他总在家里当媒人！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min laqqa' lil Anna ma' Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Min laqqa' lil Anna ma' Pawlu?
messages.zh: 是谁介绍 Anna 和 Pawlu 认识的？
messages.en: Who introduced Anna to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-ziju tiegħi; dejjem jagħmilha ta' ħuttab fil-familja!
messages.mt_standard: Iz-ziju tiegħi; dejjem jagħmilha ta' ħuttab fil-familja!
messages.zh: 我叔叔，他总在家里当媒人！
messages.en: My uncle; he is always playing matchmaker in the family!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħuttab 想成站在两人中间牵线的人：牵起婚姻是媒人，促成买卖是经纪人。用两个场景分别巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Swallows: birds referred to individually or as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燕子；可用于谈论这种鸟，也可指一群燕子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasafar magħrufa bħala ħuttaf, meqjusa bħala tip ta' għasfur jew bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燕子。
燕子，一种鸟。
燕子群；多只燕子。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw qatgħa ħuttaf itiru fuq l-għalqa u kitbu dwarhom.
formal.en: The students observed a flock of swallows flying over the field and wrote about them.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一群在田野上空飞翔的燕子，并写下了观察记录。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhuma dawk l-għasafar fuq l-għalqa? Pawlu: Dawk ħuttaf. Ara kemm qed itiru flimkien!
colloquial.en: Lara: What are those birds over the field? Pawlu: Those are swallows. Look how many are flying together!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：田野上空那些是什么鸟？保罗：那些是燕子。看，有这么多一起飞！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 田野上空那些是什么鸟？
messages.en: What are those birds over the field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk ħuttaf. Ara kemm qed itiru flimkien!
messages.mt_standard: Dawk ħuttaf. Ara kemm qed itiru flimkien!
messages.zh: 那些是燕子。看，有这么多一起飞！
messages.en: Those are swallows. Look how many are flying together!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħuttaf 和田野上空一群飞翔的燕子连在一起记；用 qatgħa ħuttaf 练习表达“一群燕子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dry grass or hay; figuratively, a person considered useless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 晒干的草或干草；比喻用法中可贬指一个无用的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix niexef, spiss għall-għalf tal-annimali; b'mod figurattiv, persuna meqjusa bla siwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干草；已经干燥的草。

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who is no good
sense_translations.zh_definition: 无用的人；不中用的人，带贬义。
干草，尤指用作动物饲料的干草。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħażen il-ħuxlief f'post niexef biex ikollu għalf għall-annimali.
formal.en: The farmer stored the hay in a dry place so that he would have feed for the animals.
formal.zh: 农民把干草储存在干燥的地方，以备喂养动物。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn inpoġġi din il-balla ħuxlief? Ġużeppi: Poġġiha fil-maħżen, ħdejn l-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where shall I put this bale of hay? Ġużeppi: Put it in the storeroom, next to the others.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这捆干草放在哪里？朱塞佩：放到储藏室里，挨着其他几捆。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 这捆干草放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put this bale of hay?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.zh: 放到储藏室里，挨着其他几捆。
messages.en: Put it in the storeroom, next to the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仓库里一捆捆喂动物的干草，用 balla ħuxlief 记住实物义；指人时另记为带贬义的“不中用的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large outdoor fire made by burning a pile of wood or other material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在户外把木柴等材料堆在一起燃烧形成的大火，通常称为篝火。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nar kbir fil-beraħ magħmul minn munzell injam jew materjal ieħor li jinħaraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 篝火；由堆积的木柴等燃起的露天大火。

formal.mt: Matul il-festa, in-nies inġabru madwar il-ħuġġieġa u kantaw flimkien.
formal.en: During the celebration, people gathered around the bonfire and sang together.
formal.zh: 庆祝活动期间，人们聚在篝火周围，一起唱歌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se noqogħdu? Ben: Hawn, ħdejn il-ħuġġieġa; hawn aktar sħun.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we sit? Ben: Here, near the bonfire; it is warmer here.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们坐哪里？Ben：这里，靠近篝火，这边更暖和。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we sit?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, ħdejn il-ħuġġieġa; hawn aktar sħun.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, ħdejn il-ħuġġieġa; hawn aktar sħun.
messages.zh: 这里，靠近篝火，这边更暖和。
messages.en: Here, near the bonfire; it is warmer here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ħuġġieġa 时想象一群朋友围着户外柴堆火唱歌：把“堆起木柴、点火、围坐”连成一幅篝火画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Herbs, spices, or other seasoning used to give food flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于给食物增添风味的香草、香料或调味料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħxejjex aromatiċi jew ħwawar li jintużaw biex jagħtu t-togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香草；用于调味的草本植物。
调味料；用于增添食物风味的材料。
香料和香草。
香料；香草，即用于调味的植物。

collocations.en: a blend of herbs and spices

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob taħlita ta' ħwar li tiżdied mas-soppa lejn tmiem it-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a blend of herbs and spices to be added to the soup near the end of cooking.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在烹煮接近结束时，向汤中加入混合香草香料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'żidt mas-soppa biex tajtha din it-togħma? Toni: Żidt ftit ħwar. Trid idduqha?
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you add to the soup to give it this flavour? Toni: I added a little seasoning. Would you like to taste it?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你往汤里加了什么，让它有这个味道？托尼：我加了一点调味料。你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'żidt mas-soppa biex tajtha din it-togħma?
messages.mt_standard: X'żidt mas-soppa biex tajtha din it-togħma?
messages.zh: 你往汤里加了什么，让它有这个味道？
messages.en: What did you add to the soup to give it this flavour?

messages.speaker: Toni (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 我加了一点调味料。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: I added a little seasoning. Would you like to taste it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħwar 放进“汤里加一点香草香料”的画面中记忆；先抓住增添风味的共同用途，再区分香草和香料。

gloss_zh: 变得不育或贫瘠；贫瘠；休耕状态；不育

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sterile or barren, losing the ability to reproduce or produce growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得不育或贫瘠，失去繁殖能力或生长产出的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir sterili jew bla ħila li jipproduċi; meta jingħad dwar art, ma tibqax tagħti frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得不育；丧失生殖能力，或变得不能生长产出。
贫瘠；不结果实或不能生育的状态。
休耕状态；土地暂不耕种的状态。
不育；缺乏生殖或生长产出能力的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif ir-raba' ħwiel u ma baqax jagħti frott.
formal.en: The report describes how the farmland became barren and stopped yielding produce.
formal.zh: 报告描述了农田如何变得贫瘠，并不再产出作物。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dan ir-raba' m'għadux jagħti frott? Pawlu: Ħwiel. Irridu naraw kif nistgħu ntejbu l-ħamrija.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is this farmland no longer yielding produce? Pawlu: It has become barren. We need to see how we can improve the soil.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这片农田为什么不再产出作物了？保罗：它变贫瘠了。我们得看看怎样改善土壤。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan ir-raba' m'għadux jagħti frott?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan ir-raba' m'għadux jagħti frott?
messages.zh: 这片农田为什么不再产出作物了？
messages.en: Why is this farmland no longer yielding produce?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħwiel. Irridu naraw kif nistgħu ntejbu l-ħamrija.
messages.mt_standard: Ħwiel. Irridu naraw kif nistgħu ntejbu l-ħamrija.
messages.zh: 它变贫瘠了。我们得看看怎样改善土壤。
messages.en: It has become barren. We need to see how we can improve the soil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“田地变得不再产出”记动词 ħwiel；名词另分贫瘠、不育和休耕三张卡，休耕本身不等于失去生产能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become fat or gain weight; also to swell, or for a voice to become deeper or throaty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长胖或增加体重；也可指肿胀，或嗓音变得低沉、带喉音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fil-piż jew isir aktar oħxon; jista' jfisser ukoll jintefaħ, jew li l-leħen isir aktar baxx jew gerżumi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长胖；变得肥胖。
肿胀；膨胀。

sense_translations.en_definition: to deepen or become throaty (used of sb.'s voice)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得低沉或带喉音，用于描述某人的嗓音。

sense_translations.en_definition: to gain weight, to become fat
sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加体重；长胖。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-karattru jinnota li leħnu ħxien meta jisma' reġistrazzjoni tiegħu nnifsu.
formal.en: In the story, the character notices that his voice has become deeper when he listens to a recording of himself.
formal.zh: 故事中的人物听自己的录音时，发现自己的嗓音变低沉了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan int fir-reġistrazzjoni? Leħnek differenti! Mark: Iva, leħni ħxien. Dik ir-reġistrazzjoni antika.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that you in the recording? Your voice sounds different! Mark: Yes, my voice has become deeper. That recording is old.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：录音里是你吗？你的声音不一样！马克：是啊，我的嗓音变低沉了。那是以前的录音。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 录音里是你吗？你的声音不一样！
messages.en: Is that you in the recording? Your voice sounds different!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, leħni ħxien. Dik ir-reġistrazzjoni antika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, leħni ħxien. Dik ir-reġistrazzjoni antika.
messages.zh: 是啊，我的嗓音变低沉了。那是以前的录音。
messages.en: Yes, my voice has become deeper. That recording is old.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅变化图记 ħxien：身体长胖、部位肿起、声音变低沉；看到主语后再判断是哪一种变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The thickness of something, or fat and the state of being fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体的厚度；也可指脂肪或身体肥胖的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' kemm hi ħoxna xi ħaġa; ukoll xaħam jew il-qagħda ta' min hu oħxon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厚度；厚的程度。
脂肪；肥肉。
肥胖；厚度或厚实程度。

formal.mt: Il-ħxuna tal-ħġieġ għandha titkejjel qabel ma jiġi installat fit-tieqa.
formal.en: The thickness of the glass should be measured before it is installed in the window.
formal.zh: 玻璃安装到窗户上之前，应先测量其厚度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema karta nagħżlu għall-kartolina? Ben: Din. Il-ħxuna tagħha tajba u ma titgħawwiġx faċilment.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which paper shall we choose for the card? Ben: This one. It has a good thickness and does not bend easily.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：做贺卡我们选哪种纸？本：这种。它的厚度合适，不容易弯折。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 做贺卡我们选哪种纸？
messages.en: Which paper shall we choose for the card?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din. Il-ħxuna tagħha tajba u ma titgħawwiġx faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Din. Il-ħxuna tagħha tajba u ma titgħawwiġx faċilment.
messages.zh: 这种。它的厚度合适，不容易弯折。
messages.en: This one. It has a good thickness and does not bend easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħxuna 和尺子测量墙壁、纸张厚度的画面相连；遇到身体或食物语境，再联想到肥胖或脂肪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Body fat or the state of carrying excessive weight; also fatness or thickness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体脂肪或体重过重的状态；也可表示肥胖或厚实程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xaħam tal-ġisem jew il-qagħda ta' min għandu piż żejjed; ukoll il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa ħoxna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体脂；身体中的脂肪。
体重过重；过多的体重。
肥胖；厚度或厚实程度。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jispjega t-terminu ħxunija bħala xaħam tal-ġisem jew piż żejjed, skont il-kuntest.
formal.en: The article explains the term ħxunija as body fat or excessive weight, depending on the context.
formal.zh: 文章说明，ħxunija 根据语境可以表示身体脂肪或体重过重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser ħxunija f'din is-sentenza? Rita: Hawn tfisser ix-xaħam tal-ġisem. Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does ħxunija mean in this sentence? Rita: Here it means body fat. Let's read the whole sentence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 ħxunija 是什么意思？丽塔：这里指身体脂肪。我们把整句话读一遍吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 ħxunija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ħxunija mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser ix-xaħam tal-ġisem. Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser ix-xaħam tal-ġisem. Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha.
messages.zh: 这里指身体脂肪。我们把整句话读一遍吧。
messages.en: Here it means body fat. Let's read the whole sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用 il-ħxunija tal-ġisem 记“体脂”，再用 ħxunija żejda 记“过多体脂”；体脂与体重过重要按语境分别理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hard, usually transparent material used to make windows, bottles, and similar objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通常透明的坚硬材料，用来制作窗玻璃、瓶子等物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal iebes, ġeneralment trasparenti, li jintuża biex isiru twieqi, fliexken u oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玻璃；通常透明、坚硬且易碎的材料。

formal.mt: Il-fliexken tal-ħġieġ għandhom jitqiegħdu fil-kontenitur apposta għar-riċiklaġġ.
formal.en: Glass bottles should be placed in the designated recycling container.
formal.zh: 玻璃瓶应放入指定的回收容器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-vażett tal-ħġieġ? Pawlu: Iva, oqgħod attenta biex ma twaqqgħux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this jar made of glass? Pawlu: Yes, be careful not to drop it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个罐子是玻璃做的吗？保罗：是的，小心别把它掉到地上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个罐子是玻璃做的吗？
messages.en: Is this jar made of glass?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, oqgħod attenta biex ma twaqqgħux.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, oqgħod attenta biex ma twaqqgħux.
messages.zh: 是的，小心别把它掉到地上。
messages.en: Yes, be careful not to drop it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象透明玻璃瓶和地上的碎玻璃，把 ħġieġ 牢牢记作材料“玻璃”，连同 tal-ħġieġ“玻璃制的”一起学。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A belt or band around the waist, a waistband, or a girth; also the waist itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在腰间的带子、衣物的腰头或马具的肚带；也可指腰部本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċinturin jew faxxa madwar il-qadd, il-parti ta' fuq ta' qalziet jew dublett li ddur mal-qadd, jew faxxa li żżomm is-sarġ; ukoll il-qadd innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 束腰带；围在腰间的带子。
腰头；裤子或裙子腰部的带状部分。
肚带；绕过马等动物腹部、用于固定鞍具的带子。
腰；身体的腰部。
束腰带；固定鞍具的肚带；腰带。

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat se jwessa' l-ħżiem tal-qalziet biex ikun aktar komdu għall-klijent.
formal.en: The tailor will widen the waistband of the trousers to make it more comfortable for the customer.
formal.zh: 裁缝会把裤子的腰头放宽，让顾客穿着更舒服。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-ħżiem ta' dan il-qalziet issikkat wisq. Tista' twessgħu ftit? Rita: Iva, ejja nkejlu kemm hemm bżonn.
colloquial.en: Mark: The waistband of these trousers is too tight. Can you widen it a little? Rita: Yes, let's measure how much is needed.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条裤子的腰头太紧了。你能稍微放宽一点吗？丽塔：可以，我们量量需要放宽多少。

gloss_zh: 变坏；腐败；恶化；变得狡猾

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become bad or deteriorate, as food, conditions, or a person's conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变坏或恶化，可指食物变质、情况变糟，也可指人的品行败坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ħażin jew agħar, bħal ikel li jitħassar, qagħda li tmur lura jew imġiba li ssir ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变质；坏掉，尤指食物。
变得腐败；品行败坏。
恶化；状况变差。
变得狡猾或世故。
变坏；变得不好。
变得狡猾。

formal.mt: Il-ħalib ħżien minħabba li ma nżammx fil-friġġ.
formal.en: The milk went bad because it was not kept in the refrigerator.
formal.zh: 牛奶由于没有冷藏而变质了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistax nixrob dan il-ħalib? Lara: Għax ħżien. Ħu l-ħalib mill-flixkun l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't I drink this milk? Lara: Because it has gone bad. Take the milk from the other bottle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我不能喝这瓶牛奶？拉拉：因为它变质了。喝另一瓶里的牛奶吧。
